steps: 1. You can also use sugar snap peas for this recipe. Save prep time by prepping the peas, ginger, and garlic while the shrimp is marinating.
2. Marinate the shrimp:
3. Mix all marinade ingredients in a large bowl, then add the shrimp. Toss to coat. Let sit for 15 to 20 minutes while you prep the peas, ginger, and garlic.
4. Stir-fry the ginger and garlic:
5. Heat a wok or large sauté pan over high heat for 1 minute. Add the peanut oil and let it get hot, about 30 seconds. Add the ginger and garlic and toss to combine. Stir-fry for about 30 seconds.
6. Add the shrimp, snow peas, soy sauce, stock:

7. Add the shrimp and all the marinade to the pan (scrape out all the marinade with a rubber spatula). Add the snow peas, soy sauce and chicken stock. Stir-fry until the shrimp turns pink, about 2 minutes.
8. Add the scallions and finish with sesame oil:
9. Add the scallions and stir-fry 1 more minute. Turn off the heat and add the sesame oil. Toss to combine once more and serve with steamed rice.
title: Shrimp With Snow Peas

steps: 1. Combine the sake or rice wine, soy sauce, sesame oil and cornflour dissolved in water. Divide mixture in half.
2. In a glass dish or bowl, combine half of the sake mixture with the chicken pieces and toss to coat. Cover dish and place in refrigerator for about 30 minutes.

3. In a medium frying pan, combine remaining sake mixture, chillies, vinegar and sugar. Mix together and add spring onion, garlic, water chestnuts and peanuts. Heat sauce slowly over medium heat until aromatic.
4. Meanwhile, remove chicken from marinade and sauté in a large frying pan until juices run clear. When sauce is aromatic, add sautéed chicken and let simmer together until sauce thickens.
title: Kung Pao Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 large tomatoes, peeled and cut in 1-inch cubes
1 lb. sirloin, cut in diagonal thin pieces

steps: 1. Pour soy sauce and sugar over meat.
2. Marinate for 1/2 hour. Heat oil in skillet.
3. Add ginger and garlic; cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
4. Discard garlic.
5. Add meat and liquid.
6. Saute about 5 minutes.
7. Add tomatoes, pepper and cornstarch, blended with water. Cook gently, about 5 minutes.
8. Serve over plain rice.
9. Serves 4.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Mix first 5 ingredients and add next 4 ingredients.
2. Using a 9 x 9-inch pan, bake in 350° oven for about 45 minutes.
3. Top with Cool Whip.
4. Serves 9.
title: Apple Chop Suey

steps: 1. Dip chicken pieces into mixture of eggs and orange juice, then into mixture of bread crumbs, salt, paprika and shredded peel. Melt butter in large shallow baking pan in 400° oven.
2. Remove pan from oven.
3. Turn chicken in butter to coat.
4. Arrange skin side down (don't crowd).
5. Bake 30 minutes.
6. Yumm!
7. Serves 6.
title: Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Combine the first 7 ingredients.
2. Heat corn oil in skillet; add shrimp and cook for about 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add sauce and remaining ingredients.
3. Boil for 1 minute, stirring gently.
4. Serve over rice.
5. Serves 4.
title: Peking Shrimp

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb. lean pork, cut into 1/2-inch cubes

steps: 1. Combine pork and 2 tablespoons soy sauce; refrigerate for 30 minutes.
2. Combine remaining 2 tablespoons soy sauce, lemon juice, cornstarch, crushed red pepper and 1/4 cup water.
3. In wok or large skillet, stir-fry pork and garlic in hot oil for 3 minutes or until brown.
4. Add red pepper and onion.
5. Stir-fry for 3 minutes.
6. Add cornstarch mixture; cook and stir until slightly thickened.
7. Add peanuts.
8. Serves 4.
title: Kung Pao Pork

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup margarine, butter, oil, or chicken fat

steps: 1. Bring to a boil the 2 cups water and salt.
2. Add rice and let water return to a boil.
3. Lower heat to simmer and cook 14 minutes. Meanwhile, saute diced onion, celery, and green pepper in fat until tender.
4. Combine sauteed vegetables with cooked rice.
5. Add the remaining ingredients.
6. Place in a greased 2-quart capacity baking dish.
7. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 20-30 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
8. Serves 4.
title: Cashew Chicken-Licken

ingredients.text: 1 large yellow onion, sliced razor thin
1 green pepper, cut in thin julienne strips

steps: 1. Heat oil in a deep skillet.
2. Cook garlic and onions 2 to 3 minutes.
3. Add celery, zucchini, cabbage, carrots and green pepper. Cook 2 or 3 minutes and add mushrooms, water chestnuts and soy sauce.
4. Stir and cook for 3 or 4 minutes.
5. Crunchy and good with any meat.
6. Serves 6.
title: Chinese Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 large green pepper, cut into strips

steps: 1. Heat electric wok or skillet at 325° for 2 to 3 minutes.
2. Add oil and heat for 2 minutes.
3. Add celery, green pepper and onion. Stir-fry 2 minutes.
4. Add zucchini and stir-fry 5 minutes or until crisp-tender.
5. Stir in parsley and seasonings.
6. Serve immediately. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Zucchini Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 bunch green onions, cut in 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Cut chicken in 1 1/2-inch cubes.
2. Toss in cornstarch.
3. Heat oil and add chicken and garlic.
4. Stir-fry until browned.
5. Add soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and water.
6. Cover and cook 3 minutes.
7. Add green onions and cayenne and heat 2 minutes.
8. Serve over rice. Makes 4 servings at 221 calories each.
title: 10 Minute Szechuan Chicken

steps: 1. Slice steak into very thin strips diagonally.
2. Combine cornstarch, sugar and ginger; stir in soy sauce.
3. Pour mixture over meat; stir.
4. Cut peppers into thin strips and tomatoes into wedges.
5. Quickly brown meat, one third at a time, in hot oil; remove from pan.
6. Reduce heat; add peppers, garlic and water to pan and cook until peppers are tender-crisp, 5 to 6 minutes.
7. Stir in meat and tomatoes; heat through.
8. Makes 4 servings.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Heat electric wok or skillet at 325° for 2 to 3 minutes; add oil and heat 1 minute.
2. Add celery, onion and broccoli; stir-fry 2 minutes.
3. Add cabbages and stir-fry 3 minutes.
4. Cover and cook vegetables over low heat 3 minutes.
5. Stir in salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce.
6. Serve immediately.
7. Serves 6.
title: Stir-Fry Medley

steps: 1. In a little oil, brown both sides of chops.
2. Place in shallow casserole, do not overlap.
3. Mix remaining ingredients, except sesame seed.
4. Pour over chops. Sprinkle sesame seed over. Cover tightly (foil may be used). Bake at 325° for about 1 hour until tender. Serve with rice.
5. Serves 6.
title: Chinese Pork Chops

steps: 1. Mix ingredients and marinate chicken.
2. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes if bone-in or 30 minutes if boneless.
3. Baste while baking. Serves 4 to 6.

6. Place lemon slices on chicken.
7. Heat to boiling; reduce heat.
8. Cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is done.

12. Sprinkle with green onions.
13. Makes 4 servings; 190 calories, 9g fat.
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Combine soy sauce, water, sugar, onions, vinegar, garlic and ginger.
2. Add beef to marinade and refrigerate for 2 hours.
3. Heat oil in wok.
4. Add mushrooms and saute 2 minutes.
5. Add cabbage and saute 5 minutes.
6. Add beef and marinade.
7. Stir-fry 5 minutes.
8. Add bean sprouts and water chestnuts.
9. Stir-fry 5 minutes.
10. Makes 6 servings.

9. Add beef and stir until warmed through.

13. Serve at once.

15. 6 servings.

8. Serve with rice.
9. Serves 4.

2. Slice broccoli stalks into thin rounds, about 1/8-inch thick.

1 large green pepper, cut in strips

2. Push meat to side of skillet.
3. Add mushrooms, pepper, zucchini, celery, carrots, garlic and onion.

steps: 1. In a large broiling pan, place chicken, garlic, cut-up wedges of potatoes and olive oil and bake until brown.
2. Add lemon juice, water, parsley, then salt and pepper to taste.
3. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together. Shape into 8 patties.

title: Burgers 'N Sprouts

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts, cut into bite sized pieces
2 small zucchini, cut into bite sized pieces

steps: 1. Heat oil and pepper flakes in skillet over medium high heat.
2. Add chicken and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, until no longer pink. Stir frequently.
3. Add remaining ingredients, stirring frequently until vegetables are cooked.
4. Serve with brown rice.

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the butter, chives, parsley, salt and pepper. Shape into a 6x2-in. rectangle; place on waxed paper. Freeze until firm, about 30 minutes.

4. Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 35-40 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Discard toothpicks.
title: Orange Chicken Kiev

steps: 1. 1st cook the chicken thoroughly in a large frying pan, then add the chopped onion into the pan. next add, the carrots add olive oil cook all until vegetables are browned. Serve will soy sauce!
title: Fancy Stir Fry

steps: 1. Marinate 8 to 10 pork chops in sauce overnight.
2. Place pork chops in shallow roasting pan and pour sauce over them.
3. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.
4. Serve over hot buttered rice.
title: Chinese Pork Chops

steps: 1. Wash chicken; pat dry.
2. Place chicken in roasting pan; squeeze lemons over chicken.
3. Add onion and sprinkle garlic powder, pepper, salt and parsley.
4. Cover with aluminum foil.
5. Refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake at 350° with cover for 1/2 hour.
7. Remove cover and cook for another 1/2 hour or until tender.
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. In wok, melt margarine; mix in soy and teriyaki sauce.
2. Stir in chicken.
3. Cover and cook until tender.
4. Take up chicken and set aside.
5. Put in all of the vegetables (cut in bite size pieces). Stir very well.
6. Cover and let cook until tender-crisp.
7. Serve chicken and vegetables over rice.
title: Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Shake chicken in bag with flour, salt and pepper.
2. Save leftover flour.

6. Add broth and 2 tablespoons lemon juice and thyme.
7. Bring mixture to boil, stirring.
8. Return chicken to pan; reduce heat and cover.
9. Simmer until chicken is done.
10. Put chicken on a plate.
11. Stir remaining 1 tablespoon lemon juice into skillet and pour over chicken.

title: Lemon Chicken With Thyme

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400. Coat a large baking dish or cast iron skillet with 1 teaspoon of the olive oil. Arrange the lemon slices in a single layer in the bottom of the dish or skillet.
2. In a large bowl, combine the remaining oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper. Add the chicken, green beans and potatoes and toss to coat.

1 red bell pepper, cut in strips

3. Heat oil in frying pan.

title: Green Bean And Red Bell Pepper Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breasts, sliced into 1/2 inch strips (thawed, if using frozen)

4 cups mixed vegetables, cut up (I used sweet onion, orange pepper, and broccoli)

steps: 1. To make the sauce, in a bowl mix honey, apple cider vinegar, orange juice, soy sauce, and cornstarch. Set aside.

6. Serve over rice.

steps: 1. Place ingredients in saucepan. Boil, stirring from time to time making sure the chicken is turned over in sauce. Boil until chicken is tender (water may be added if it starts to go dry).

steps: 1. Marinate chicken breasts several hours in sauce.
2. Bake in marinade for 1 hour at 350°.

2. add egg, salt, pepper, and 1 tablespoon vegetable oil and mix well.
3. stir flour and cornstarch together.

steps: 1. This is a very crucial ingredient and can't be omitted/substituted. With a cheese grater, grate an orange peel. Mine is a cheap dollar store one and it's easier grating the skin while still attached to the whole orange. About 1/2 teaspoons I'll go up to 1 tsp at times.
2. Add baking soda to beef.

3. Add the beaten egg to the mixture. An alternative to the egg is pick up beef in hand and form into a large ball. Then throw the beef with some force into a large bowl. Repeat 10 - 15 times. The egg or throwing makes the beef less crumbly when cooked. I use the egg trick.

7. Form beef balls of about 2 tablespoons of beef with your spoon.
8. Place beef balls on a medium plate, or whatever size plate fits in your steamer. If you're using small dishes, the beef can be steamed in batches.
9. Steam on high heat for 8 minutes after water has come to a boil.
10. Serve with a soy/maggi sauce mixture.

title: Chinese Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/2 to 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
3/4 pound pork tenderloin, cut into 2-inch strips

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine the soy sauce, honey, ginger and pepper flakes. Place 3 tablespoons in a large bowl; add the pork and turn to coat. Cover; refrigerate for 1 hour. Cover and refrigerate remaining marinade.
2. Combine the cornstarch, orange juice, vinegar and reserved marinade; stir until blended and set aside. Drain and discard marinade from pork. In a
3. or wok, stir-fry pork in oil for 4-5 minutes or until no longer pink. Remove pork and keep warm.

4. In the same pan, stir-fry snow peas for 2-3 minutes or until crisp-tender. Stir in garlic and orange zest. Stir cornstarch mixture and stir into pan. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 1-2 minutes or until thickened. Return pork to the pan; heat through.
title: Pork ‘N’ Pea Pod Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 large chicken breasts, boned and cut in 2 inch pieces or 6 chicken thighs, bone in

steps: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in heavy pot over high heat, about 30 seconds. Add garlic; fry until brown. Add onions; stir fry 3 minutes. Remove onions and set aside.

2. Heat remaining oil in pot. Add chicken and curry powder. Stir fry 3 minutes. Add sugar, salt, soy sauce and water. Mix in potatoes (or you can add it carrots too). Bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer 20 minutes.
3. Mix in onions. Cover and simmer 10 minutes longer. Stir cornstarch and water mixture into chicken. Boil 1 minute or until thick.
title: Chinese Chicken Curry

steps: 1. Sift together dry ingredients and add dates and nuts.
2. Spread in well-greased 8-inch square pan and bake for 40 minutes at 350°. Score into 1-inch squares while warm.
title: Sugar-Free Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Slice zucchini and squash into 1/8-inch rounds.
2. Chop tomatoes.
3. Slice onion and separate into rings.
4. Heat the olive oil in a hot wok.
5. Add onion, zucchini and squash.
6. Cook until tender.
7. Add tomatoes and oregano.
8. Add salt and pepper to taste.
9. Stir until tomatoes are warm.
10. Pour into microwave-safe dish.
11. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and microwave on low until cheese begins to melt.
title: Summer Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Mix egg and the 1 teaspoons water. Add chicken and turn to coat.

2. Heat oven to 425 degrees. Spray a baking sheet that has a lip with Pam. In plastic bag mix flour, baking soda and cayenne. Remove chicken from egg and shake in flour bag one at a time and put on baking sheet. Spray chicken with cooking spray to moisten.
3. Bake uncovered 20 to 25 minutes until done.

4. While baking, make the sauce. In small saucepan combine the sugar, chicken broth, lemon peel, lemon juice, corn syrup, vinegar, salt, and garlic. Bring to boil. In small bowl, mix cornstarch and the 2 teaspoons water. Add to sauce and stir to thicken. Serve with chicken.
title: Baked Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 cups bean sprouts, rinsed and dried

steps: 1. In a wok or large heat 1 1/2 tablespoons oil over high heat; add sprouts and cook, stirring quickly and frequently, until lightly browned and tender, 1 to 2 minutes. transfer sprouts to plate and keep warm.
2. To same wok add remaining oil and heat for 30 seconds to 1 minute; add chicken, garlic, carrots and ginger and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
3. Add scallions and continue stir-frying until chicken is tender and browned on all sides, 2 to 3 minutes longer.
4. Add soy sauce (to taste) and honey and mix well; cook, stirring constantly for 1 minute longer.
5. Top warm sprouts with chicken mixture.
title: Chicken And Sprouts Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1 bunch green onions, sliced into 1 inch pieces
8 oz broccoli florets, blanched in boiling water for 1-2 mins, drained
8 oz rice noodles, softened in boiling water for 2-3 mins, drained

steps: 1. Heat oil in a wok or frying pan. Add pork and stir-fry for 8 mins. Add pepper, cumin, garlic, green onions and sesame oil. Stir-fry for 2-3 mins. Add broccoli, chili sauce, soy sauce and 4 tbsp water. Stir-fry for 2 mins. Add herbs and noodles and toss to combine. Serve.
title: Pork And Pepper Stir Fry

steps: 1. In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, combine the soy sauce, chili powder and garlic.
2. Add skinned and cut up chicken and scallions (cut into 1-inch sections with green tops), and stir to coat the chicken well.
title: Joshua'S Favorite Chinese Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 tsp. red food coloring (optional; looks nicer with)

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in Ziploc bag.
2. Add pork; mix well and refrigerate 3 to 10 hours (or overnight), turning occasionally. Drain pork, reserving marinade.
3. Place pork on wire rack over baking pan.
4. Bake in preheated oven (350°), turning and basting often until cooked through, approximately 45 to 60 minutes.
5. Slice into thin diagonal slices.
title: Chinese Barbecued Pork

steps: 1. Place the chicken into a large bowl, and pour in the lemon juice, lime juice and orange juice. Sprinkle the mint leaves over, and drizzle with honey. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
2. Preheat a grill for medium heat. When the grill is hot, lightly brush the grate with oil.
3. Place the chicken onto the preheated grill, and discard the marinade. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes per side, or until no longer pink and juices run clear.
title: Chris' Grilled Orange Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast halves

steps: 1. Combine first 6 ingredients in a medium bowl; stir well.
2. Reserve 1 cup hoisin sauce mixture; set aside.
3. Cut chicken diagonally across the grain into thin slices.
4. Add chicken to the remaining sauce mixture in bowl and stir well.
5. Cover and marinate in refrigerator up to 8 hours, stirring occasionally.
6. Remove chicken from bowl; discard marinade.
7. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray; add 1 1/2 teaspoons oil and place over medium-high heat until hot.
8. Add half of chicken; cook 5 minutes or until done.
9. Remove chicken and set aside.
10. Repeat procedure with remaining oil and chicken.
11. Warm tortillas.
12. Spread 2 tablespoons reserved hoisin sauce mixture down the center of each tortilla.
13. Arrange one-eighth of chicken slices and 2 tablespoons green onions down the center of each tortilla; roll up.
title: Peking Chicken

steps: 1. Take the first 4 ingredients and mix in a bowl. Next beat the Egg and add it to the Club Soda. Pour the Egg mix into the dry mix; add the Vanilla & Brown Sugar. Mix, adding more pure Club Soda until desired thickness.
2. A thin batter is desirable if the protein is to be stir fried after cooking. A thick batter is desirable if the protein is served with a sauce.
3. Dredge the protein in the Brown Rice Flour. Then dip it in the batter mix. Let excess fall off and then place in fryer.
title: Gluten Free Chinese Fry Batter

steps: 1. Roll chicken in flour to coat.
2. Spray 10-inch skillet with nonstick Pam cooking spray; add butter.
3. Let melt; add chicken breasts.
4. Cook over medium heat until chicken is lightly browned (5 to 7 minutes).
5. Turn chicken over.
6. Continue cooking until lightly browned (5 to 7 minutes).
7. Remove chicken; set aside. Stir in lemon juice and garlic.
8. Return chicken breasts to pan, simmer 3 minutes.
9. Turn chicken breasts over.
10. Continue cooking until fork-tender (2 to 3 minutes).
11. Serve over rice.
title: Lemon Chicken Saute

ingredients.text: 1 lb kielbasa, cut up into bite-size pieces (pre-boil and cool if you find it too salty straight from the package)
1/2 head cabbage, coarsely shredded with a knife. Using a Kraut cutter is OK, but the regular grater cuts too finely

steps: 1. Lightly grease big, iron skillet (I like to use my chicken fryer), with canola oil.
2. Brown the Kielbasa. Take it out and put it aside. Drain excess grease.
3. Fry potatoes and carrots, stirring often, until half-cooked.
4. Add onion and keep frying, stirring frequently.
5. When the onion is half-cooked, add the cabbage and continue until everything is completely cooked.
6. Return Kielbasa to the pan, mix well, and serve once it is reheated.
7. This dish travels well and reheats well.
title: Polish Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Mix. Bake at 350° in 9 x 9-inch pan for 12 to 15 minutes.
2. Cool slightly.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Preheat broiler. In a glass measuring cup, whisk together orange juice, hoisin sauce, and honey.
2. Season salmon with salt and pepper, and place on broiler pan skin side down. Brush half of the hoisin sauce mixture on salmon.
3. Broil salmon about 4 inches from the heat source 10 minutes.
4. Drizzle remaining sauce over salmon and serve.
title: Hoisin Salmon

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon ground fresh ginger (such as Spice World), divided
1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into 1/4-inch strips

steps: 1. Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add broccoli and 2 teaspoons ginger to pan; saute 1 minute. Add water. Cover; cook 2 minutes or until broccoli is crisp-tender. Remove broccoli from pan; keep warm.
2. Heat remaining 2 teaspoons oil in pan; add remaining 1 teaspoon ginger, crushed red pepper, and chicken. Cook 4 minutes or until chicken is lightly browned, stirring frequently.

3. Combine broth and next 5 ingredients (through garlic) in a small bowl, and stir with a whisk. Add broth mixture to pan; cook 1 minute or until mixture thickens, stirring constantly. Return broccoli mixture to pan; toss to coat. Sprinkle with peanuts.
title: Kung Pao Chicken

steps: 1. Sift all dry ingredients together; mix with beaten eggs.
2. Roll into little balls, then roll in granulated sugar.
3. Place on floured cookie sheet and bake for 30 minutes at 300°.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon coconut oil, or as needed

steps: 1. Mix together lemon juice, onion, olive oil, garlic, lemon zest, ginger, and turmeric in a bowl. Place shrimp into marinade, cover, and refrigerate shrimp and marinade mixture overnight.

2. Remove shrimp, saving the marinade. Heat a wok or skillet over medium-high heat; melt coconut oil in hot wok. Stir-fry shrimp in coconut oil until shrimp are opaque and pink, 5 to 10 minutes. Add reserved marinade and bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
title: Paleo Spicy Shrimp Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Blend together water, dry sherry, soy sauce, cornstarch, garlic and pepper; set aside.
2. Heat peanut oil in a wok or skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add chicken, celery and onion.
4. Stir-fry 4 minutes, until chicken is cooked and celery and onion are tender. Add the mushrooms and cashews; stir-fry 1 minute.
5. Mix in soy mixture; cook and stir until sauce is thickened.
6. Serve immediately over a bed of cooked rice.
title: Chicken And Cashew Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Rinse of Chicken Breasts and place in a dish that will fit in your toaster oven. Then sprinkle lemon pepper on them ( as much or as little as you want ). Then place them into the toaster oven for 1 hour on broil. Turn the breasts over after 25 minutes. They will be done after 45 - 50 total.

2. Place on a plate with a sprig of parsley. The chicken breasts can be frozen for a later date. To freeze them, place each breast in a sandwich baggie and put into a freezer bag. It's a great meal for the college student or the person who lives alone.
title: Toaster Oven Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces.
2. Heat 2 to 2 1/2 inches oil to 360°.
3. Mix remaining ingredients until smooth.
4. Dip chicken in this and fry until golden brown, turning once.
5. Drain.
6. Serve with Lemon Sauce.
title: Lemon Chicken Hawaiian Style

ingredients.text: 3 lb. boneless chicken breasts (or any chicken parts)

steps: 1. In a large frying pan or electric skillet, brown chicken in butter.
2. Season with salt and pepper.
3. Add remaining ingredients, except Burgundy and orange slices.
4. Reduce heat, cover (can also be put in 375° oven) and simmer, stirring and basting occasionally until tender.
5. Add Burgundy and orange slices.
6. Continue simmering another 10 minutes.
7. Serve hot.
title: Orange Chicken Burgundy

ingredients.text: 2 green peppers, cut into thin 1 1/2-inch strips

steps: 1. Mix cornstarch, beef broth and soy sauce; set aside.
2. Heat oil in wok or skillet until hot.
3. Add meat and garlic.
4. Stir-fry until meat is no longer pink.
5. Add onion and peppers; stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes.
6. Add salt and pepper.
7. Stir in cornstarch mixture. Stir-fry until sauce thickens slightly.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Place roast in shallow pan, coat with marmalade and place in preheated 350 degree F. oven. Roast for about 40 minutes (20 minutes per pound) until internal temperature on a thermometer reads 145 degrees F. Remove roast from oven; let rest about 10 minutes before slicing. Garnish servings with mandarin oranges.
title: Mandarin Pork Roast

steps: 1. Cut meat across the grain into thin slices, 2-inches long. Combine soy sauce, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, sugar, salt, cooking wine, pepper, cooking oil and egg in medium glass or plastic bowl; beat lightly with a fork.
2. Mix in meat.
3. Let stand 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
title: Mongolian Beef

ingredients.text: 6 frozen boneless skinless chicken breast halves (do not thaw)

steps: 1. In a zip lock bag, combine the orange juice, honey, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil. One at a time, put the chicken in the bag, seal, and gently shake to coat with the sauce. Transfer the coated chicken to the slow cooker, then pour the remaing sauce over the chicken.
2. Cover and cook on low until the chicken is tender and cooked through 5-6 hours.

3. Transfer the chicken to a warm platter. Strain the sauce through a fine mesh strainer into a small saucepan. In a small bowl, stir together the cornstarch and cold water. Bring the sauce to a boil over high heat, add the slurry, and cook, stirring a few times until thickened, 1-2 minutes.
4. Pour some of the sauce over the chicken & pass the rest on the side. If desired, sprinkle the sesame seeds over the top.
title: Orange Hoisin Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (6 ounces each)

steps: 1. Place chicken in a 6-qt. electric pressure cooker. Finely grate enough zest from lemons to measure 4 teaspoons. Cut lemons in half; squeeze juice. Add zest and juice to pressure cooker.

2. Tear basil leaves directly into pressure cooker; add chicken stock. Lock lid; close pressure-release valve. Adjust to pressure-cook on high for 6 minutes. Quick-release pressure. A thermometer inserted in chicken should read at least 165°. When cool enough to handle, shred meat with 2 forks; return to pressure cooker. If desired, stir in additional lemon zest and chopped basil. Serve with a slotted spoon.

3. Place chicken and cooking liquid in freezer containers. Cool and freeze. To use, partially thaw in refrigerator overnight. Microwave, covered, on high in a microwave-safe dish until heated through, stirring gently.
title: Pressure Cooker Lemon Chicken With Basil

ingredients.text: 1 c. shredded cooked chicken, pork, shrimp, lobster or crab

steps: 1. Slice mushrooms thin; saute in butter or margarine for 3 minutes.
2. Add onion, meat or fish, sprouts and seasonings.
3. Add this to the well beaten eggs; blend well.
4. Drop from large spoon into frying pan with about 1/4 inch of hot fat.
5. Brown one side; turn and brown other side.
6. Serve hot with Chinese Sauce.
title: Egg Foo Yong

steps: 1. Saute broccoli, onion and bell pepper for 5 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds.
2. After 5 minutes, add Worcestershire sauce and soy sauce, then simmer for 30 seconds. Serve over rice.
title: Fend For Yourself Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Marinate chicken pieces in all the other ingredients for at least 2 hours, turning pieces now and again.
2. Arrange in a single layer in a roasting dish and cook in a moderate oven (160 C / 325 F) for 30 minutes, turn pieces and cook a further 25 minutes.
3. Serve hot or cold (cooking time includes marinating time).
title: Chinese Roasted Chicken

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add eggs and green onions. Cook and stir until eggs are nearly set, about 10 seconds. Immediately scrape eggs into a bowl.

2. Add tomatoes to the skillet. Saute, stirring occasionally, until juices are released and tomatoes are slightly wilted, about 5 minutes. Add salt and sugar; stir to mix well. Return eggs to skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until eggs are set, 2 to 3 minutes.
title: Chinese Stir-Fried Egg And Tomato

steps: 1. Place Chicken breasts in a medium, non reactive bowl.
2. Add garlic, salt, pepper, lemon juice and olive oil.
3. Turn chicken several times to coat with marinade.
4. Cover and marinate 1-2 hours in the refrigerator.
5. Prepare a hot fire in a barbecue grill.
6. Oil the grill.
7. Remove breasts from the marinade, shaking off excess and place on hot grill.
8. Cook until lightly browned, about 6 minutes.
9. Turn and brush with marinade.
10. Grill second side 4-6 minutes or until white throughout but still juicy.
title: Grilled Garlic-Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1/2-inch strips

steps: 1. Place chicken in a large resealable plastic bag. Add cornstarch and toss to coat. Combine soy sauce, ginger and garlic powder. Add to bag and shake well. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
title: Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 3 lb. chicken, skinned and cut up

steps: 1. Combine first 6 ingredients in large bowl to make marinade. Add chicken.
2. Cover and chill at least 8 hours.
3. Remove chicken from marinade.
4. Reserve marinade.
5. Place flour in plastic bag. Add chicken and shake to coat.
6. Heat oil in large skillet.
7. Add chicken and brown on all sides.
8. Drain on paper towel.
9. Place in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
10. Pour marinade over; cover with foil and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
title: Greek Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice (I use grated rind as well)
1 lb lean ground beef (or other ground meat)

steps: 1. Combine orange juice& cornstarch and set aside.
2. Saute meat over medium high heat until cooked.
3. Drain off excess fat, remove and set aside.
4. Add sesame oil to skillet, stir fry ginger, garlic and orange peel briefly.
5. Add green onion and stir fry 1 minute.
6. Return meat to skillet, add hoisin and stir until blended.
7. Add orange juice mixture and stir until thickened (about 1 minute).
8. Can serve over rice or couscous or"fusion" it as I do.
title: Ground Beef With Hoisin

steps: 1. In large skillet, heat corn oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add shrimp.
3. Cook, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes.
4. Stir in tomatoes and green peppers.
5. Stir together remaining ingredients. Add to skillet.
6. Stirring constantly, bring to boil over medium heat and boil 1 minute.
7. Serve over cooked rice.
title: Peking Shrimp

steps: 1. Roll chicken in flour mixture.
2. Melt 1/2 cup butter and coat pieces of chicken with flour well.
3. Bake 45 minutes.
4. Glaze with honey lemon mixture.
5. Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
title: Honey Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Brown the onions and the ground round steak and let cook for a few minutes.
2. Add the tomatoes and chopped celery, adding water as needed.
3. Cook 20 minutes.
4. Add the cooked kidney beans.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Let cook for 30 to 40 minutes until everything is blended together.
7. Add thickening, if too thin.
title: Beef Chop Suey

steps: 1. Sift sugar, flour, baking powder and salt into a bowl.
2. Stir in dates and nuts.
3. Add eggs, mix thoroughly.
4. Spread in greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1 inch pan.
5. Bake at 375 degrees for about 20 minutes.
6. Cut into squares while warm.
7. Roll in confectioners sugar.
8. Yield:
9. 6 dozen.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Coat chicken with flour mixture and pan-fry in margarine in 2-inch skillet over medium heat, until lightly browned on both sides (adding more margarine as needed).
2. Remove chicken.

3. Reduce heat and add any leftover flour mixture, 1/2 cup chicken broth and 1/2 cup orange marmalade or more according to taste, to skillet. Return chicken to skillet and simmer for 5 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender.
title: Orange Chicken

ingredients.text: 3 tomatoes, peeled and quartered or 1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes
1/3 c. soy sauce or to taste

steps: 1. Brown meat in oil.
2. Add onions, peppers and garlic.
3. Stir and simmer for two minutes.
4. Add tomatoes, soy sauce and sugar. Simmer for 15 minutes.
5. Serve over rice.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

ingredients.text: 3 green peppers, cut in thin strips

steps: 1. Cut steak into thin strips; set aside.
2. In big bowl, combine soy sauce and bouillon cube, dissolved in small amount hot water, ginger and garlic powder.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

ingredients.text: 4 (6 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves

steps: 1. Rinse chicken breasts and pat dry with paper towels. Stir together the lemon juice, soy sauce, ginger, and black pepper in a bowl; pour into a large, resealable plastic bag. Add the chicken breasts, seal the bag, and massage to evenly coat chicken with lemon juice mixture. Place in refrigerator to marinate at least 20 minutes, or up to 24 hours.
2. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat. Lightly oil grill grate, and place about 4 inches from heat source.
3. Drain and discard marinade from the bag, and place chicken on preheated grill. Cook until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear, 6 to 8 minutes on each side.
title: Easy Grilled Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Chop your jalapeno up in small pieces, use as much as you want of it. I use about half of a medium sized pepper.
2. Microwave chicken patties. 2 minutes if frozen, 1 if refrigerated. Chop into small squares, set aside.
3. Add water, 1 tbsp butter and bouillon together and bring to boil.
4. While water is coming to a boil add remaining teaspoon of butter to skillet along with the jalapeno and fry for about 2 minutes.
5. At this point your water is probably boiling. Add rice, stir cover and set aside.
6. Add chicken to the skillet mixing it up with the jalapeno and fry about 5 minutes.
7. Add rice into skillet and fry about 2 more minutes mixing well.
8. Crack egg over the pan and stir the egg around the mixture until fully cooked.
9. Add soy sauce, evenly mix.
10. Serve with or without chow mien noodles.
title: Chicken Patty Stir Fry

steps: 1. Slice steak diagonally across grain into 1/8 inch thick strips. Place in a large heavy-duty zip-top plastic bag. Set aside.
2. Combine hoisin sauce and remaining 8 ingredients; stir well. Pour marinade over steak, seal bag securely. Marinate in refrigerator 8 hours, turning occasionally.
3. Remove steak from marinade, discarding marinade, thread steak onto 32 (6 inch) wooden skewers. Broil strips 3 inches from heat 2 to 3 minutes on each side or to desired degree of doneness.
4. Note: Unlike metal skewers, wooden skewers can burn under the broiler. make sure you soak wooden skewers in water at least 10 minutes before threading food onto them to prevent any flare-ups.
title: Mongolian Beef Sticks

steps: 1. To Marinate: Combine chicken and lemon juice in a large resealable plastic bag. Squeeze out air and seal bag. Refrigerate to marinate overnight, turning once.

2. Remove chicken from marinade, reserving 2 tablespoons marinade and disposing of the remainder. Mix together flour, salt, paprika and pepper in a large resealable plastic bag. Add chicken breasts one at a time, seal bag and shake to coat evenly.
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

4. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Fry coated chicken until well browned, about 10 to 15 minutes. Arrange browned chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish and sprinkle with brown sugar. Mix broth with reserved marinade and pour mixture over chicken. Top each breast with a lemon slice and sprinkle all with parsley.
5. Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 to 30 minutes, or until cooked through (juices run clear) and tender.
title: Lemon Chicken Iii

ingredients.text: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 1 1/4 pounds), cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (or to taste)

steps: 1. In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, vinegar, and cornstarch with 1/4 cup water. Stir in the hoisin sauce and set aside. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the peanuts and stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes or until lightly browned; remove from pan with a slotted spoon. Add the remaining oil to the pan and heat. Add the chicken and crushed red pepper and stir-fry 2 minutes or until the chicken is nicely browned. Stir in the garlic and ginger and continue stir-frying until the chicken is opaque throughout, about 2 minutes. Stir in the green onions and the hoisin mixture and heat until the sauce thickens. Remove from heat. Stir in the cilantro and serve over the hot rice.
title: Kung Pao Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 large carrots, peeled and sliced diagonally

steps: 1. Cut pork tenderloin into thin strips.
2. Set aside.
3. Combine next 6 ingredients, stirring well.
4. Heat one tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
5. Add carrots and celery, stir-frying about 3 minutes.
6. Remove vegetables; set aside.
7. Pour remaining tablespoon oil into skillet.
8. Add pork, stir-frying about 3 minutes.
9. Return vegetables to pan; add orange juice mixture and cashews.
10. Cook, stirring constantly over medium-high heat, until thickened.
11. Serve over hot rice, if desired.
title: Cashew Pork Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Marinate strips of steak for 30 minutes in ingredients.
2. Heat a little oil in skillet and brown meat.
3. Add water to make gravy, then add onion and green pepper.
4. Simmer 45 minutes or longer. Serve over rice.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. In a large skillet, saute parsnips in butter for 3-4 minutes. Add carrots and onion; cook and stir until vegetables are tender, about 10-15 minutes.
title: Carrot Parsnip Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Partially freeze pork. Slice across the grain into 1/4-in. thick strips; set aside. Combine broth, soy sauce, cornstarch and ginger; set aside. In a large skillet that has been coated with cooking spray, stir-fry pork and garlic for 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Add carrots, celery, onion, cabbage and spinach; stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add broth mixture; cover and simmer for 3 minutes.
title: Pork And Vegetable Chow Mein

steps: 1. Lightly pound chicken to help prevent shrinkage.
2. Dip each breast in egg white, then in bread crumbs, coating evenly.
3. In a large skillet, heat oil and saute each breaded breast over medium heat until golden. Clean skillet.

4. In it combine orange juice, marmalade, lemon juice, lemon zest, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and garlic. Cook over medium heat, stirring until smooth. Add chicken. Cover and cook 10 more minutes or until tender.
5. Contains 73 mg cholesterol and 397 calories.
title: Orange Chicken(Good!)

steps: 1. Combine first seven ingredients and pour over poultry that has been placed in a Dutch oven.
2. Baste 2 to 3 times while baking. Bake at 350° covered for one hour.
title: Red Chinese Chicken

steps: 1. Cook onions and celery until tender.
2. Stir in soup and chicken stock; heat to boiling.
3. Combine cornstarch, lemon juice and soy sauce.
4. Mix until smooth.
5. Add to soup mixture.
6. Cook until thick; add chicken and toasted almonds.
7. Salt and pepper.
8. Pour chicken chow mein over chow mein noodles.
title: Celeste'S Chicken Chow Mein

steps: 1. Cut off separable fat from meat and discard.
2. Cut lean meat into 1/2 x 3-inch strips.
3. Brown meat in oil.
4. Add ginger, garlic powder, salt and broth.
5. Bring to a boil.
6. Lower heat, cover pan and cook for 1 hour or until tender.
title: Steak Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cubed (or cut into strips)
2 teaspoons fresh minced ginger (or 1/2 tsp. ground, but fresh tastes better in this recipe)
1 medium red pepper, cut into thin strips
1/3 cup roasted cashews (or other nuts, if preferred)

steps: 1. Toss chicken and ginger together in a med. bowl.
2. Heat wok or large skillet over med-high heat. Add oil and heat until oil is hot.
3. Add chicken and stir-fry 2 minutes.
4. Add red pepper and continue to cook and stir 4 more minutes.
5. Whisk cornstarch into teriyaki sauce.
6. Add to meat mixture, and cook and stir until thick and bubbly.
7. Stir in cashews and cook just to heat through.
8. Serve with white rice.
title: Low-Fat Cashew Chicken (Oriental Dish)

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lbs boneless chicken breasts, sliced thin
2 cups bell peppers, julienned, I used green, red, yellow and orange

steps: 1. Preheat wok to med. high and add chicken.
2. Cook until no pink shows.
3. Remove and set aside.
4. Add peppers and carrot.
5. Cook until tender crisp.
6. Add chicken back in with the garlic.
7. Cook about 30 sec.
8. Add chicken broth, honey and soya sauce.
9. Bring to a boil, cooking just until some of sauce is reduced.
10. Serve over rice.
title: Stir Fry Chicken And Peppers

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup yellow onion (diced-amt depends on your liking)

steps: 1. Fry the 2 pieces of bacon until brown, remove from grease and set aside. Drain excess grease but DO NOT wipe the pan clean.
2. Throw diced vegetables in to the same pan and heat 4 minutes on medium to high heat until vegetables soften slightly.
3. While vegetables cook, crumble bacon.
4. Stir in baby scallops and crumbed bacon to the pan of your cooking vegetables.
5. Continue to cook together for an additional 4 minutes.
6. Use to top linguini, rice or nothing at all and enjoy!
title: Succulent Baby Scallop Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Melt butter in skillet or wok. Saute scallops

2. in melted butter for 3 minutes. Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 2 more minutes. Pour in teriyaki sauce and cook 2 additional minutes. Stir in cashews just before serving. Serve over favorite rice.
title: Scallop Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 (1-lb) head broccoli, cut into florets (3.5 to 4 cups)

steps: 1. Fill bottom part of a steamer with 1 inch of water; bring to boil.

2. Toss chicken with garlic, ginger, scallions, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes, coating breasts well. Place chicken in the steamer basket, pouring remaining soy sauce mixture over chicken. Lower basket into water container, reduce to a rapid summer, and cover with a lid. Steam for 5 minutes.
3. Turn chicken breasts, add broccoli, cover, and continue steaming until chicken is cooked through and broccoli is tender, 5 to 6 minutes more. Serve hot.
title: Chinese-Style Steamed Chicken

steps: 1. First Preheat your oven to 400 degrees. Then clean off your chicken breast, your red potatoes, and fresh green beans.
2. Next cut your red potatoes into slices, cut your fresh green beans in half, and chop up your fresh garlic. Then cut your lemons into slices and set asisde for later.

3. Place each chicken breast on a sheet of Aluminum foil then place the slice red potatoes around the chicken breast. Place the cut green beans on the potatoes, then sprinkle the chop garlic on top of the green beans and potatoes.

4. Seaon each foil packet with Italian seasoning, the salt, the black pepper, the garlic powder , then drizzle each packet with olive oil, and top each one with 2-3 slices of the lemon slices you sliced earlier.
5. Then put the foil packets into a baking pan and place it in the oven to bake for 30-35 minutes. You can also grill the foil packet as well for 30-35 minutes.
6. After 30-35 minutes take out the foil packet place it on a plate and enjoy but be careful because the foil gets extremely hot. This foil packet dinner is so yummy that everybody can enjoy.
title: Lemon Chicken Foil Packet Dinner

steps: 1. In a blender, blend lemon juice, wine, mustard, garlic, and rosemary until well combined. Ina a large zipper bag, throw the chicken and lemon juice mixture. Keep in fridge for at least 1 hour. In a small bowl, stir together 2 tbsp chicken broth and cornstarch until dissolved. Set aside.
2. In a skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Cook chicken (reserving the marinade) on each side, about 4min. or until no longer pink. Remove chicken from skillet and cover to keep warm.

3. Now add reserved marinade to the skillet and using wire wisk, stir in the cornstarch mixture and remaining broth. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Cook and stir for 2 min more. Return chicken to skillet, heat through, serve with sauce.
title: Skillet Lemon Chicken With Rosemary

steps: 1. Mix together until warm.
2. Pour over cakes.
title: Egg Foo Yong

steps: 1. Melt butter and soy sauce in a skillet. Add eggs and cook for 5 minutes, basting and turning eggs until the eggs become dark. Brown. Slice eggs and place on serving plate. Drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with chopped green onion. Can be served warm or cold.
title: Chinese Eggs

steps: 1. Brush chicken with hoisin sauce.
2. Heat oil in a large frying pan. Cook chicken over medium-low heat until browned on both sides and just cooked through.
3. Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients and 1 tbsp water in a small bowl. Serve chicken with sauce.
title: Hoisin Chicken

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400.
2. Combine first 6 ingredients in a small bowl. Pour 1/4 c honey mixture into a large ziplok bag; reserve remaining mixture. Add pork to bag; seal and marinate in fridge at least 30 minute.

3. Remove pork from bag and discard marinade. Sprinkle pork with salt. Heat large ovenproof skillet over med-high. Coat pan with cooking spray. Add pork; cook 2 min, browning on all sides. Brush 1 T reserved honey mixture over pork and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Place skillet in oven. Bake at 400 for 20 min or til thermometer registers 160.
4. Place pork on a platter; let stand 5 minute Cut across the grain in thin slices and drizzle with sauce.
title: Honey-Hoisin Pork Tenderloin

ingredients.text: 2 chickens (2 1/2 lb. each), cut into pieces

steps: 1. Combine chicken pieces and lemon pieces in a bowl just large enough to hold them comfortably.
2. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator overnight, turning occasionally.
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Combine first 8 ingredients in a small bowl; stirring with a whisk.
2. Place in a large zip top bag; seal. Marinate 2 hours, turning occasionally (can skip this step).
3. Place pork and marinade in slow cooker. Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours.
4. Remove pork from slow cooker using slotted spoon; place on cutting board or work surface and shred.
5. Can thicken sauce and serve with meat.
6. Serve with sticky rice and some stir fry veggies.
title: Slow Cooker Char Siu Pork Roast

steps: 1. Finely chop onion, celery and green pepper. Brown hamburger and add chopped vegetables and saute. Add salt and pepper. Mix soups, milk and mayonnaise and add to cooked meat and vegetables. Pour into a 9 x 12 greased and add the chow mein noodles mixing till combined. Top with Cashews.
title: Chow Mein Hamburger Hot Dish

steps: 1. Brown
2. meat
3. in
4. oil, add onions and celery; cook until soft. Add
5. other	ingredients.
6. Pour into an 8 x 11-inch pan. Bake, uncovered,	at 350° for 30 minutes.
7. Spread 1 large pan Chinese noodles over top and bake for 15 minutes uncovered.
title: Chinese Hamburger Hash

steps: 1. Brown chicken in skillet in margarine.
2. Place chicken in baking dish. Top with orange slices.
3. In the same skillet, blend flour, salt, cinnamon and 2 tablespoons drippings.
4. Gradually stir in orange juice.
5. Heat to boiling, stirring over medium heat, until mixture comes to a boil and is thickened.
6. Pour over chicken and orange slices.
7. Bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes or until done.
title: Baked Orange Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb fresh asparagus, chopped, woody ends removed

steps: 1. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in wok.
2. Add asparagus and cook til crisp tender, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove and place in bowl.
4. Add sliced zuchinni and cook until crisp tender.
5. Place in bowl with asparagus.
6. Add cabbage to wok, adding additional oil if needed.
7. Cook until translucent and tender.
8. Add pine nuts, sunflower seeds and asparagus/zuchinni mixture.
9. Season and cook an additional 5 minutes.
title: Pine Nut Veggie Stir Fry

steps: 1. Wash and slice thin 2 cups zucchini.
2. Chop 1 small onion fine. Melt butter in skillet on medium heat.
3. Add vegetables and stir-fry until tender.
title: Zucchini Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Place a pot containing 3 quarts of water over high heat.
2. When the water comes to a boil, lower the chicken into the water (it should be completely immersed).
3. Cook the chicken for about a total of 10 minutes. (It will take about 5 minutes for the water to return to the boil, and the chicken should cook for an additional 4 or 5 minutes at a gentle boil.)
4. Drain the chicken and place it, on a rack, uncovered, in the refrigerator, for 5 to 6 hours, or overnight.
5. The skin should be somewhat dry at this point.
6. (The drier the skin, the crispier it will be after cooking.)
title: Roasted Peking Chicken

steps: 1. Combine and pour over meat and stir the cornstarch, sugar, ginger, soy sauce and lemon juice.
2. Clean, seed and cut into squares the peppers and onion.
3. Brown meat in hot oil.
4. Remove from pan.
5. Reduce heat; add peppers, onion, garlic and water. Cook to tender-crisp; stir in meat and reheat.
6. Serve over rice or noodles.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Brown and drain ground beef.

2. In clean pan saute ground beef with the garlic a few minutes. Add the oil and all vegetables with the black pepper. Stir and cook about 5 minutes then add about 1tbsp soy sauce and cook about 3 more minutes.
3. Combine the remaining soy sauce with the water and corn starch. Add to the stir fry for sauce. Serve over hot rice.
title: Great Ground Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 whole boneless skinless chicken breasts (4 pieces)

steps: 1. Slice chicken breasts into strips about 1/2 inch wide. Place into a bowl. Add sherry, cornstarch, garlic, salt and curry powder, tossing well. Set aside to marinate for 15 minutes.
2. Meanwhile saute mushrooms in 2 Tbsp of the butter for 2 minutes or until browned. Remove from the pan.
3. Add the remaining butter to pan. Over high head, add chicken slices. Saute quickly for 5-10 minutes until pieces are golden. Add mushrooms to chicken. Toss over high heat for 30 seconds.
4. Add cream. Cook, stirring, until cream is boiled down and thickened. Transfer to a serving dish. Sprinkle with cashews and parsley.
5. Serve over hot rice.
title: Cashew Chicken (From My Great Recipe Cards)

steps: 1. Combine orange juice, sherry, soy sauce, honey, garlic and shallot in a shallow glass dish.
2. Add chicken and turn to coat.
3. Refrigerate overnight, turning once.
4. Place flour in shallow dish.
5. Beat egg in another shallow dish.
6. Remove chicken, reserving marinade.
7. Dip chicken in flour, then in egg, then in flour again.
8. Melt butter with oil in large skillet over medium heat.
9. Add chicken and cook until browned and tender, 3-5 minutes per side.
10. Remove chicken and keep warm.
11. Add reserved marinade to skillet, scraping up any browned bits.
12. Continue cooking until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
13. Arrange chicken on platter and pour sauce over.
14. Garnish with orange slices.
15. Serve with steamed rice and asparagus.
title: Orange Chicken

steps: 1. In a bowl, mix the soy sauce, brown sugar, lemon juice, vegetable oil, ginger, and garlic powder. Set aside some of the mixture in a separate bowl for marinating during cooking. Pierce the pork chops on both sides with a fork, place in a large resealable plastic bag, and cover with the remaining marinade mixture. Refrigerate 6 to 8 hours.
2. Preheat the grill for high heat.
3. Lightly oil the grill grate. Discard marinade, and grill pork chops 6 to 8 minutes per side, or to desired doneness, marinating often with the reserved portion of the marinade.
title: Chinese Pork Chops

ingredients.text: 1 cup cut fresh green beans (2-inch pieces)
1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, optional

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine cornstarch, orange juice and soy sauce until smooth; set aside. In a large skillet or wok, stir-fry carrot, broccoli and beans in oil for 8 minutes. Add sweet potato and onion; stir-fry until vegetables are crisp-tender.
2. Stir the soy sauce mixture; add to the skillet with garlic, rosemary, ginger, and pepper flakes if desired. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 1 minute or until thickened.
title: Ginger Veggie Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
2. Add the chicken and cook until browned.
3. Add the mushrooms and green beans. Stir while cooking, until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through.
4. Stir in the fish sauce and ginger and cook for 1 more minute.
5. Stir in the sesame seeds and green onions. Serve.immediately.
title: Mushroom Green Bean Chicken Stir Fry

steps: 1. slice steak thin, against the grain. if it is difficult, partially freeze it to cut better.
2. Put into ziplock bag with the cornstarch, shake to coat and leave leave sit while you make the sauce.
3. Heat canola oil in pan, if you make a larger batch or you pan isnt big enough, cook in batches. We're aiming to sear the meat. Don't over crowd.
4. Remove from pan when cooked through.
5. Add ginger and garlic and saute for 10-15 seconds.
6. Add soy sauce, water, and dark brown sugar and bring to a boil.
7. Add steak back in and let sauce thicken for 20-30 seconds.
8. If the sauce isn't as thick as you'd like, mix cornstarch with a little water and add it in per preference.
9. When it is bubbly and thick, add in green onions and cook for 20-30 seconds, just to warm onions.
10. Serve over rice or noodles.
title: Mongolian Chicken

steps: 1. Cut roast in half. Combine 1/3 cup hoisin sauce and ginger; rub over pork. Transfer to a 3-qt. slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 7-8 hours or until pork is tender.
2. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine the cabbage, carrots, onions, vinegar and sugar. Chill until serving.

3. Shred meat with two forks and return to the slow cooker; heat through. Place 2 teaspoons remaining hoisin sauce down the center of each tortilla; top with 1/3 cup shredded pork and 1/3 cup coleslaw. Roll up.
title: Hoisin Pork Wraps

steps: 1. Whisk together the cornstarch and water in a small bowl. Mix in the soy sauce and olive oil, and set aside.

2. Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Saute the carrot, pepper, and zucchini in oil for about 5 minutes. Stir in the corn, garlic, green onions, and bean sprouts. Pour in the soy sauce mixture. Cook and stir for about 5 minutes, or until vegetables are tender but crisp. Serve immediately.
title: Owen'S Veggie Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 slice bacon, finely diced (Canadian or British bacon)

steps: 1. Melt butter in a wok or pan over medium heat and add bacon and chicken.
2. Stir-fry a few minutes until lightly cooked.
3. Allow to cool 5 minutes and serve in your best china.
title: Bacon And Chicken Stir-Fry For Your Cat

ingredients.text: 1 lb flank steak (I also use stew meat, or what I have on hand)

steps: 1. Cut meat into bite size pieces.
2. Shake with cornstarch.
3. Let sit for 10 minutes.
4. Fry in oil for 2-4 minutes.
5. Put in crock pot.
6. Mix all other ingredients together and add to crock pot.
7. Cook on low for about 4 hours.
8. Serve over steamed rice.
title: Emily'S Mongolian Beef In The Crock Pot

ingredients.text: 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts (6 oz. each)

steps: 1. Place the wine, stock, shallots, and lemon juice in a small pot and reduce to about 1/4 cup over high heat, about 25 minutes. Stir in salt and allow to.

2. cool. When slightly warmer than room temperature, whisk in 8 T. of softened butter, a few tablespoons at a time, until mixture is the consistency of mayonnaise. Beat in lemon zest and set this lemon butter aside.
3. Flatten the chicken breast slightly. Dredge the chicken breasts in flour,.
4. shaking off excess, then place in the beaten egg, allowing excess to drain.
5. off, then once more in flour. Shake off any excess. Place aside carefully.
6. Put the remaining 2 T. of butter and the olive oil in a large heavy skillet,.
7. Over medium-high heat, saute the chicken until golden brown on both sides,.
8. about 5 minutes in total. Transfer to a warm plate and spread some of the.
9. lemon butter over the top of each.
title: Papa Gouras'S Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons brown sugar (Leave this out if you want the sauce less sweeter)
1 teaspoon of minced garlic, to taste

steps: 1. Mix all the ingredients except the Lemon Juice, Water and apple.
2. Divide mixture in two, put one half aside.
3. Put half of the mixture in a sealable bag with Pork Loins and let it marinate for 3 hours (You can do less but I like the flavor to really permeate the meat) but do have at least an hour.
4. Broil (or BBQ) the pork loins using the marinade mixture from the bag to baste.
5. Cook on low to medium heat about 8 mins either side so that the meat is properly cooked but the outside does not burn.
6. The loins will turn brown because of the marinade and this is OK but dont let it burn or it could taste bitter.
7. Peel your half apple and cut out the core so that you just have the flesh of the apple and dice it into small chunks.
8. Take the half of the mixture you put aside and add the water, diced apple and lemon juice.
9. Put the contents in a small pan and warm up on the stove top prior to serving.
10. You can let it reduce and thicken or leave as is, according to taste.
11. Just before serving you can drizzle some of the warmed sauce over the pork loins or serve in a gravy boat or sauce jug on the side.
title: Hoisin Barbecued Pork Loins With Apple

ingredients.text: 2 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts, chopped

steps: 1. Heat a skillet on medium heat and add 1 tablespoon olive oil. Add mushrooms and saute until soft, about 5 minutes. Remove from skillet. Season chicken with salt and pepper, then sprinkle cornstarch on chicken pieces and make sure each piece is somewhat coated. (You can add a little more if needed.) Add the remaining olive oil to the skillet and add chicken. Brown on both sides until cooked, about 5 minutes per side. Add garlic, red pepper, edamame, half of the green onions and cashews and stir for 30 seconds. Turn heat to medium low.
2. In a small bowl, mix soy sauce and honey. Pour into skillet, coating chicken and vegetables. Serve with jasmine rice.
title: Cashew Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh lemon zest

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except chicken in a blender and blend until emulsified.

2. Put chicken pieces in a nonreactive bowl or dish or a large sealable plastic bag. Add marinade and turn chicken once or twice to coat. Marinate, covered and chilled, at least 8 hours. Bring chicken to room temperature 30 minutes before grilling and discard marinade.

3. Open vents on bottom of grill and on lid. Light a large chimney starter of charcoal (80 to 100 briquettes). Leaving about one quarter of grill free of charcoal, bank lit charcoal across rest of grill so that coals are about 3 times higher on opposite side.

4. When charcoal turns grayish white (about 15 to 20 minutes) and you can hold your hand 5 inches above rack for 3 to 4 seconds, sear chicken on lightly oiled grill rack over coals, uncovered, turning occasionally, until browned, 4 to 8 minutes total. Move chicken to side of grill with no coals underneath and cook, covered with lid, turning occasionally, until just cooked through, about 12 minutes for wings, 18 to 20 minutes for breasts, and 20 to28 minutes for dark meat. Transfer chicken as cooked to a platter.

5. Preheat all burners on high, covered, 10 minutes, then adjust heat to moderately high. Sear chicken on lightly oiled grill rack, uncovered, turning over once, until well browned, 4 to 8 minutes total. Turn off 1 burner (middle burner if there are 3) and arrange chicken on rack above shut-off burner. Cook, covered with lid and turning over occasionally, until just cooked through, about 12 minutes for wings, 18 to 20 minutes for breasts, and 20 to 28 minutes for dark meat. Transfer chicken as cooked to a platter.
title: Grilled Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Coat chicken pieces in mixture of flour and paprika.
2. Melt butter in baking pan, add chicken pieces and coat evenly with butter.
3. Arrange in a single layer.
4. Bake uncovered at 375° for 30 minutes.
5. Turn chicken pieces and pour basting sauce over them. Continue baking until chicken is brown and tender, about 30 minutes.
6. Garnish with lemon slices.
title: Oven Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into strips
1 cup red bell pepper, cut into thin strips

steps: 1. In a shallow glass bowl, combine orange juice and cornstarch; mix well.
2. Stir in chicken.
3. Cover and chill for 2 hours or as long as you can.
4. Drain chicken; discard juice mixture.
5. In a small bowl, combine broth and soy sauce.
6. Set aside.
7. In a wok or large non-stick skillet, heat canola oil over medium heat.
8. Add garlic and ginger; stir-fry for 30 seconds.
9. Add chicken; stir-fry for 3 minutes.
10. Add vegetables; stir-fry until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes.
11. Stir in broth mixture.
12. Place 1/2 cup of rice on each serving plate.
13. Top with the chicken mixture, dividing evenly.
title: Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 c. celery, sliced thin in 1-inch strips

steps: 1. Cook celery, onion and ground beef in hot fat in a large frypan about 5 minutes until meat begins to brown.
2. Blend cornstarch with water.
3. Stir into beef mixture.
4. Add bouillon cube, soy sauce and salt.
5. Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce is thickened and clear.
6. Stir in cabbage.
7. Cook, covered, about 3 minutes until cabbage is tender but still firm.
8. Serve on rice.
title: Ground Beef Chop Suey

steps: 1. Mix spaghetti with the soy sauce, brown sugar, vegetable oil and oyster sauce making sure to mix it well.

2. Spray a large cookie sheet with Pam spray and cover the pan with a layer of the spaghetti and bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 minutes turning the spaghetti every 10 minutes until it "drys out", you will see the difference. Continue until all the pasta has been dryed out.
3. Stir fry the pork loin that has been sliced into strips in vegetable oil,.
4. remove and set aside. Use your favorite teriyaki recipe for the pork.
5. Stir fry the onion and mushrooms in vegetable oil along with the garlic and ginger paste available in the Asian dept. of grocery store until soft.
6. Add the rest of the vegetables mixing well and cook for about 2 minutes.
7. Add vegetables and pork to spaghetti mix and mix together well making sure everything is evenly distributed.
8. Great for OAMC.
9. Enjoy.
title: Pork Lo Mein

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except chicken in a plastic bag.
2. Stab the chicken a few times to make sure it soaks up all the goods, then add to the liquid.
3. Place in fridge for at least a few hours.
4. Remove chicken from marinade and grill until done turning once.
title: Chinese Grilled Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 medium onion, thinly sliced and separated

steps: 1. Heat oil in wok or large skillet.
2. Add remaining ingredients; stir-fry over high heat for about 5 minutes, or until zucchini is crisp-tender.
3. Serve over Texmati rice.
title: Vegetable Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. boneless chicken breast, cut up

steps: 1. In wok or skillet, fry chicken in margarine until cooked throughout, using medium-high heat.
2. Add vegetables and cook 2 to 3 minutes.
3. Mix remaining ingredients in a bowl until cornstarch is dissolved.
4. Pour over chicken and vegetables; bring to a boil. Cook until vegetables are desired tenderness.
title: Stir-Fry Ginger Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 pound small shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 teaspoon Sriracha (hot chile sauce, such as Huy Fong)

steps: 1. Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic and shrimp; stir-fry 3 minutes or until shrimp are cooked through. Remove shrimp from pan; keep warm.

2. Add remaining 1 teaspoon oil to pan. Add remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic and mushrooms; stir-fry 1 minute or until mushrooms are tender. Add carrot and onions; stir-fry 2 minutes. Stir in cabbage; cook 2 minutes or until wilted.

3. Combine soy sauce, 1 tablespoon water, cornstarch, and Sriracha in a small bowl, stirring with a whisk. Stir soy sauce mixture into cabbage mixture. Remove from heat; stir in shrimp, tossing to coat. Serve with hoisin and tortillas.
title: Moo Shu Shrimp

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. round steak, cut into thin strips

steps: 1. Brown meat in a small amount of oil.
2. Add chopped onions, water and salt.
3. Cover and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Add green peppers and cook 5 minutes.
4. Blend cornstarch with a little water and add to meat mixture.
5. Cook, stirring, until thick.
6. Just before serving, add tomatoes and soy sauce; heat. Serve over rice.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in large mixing bowl, coating chicken pieces well.
2. Marinate in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours, turning chicken over several times during this period.
3. Heat oven to 450°. Place chicken in baking pan.
4. Bake for 1 hour in the marinating mixture, basting occasionally.
5. Remove chicken pieces onto a serving dish.
6. Pour marinade over chicken pieces.
7. Serve with Tabouli, Zucchini-Potato Stew and Rice Pilaf.
title: Lemon Chicken(Djaj Mtabbel)

steps: 1. Brown the meat; add boiling water, bouillon cubes, soy sauce and molasses.
2. Mix cornstarch and cold water together; add to meat mixture, stirring until thickened.
3. Add celery and onion; cover and cook for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
4. Serve over hot rice or Chinese noodles.
title: Quick Chop Suey

ingredients.text: 1/2 pound shrimp peeled and deveined, tails left intact optional
5 stalks green onion chopped, white and light green parts
2 teaspoons fresh ginger finely minced or grated

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine oyster sauce, soy sauce and cilantro and set aside.

2. Pat the shrimp very dry with paper towels. In a medium bowl, add shrimp and cornstarch and toss to coat.
In a wok or large saute pan over high heat, add half the cooking oil and swirl to coat the bottom of the pan. When the wok is very hot, add the shrimp in a single layer and cook partially until one side is seared brown, about 1 minute. Flip and sear the other side of each shrimp, about one more minute. They don't need to be cooked all the way through yet. Remove them to a plate or bowl and set aside.

3. Turn the heat down to medium and let wok cool off a bit to prevent the aromatics from burning. Add the remaining cooking oil and add green onion, garlic and ginger and stir fry for a minute until fragrant.
4. Pour in the sauce mixture and add the shrimp back into the pan. Stir fry for another minute until shrimp is cooked through. Serve immediately.
title: Garlic Ginger Shrimp Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves , cut into cubes

steps: 1. Sprinkle salt evenly over both sides of eggplant slices; set aside for 5 minutes. Cut eggplant into cubes.
2. Cook and stir chicken, garlic, and soy sauce together in a large skillet over medium heat until the chicken is nearly cooked through, 7 to 10 minutes.
3. Stir mushrooms and black pepper into the chicken mixture; continue cooking until the mushrooms brown, 2 to 3 minutes.
4. Heat canola oil in a separate skillet over medium heat. Cook eggplant in hot canola oil until lightly browned; add to skillet with the chicken.
5. Stir spinach through the chicken and eggplant mixture; cook and stir until the spinach wilts, 2 to 3 minutes.
title: Chicken Eggplant Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 5 c. cut up fresh vegetables (broccoli, carrots, cauliflower, celery, onion and mushrooms)

steps: 1. Stir together cornstarch, ginger, broth and soy sauce until smooth.
2. Set aside.
3. In skillet, in 3 tablespoons oil. brown chicken.
4. Set aside.
5. In skillet in remaining 3 tablespoons oil, stir-fry vegetables with garlic until tender and crisp.
6. Stir in reserved chicken broth mixture.
7. Cook until mixture boils and thickens.
8. Serve over rice.
title: Chicken Vegetable Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Heat oil in skillet or wok and saute chicken until brown. Blend rest of ingredients and add to skillet.
2. Mix; cover and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
3. Place chicken in platter and coat with sauce.
title: Harriet'S Chicken Cantonese

ingredients.text: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into thin strips
1 1/2 teaspoons lemon pepper (I used Lemon & Herbs seasoning and fresh pepper)
1/3 cup lemon juice (I used fresh lemon juice)

steps: 1. HINT: To prevent wooden skewers from burning soak first (I put a little oil in the water. I don't know if it helps. but I feel it may help lock in the water a little longer.) fit bacon to chicken strips, and thread onto wooden skewers.
2. Combine remaining ingredients.
3. Add chicken skewers.
4. Marinate overnight. (I used a long plastic dish with lid and gave it a light shake every so often).
5. BBQ - on medium, reserving marinade to baste with barbecue 4 to 5 inches from heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink& bacon is crisp.
6. (I made this for a big BBQ I used all the chicken and bacon I needed or had, and 2X or 3X the marinade until I was happy).
title: Lemon Honey - Honey Lemon Chicken Skewers

steps: 1. In a double boiler over simmering water, melt the butterscotch morsels, stirring frequently until smooth. Remove from heat, and stir in the chow mien noodles and peanuts.
2. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Refrigerate until firm.
title: Chow Mein Clusters

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut in 1/2-inch cubes

steps: 1. Chop vegetables into uniform sizes.
2. Then heat margarine in skillet over medium-high heat until bubbly.
3. Add vegetables and oregano to skillet.
4. Stir-fry 4 to 5 minutes.
5. Add 1/2 cup water. Cook 5 minutes longer.
6. Stir in rice.
7. Heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally.
8. Stir in cheese.
9. Serve hot.
title: Vegetable Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Whisk together in a pan and heat until all dry ingredients are incorporated.
2. Cut a rack of St. Louis stlye pork spareribs into individual ribs and put in a container for marinating and marinate at least two hours, if not overnight.

3. Remove ribs from marinade (reserve marinade); arrange on the rack, meat (not bone) side up. Place pan on middle rack of oven; pour in enough water that it reaches halfway up the sides of the pan, making sure the water does not touch the ribs. Bake ribs for 35 minutes. Baste ribs with reserved marinade; flip and baste again. Bake for 35 minutes more. (Add more water to pan if it dries up.) Raise heat to 450°. Flip ribs again; baste with remaining marinade. Continue baking until ribs are glazed, browned, and tender, about 20 minutes more.
title: Bonnie'S Chinese Spare Ribs

ingredients.text: 2 medium green bell peppers, cut into 1/2-inch strips

steps: 1. Cut steak across grain on a slight diagonal into thin strips. In a medium bowl, combine vinegar, soy sauce, garlic and ginger. Add beef slices and toss to coat.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Toss chicken in five spice powder and red pepper flakes
2. Heat vegetable oil in skillet
3. Add chicken and onion and cook for five minutes until browned
4. Add mushrooms and garlic and cook until chicken is no longer pink
5. Stir 1/4 cup broth into cornstarch in small bowl until smooth and set aside
6. Place chicken mixture and remaining broth into crock pot with bell pepper and soy sauce cook on low for 3 and a half hours
7. Whisk cornstarch and sesame oil and put into crock pot. Cover and place on high for another 45 minutes until thickened
title: Chinese Chicken Stew

steps: 1. Put sugar and syrup in a saucepan.
2. Mix and bring to a boil. Remove from heat.
3. Add peanut butter and noodles and mix.
4. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper and allow to harden.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. In large wok, heat oil over medium high heat.
2. Add celery, onion, and green pepper; stir-fry 2 minutes or until crisp-tender.
3. Add ham, garlic powder and pepper; stir fry 3 to 4 minutes.
4. Add rice and soy sauce; stir fry 3-4 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
5. Serve with additional soy sauce, if desired.
title: Quick Ham Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients.
2. Add boneless chicken breasts.
3. Coat well.
4. Bake at 375° for 1 hour; baste frequently.
title: Orange Chicken

steps: 1. finely chop celery, carrot, and onion.
2. whisk together all ingredients except oil and marinate pork in mixture for 48 hours.
3. remove pork from marinade.
4. strain marinade into pot and reduce until thick and bubbly.
5. brush pork with 1 tbp sesame oil and grill, basting with reduced marinade.
title: Chinese Grilled Pork

steps: 1. Brown beef roast and onion in hot oil.
2. Pour oranges on top. Mix ketchup and sauce and put over roast.
3. Bake 2 1/2 hours at 325°.
title: Mandarin Roast

steps: 1. THE REST: You can use any vegetable, this combination works nicely with beef. Prepare everything first because cooking only takes a few minutes.
2. 3-4 carrots sliced in matchstick
3. 1/2 pepper of any kind also thinly sliced
4. optionally, about 1/4 cup of the thick brocolli stems, thinly sliced in matchstick (They have a great crunchy texture)
5. 2-3 tablespoons minced ginger, way smaller than a pea
6. 3-4 medium cloves of garlic minced, way smaller than a pea, 1-2 teaspoons
7. 1/4 cup chicken broth, or a little less, (too much sauce dilutes the yummy flavors), mixed with 2 tablespoons additional soy sauce
8. some hot pepper, maybe 1/8 teaspoon (I use dry habernero or cayenne or any hot pepper is ok)
9. COOK:
10. Saute meat in canola oil (or any non-flavored oil) over medium-high heat and when done, remove to a bowl, set aside
11. add a tinch more oil and add ginger and saute over medium heat but do not brown
12. When ginger done add red pepper (could be powered cayenne, just a dash,maybe 1/8th of a teaspoon, to add zest but not make it overbearingly hot)
13. Lastly, add garlic and saute, do not burn
14. Dump spice mixture over the meat in the bowl.

15. Saute carrots, then add broccoli and lastly peppers. Don't overcook the veggies, should have a crunch. When veggies almost cooked, dump in the meat/spice mix and immediately add 1/4 cup chicken broth mixed with 2 more tablespoons of soy sauce.
16. Cook everything together for 1-2 minutes at most, until piping hot.
17. SERVE
title: Jane Cody'S Awesome Stir Fry

steps: 1. In a
2. , saute zucchini in oil until tender. Add garlic; cook 1 minute longer. Stir in soy sauce; sprinkle with sesame seeds.
title: Chinese-Style Zucchini

steps: 1. Put steak in freezer until partially frozen.
2. Slice diagonally into 1/8-inch slices.
3. In bowl combine steak and 4 tablespoons cornstarch; mix well.
4. Add 4 tablespoons soy sauce, put in refrigerator 30 minutes or longer.
5. Peel carrots and slice diagonally in 1/4-inch slices.
6. Cook carrots about 5 minutes.
7. Chop onion and green pepper in bite size pieces.
8. Set aside.
title: Beef And Vegetable Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 lb large shrimp, raw and in shells
1 tablespoon light soy sauce (I like to use low-sodium)

steps: 1. Marinate the shrimp, in shells, for about 15 minutes in the soy sauce, sherry, and ginger. Drain.
2. Stir-fry in a hot pan (on med. high heat) with the peanut oil and garlic until the color of the shrimp changes to pink.
3. Add the green onions, salt and sesame oil. Toss until the onions barely wilt.
4. Serve hot and let guests remove the shells right at the table!
title: Stir-Fried Shrimp, Chinese Style

ingredients.text: 1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced on bias (or boneless sirloin steak)
8 green onions, cut into 1 inch pieces (white and light green part only)

steps: 1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a small bowl. Heat wok or skillet over high heat. Add oil to pan; swirl to coat. Add half of the beef to pan, and cook for 3 minutes or until browned. Remove the beef from pan and repeat procedure with remaining beef. Add onions; cook for 1 minute. Add soy sauce mixture; cook 1 minute. Return beef to pan; cook 1 minute. Stir in spinach, and cook 30 seconds. Top with sesame seeds.
title: Sesame Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 whole boneless skinless chicken breasts, thinly sliced *
1/2 lb. broccoli, cut into bite-size pieces *

steps: 1. *I use Market Day chicken steaks and broccoli florets!! Takes only 15 minutes to prepare!!
title: Chicken-Soy Stir-Fry(Serves 4)

steps: 1. Mix together oil, juice, honey, vinegar, Worcestershire and salt and pour over chicken.
2. Marinate overnight.
3. Bake, uncovered, for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.
title: Orange Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. finely chopped mild sweet onion

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except nuts in a large bowl.
2. Use a teaspoon to scoop out amount to form balls.
3. Roll in cashews. Chill.
4. Yields 20 appetizers.
title: Cashew Chicken Balls

steps: 1. In shallow dish, combined butter, lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper. Place bread crumbs in another dish.
2. Dip chicken in butter mix, then coat w/ crumbs. Place in a greased baking dish. Drizzle w/ remaining butter mix.
3. Bake, uncovered, at 350" for 25 - 30 minutes.
4. Serve.
title: Baked Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Preheat frypan at 300°.
2. Put cabbage and onion through meat grinder, using coarse cutter.
3. Combine ginger, salt and soy sauce. Add to meat mixture.
4. Mix well.
5. Shape into balls about 1 to 1 1/2-inches.
6. Fry in oil or shortening until done, browning well on all sides.
title: Chinese Meat Balls

ingredients.text: 1-1/2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-1/2-in. pieces
3 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and cut into 1-1/2-inch slices

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the first nine ingredients; set aside 1/4 cup for basting. Pour half into a large bowl. Add chicken; turn to coat. Pour the remaining marinade into another large bowl. Add the zucchini, onions and tomatoes; turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate chicken and vegetables for up to 4 hours or overnight.

2. Drain and discard marinade. Alternately thread chicken and vegetables onto metal or soaked wooden skewers. Grill, covered, over medium heat for 6 minutes on each side or until chicken juices run clear, basting occasionally with reserved marinade.
title: Lemon Chicken Skewers

steps: 1. Place flank steak in the freezer for 10 minutes.
title: Szechuan Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Coat chicken with flour.
2. In 10-inch skillet, melt butter until sizzling; add chicken breasts.
3. Cook over medium heat, turning once until chicken is lightly browned (10 to 14 minutes). In small bowl, combine teriyaki sauce and lemon juice.
4. Pour around chicken in pan.
5. Continue cooking, turning once, until chicken is lightly browned (5 to 6 minutes).
6. Serve over hot cooked rice, if desired.
title: Lemon Chicken Sauté

steps: 1. Sift together sugar, flour, baking powder and salt.
2. Add nuts and dates.
3. Beat eggs and add slowly to mixture.
4. Form into little balls.
5. Roll in sugar.
6. Bake on greased baking sheet at 350° for 20 minutes.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 1 bunch green onion, cut into 1 inch pieces

steps: 1. Cut beef into thin slices (I do this when slightly frozen for more ease).
2. Mix soy sauce, chili sauce, sherry, cornstarch, ginger, and pepper flakes in a small bowl. Set aside.
3. Heat 1 T. oil in a wok. Add garlic and onions, stir fry 1 minute.
