4. Remove to a bowl with a slotted spoon. Add remaining oil to wok.
5. Add meat a 1/3 at a time, stir frying until it loses it's red color.
6. Place in bowl with onions.
7. Add chili mixture to wok, heat until bubbly hot. Stir in meat and onion mixtures, stirring until sauce coats meat and onions and is warmed through.
8. Serve over rice.
title: Szechuan Beef

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb medium raw shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: 1. Break eggs into a large bowl; beat with a fork until thoroughly blended but not frothy.
2. Add shrimp, cornstarch, salt, and fish sauce; mix well.
3. Place a medium frying pan over high heat until hot.
4. Add oil, swirling to coat surface.
5. Add egg mixture and cook undisturbed until eggs are almost set, about 1 minute.
6. Stir eggs gently with a spoon and continue cooking until shrimp turn pink and eggs form creamy curds, about 2 minutes.
7. Sprinkle with green onion and serve.
title: Cantonese Shrimp Scramble

steps: 1. Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.
2. Cool and cut into squares.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Stir-fry chicken in oil for 4 minutes.
2. Combine chicken and vegetables; stir-fry 4 to 5 minutes.
3. Add 1/2 cup mayonnaise and soy sauce to taste.
title: Stir-Fry Chicken

steps: 1. Add the ginger, soy sauce, and sugar to a bowl. Add the chicken to the bowl and coat well. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour.
2. Add the almonds to a skillet and toast on medium heat for about 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from the heat and set aside.
3. In the same skillet, add the oil, carrot, and shallot. Saute for 5 minutes. Add the almonds and mix well. Set aside.
4. Drain the chicken and add to the skillet. Saute for 3 minutes on each side.
5. Add the almonds and vegetables. Cover with chicken stock and let simmer 10 minutes. Before finishing, add the cornstarch dissolved in a little cold water. Let simmer for another 2 minutes.
title: Chinese-Style Almond Chicken

steps: 1. Rub fish with Puritan oil.
2. Roll fish in corn flake crumbs. Season fish with salt and pepper.
title: Heart Healthy Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Cut pork into 4-in x 1/2-in x 1/4-in strips; place in a bowl.
2. Add garlic and 2 T soy sauce; cover and refrigerate 2-4 hours.
3. Meanwhile, combine broth, cornstarch, ginger, and remaining soy sauce; mix well and set aside.
4. Heat oil in a large skillet or wok on high; stir-fry pork until no longer pink; remove and keep warm.
5. Add carrots and celery to skillet; stir-fry 3-4 minutes.
6. Add onion, cabbage, and spinach; stir-fry 2-3 minutes.
7. Stir broth mixture and add to skillet along with pork.
8. Cook and stir until broth thickens, about 3-4 minutes.
9. Serve immediately.
title: Pork Chow Mein Made Healthier

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon cornstarch, dissolved in 1 tablespoon water

steps: 1. Combine the lemon juice, mustard, garlic and white pepper. Beat in 5 tablespoons of the olive oil. Put the chicken in a shallow container and pour the lemon mixture over it. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

2. In a large skillet, saute the almonds in 1/2 tablespoon of the olive oil until golden. Remove from skillet and reserve. Wipe out the skillet. Drain the chicken, reserving the lemon marinade. Add remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil to skillet, then add chicken breasts and brown over high heat until breast is brown on each side (6 to 10 minutes). Remove from skillet and reserve.

3. Strain the lemon marinade into the skillet. Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute. Add chicken broth and cornstarch/water mixture. Cook over high heat, stirring occasionally, until the mixture reduces by half (about 5 minutes). Add marmalade and stir over medium heat until melted. Stir in the butter a bit at a time over high heat, stirring constantly. Stir in parsley and red pepper flakes. Return chicken to skillet and heat through. Add reserved almonds and garnish with lemon slices.
title: Almond Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 pound flank steak, cut into bite-size pieces
3 large green onions, sliced diagonally into 1/2 inch pieces

steps: 1. Place flank steak and cornstarch into a resealable plastic bag. Shake the bag to evenly coat the flank steak with the cornstarch. Allow to steak rest for 10 minutes.

2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir steak until evenly browned, 2 to 4 minutes. Place onion, garlic, flank steak, green onions, soy sauce, water, brown sugar, ginger, and hoisin sauce in a slow cooker. Cook on Low setting for about 4 hours.
title: Slow Cooker Mongolian Beef

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup peanut oil, heated to smoking point

steps: 1. Fill a large kettle with water and bring to a boil. (An 8-quart pot two-thirds filled with water works great for a 2 1/2 to 3-pound bird.)
2. When the water boils, place the whole cleaned chicken into it. When the water stops boiling, take the chicken out.

3. Cover the pot and when the water again boils, place the chicken back in the pot. Cover the pot and turn off the heat. Leave the chicken in the pot and the pot on the burner. After one hour, the chicken is done. Remove, and cool.
4. Debone the chicken and tear the meat into small strips.
5. Place them on a large platter.
6. Clean the green onions, and split each onion down the middle. Then cut them up into 1/2-inch pieces and place over the mound of chicken.
7. Pour the soy sauce and the sesame oil over the chicken.
8. Pour the salt over the onions.
9. When you are ready to serve, pour the hot peanut oil over onions and chicken.
10. Toss like salad and serve.
title: Chinese Boiled Chicken With Onions - Chow Yow Gai

steps: 1. Marinate chicken with the soy sauce,sugar and wine for at least 30 minutes or overnight.
2. Place chicken onto a baking pan, skin side up and bake in a preheated oven of 450F for 25 - 30 minutes or until cooked and skin is golden brown.
3. Squeeze lemon juice over chicken and serve immediately.
title: Chinese Baked Chicken

steps: 1. In bowl, combine cabbage, rice, carrot, 1/4 c scallions, sesame seeds, garlic, ginger, and pepper.
2. In separate bowl, beat eggs with 1 TBL soy sauce; stir into vegetable mixture. Spray nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray and heat.
3. Drop 1/4 c batter for each pancake into heated skillet; cook, turning once, until brown on each side. Repeat until all batter is used.

4. In small saucepan, combine broth, remaining 1 tsp soy sauce and 1/4 c scallions. Bring to a boil; stir in dissolved cornstarch and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Serve sauce over pancakes.
title: Egg Foo Yung

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb lean pork, cut into 1/2 inch cubes

steps: 1. Combine pork and 2 tbsp soy sauce chill 30 minute Combine remaining 2 tbsp soy sauce, lemon juice, sugar, cornstarch, crushed red pepper, and 1/4c water. In wok or large skillet, stir fry pork and garlic in hot oil 3 min, or till brown.
2. Add bell pepper and onion; stir-fry 3 minute Add cornstarch mixture; cook and stir till slightly thickened. Add peanuts. Refrigerate leftovers.
title: Kung Pao Pork

steps: 1. Cook first five ingredients in small amount of oil for 3 minutes.
2. Stir in chicken broth.
3. Add chicken.
4. Add remaining ingredients.
5. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes.
6. Serve over rice or noodles.
7. Salt to taste.
title: Chicken Chow Mein

steps: 1. Remove peel from all fruit, being careful to remove only the colored part from the lemon, and slice the peel thinly, using scissors or a sharp knife. Place slivers in a small non-reactive pan with the water, bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 20 minutes.

2. Remove and discard white pithy rind and seeds from the lemon. Chop orange and lemon pulp finely in a food processor or with a sharp knife.Add to the saucepan, return to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer 20 minutes.Add sugar to mixture, return to boil, and boil rapidly, uncovered, until mixture forms a gel, about 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat.
3. Ladle into hot jars and process 10 minutes in a boiling water bath.
title: Small-Batch Mandarin Orange (Or Clementine) Marmalade

steps: 1. Fry beef in frying pan until broken up and well browned.
2. Drain off fat and spread meat in 2 quart casserole; Set aside.
3. Spread snow peas over top of meat.
4. Slice celery on an angle; spread over peas.
5. In bowl combine onions, soup, milk and pepper; mix well and pour over celery.
6. Sprinkle chow mein noodles over all.
7. Cover and bake in 350F for 40 minutes.
title: Chinese Chow

ingredients.text: 2 Tbsp. dry sherry (do not use cooking sherry)
1 large pepper, cut in medium strips
1 medium zucchini, quartered and thinly sliced

steps: 1. Put cornstarch, salt, garlic and sherry in bowl; stir well. Add chicken that has been cut in 3/4-inch pieces (bite size) and mix well.
2. Let sit for 1/2 to 1 hour.
3. Stir again to make sure all pieces are separated.
4. Add 1/4 cup of oil to skillet and when hot, add chicken stirring quickly about 2 to 3 minutes.
5. Add vegetables and sprinkle liberally with soy sauce.
6. Continue stirring about 3 to 5 minutes.
7. Vegetables should be medium crisp, not mushy. Serve with a bowl of fluffy white rice.
title: Oriental Stir-Fry Chicken

steps: 1. In a medium skillet, cook the ginger root in oil, stirring, over medium heat for 1 minute.
2. Add the kale and raise the heat to medium high.
3. Add the soy sauce and water, and stir-fry until the kale is wilted but still slightly crunchy, about 3 minutes.
4. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
5. Serve warm or cold.
6. You may substitute spinach or bok choy for the kale.
7. Enjoy!
title: Kale And Ginger Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 12 ounces boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1 inch pieces
5 ounces butternut squash, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces
1 medium zucchini, cut lengthwise and then sliced
4 garlic cloves, minced (2 tsp minced garlic)

steps: 1. Spray skillet with non-stick cooking spray.
2. Saute onion and garlic over high heat until browned.
3. Add chicken; cook one minute without stirring. Turn and cook two or three minutes more.
4. Add the spices and stir for one minute.
5. Stir in squash, chicken broth, and raisins and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cover. Simmer for 15 minutes, until squash is just tender-- not mushy.
6. Add in zucchini and simmer, uncovered for 5 minutes.
title: Moroccan Chicken Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and sliced

steps: 1. Cut chicken into thin strips and set aside.
2. In a small bowl, combine orange juice, honey, soy sauce, cornstarch and ginger; mix well.
3. Heat 1 Tablespoon oil in a large skillet or wok over medium heat.
4. Add all vegetables except pea pods.
5. Stir fry about 3 minutes, or until vegies are as done as you like.
6. Remove vegies and set aside.
7. Pour remaining oil into skillet.
8. Add chicken; stir fry about 3 minutes.
9. Return vegies to skillet; add sauce mixture, pea pods and nuts.
10. Cook and stir over medium high heat until sauce is thickened.
11. Serve over hot rice.
title: Chicken Honey Nut Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lbs beef flank steak, cut into stir-fry sized strips

steps: 1. Spray slow cooker with non-stick cooking spray.
2. Place cornstarch in a bowl. Coat each piece of steak in cornstarch and place in crock pot.
3. Discard any remaining cornstarch.
4. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl and pour over beef in crock pot.
5. Cook in crockpot on high for 2-3 hours or low for 4-5 hours.
6. Serve over rice, topped with additional sliced green onions.
title: Slow Cooker Mongolian Beef

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb sirloin steak, trimmed of fat, cut in half lengthwise and thinly sliced
10 raw shrimp, peeled, deveined and chopped (21-25 per pound)
1 lb bok choy, preferably baby bok choy, trimmed and sliced into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Whisk rice wine, oyster sauce and cornstarch in a small bowl until the cornstarch is dissolved.
2. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in a large nonstick skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
3. Add beef and crushed red pepper to taste; cook, stirring, until the beef begins to brown, 1 to 2 minutes.
4. Add shrimp and continue to cook, stirring, until the shrimp is opaque and pink, 1 to 2 minutes.
5. Transfer the beef, shrimp and any juices to a plate.
6. Heat the remaining 2 teaspoons oil over medium-high heat in the same pan.
7. Add bok choy and cook, stirring, until it begins to wilt, 2 to 4 minutes.
8. Stir in the cornstarch mixture. Return the beef-shrimp mixture to the pan and cook, stirring, until heated through and the sauce has thickened slightly, about 1 minute.
title: Spicy Beef With Shrimp And Bok Choy

steps: 1. Brown ground beef and onion.
2. Drain in ovenware dish.
3. Put 1/2 of the can of mixed vegetables in bottom of dish.
4. Top with half of ground beef and onion mixture.
5. Add other half mixed vegetables.
6. Add other 1/2 ground beef and onion mixture.
7. Top with mashed potatoes.
8. Heat before serving.
9. Ready to eat with salad and rolls.
title: Chinese Casserole

ingredients.text: 3 lb. chicken, cut up and skinned

steps: 1. Grease foil-lined pan.
2. Heat oven to 375°.
3. Place oats, paprika, oregano, salt and pepper in the blender container and mix well.
4. Stir in parsley.
5. Coat chicken in oat mixture.
6. Dip into milk and coat again with oat mixture.
7. Place on rack.
title: Zesty Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 3 medium carrots, cut diagonally into 1/2-inch pieces
1 small onion, cut into thin slices and separated into rings

steps: 1. Mix Bisquick and pepper in a large plastic bag.
2. Stir chicken into eggs;
3. Remove chicken with slotted spoon and place in bag with baking mix. Shake bag until chicken is coated; remove chicken from bag.
4. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat until hot.
5. Stir-fry carrots 2 minutes; add green pepper and stir-fry 2 minutes. Remove from skillet.
6. Keep warm. Add remaining oil to skillet.
7. Heat until hot.
8. Stir-fry chicken until golden brown. Add carrots, green pepper and onion. Stir-fry until warm, about 2 minutes.
9. Stir in pineapple.
10. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Crispy Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons orange zest (grated or julienned (try to avoid the white pith)
2 tablespoons mustard, prepared table mustard (preferably wholegrain mustard)
1 tablespoon rosemary, fresh, chopped (or 1/2 Tbsp dried)

steps: 1. Set oven at 350 deg F/180 deg Celsius.
2. In a small pot, mix all the ingredients EXCEPT the chicken pieces. Use a whisk to mix everything well.
3. Simmer this sauce, stirring now and then, until the sauce has reduced by one quarter or more. This reduction process will thicken it slightly and intensify the flavours.

4. Watch it, as it can boil over if heat is too high. You want a brisk bubbly simmer. As the liquid evaporates, the sauce will thicken just a little. Donlt worry if some "scum" forms. It's just foam, and will disappear as the sauce boils.

5. Add the brandy after you've removed the sauce from the heat. (The alcohol will evaporate in the baking process, but it gives additional flavour, and boy, you can taste that extra flavour, especially if you use a good brandy/cognac/Armagnac).
6. Taste a little of the sauce with a teaspoon, being very careful not to burn your tongue! If too acid, stir in more honey, or a little sugar. You want a tangy taste.
7. Pack the chicken pieces, skin side up, in a large oven dish, preferably in one layer, and pour over the thickened orange sauce. Put in preheated oven, open.
8. Bake about 3/4 hour. You will need to check after 15 mins., and lay a piece of foil loosely over the chicken, to prevent burning.
9. Baste with the sauce a few times during baking. Take off the foil to let the chicken brown.
10. Note: if you use fewer chicken pieces, as I often do, you'll probably have sauce left over. Save for another purpose, or add it to the chicken when baking is nearly done.

11. To serve to guests, put in heated serving dish, and decorate with thin strips of orange zest and a scatter of very finely chopped parsley. Goes well with fluffy rice or roast potatoes, young green beans (steamed) and a large salad. Serve with an off-dry wine such as a good blanc de noir, chenin blanc or a dry rose.
title: South African Orange Chicken

ingredients.text: 3 lbs pork tenderloin, cut in bite sized chunks
1 cup leek, thinly sliced (washed well first, as they can be sandy)
2 cups carrots, cut into rounds (I like to cut them on the bias to look pretty & you don't need to peel them)

steps: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet over med/high heat.

2. Saute the tenderloin chunks quickly for about 5 minutes(watching them closely to not burn the outsides of the meat) to get some color on them. This will get rid of a little fat and liquid from the meat as well.
3. With a slotted spoon, scoop out the meat and place in your slow cooker, discard any fat or liquid from the meat cooking.
4. Add the mushrooms, leeks, carrots, water chestnuts, and garlic to your slow cooker also.
5. In a medium sized bowl, whisk together the orange marmalade, chili sauce, hoisin sauce, dry sherry, soy sauce, and crushed red pepper.
6. Pour sauce mixture over the ingredients in the slow cooker, and stir to coat everything well.
7. Cover with lid, put your slow cooker on High and cook for 2 1/2 hours.
8. After 2 1/2 hours, mix the cornstarch and water in a small cup until smooth, and add it to the mixture in your slow cooker.
9. Stir for a couple minutes, until you see the sauce thicken slightly, then close lid again and let cook on High for another 30 minutes.
title: Spicy Chinese Pork For The Crock Pot

steps: 1. Cut chicken in thin strips, place in shallow dish.
2. Combine teriyaki sauce, ginger and garlic.
3. Pour over chicken.
4. Cover and chill 1 hour.
5. Drain chicken, discard marinade.
6. Stir fry celery,and onions in 1 TBS oil in large skillet 3 minutes.
7. Remove from skillet and set aside.
8. Stir fry chicken in remaining oil 4 minutes.
9. Remove from skillet and set aside.
10. Mix broth,cornstarch and soy sauce.
11. Pour into skillet and cook and stir until thickened.
12. Add vegetables, chicken and cashews, stir until heated thru.
13. Serve over chow mein noodles.
title: Cashew Chicken Chow Mein (Easy)

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon peeled and grated fresh gingerroot
4 cups chopped mixed vegetables (e.g., broccoli, red bell peppers, carrots, mushrooms)

steps: 1. In large saucepan or wok, heat 2 teaspoons (10 mL) sesame oil. Add tofu and stir-fry until golden and slightly crisp.
2. Add garlic and ginger and cook until softened.
3. In small bowl, combine next 7 ingredients and remaining sesame oil to create sauce.
4. Add sauce and chopped vegetables to wok and stir-fry until vegetables are tender-crisp.
title: Crispy Tofu Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1 to 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes

steps: 1. In a 4- or 5-quart slow cooker, combine the first six ingredients. Stir in chicken, onion and broccoli. Cook, covered, on low until vegetables are tender, about 2 hours. Top with green onions and sesame seeds to serve.
title: General Tso’S Stew

ingredients.text: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 8 oz each)

steps: 1. Place the chicken on a cutting board. Working with one breast at a time, place your hand on top and use a sharp knife to cut the breast in half horizontally, to make two thinner chicken cutlets. (Don't worry if they're not perfectly even, mine never are!) Place each cutlet between two sheets of plastic wrap and use a meat mallet or skillet to pound to 1/4-inch thickness.
2. Season the chicken on both sides with the salt and pepper. Lightly dredge each cutlet in flour, shaking off the excess.

3. Set a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tablespoon of the butter and the olive oil to the pan. Once the butter is melted and the pan is hot, add the chicken. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a plate and tent with foil to keep warm.

4. Reduce the heat to medium, and add the chicken broth and lemon juice to the pan. Cook for 1-2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly, scraping the bottom of the skillet to loosen any brown bits. Add the lemon slices to the sauce and let sit undisturbed for about 30 seconds. Remove the pan from the heat and add the parsley and remaining tablespoon of butter. Stir until the butter is melted and the sauce is smooth. Pour the sauce over the chicken and serve (you can garnish with the lemon slices if desired).
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Put the hens in a baking dish.
2. Mix the hoisin sauce, red wine, scallions, ginger, garlic and sesame oil together in a bowl and pour the marinade over the hens.
3. Cover and refrigerate the hens for 1-2 days.
4. Preheat grill to medium heat.
5. Put the hens on the grill bone side down and grill, covered, about 10 minutes.
6. Gently turn them over and continue grilling for another 10 to 15 minutes or until the juices run clear.
7. Let the hens rest for 5 minutes before serving. Enjoy!

title: Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Dried shrimp gives this Chinese dish a punch of salty umami flavor. You can find it at an Asian grocery store in the frozen or refrigerated section. Look for small-sized dried shrimp, about a 1/4-inch in size. If you use medium or large dried shrimp, hydrate the shrimp with more water (1 cup for medium-sized shrimp, 1 1/4 cup for large) and for longer time (45 to 60 minutes), then chop it up into smaller 1/4-inch chunks. To make this recipe vegetarian, omit the dried shrimp and use four or five dried shiitake mushrooms, rehydrated, and sliced thin.
2. Rehydrate the dried shrimp:

3. Place the dried shrimp in a small bowl and pour the boiling water over it. Cover with a small plate and let sit for 30 minutes so the shrimp can rehydrate. The shrimp will be lighter in color and plump up slightly.
4. Prep the cabbage:
5. Meanwhile, split the napa cabbage in half lengthwise. Rinse the cabbage and shake it dry. Cut out the core of the cabbage and discard.

6. Set out two large bowls. Cut the remaining cabbage into 1-inch pieces, putting the thicker white pieces at the bottom of the cabbage into one bowl and the top thinner leafy green pieces into the other bowl.
7. Drain the shrimp:
8. Once the shrimp has rehydrated, drain it and discard the liquid.
9. Cook the shrimp and cabbage:
10. In a large wok or skillet over high heat add the peanut oil, swirling it around to coat the pan.

11. Heat until the oil looks shimmering hot, then carefully add the scallions, ginger, and rehydrated shrimp, paying specially attention as the wet ingredients may cause the hot oil to splatter. Toss with a spatula until the scallions are bright green and the entire mixture is fragrant, about 1 minute.

12. Add the thicker white part of the napa cabbage to the pan and lower the heat to medium high. Continue to cook and stir for 3 to 4 minutes, or until the edges of the cabbage pieces start to look slightly translucent but the center of the cabbage pieces are still opaque white.
13. Reduce the heat to medium low and add the leafy green pieces of cabbage into the pan. Cook until the leaves are wilted, about 2 minutes.
14. Make a cornstarch slurry:

15. In a small bowl, combine the soy sauce, cold water, and cornstarch, stirring to make a slurry. Then pour over the cabbage and continue to cook and stir until a sauce has thickened slightly to the consistency of whole milk.
16. Season the stir fry:
17. Season the stir fry with salt and pepper, then taste and add more salt and pepper if you wish. The cabbage will be translucent and silky looking, with specks of dried shrimp all over.
title: Napa Cabbage with Dried Shrimp

steps: 1. Fried rice is best made with leftover rice that's at least a day old. Otherwise it becomes gummy in the skillet.

2. If you don’t have any leftover rice from the night before, cook a batch of rice and spread it on a large baking sheet or several large plates. Let the rice dry out for about 1 to 2 hours before using it for fried rice.

3. Rice sticks to the pan very easily, so make sure to use a wok or pan that doesn’t have a sticky surface. I usually cook stir-fries in my seasoned carbon steel wok, but cast iron or nonstick pans work well, too. You might need to add a little more oil if things aren’t releasing easily.
4. Prepare the chicken:

5. Chop the chicken into small 1/4-inch to 1/2-inch cubes. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of salt over the chicken and mix to combine. Set the chicken aside for about 10 minutes (I usually use this time to chop all the vegetables).
6. Scramble the egg:

7. Heat a wok or large sauté pan over medium-high heat. Swirl in a tablespoon of oil and add the whisked eggs. Use a spatula to quickly scramble the eggs, breaking the curds into smaller pieces as they come together. Transfer the eggs to a plate.
8. Cook the chicken:
9. Add another tablespoon of oil in the wok or pan. Add the chicken and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Turn off the heat and transfer the cooked chicken to a plate.
10. Using your spatula, scrape off any chicken bits that are still stuck to the wok so they don't burn during the next step. You can also use paper towels to wipe down your wok or pan.
11. Cook the vegetables:

12. Swirl 1 tablespoon of oil into the wok over medium-high heat. Add the diced onions and cook them for 1 minute, until they start to soften. Mix in the minced garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add the diced carrots and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and the peas, and stir to incorporate.
13. Cook the rice:

14. Add the rice to the wok or pan on top of the vegetables and stir to combine. Using the back of your spatula, smash any large chunks of rice to break them apart. Add the white and green parts of the sliced scallions (save the dark green parts) and five-spice powder. Stir to incorporate. If the rice starts to stick to the pan, stir in a little more oil.

15. Drizzle the soy sauce and sesame oil over the rice and stir to incorporate. Stir in the cooked chicken, scrambled eggs, and the dark parts of the scallions. Stir briefly to bring it together, and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes.
16. Serve:
17. Taste, and add more soy sauce if necessary. Serve immediately.

steps: 1. Mince the cilantro, garlic and onion. Combine them with the ground meat, water, pepper flakes and butter and set aside.
2. Heat water until it is hot but not boiling.
3. Combine the water with sifted flour and salt.

4. When all of the ingredients are combined, begin to kneed the dough. The dough should be dry enough not to stick to your fingers. Continue to add small amounts of flour until a smooth ball is formed. The dough should be very stiff, similar to pie crust.
5. Cover the dough and all it to sit for 15 minutes in a warm dry place.
6. Knead for an additional 6 minutes, then set aside.
7. Cut the dough into 2 equal parts.
8. Roll the dough out on a clean floured surface.
9. Cut the dough into 3" rounds, using a form such as a cookie cutter.
10. Roll out each round until it is about 5 inches in diameter.
11. Place 1 1/2 tablespoons of filling in the center of the dough round.
12. Pin the dumpling using an accordion style fold.
13. Pinch the top tightly to ensure no filling can escape.
14. Place the dumplings in a pot of salted boiling water. When they float to the surface after about 7 minutes (bottom side up) they are done.
15. Place the dumplings on a serving platter.
16. Sprinkle with finely ground pepper (optional) and serve immediately.
17. For a video demonstration for folding the dumplings, go to https://www.venturists.net/khinkali-georgian-beef-pork-soup-dumplings/.

8. About 2 minutes. Enjoy!
title: Chinese Egg Drop Soup

steps: 1. Scramble (finely, little pieces) the eggs in a wok. Remove and set aside.
2. Add one tablespoon of shortening to hot wok (medium high heat) and add onions. Saute (I like mine caramelized a bit) onions to your preference.
3. Add to wok the celery and carrot. Saute for about ten minutes, stirring often.
4. Add garlic and saute for another four to five minutes.
5. Add remaining two tablespoons of shortening to wok and add cold rice.
6. Cook for about fifteen minutes, stirring every three to four minutes. (I let my rice caramelize also).
7. Mix ginger and soy sauce together, toss in with rice.
8. Add scrambled eggs to rice.
9. Cook, stirring, another five minutes or until your preference.
10. Makes 4 one cup servings.
title: Ali'S Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat oils in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add carrot, ginger, red pepper, and garlic; saute for 1 minute. Add rice; saute 2 minutes. Stir in shrimp and soy sauce; saute 1 minute. Remove from heat; stir in cilantro.
title: Shrimp Cilantro Fried Rice

steps: 1. After dicing carrots, celery and bacon, cook eggs in skillet and put into another container.
2. Stir together on medium heat the rice, soy sauce and seasonings.
3. Then add vegetables, bacon and eggs.
4. Leave on low for about 1/2 hour.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. chopped beef, pork or chicken

steps: 1. Fry bacon until brown.
2. Add chopped ingredients and fry 2 to 3 minutes.
3. Add rice.
4. Cook 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally. Mix eggs and soy sauce in bowl.
5. Pour over rice and stir until cooked.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. First, place your rice on to cook.
2. In a skillet, salt and pepper pork chops and fry until brown on each side.
3. Cut chops away from bone into small bite size pieces.
4. In a small saucepan, melt butter.
5. Then slowly cook bell pepper and onion until done.
6. Then add chops.
7. Let simmer until rice is done.
8. Mix rice and ingredients in saucepan all together in a big pan.
9. Serves about 4 people.
title: Pork Fried Rice Or Shrimp

ingredients.text: 4 c. shelled fresh or frozen green peas

steps: 1. Combine peas, water, onion, parsley and salt.
2. Bring to a boil, simmer for 40 minutes.
3. Puree part or all in a blender.
4. Add wine, milk, butter and pepper.
5. Add dumplings, simmer 10 minutes.
title: Cream Of Fresh Pea Soup With Corn Dumplings

ingredients.text: 2 boneless chicken breasts, chopped in bite sized pieces
10 -12 asparagus spears, broken off at soft spot

steps: 1. Heat up 2 tbsp oil in a wok, when hot, add chicken, 1 minced clove garlic and 1/2 tsp ginger; cook through, remove chicken and set aside.
2. Clean pan and add 2 tbsp oil and add asparagus, 1 minced clove garlic and 1/2 tsp ginger, cook for 2 minutes.
3. Add onion and mushrooms and cook until veggies are just done.
4. Add the oyster sauce.
5. Serve.
title: Bea'S Oriental Chicken And Asparagus Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 cups rice, best if cooked the day before & kept in the fridge
3 tablespoons soy sauce, never have too much soy sauce

steps: 1. If your shrimp is frozen cook it in 2 Tablespoons oil. Cook till it is thawed and all the water is gone. Take out of pan.
2. By hand or food processor (which I prefer) finely cut up your green onions, garlic and carrots.
3. Put your shredded mix in with 3 Tablespoons oil, rice, soy sauce, salt.
4. Cook stirring often till all if well heated and add your shrimp and eggs.
5. Continue cooking till your vegetables are done.
6. Serve with Soy sauce - like I said never enough soy sauce!
title: Shrimp Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 3 whole Large Carrots, Peeled And Chopped
1 whole Red Pepper, Seeded And Chopped

steps: 1. In a large nonstick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat. Add onion and garlic and cook for 2-3 minutes until softened. Add carrots, mushrooms and red pepper and continue to cook, stirring, until crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. Move veggies to a bowl.
2. In the same skillet, add another tablespoon of olive oil and cook eggs, stirring, until scrambled, then remove them to the same bowl as veggies.

3. If needed, add remaining tablespoon of olive oil to skillet and add cold rice. Make sure rice is cold, not just cooked, or it will end up mushy. Cook for 3-4 minutes, breaking up clumps and stirring until heated. Turn heat down to low and add back veggies and eggs, cashews and soy sauce. Stir everything together and cook until heated through.
title: Veggie Fried Rice

steps: 1. In a large skillet, heat oil. Quickly stir-fry the onion and garlic.
2. Add chicken and cook for a few minutes until just done. Push chicken to sides of pan.
3. Scramble eggs in pan. Push to side.
4. Add shrimp, mushrooms, bean sprouts, broccoli and parsley and rice.
5. Mix in chicken and eggs and stir-fry 4-5 minutes. Do not burn.
6. Add soy sauce and pepper and stir-fry another 2-3 minutes.
7. Garnish with green onions.
title: Chicken Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat oil in large skillet or wok at high heat 3 to 4 minutes. Add cabbage, bell pepper, and onion, and stir-fry 7 to 10 minutes or until crisp-tender or to desired degree of doneness. Stir in cilantro and remaining ingredients.
2. Spicy Cabbage Stir-fry: Stir in 3 tablespoons jalapeno jelly with cabbage, bell pepper, and onion. Proceed as directed.
title: Cabbage Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes

steps: 1. In a medium skillet over medium heat, melt butter; cook potatoes and onion 10 to 15 minutes, or until tender. Add milk and pepper and heat until hot. Do not boil. Remove from heat and set aside.
2. In a medium bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, and water; mix well to form a stiff dough (you may need to use your hands). Roll dough into a 1/2-inch rope, then cut into 1/2-inch pieces.

3. In a soup pot over medium-high heat, bring chicken broth to a boil. Add carrot and drop dough pieces into broth. Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook 15 to 20 minutes, or until dumplings are light and fluffy in center. Add potato mixture and parsley to soup pot and heat 5 minutes, or until heated through.
title: Mr. Food Potato Dumpling Soup

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon gingerroot, finely chopped or 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger
4 green onions, cut in 1 inch pieces

steps: 1. In a large nonstick skillet, stir fry carrots, ginger and garlic in oil over medium heat for 5 minutes or till crisp tender.
2. Add green onions, broth and salt. Stir fry 1 minute more. Stir in fresh spinach and heat through.
title: Carrot And Spinach Stirfry

steps: 1. Put small amount of oil or butter in skillet; add almonds and cook over low heat, stirring, until browned.
2. Add onion, green pepper and seasonings.
3. Stir together and cook for 5 minutes.
4. Add rice and soy sauce.
5. Mix well and cook until well heated (approximately 10 minutes).
title: Fried Rice Almondine

steps: 1. Heat in skillet the salad oil and garlic, then add the celery, asparagus, onion and mushrooms.
2. Stir-fry until crisp-tender.
3. Add soy sauce.
title: Stir-Fry Asparagus

steps: 1. Blend soy sauce, oil, sherry, honey and sugar.
2. Pour 1/2 over chicken and let set 2 hours.
3. Cook pasta (al dente), parcook (not all the way) the snow peas (you want them crunchy).
4. Mix everything else together.
5. Add cashews right before serving, they may get soggy.
title: Chinese Chicken Salad

steps: 1. In a saucepan bring water, salt and soy sauce to a boil. Add rice and stir. Remove from heat, cover and let stand 5 minutes.
2. Heat oil in a medium skillet or wok over medium heat. Saute onions and green beans for 2 to 3 minutes. Pour in egg and fry for 2 minutes, scrambling egg while it cooks.
3. Stir in the cooked rice, mix well and sprinkle with pepper.
title: Egg Fried Rice

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in a covered pot in boiling salted water for 3 to 5 minutes.
2. Drain.
3. Combine 2 tablespoons water, teriyaki sauce and cornstarch; set aside.
4. Cook onion and garlic in hot oil for 1 minute.
5. Add cabbage.
6. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
7. Add potatoes. Stir-fry another 2 minutes.
8. Add teriyaki mixture and parsley. Cook for 1 minute.
title: Cabbage Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 c. meat of choice, cooked, salt and peppered and chopped

steps: 1. Fry onion and rice in oil until golden.
2. Fry eggs until firm. Cut into squares.
3. Add eggs, meat, soy sauce, vegetables, salt and pepper to rice.
4. Fry for a few minutes and serve.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Using a Rice Cooker, cook the Jasmine Rice. (You can use a different method to cook it, if you want.).
2. Scramble and Cook the egg.
3. Chop egg up and put on a small plate.
4. When rice is done, add garlic salt, stir with rice still in cooker.
5. Stir in Soy Sauce, and egg.
6. Enjoy!
title: Mock Fried Rice

steps: 1. In a large bowl, place shrimp, seasoning with salt and pepper; set aside.
2. In a smaller bowl, mix the water with the sugar, oyster sauce, and corn starch; set aside.
3. Heat your wok, or skillet, over high heat; stir fry oil, garlic, onion, and shrimp.
4. Once shrimps become opaque and a pink color, add asparagus.
5. Stir in cornstarch mixture and stir until sauce thickens; remove from heat and stir in green onion.
6. Serve with hot white rice as desired.
title: Shrimp And Asparagus Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 2 1/2 None lemons, 2 chopped, 1/2 zested and juiced
1/4 lb spring onions, trimmed and thinly sliced

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Mix the lemon zest, lemon juice, and 2 tbsp olive oil together and season. Spread over the chicken. Fill the chicken with the chopped lemon then place in a roasting pan. Mix the thyme, potatoes, 3 tbsp olive oil and the olives together and season. Spread around the chicken then bake for 1 hour 20-30 mins, until cooked through.

2. Meanwhile, place the red lentils and cold vegetable stock in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 5-6 mins over low heat. Remove from the heat and leave to sit for 2-3 mins. Mix 3 tbsp water, the vinegar and 2 tbsp olive oil into the lentils and season.
3. To serve, mix the lettuce, spring onions and tomatoes together in a serving bowl. Add the dressed lentils on top. Remove the chicken from the oven and serve.
title: Mediterranean Lemon Chicken With Lentil Salad

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lbs skinless salmon fillets, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces
1 1/2 lbs asparagus, trimmed and cut into 2 inch pieces

steps: 1. Heat non-stick skillet or wok over medium-high heat until hot.
2. Add fish and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
3. Cook fish 5-7 minutes or until fish turns opaque throughout, gently stirring occasionally.
4. Transfer fish to platter and keep warm.
5. To same skillet, add asparagus and red pepper, cook covered for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender/crisp, stirring occasionally.
6. Meanwhile in a small bowl, whisk together green onion, soy sauce, vinegar, ginger, garlic, cornstarch, sugar and water until well blended.
7. Add soy sauce mixture to vegetables and bring to boil.
8. Boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
9. Spoon vegetable mixture over fish and toss gently to coat.
10. Serve!
title: Salmon And Asparagus Stir Fry

steps: 1. 1. Spray a medium to large size skillet with oil and heat over medium-high.
2. 2. Cook onion in oil until slightly softened.
3. 3. Add pumpkin and rice and stir well.
4. 4. Push rice to one side of the pan and pour beaten eggs onto exposed skillet surface.
5. 5. Let cook slightly and stir in such a way that the eggs are scrambled.
6. 6. Stir rice mixture into eggs and sprinkle with soy. Stir and let cook a few more minutes.
7. 7. Remove from heat and enjoy!
title: Pumpkin Fried Rice

steps: 1. Combine first 5 ingredients.
2. Pour over cabbage and oranges.
3. Toss.
title: Mandarin Coleslaw

ingredients.text: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into 1/2-inch chunks

steps: 1. Mix chicken, broth, rice, pepper, zucchini, lemon peel, lemon juice, butter, cornstarch and garlic powder in 2-quart microwave casserole.
2. Cover.
3. Microwave on High 10 minutes or until chicken is cooked through, stirring halfway through cooking time.
4. Let stand 5 minutes.
5. Stir.
title: Microwave Lemon Chicken And Rice

steps: 1. Fry onion in butter until tender.
2. Add rice, soy sauce, pepper, parsley and garlic salt.
3. Cook over low heat 5 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
4. Add egg, stirring constantly. Cook on low heat 5 minutes more.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 2 None scallions, chopped, plus extra curls for garnish

steps: 1. Bring chicken stock to a boil. Add rice and bring back to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until rice is tender.
2. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add eggs and cook until lightly set. Flip over and cook for another 30 seconds. Remove from pan and slice.

3. Add remaining oil to pan. Cook scallions, garlic and carrot for 2 mins, or until carrot wilts. Add rice, parsley and soy sauce. Cook until heated through. Stir in egg. Serve warm, garnished with scallion curls.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat 2 tsp oil in a wok over high heat. Add eggs and swirl to coat sides of wok. Cook for 30 seconds, until eggs sets. Slide omelette onto a cutting board, roll up and slice thinly. Set aside.

2. Add remaining oil. Stir-fry carrots for 2 mins. Add garlic, peas and 1/2 of the onions. Stir-fry for 1 min. Add soy sauce and fish sauce. Simmer for 1 min. Add rice and toss for 1 min, until combined. Add sliced omelette, cilantro and remaining onions. Toss to combine. Serve hot.
title: Vegetable Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. bacon, fried crisp and broken into small pieces
3 eggs, cooked and scrambled very soft

steps: 1. Stir-fry rice in hot oil for 1 minute. Add sugar, salt and soy sauce. Stir until heated through. Add eggs, scallions and bacon. Stir to mix and serve.
title: Fried Rice With Bacon

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. chopped sweet pepper (maybe 1 hot pepper)

steps: 1. Heat oil about 1 minute.
2. Add vegetables with wooden spoon. Stir constantly until food is only wilted, but still crunchy.
3. The secret of good stir-fry is not to overcook.
title: Stir-Fry Vegetables

steps: 1. Rinse green beans and trim ends off. Leave beans in long lengths.
2. Blanche beans for 4 minutes in hot water. Immediately immerse into bowl of ice water to stop cooking and retain bright color. Remove and pat dry.
3. In a small bowl, mix all remaining ingredients except butter. Place beans in a saucepan with butter. Add mixture and sautee green beans for 2 minutes. Shake pan to gently let beans roll.
4. Serve immediately and enjoy!
title: Chinese Green Beans

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. diced, cooked pork, shrimp or chicken

steps: 1. Saute onion in oil until golden.
2. Add egg and scramble mixture.
3. Stir in rice, soy sauce and diced meat. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes.
4. Serves four.
title: Chinese Fried Rice

steps: 1. Combine the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and oregano and use to coat the chicken. Set aside to marinade for at least 30 minutes.
2. Preheat the oven to 190C/Gas 5.
3. Put the chicken, marinade, potatoes and lemon wedges into a roasting tin and roast for 3/4 - 1 hour, until the chicken is cooked right through, and the potatoes are tender.
title: Simple Greek Lemon Chicken Thighs With Potatoes (Low Fat) For 1

steps: 1. Mix.
2. Cover with foil.
3. Let cook for 1 hour and 5 minutes at 350°.
4. Do not touch until cooked.
title: Oven Fried Rice

steps: 1. Chop all vegetables.
2. Saute in 1/4 cup oil.
3. Add rice and meat.
4. Scramble 2 eggs, then add with soy sauce, salt and pepper. Mix all together, stirring frequently over medium heat.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon Red Pepper Flakes (this Will Be Spicy - Reduce, If You Prefer Less Spice)
1 pound Green Beans, Cut Into 1-inch Pieces And Rubbed Dry With A Towel

steps: 1. Whisk together the first seven ingredients (garlic through crushed red pepper) in a small bowl. Set aside.

2. Heat the sunflower oil in a wok or heavy-bottomed saute pan over medium-high heat. Just when the sunflower oil begins to shimmer, add the green beans and saute, stirring constantly, until they begin to blacken in small spots, about 3 minutes. (Note: Be careful when adding the green beans to the pan, as they should sizzle and pop a bit if the oil is hot enough. This process should go very quickly, with the green beans retaining a bright green color, even though they will start to blacken a bit in spots.)
3. Add the sauce to the pan, stirring to coat the green beans. Cook just until the sauce reduces slightly, about 2 minutes.
4. Serve immediately, on their own, or over rice.
title: Crunchy Szechuan Green Beans

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon fresh ginger, minced and peeled
1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch strips
1 teaspoon cornstarch, dissolved in 1 T water

steps: 1. In a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat, heat the oil.
2. Add the chicken, cook 3 minutes.
3. Add the ginger and cook ginger and chicken 2 more minutes, or til chicken is cooked through.
4. Transfer chicken to a plate and set aside.
5. In the skillet, combine the broccoli and water, stirring to scrape up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan; cook, covered, until tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
6. Return the chicken to the skillet; stir in the broth, orange juice, and soy sauce.
7. Add the dissolved cornstarch; cook, stirring frequently, until the mixture boils and thickens slightly.
8. Add the orange; heat through.
title: Orange Chicken With Broccoli (Weight Watchers)

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 cups snow peas, cut on the diagonal (green pea could be used instead)
1 lb shrimp, coarsely chopped (raw or cooked)

steps: 1. Combine first 6 ingredients in a bowl; set aside.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add eggs; stir fry for 30 seconds or until soft scrambled.
3. Add onions, ginger and snow peas. If using uncooked shrimp, add them to the skillet and cook until just before they start to look pink. Add rice and broth mixture; toss gently to coat.
4. If using cooked shrimp, add them at the end and cook until just heated through. Depending on the amount of rice used, you might need to add a bit more chicken broth to give it a bit more moisture.
title: Easy Shrimp Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 2 cups white rice, cooked and cold

steps: 1. Beat egg with water in a small bowl.
2. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium low heat. Add egg and let it lie flat until cooked. Remove from skillet and cut into shreds.
3. Add onion to skillet. (The recipe called for 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to be added also, but I found that this made the dish too greasy.) Saute onion until tender.
4. Add rice, soy sauce, pepper, and chicken. (Make sure the rice is COLD before adding it to the skillet! It gets messy if it's not cold -- ) Stir fry together for about 5 minutes then stir in egg.
title: Best Ever Chicken Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 30 g cold butter, cut into small pieces
2 teaspoons finely grated fresh lemon rind (optional)

steps: 1. Rub butter into the flour until crumbly.
2. Mix in the cheese, thyme and about 1/2 cup (125ml) of water or enough to bind the mixture together.
3. Roll 2 level teaspoons of the mixture into balls.
4. Place in to the soup and simmer covered for 8 minutes or until the dumplings are plump.
5. Season to taste and scatter with the lemon rind.
title: Cheese Dumplings For Soup

ingredients.text: 1/2 pound green beans, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Combine green beans and water in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender crisp, 4 to 5 minutes. Add ginger, garlic, and sesame oil; cook, stirring frequently, until garlic is lightly browned, 1 to 2 minutes.
2. Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and red pepper flakes together in a small bowl. Pour over beans and cook until sauce thickens enough to coat beans, 3 to 5 minutes.
title: Spicy Szechuan Green Beans

ingredients.text: 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into thin strips

steps: 1. In a large skillet or wok, stir-fry chicken in oil for 7 minutes or until juices run clear; remove and set aside. In the same skillet, stir-fry onion until tender. Add broccoli, green pepper and garlic; stir-fry until tender. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients until smooth; pour over vegetable mixture. Add chicken; bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 1 minute or until sauce is thickened and bubbly.
title: Broccoli Pepper And Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup mushroom, chopped (I use shiitake mushrooms)
1/4 teaspoon browning sauce (I use Gravy Master seasoning and browning sauce)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Pierce the rind of the squash, and place it on a foil-covered cookie sheet
3. Cook the pierced squash in the oven for about 1 hour.
4. Start cooking the veggies about 20 minutes before squash is done cooking

5. In a large skillet on medium heat, melt one tablespoon of the butter and saute the Brussels sprouts, carrots, zucchini, and mushrooms. Saute vegetables until the zucchini is soft, about 20 minutes.
6. Take the squash out and set it aside for about fifteen minutes.
7. Mix the browning sauce with the water and pour into the skillet with the veggies and stir it inches Let skillet set on very low heat while you prepare the squash.

8. Cut squash in half, remove and dispose of the seeds and the stringy stuff attached to the seeds. Then take a fork and scrape out the "spaghetti" from the squash and put it into the skillet with the veggies.
9. Add the rest of the butter and the parmesan. Stir until the butter and parmesan are melted.
10. Serve immediately. Add salt and pepper if desired.
title: Veggie Stir Fry With Spaghetti Squash

steps: 1. Drain all the fruit well.
2. Combine oranges, pineapple, coconut, sour cream and marshmallows.
3. Blend gently.
4. Add the cherries for color.
5. Chill a few hours and serve.
title: Mandarin Salad

steps: 1. Start off by chopping up the raw chicken into small strips or roughly chop it into small, uneven pieces. In large pot, heat about 2 tablespoons of olive oil on medium-high. Throw chicken into the pot stirring occasionally.
2. As the chicken cooks, finely chop the onion and garlic and throw into the pot once chicken is mostly white.
3. Add oregano, cumin, and chili powder.
4. Stir in to mix the ingredients.
5. At this point what I do is add lemon juice so it's properly incorporated into the dish.
6. Let chicken cook until finished (about 5 minutes at this point with frequent stirring).
7. Roughly chop the cilantro and tomato and add to chicken.
8. Let cook for about 5 minutes.
9. You should start to notice a good amount of liquid in the pot from the oil, lemon, and tomato.
10. This is when I add the tomato sauce and stir.
11. Again, I let sit for about 5 minutes.
12. Once it's all nicely incorporated, add the chicken broth.
13. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
14. Add black beans.
15. Simmer for about 15 minutes.
16. The soup should be an deep red color when finished.
17. Ladle into a bowl, add more fresh cilantro, cheese, and crushed tortilla chips. Enjoy!
title: Lemon Chicken Tortilla Soup

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless round steak, sliced thinly into 2-inch inch long strips
2 cups fresh asparagus, chopped into bite-sized pieces
1 medium bell pepper, chopped into bite-sized pieces

steps: 1. To make the sauce: combine the flour, beef broth, soy sauce, oyster sauce, red pepper flakes & brown sugar in a small bowl. Whisk until well-mixed. Set aside.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a large pan. Add the garlic once the oil is hot, and let cook until golden-brown.
3. Add the beef and stir-fry for about 3-4 minutes, or until the beef is halfway cooked.
4. Add the vegetables and stir-fry for about 3-4 minutes.
5. Add the sauce and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and allow it to simmer for about 5 minutes, or until the sauce has slightly thickened.
6. Sprinkle with sesame seeds right before serving. I like to serve with white rice.
title: Kona K'S Beef With Broccoli (& Other Veggies!) Stirfry

steps: 1. Fry ham with soy sauce. Add carrots. Stir-fry to heat through. Add onions, rice and peas.
2. Mix and heat over medium heat.
3. Make a well in the center so bottom of pan is exposed. Add eggs and cook, stirring constantly, until soft scrambled, then mix into rice mixture.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. In a small saucepan, bring 1 1/2 cups water to a boil.
2. Stir in rice.
3. Cook according to directions.
4. In a 10-inch skillet, cook beaten egg in butter.
5. Add chopped onion and the rice. Saute, stirring, over medium heat, until the mixture is slightly brown.
6. Mix 1/4 cup water with soy sauce and stir into the rice. Makes four servings.
title: Chinese Fried Rice

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients, except poppy seed, in blender.
2. Blend for 1 minute.
3. Add poppy seed and blend a few seconds.
4. Dressing will have a green color.
5. May be stored in refrigerator as long as 3 weeks.
title: Poppy Seed Mandarin Orange Salad

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. chopped green onions and tops

steps: 1. Cook rice in water.
2. In preheated frypan, cook oil (less oil if you have a nonstick pan).
3. Break egg in cup; beat with fork. Pour into warm oil; keep stirring until egg is stringy.
4. Cook about 1 minute.
5. Add cooked rice, green onions and tops and soy sauce.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Rinse rice once.
2. Bring the rice and 2 cups water to boil. Stir and cover with lid.
3. Turn off heat; let set.
4. Brown ground beef.
5. Add onion; stir until tender.
6. Add carrots, celery and peppers.
7. Stir-fry until vegetables begin to be tender.
8. Do not overcook.
9. Add salt and pepper to taste.
10. Add rice.
11. Sprinkle with soy sauce and Accent; stir until well blended.
12. Serve hot.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 3/4 pound cooked shrimp - peeled and deveined

steps: 1. In a saucepan bring water to a boil. Add rice and stir. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
2. In a large skillet over high heat, add sesame oil and allow it to get hot. Add rice and 1 tablespoon of butter. Saute for three minutes.
3. Stir in the snow peas and corn. Saute until rice begins to brown slightly. Add shrimp to top of rice. Reduce heat to low and cover to keep warm.
4. In a mixing bowl, whisk together the orange and lime juices, onion, honey, ginger root and garlic. Mix thoroughly. Spoon enough of the mixture to coat the shrimp.

5. In a saucepan over high heat, combine the remaining juice mixture with chicken broth and cornstarch. Bring to a boil and reduce heat. Simmer until thickened. Stir in 1 teaspoon of butter. Serve over the rice and shrimp.
title: Ginger Shrimp With Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 cabbage (or other vegetables or pods of legumen)
1 teaspoon salt (you may regulate the amount to suit your taste)
1 piece ginger (for vegetables only, size like two cloves of garlic)
2 cloves garlic (for pods of legumen only)

steps: 1. Chop the vegetables or pods to the size you like.
2. Remove the skin of ginger or garlic.
3. Crush the ginger or garlic flat but DO NOT chop it.
4. Add the oil onto a hot pot, for us Chinese people, we use a"wok".
5. Cook the ginger or garlic for a while.
6. Add the vegetables or the pods.
7. Stir fry them until they are soft.
8. Add water if it is too dry.
9. This is often necessary for pods and harder veggies.
10. For pods, cover the pot with a lid and stir fry the veggies alternately until they are cooked.
11. Add salt, sugar and oyster sauce and mix well.
12. Serve hot.
title: Cantonese Family Stir Fried Vegetables

ingredients.text: 1 c. meat, chopped (such as leftover pork chops, chicken, beef, ham)

steps: 1. Pour rice into boiling water; remove from heat.
2. Let cook for 5 minutes.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat; add ginger and garlic. Cook 10 minutes or until browned and crisp, stirring constantly. Remove from pan; set aside.
2. Add sliced onion to pan; reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and cook 10 minutes or until soft; stir occasionally. Sprinkle salt over onion; increase heat to medium-high.
3. Add rice; cook 4 minutes or until heated, stirring frequently.

4. Make a well in center of rice; add eggs, stirring to scramble. Gradually incorporate eggs into rice; stir in ginger mixture, green onions, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Garnish with cilantro, if desired.
title: Easy And Simple Fried Rice

steps: 1. Melt margarine in frying pan.
2. Add rice; cook until browned. After rice is browned, add beef broth.
3. Cover pan and put in a 350° oven until tender (about 45 minutes).
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a large, nonstick pan or wok over medium high heat. It should be hot enough that egg will sizzle when you add it.
2. Beat the eggs and salt together. Slice the green onions into thin rounds.
3. Pour the eggs into the pan and stir constantly so that they are in small bits. Cook 1-2 minutes, until the eggs are cooked through but moist.
4. Push the egg pieces to the side and add the rice to the pan. Break it up with a spatula so that the grains separate. Cook, stirring, for 2-3 minutes.
5. Add the water, soy sauce, and green onions. Cook and stir for 2-3 more minutes.
