title: Sweet And Sour Red Cabbage

steps: 1. Mix well and form into small balls.
2. Brown in oil and drain well.
title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs

steps: 1. Combine sugar and syrup; boil for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
2. Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter.
3. Add noodles.
4. Drop onto wax paper and cool.
title: Chow Mein Crispies

steps: 1. In a medium saucepan, cook fresh or frozen carrots covered. Cook until tender.
2. Drain.
3. Remove from pan.
4. Mix all together onions, juice, honey, butter, cornstarch and soy sauce.
5. Cook until tender.
title: Sweet And Sour Carrots

ingredients.text: 1 Granny Smith apples - peeled, cored and sliced

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, saute the apple and onion in the butter until tender. Stir in the cabbage and saute for 5 more minutes.
2. Pour in stock and vinegar; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and stir in sugar, salt, pepper, celery seed, and raisins. Simmer, uncovered, for an hour. Stir in apple butter.
title: Ukrainian Sweet And Sour Cabbage Soup

steps: 1. Mix first 7 ingredients well.
2. Blend in flour mixture and almonds.
3. Shape into 1-inch balls on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with a glass; brush with slightly beaten egg white.
4. Place an almond half on each cookie, pressing in slightly.
5. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.
title: Chinese Almond Cookies

steps: 1. Combine and roll into balls.
2. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly butter 2 cookie sheets.
2. Place butter and sugar in mixter bowl and beat until light and fluffy. Add 1 egg and continue beating until completely blended.
3. Sift flour, baking soda and salt onto sheet of waxed paper and gradually mix in butter mixture. Add chopped almonds, orange zest, and vanill and mix just until blended.
4. Drop dough by rounded teaspoon 1 inch apart onto prepared cookie sheets. Dip thumb in flour and make indentation in center of each cookie.
5. Beat remaining egg and lightly brush over each cookie, using pastry brush. Place whole almond in each indentation.
6. Bake until cookies are puffed and edges are golden brown, about 12 minutes. Let cool slightly on cookie sheets, then remove to wire racks to cool completely. Store in airtight container.
title: Chinese Orange-Almond Cookies

steps: 1. Cook carrot in microwave a few minutes.
2. Put all in deep Pyrex pan.
3. Mix milk, eggs and Bisquick in blender; pour over veggies.
4. Bake 25 to 35 minutes in a 400° oven.
5. Last 5 minutes, top with cheese.
6. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before cutting.
title: Stir-Fry Pie

steps: 1. Melt first two ingredients in double boiler just to smoothness.
2. Stir in noodles and marshmallows.
3. Spoon drop onto wax paper.
4. Refrigerate to set.
5. Great taste!
title: My Chinese Candy

steps: 1. Combine egg, wheat germ, soy sauce, garlic powder and pepper. Add pork and mix well.
2. Shape into 24 meatballs.
3. Spray large skillet with Pam.
4. Add meatballs and cook over medium heat until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
5. Drain on paper towels.
title: Sweet And Sour Meatball Bake

steps: 1. In a large skillet, cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon; set aside. Saute cabbage and onion in drippings until tender. Add remaining ingredients; stir until thickened. Stir in bacon. Serve warm.
title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage With Bacon

steps: 1. Coat beef with flour.
2. Fry in Dutch oven in hot oil until brown.
3. Combine catsup, sugar, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, water, salt and pepper and pour over meat.
4. Cover pan.
5. Reduce heat and simmer about 1 hour, stirring once or twice.
6. Add carrots and cook until done.
7. Serve over egg noodles and garnish with chopped parsley.
title: Sweet And Sour Beef Stew

steps: 1. Combine it all together. Store covered in the refrigerator.
title: Sugar-Free Sweet And Sour Mix

steps: 1. Sift flour, salt and baking powder together.
2. Work in shortening with a knife or fingertips; add milk to make a soft dough.
3. These are dropped a tablespoon at a time on boiling soup or stew for the last 15 or 20 minutes of cooking.
4. Kettle must be covered tightly and cover must not be removed during cooking. Makes 12 to 15 dumplings.
5. Serves 4.
title: Best Ever Dumplings

steps: 1. Secure one large elephant.
2. Kill, clean and cut into small cubes (this will take about two months).
3. Put in large kettle and simmer over kerosene heat at 465° for 14 weeks.
4. Make gravy to cover.
5. This serves 3,685 people.
6. If more meat is needed, add two rabbits.
7. But use only if necessary, as few people care for hare in their stew.
title: Never Fail Dumplings

steps: 1. Place chicken breasts & bouillon cubes in a large pot & cover with 2 quarts of water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium and simmer for 20-25 mins until chicken is done.

3. Meanwhile, boil the eggs. Then mix together the bisquick and milk until soft dough forms. When chicken is done, remove from pot and set aside. Drop spoonfuls of dough into the chicken stock. Simmer over low heat, covered, for 10 mins, then uncovered for 10 mins.

5. Meanwhile, dice 2-4 stalks of celery until you have approximately 1/2 - 1 cup of diced celery. Cut or shred chicken into bit sized pieces. Saute celery in 2 tbsp of butter for a couple of mins. Add in chicken & season well with salt and pepper. Stir to combine. Add the chicken and celery to the soup. Remove yolk from boiled eggs and chop whites and add to soup. Stir all to combine. Serves 4.
title: Creamy Chicken & Dumplings

steps: 1. Sift flour and baking powder.
2. Add to beaten eggs and milk. Roll and stretch each dumpling before dropping into hot broth, cooking until tender.
3. Serves 6.
title: Granny Gibbs' Famous Dumplings

steps: 1. Disjoint chicken wings, discarding tip ends.
2. Stir together the soy sauce, vinegar, sugars, ginger and garlic for marinade. Place in bowl; cover and marinate at least 2 hours or best overnight.
3. To cook, place in 13 x 9-inch oblong pan and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.
4. Serves 10 to 12 appetizers.
title: Chinese Chicken Wings(For Appetizers Or Meals)

steps: 1. Cook chicken until done.
2. Mix rest of ingredients well.
3. Drop by teaspoon onto pieces of chicken.
4. Steam 12 minutes.
5. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Mommy'S Dumplings

steps: 1. Melt butter in 1 1/2-quart casserole.
2. Combine flour, sugar, milk and baking powder and pour over melted butter.
3. Pour peaches over this.
4. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.
5. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
6. Yield:
7. 6 servings.
title: Peach Dumpling

steps: 1. Simmer chicken until tender enough to bone and skin in salt water.
2. Put chicken back into broth and bring to boil.
3. Cut butter into flour and add eggs.
4. Mix well and roll thin as for pastry.
5. Cut into narrow strips and drop into boiling broth with chicken.
6. Cook for 10 minutes or until done.
7. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Old Fashioned Chicken And Dumplings

steps: 1. Grate potatoes; add egg and salt with enough flour to make a thick dough.
2. Drop by tablespoon into a pot of boiling water. Cook about 10 minutes.
3. Drain.
4. Rinse with cold water.
5. Melt shortening in large frying pan.
6. Add drained sauerkraut.
7. Brown. Add dumplings.
8. Cook until dumplings are heated through, about 10 minutes.
9. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Sauerkraut Dumplings(Hungarian Recipe)

steps: 1. Mix milk and cornmeal in a pan.
2. Cook and stir over medium heat until thick.
3. Stir into eggs.
4. Add salt, pepper, onion and 1 cup cheese.
5. Pour into baking pan so mixture is about 1 1/2 inches thick and chill.
6. Remove from pan and cut into pieces.
7. Place on greased baking sheet; brush with butter and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
8. Bake at 350° about 20 minutes, until lightly browned.
9. Makes 6 servings.
title: Dumplings(Italian Style)

steps: 1. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
2. Cut in shortening.
3. Add milk, carrots and parsley.
4. Stir until flour is moist.
5. Drop dumplings into simmering liquid in approximately 8 mounds (chicken or beef stock may be used).
6. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes without lifting cover.
7. Serves 8 people.
title: Carrot Dumplings

steps: 1. Sift dry ingredients. Combine milk and salad oil. Add to dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened. Drop from tablespoons on top of bubbling stew. Cover tightly and bring to a boil. Reduce heat (don't lift cover) and simmer for 15 minutes. Makes 5 servings.
title: Holden Family Dumplings

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients.
2. Yields 2 1/2 cups.
title: Sweet And Sour Sauce

steps: 1. Mix together, adding milk last.
2. Place on heavily floured board.
3. Work with hands until smooth enough to roll out.
4. Roll out to 12 x 16-inches.
title: Apple Dumplings

steps: 1. Mix flour, oil and milk to make dough.
2. Peel and cut apples of choice.
3. Roll out dough and wrap around apples.
4. Sprinkle a little sugar and cinnamon on the apple before wrapping.
5. Boil 2 cups sugar, water and butter; pour over dumplings.
6. Bake 45 minutes at 375°.
7. Yields 8 to 12.
title: Apple Dumplings

ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp. cornstarch, mixed with 2 Tbsp. water

steps: 1. Fry bacon crisp and break up.
2. Save grease.
3. Beat eggs and add rest of ingredients.
4. Add bacon grease and beat until thick.
5. If it doesn't thicken, add the cornstarch and bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
6. Add bacon.
7. Pour over potato salad mixture.
title: Sweet And Sour Dressing For Potato Salad

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients; cut in Crisco and add milk.
2. Mix well until moist.
3. Roll out and cut in squares.
4. Place some apple slices in each square and wrap dough around apples; seal.
5. Place in greased pan and pour syrup over each dumpling.
title: Apple Dumplings With Syrup

steps: 1. Cut shortening into flour which has been sifted with salt. Add water to flour, beat egg and work into mixture.
2. Knead lightly and roll on floured board.
3. Cut into 1-inch squares and drop into boiling chicken broth.
title: Old Fashioned Dumplings

steps: 1. Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
2. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal.
3. Stir milk in until blended.
4. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto boiling beef or chicken stew (try to drop onto meat, not liquid).
5. Cook 10 minutes uncovered, then 10 minutes more tightly covered.
title: Dutch Dumplings

steps: 1. Combine Potato Buds & hot water.
2. Add remaining ingredients in given order, mix well.
3. Form into 2-inch balls with hands, flour hands occasionally so dough doesn't stick.
4. Cook in boiling salted water until they rise to the top.
5. Remove dumplings from water with a slotted spoon & place in butter casserole dish.
6. Sprinkle with bread crumbs & keep layering melted butter, dumplings & crumbs.
7. Cover with foil & bake at 325* for 5-10 minutes.
title: Easy Potato Dumplings

ingredients.text: 1 chicken, cut into pieces (during the holidays you can get a fresh hen)
2 quarts cold water (always put your raw chicken in cold water &ndash, you&rsquo,ll get a much richer broth)

steps: 1. Add the chicken to the stew pot.
2. Add salt, onion, carrot, celery, and black pepper.
3. Cover with cold water and bring to a low boil.
4. Foam will form on the water as it begins to boil.
5. Skim the foam from the water.
6. Stew chicken until tender with the salt, onion, carrot and celery ribs, about 40 - 60 minutes after liquid gets to a low boil. Cooking time depends on the size of your chicken or hen.
7. Remove the chicken from the broth and discard the vegetables.
8. While the chicken cools, make the dumplings. Mix 2 cups sifted all-purpose flour.
9. 1 teaspoon salt.
10. 1/3 cup shortening.
11. 5-7 tablespoons cold water.
12. Work the dough and roll out on a floured surface.
13. Roll out the dough very thin about 1/8".
14. Cut into 1" wide strips and let dry for about 30 minutes.
15. remove chicken from the bones.
16. Cut or pull the chicken into desired-size pieces.
17. Add pepper and butter to broth and heat to simmering. Broth should look peppery and taste great.
18. Add 1 can evaporated milk to broth.
19. Before adding your dumplings to the milk broth, add a touch of grated nutmeg to the broth.
20. Add the chicken pieces and heat. (Broth needs to be several inches above the chicken for the dumplings to have enough room to cook.).
21. Add the dumplings to the low boiling broth a few at a time to keep the broth at a boil.
22. Cook 10 minutes in the low boiling broth. (If you boil your broth too high, your dumplings will disappear or clump together.).
23. Remove from heat and let rest 10 minutes and serve.
title: Old Fashioned Chicken And Dumplings

steps: 1. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
2. Work in 3 tablespoons of lard.
3. Add milk and mix well.
4. Roll the dough to 1/4-inch thick; spread with melted oleo, brown sugar and apples. Sprinkle with cinnamon.
5. Roll and cut into slices 1 1/2-inches thick.
6. Place in greased 9 x 12-inch pan.
title: Apple Dumplings

steps: 1. Mix together flour, baking powder, and salt. Cut in shortening until well blended.
2. Stir in parsley (if using) and milk.
3. Drop small spoonfuls onto stew approximately 10-15 minutes before serving.
4. Cover and cook until puffed and dry on the inside.
5. Serve and enjoy!
title: Puff Dumplings For Stew

steps: 1. Mix.
2. Dip spoon first in hot liquid (prevents dough from sticking to spoon).
3. Drop by spoonfuls into boiling water to which 1 tablespoon oil and 1 teaspoon salt have been added.
4. Cook about 10 minutes.
title: Drop Dumplings

steps: 1. Prepare outdoor grill for covered direct grilling over medium heat. In small bowl, combine hoisin, honey, ginger, and oil.
2. Place pork on hot grill rack. Cover grill and cook pork 18 to 20 minutes, turning occasionally.
3. With serrated knife, cut pineapple half into 4 wedges. Rub cut sides of pineapple with brown sugar.

4. Grill pineapple 10 minutes or until browned on both sides, turning over once. While pineapple is grilling, brush pork with hoisin-honey glaze and turn frequently until temperature on instant-read thermometer reaches 155 degrees F. Transfer pork to cutting board; let stand 10 minutes. Transfer pineapple to platter.
5. Thinly slice pork and serve with pineapple wedges.
title: Hoisin Honey Glazed Pork Tenderloin With Grilled Pineapple

ingredients.text: 2 lemons, zest and juice of them
1/2 cup cilantro, chopped, use parsley if prefer

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
2. Rub chicken thighs with sea salt and ground black pepper. Refrigerate until ready to use.
3. Combine lemon zest, lemon juice, white sugar and 1 cup water. Set aside.
4. Combine corn starch and 1/3 cup water. Set aside.
5. Heat a large non-stick skillet over a little higher than medium heat. Pan-fry chicken thighs (skin side down first) without oil until both sides become golden brown, about 5-8 minutes each side.
6. Transfer chicken thighs to a roasting rack. Bake for about 30 minutes or until center reaches 165°F.

7. Return to skillet. Keep about 1 tablespoon oil and turn on heat over medium high. Stir in lemon juice mixture and bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium, stir in honey and corn starch mixture. Cook until thick.
8. Turn off heat. Stir in cilantro or parsley. Pour over chicken thighs. Use sliced lemon for garnish.
9. Serve immediately.
title: Honey Glazed Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. On the day before you want to serve them, boil 1 1/2 lb potatoes in their jacket.

2. Peel the potatoes as soon as they are done, and press through a ricer or mash through a sieve; then cool them till the next day (not in the refrigerator, it will change the flavor) Next day peel and grate 1 lb potatoes.
3. Put grated potatoes in a cloth and wring out as much liquid as possible.
4. Add to the boiled potatoes.
5. Knead into this the egg, flour, and salt.
6. With floured hands shape into tennis ball sized balls.
7. In a large pot bring salted water to a full boil.

8. Put the dumplings into the water and boil 5 minutes, reduce heat to medium for and boil for 5 minutes more, reduce heat to low for and let simmer until done (dumplings will rise to the top when they are ready), about another 5 to 10 minutes.
9. Remove from water.
10. Caution, do not put a cover on the pot, the dumplings will disintegrate.
title: Half And Half Dumplings

steps: 1. On small salad plates, one plate for one serving, arrange a large leaf of lettuce, which covers most of the plate.
2. Slice and arrange three thin slices of ripe tomato and three thin slices of fresh "Mozzarella di buffala" cheese on the center of the plate. Add olive oil, salt and pepper.
3. On the sides of the plate, add a few sun-dried tomatoes, various kinds of olives, and a small portion of Prosciutto ham.
4. Simple and easy, this is an attractive and delicious appetizer for pasta dishes or chicken dishes.
5. Buon appetito!!!
title: Bernie'S Chinese Wings

ingredients.text: 1 c. chicken broth (after chicken is done)

steps: 1. Boil chicken in a large pot with 6 quarts of water and 1 teaspoon salt until tender.
2. Take chicken off bones and cube.
3. Set aside.
4. Mix dumplings.
5. First the flour, the broth, the milk and egg.
6. Mix well, then roll out on a floured surface until 1/4-inch thick.
7. Cut into noodles.
8. Put into boiling broth; cook covered 10 minutes and then cook uncovered for 10 minutes.
9. Add chicken and simmer until done.
title: Chicken And Dumplings

steps: 1. Bring the water to a boil; add the walnuts.
2. Return to boil and boil for 1 minute.
3. Drain.
4. Dump into large bowl with the sugar; stir to coat well.
5. Heat 1 inch of oil to 350°.
6. Fry half of the nuts at a time until golden brown.
7. Stir occasionally to keep from sticking.
8. Drain on a foil-covered cookie sheet.
9. (Don't use paper towels.)
title: Chinese Fried Walnuts

steps: 1. combine egg salt and milk, combine enough flour to make a stiff dough. Roll out to 1/8 inch thick. cut into 1 inch strips. Drop into boiling stock a few at a time. Make sure stock continues to boil. Cook until done. (about 15 minutes)
title: Mable'S Rolled Dumplings

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients.
2. Microwave, uncovered, on High 3 to 5 minutes or until thickened, stirring every minute until begins to thicken, then every 30 seconds.
3. Cook 30 seconds more.
4. Serve warm.
title: Sweet And Sour Sauce

steps: 1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add napa cabbage and cook uncovered until tender, about 1 minute. Drain in a colander, then immediately immerse in ice water for several minutes until cold to stop the cooking process. Once the napa cabbage is cold, drain well, squeezing out any excess water, and place in a large bowl. Stir in ground pork, 2 tablespoons of soy sauce, sherry, cornstarch, 1 1/2 teaspoon of minced ginger, and green onion.

2. Arrange half of the wonton wrappers on a large sheet of waxed paper. Brush each wrapper lightly with the egg white. Place a heaping teaspoon of the pork mixture in the center of each wrapper. Gather all 4 corners of the wonton wrapper and pinch the edges together to seal in the filling. Repeat with remaining wonton wrappers.

3. Bring large pot of water to a boil and drop the wontons into the boiling water. When the wontons rise to the surface, continue to cook them one minute longer. Remove with a slotted spoon as they finish cooking and place on a platter.
4. Dipping sauce: Mix 1/4 cup soy sauce, seasoned rice vinegar, and 2 tablespoons of shredded fresh ginger in a bowl.
title: Brandi'S Wontons

steps: 1. In a small bowl, mix together the mustard, sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, chili peppers (if using) and vinegar. Blend thoroughly and set aside.
2. Coat chicken pieces in cornstarch. Dip into beaten egg whites.
3. Saute the chicken in hot oil until crispy and brown.
4. Drain oil from the pan and add sauce.
5. Cook for 5 minutes over low heat.
title: Peking Style Chicken

steps: 1. Rinse the lobster, and hold it belly up. At the bottom of the tail, there is a small opening, stick a long skewer in it to drain any urine left in its' body, then crack the tail off, chop the tail into small pieces, and crack the claws in half as well. If you know how to eat the body of the lobster, cut it up and throw it on the pile too.

2. Heat half of the peanut oil in a deep heavy skillet over medium heat. Add the crushed garlic, and fry for about 1 minute. Throw in the lobster pieces, and fry until they are cooked through, about 4 to 5 minutes. Remove the lobster and garlic mixture to a dish and keep warm.

3. Heat the remaining oil in the skillet. Add the minced ginger and pork, and fry until the pork is no longer pink. Pour in the chicken broth, and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. In a small bowl, mix together the sherry, soy sauce, cornstarch and brown sugar until well blended. Add the sherry mixture to the pan, and stir-fry for a minute or two, until the sauce becomes thick and somewhat clear.

4. Stir in the green onions, and turn the heat off. Drizzle the beaten eggs over the mixture in the pan, and stir until the eggs are in little pieces. Finally, return the lobster to the pan, and cook over low heat for a few minutes to blend the flavors. Transfer to a serving dish, and let stand, covered, for a few minutes before serving. Eat with steamed rice and enjoy, cause you worked hard!
title: Cantonese Style Lobster

steps: 1. Cut steak into thin strips- cross grain.
2. Quarter tomatoes and chop green peppers into large pieces.
3. Heat oil to hot and add beef, garlic, salt, pepper and ginger.
4. Fry, turning until browned.
5. Add soy sauce and sugar, cover tightly and cook slowly for 5 minutes.
6. Add tomatoes, peppers, sprouts, cover and cook for 5 minutes.
7. Combine cornstarch and water and add, cooking until thickened.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Debone chicken. Cut meat into bite size pieces. (Save skin and bones for broth.)
2. Bring water to a boil;
3. add noodles.
4. Set aside flavor packets.
5. Cook noodles 2 minutes. Drain and set aside.
6. In large skillet over medium heat, stir-fry onion and garlic until onion is clear. Add chicken and stir-fry until chicken is cooked, about 6 minutes.
7. Push to side of pan. Add to center of pan the carrots, celery and contents of flavor packets. Stir-fry 2 minutes.
8. Add cabbage and stir-fry all ingredients about 2 minutes. Add noodles and broth, stirring until heated through, about 2 minutes. Serve with chow mein noodles as garnish.
9. Yields 4 servings.
title: Chicken Noodle Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 3 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into bite size pieces
6 to 8 small dried hot chili peppers
2 green onions, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces

steps: 1. 1. For marinade, combine 2 teaspoons of soy sauce, 2 teaspoons of the sherry, 2 teaspoons of the cornstarch and the salt in a large bowl, mix well. Add chicken stir to coat well. Let stand 30 minutes.
2. 2. Combime remaining soy sauce, sherry the vinegar, chicken broth, sugar and remaining cornstarch in small bowl. Mix well and set aside.
3. 3. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large wok or large skillet over medium heat. Add peanuts and cook until golden. Remove and set aside.

4. 4. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in wok over medium heat. Add chili pepper and stir fry until peppers just begin to char, about 1 minute. Increase heat to high. Add chicken and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add ginger, stir fry until the chicken is cooked through, about 1 more minute. Ass onions and peanuts to wok. Stir cornstarch mixture and add to wok; cook and stir until sauce boils and thickens.
title: Kung Pao Chicken

steps: 1. Brown beef and pork with oil, onion and garlic. Stir in remaining ingredients.
2. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Dissolve cornstarch in cold water. Stir into simmering chop suey.
3. Cover and cook until thickened.
4. Allow to cool. Place in freezer bag. Label and freeze.
5. To serve: thaw. Heat until bubbly. Serve over rice and chow mein noodles.
title: Beef And Pork Chop Suey

ingredients.text: 4 (4-ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces

steps: 1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a heavy-duty zip-top plastic bag; shake. Add chicken, and shake well to coat; marinate in refrigerator 2 hours, turning occasionally. Remove chicken, reserving marinade.
2. Prepare grill.
3. Cut plums into quarters. Thread chicken and plum pieces alternately onto 4 (12- inch) metal skewers.

4. Place skewers on grill rack coated with cooking spray. Brush skewers with half of reserved marinade. Grill 5 minutes; turn and baste with remaining marinade. Grill up to 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink in the center.
title: Hoisin-Grilled Chicken And Fruit Skewers

ingredients.text: 1 red bell pepper, cut into strips
2 tablespoons natural peanut butter (such as Smucker's)

steps: 1. Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add pork, ginger, and garlic; stir-fry 1 minute. Add bell pepper; stir-fry 2 minutes. Add picante sauce, peanut butter, and soy sauce; stir-fry 3 minutes or until pork loses its pink color and sauce is thick.
2. Transfer pork and rice to individual plates and top with green onions.
3. carbo rating: 22
title: Szechuan Pork

ingredients.text: 350 g rump roast, cut into strips
2 carrots, trimmed and thinly sliced on a diagonal
6 -8 spring onions, sliced on a diagonal

steps: 1. Marinate the beef by combining it with the vinegar, soy sauce and worcestershire sauce in a non-metallic bowl.
2. Cover and leave to marinate in the fridge for at least 20 minutes or as long as overnight if you have the time.
3. Heat the sesame oil in a large frying pan or wok.
4. Add in the carrots and peppers and cook for two minutes.
5. Add in the beef and marinade and cook for another two minutes.
6. Finally add the bean sprouts and spring onions.
7. Cook for a final two minutes.
8. Serve over cooked rice and sprinkle with sesame seeds, if desired.
title: Saucy Beef Stir Fry

ingredients.text: chicken breast (without skin or bone, or use your choice of meat)

steps: 1. Cook rice as directed (preferably Minute rice).
2. Set aside. Chop up onion and green pepper.
3. In skillet, put chicken, onion and green pepper.
4. Cook until chicken is well done.
5. Chop up chicken in bite size pieces.
6. Mix butter, rice and chicken.
7. Cook about 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
8. Let stand 5 minutes, then eat.
title: Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1/2 tbsp hoisin sauce, plus additional to serve

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large skillet on medium heat. Add onion, cook, stirring, 2-3 mins or until golden. Add garlic and ginger; cook, stirring, 1 min or until fragrant. Add pork, stirring with a wooden spoon to break up lumps, 4-5 mins or until browned.

2. Add flour; cook, stirring, 30 seconds or until mixture thickens. Gradually stir in stock, until combined. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer 5 mins until mixture thickens. Remove from heat. Stir in hoisin sauce and cilantro. Cool 10 mins.

3. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 375°F. Using a 4 inch round cookie cutter, cut 12 rounds from half the pastry sheets. Using a 2 1/2 inch round cookie cutter, cut 12 rounds from remaining pastry sheets.
4. Line a 12-cup muffin pan with 4 inch pastry rounds. Spoon pork mixture into muffin cups. Top with 2 1/2 inch rounds. Brush with egg. Using a fork, press edges to seal.
5. Bake 20 mins or until golden. Serve with additional hoisin sauce.
title: Hoisin Pork Pastries

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup soy sauce, i use kikoman light soy

steps: 1. Mix together soy sauce, lemon juice, honey, sesamme oil, dry mustard, ginger, garlic and ground black pepper to make the marinade.
2. Place chicken in a bowl or zip lock plastic bag.
3. Pour marinade over it.
4. Marinate in refrigerator for at least one hour, I marinate it for at least 12 hours.
5. Turn the chicken over in marinade occasionally.
6. Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
7. Roast chicken on rack until chicken is dark brown and a fork can be inserted with ease, at least 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours.
8. Bring marinade to full boil and use to baste chicken every 15 minutes.
title: Chinese Roast Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (to taste)
1 large red bell pepper, cut into 3/4-inch squares (about 2 cs.)
12 green onions, cut into 3/4-inch lengths (about 1 c.)
1 large ripe papaya, peeled and seeded,cut into 3/4-inch dice (about 2 cs.)

steps: 1. Whisk together soy sauce, lemon juice, honey, and sesame oil; whisk in cornstarch and crushed red pepper.
2. Reserve.
3. Heat oil in a wok or heavy frying pan.
4. Over high heat, stir-fry bell pepper until tender-crisp, about 1 minute.
5. Stir in onion, and garlic; cook 1 minute stirring constantly.
6. Stir in shrimp; cook, stirring constantly until shrimp is firm and opaque, about 2 minutes.
7. Stir in papaya; heat through.
8. Rewhisk soy sauce mixture; stir into pan.
9. Cook until mixture thickens, about 30 seconds.
10. Remove from heat; stir in cilantro.
11. Serve with steamed rice.
title: Spicy Hawaiian Papaya & Shrimp Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 (14.5 ounce) can bean sprouts, drained and rinsed

steps: 1. Heat shortening in a large, deep skillet. Sear pork until it turns white, then add onion and saute for 5 minutes. Add celery, hot water, salt and pepper. Cover skillet and simmer for 5 minutes. Add sprouts and heat to boiling.
2. In a small bowl combine the cold water, cornstarch, soy sauce and sugar. Mix together and add to skillet mixture. Cook for 5 minutes, or until thickened to taste.
title: Chop Suey

steps: 1. Cut tenderloin in half lengthwise. Cut each half widthwise into 1/4-in. slices; set aside. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the soy sauce, garlic, ginger and pepper flakes; add pork. Seal bag and turn to coat; refrigerate for 20 minutes.
2. In a

3. or wok coated with cooking spray, stir-fry pork and marinade for 4-5 minutes or until meat is no longer pink. Add peas and red pepper; stir-fry for 1 minute. Stir in spaghetti and broth; cook 1 minute longer. Remove from the heat; stir in sesame oil.
title: Pork Lo Mein With Spaghetti

steps: 1. Combine first 5 ingredients to make sauce
2. Pour over chicken and onions in rectangular Pyrex dish
3. Cook at 350 for 30 minutes.
4. Serve chicken and sauce over rice.
title: Mom'S Chinese Chicken

steps: 1. Cut vegetables into bite size pieces.
2. Heat oil in skillet. Put in vegetables and stir-fry.
3. Then add chicken broth.
4. Make thickening with cornstarch and slowly pour into skillet and stir. Then add chicken, bean sprouts and soy sauce.
5. Serve over rice or chow mein noodles.
title: Chicken Chow Mein

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients except ribs in a large pot.
2. Cut ribs in twos and add to mixture.
3. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat.
4. Keep basting and moving ribs around so they get coated, but don't stick to bottom of pot.
5. When mixture thickens (in about 1 hour), remove ribs from mixture and bake in oven for 15 to 20 minutes at 350° or broil each side or barbecue to dry them out.
6. Cut and serve.
title: Linda'S Chinese Spareribs

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. sweet red peppers, sliced thin

steps: 1. Mix chicken broth, soy sauce and cornstarch until smooth. Heat oil in wok or large saucepan.
2. Add mushrooms, celery and red pepper.
3. Cook until crisp-tender.
4. Stir in bean sprouts, scallions, snow peas and cornstarch mixture. Cook until sauce thickens and boils.
5. Add drained hot spaghetti; toss well.
title: Easy Vegetable Lo Mein

ingredients.text: 1 (6 ounce) can orange juice, frozen and thawed

steps: 1. Heat over to 375.
2. Put chicken in a bowl and pour melted butter over chicken, set aside.
3. In another bowl, combine thawed orange juice with honey, set aside.
4. In another bowl, combine flour, bread crumbs and seasonings.
5. Roll chicken in orange mix then in flour mix. Place chicken in GREASED baking pan.
6. Drizzle any left over butter and orange mix over chicken.
7. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes. Check after 30 minutes, the honey does tend to burn. I usually just lower the oven temp a bit.
title: Oven Baked Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Combine marinade ingredients in small bowl.
2. Place tenderloin in shallow bowl, pour in the marinade.
3. Refrigerate 4 hrs (or overnite).
4. Preheat oven to 425.
5. Roast 15 minutes per side.
title: Hoisin Pork

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, fresh and minced

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine the salt, ginger and pepper. Sprinkle over both sides of chicken.
2. In a nonstick skillet, saute chicken in oil for 2 minutes on each side or until browned.
3. Remove chicken to plate and keep warm.
4. Reduce heat to medium low.
5. Drain oranges, reserving juice.
6. Stir juice, onion and red pepper flakes into skillet.
7. Cook and stir for about 3 minutes or until onion is tender. Bring to a boil.
8. Return chicken to skillet. Reduce heat; cover and cook for about 10 minutes or until chicken juices run clear.
9. Place chicken over rice; keep warm.
10. Combine corstarch and water until smooth.
11. Gradually stir into skillet. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for about 2 minutes or until mixture is thickened.
12. Add mandarin oranges; heat through.
13. Pour sauce over chicken.
14. Sprinkle with cilantro.
title: Chicken And Mandarin Oranges

ingredients.text: 1 to 2 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes
1 pound boneless skinless chicken breast halves

steps: 1. In a 6-qt. electric pressure cooker, combine the first 7 ingredients. Top with chicken, onion and broccoli. Lock lid; close pressure-release valve. Adjust to pressure-cook on high for 6 minutes. Quick-release pressure. A thermometer inserted in chicken should read at least 165°.
2. Remove chicken; shred with 2 forks. Return to pressure cooker; heat through. Top with green onions and sesame seeds to serve.
3. Freeze cooled stew in freezer containers. To use, partially thaw in refrigerator overnight. Heat through in a saucepan, stirring occasionally and adding a little water if necessary.
title: Pressure-Cooker General Tso’S Stew

steps: 1. Mix beef and cornstarch well and allow to stand for 5 minutes.
2. Heat 4 cups vegetable oil and fry beef until it is crispy. Remove beef from oil.
3. Heat 2 teaspoons vegetable oil and add chopped garlic, rice wine, soy sauce, and beef. Stir-fry well.
4. Add sugar and continue stirring for 1 minute.
5. Add sliced yellow onion and green onion. Stir.
6. Add white pepper. Stir well.
7. Add sesame seed oil. Remove from heat and serve.
title: Mr. Wang'S Mongolian Beef

steps: 1. Cut pork into 1-inch thick strips.
2. Mix the last 4 ingredients and soak the pork in it.
3. Spread the pork in a baking pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.
4. Baking pan should be dry and pork fat starting to come out.
title: Chinese Barbecue Pork

steps: 1. Fill a large kettle with water; bring to a boil.
2. Place the chicken in the boiling water.
3. Return to a boil.
4. Lower heat, cover and cook 1 hour.
5. Remove and cool.
6. Debone chicken; tear into small strips.
7. Place in a large bowl.
title: Chinese Boiled Chicken(Chow Yow Gai)

ingredients.text: 1 pound boneless beef sirloin steak, cut into 2-inch strips
2 medium green pepper, cut into strips
2 medium onions, halved and thinly sliced

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine cornstarch and 2 tablespoons soy sauce until smooth. Add beef; stir to coat.

2. In a large skillet or wok, stir-fry the green peppers and onions in oil for 3 minutes; add beef. Cook and stir for 3 minutes. Add mushrooms. Cook and stir for 3-5 minutes or until vegetables are tender and meat is no longer pink. Stir in remaining soy sauce.
title: Beef Strip Vegetable Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 to 3 lb. chicken, cut off bone

steps: 1. Cut chicken into 1 1/2 inch pieces.
2. Mix flour and cornstarch together.
3. Flour chicken and set aside.
4. Mix egg and milk.
5. Soak chicken in mixture 10 minutes.
6. Re-dip into flour and fry in hot oil until golden brown.
7. Mix bouillon cubes, 1 cup water, sugar, soy sauce and cornstarch until dissolved.
8. Cook on medium heat until thick.
9. Cook rice according to directions.
10. Place chicken and rice on plate.
11. Cover with sauce, cashews and onions.
12. Use more soy sauce if desired.
title: Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350° F. Spray a 9x13-inch baking pan with non-stick spray.
2. Combine soy sauce, ½ cup water, brown sugar, ginger and garlic in a small saucepan and cover. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Remove lid and cook for one minute once boiling.

3. Meanwhile, stir together the corn starch and 2 tablespoons of water in a separate dish until smooth. Once sauce is boiling, add mixture to the saucepan and stir to combine. Cook until the sauce starts to thicken then remove from heat.

4. Place the chicken breasts in the prepared pan. Pour one cup of the sauce over top of chicken. Place chicken in oven and bake 35 minutes or until cooked through. Remove from oven and shred chicken in the dish using two forks.
5. *Meanwhile, steam or cook the vegetables according to package directions.

6. Add the cooked vegetables and rice to the casserole dish with the chicken. Add most of the remaining sauce, reserving a bit to drizzle over the top when serving. Gently toss everything together in the casserole dish until combined. Return to oven and cook 15 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes before serving. Drizzle each serving with remaining sauce. Enjoy!
title: Teriyaki Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Boil some water in a large saucepan. Add 250ml cold water and the udon noodles. (As they are so thick, adding cold water helps them to cook a little bit slower so the middle cooks through). If using frozen or fresh noodles, cook for 2 mins or until al dente; dried will take longer, about 5-6 mins. Drain and leave in the colander.

2. Heat 1 tbsp of the oil, add the onion and cabbage and sauté for 5 mins until softened. Add the mushrooms and some spring onions, and sauté for 1 more min. Pour in the remaining sesame oil and the noodles. If using cold noodles, let them heat through before adding the ingredients for the sauce – otherwise tip in straight away and keep stir-frying until sticky and piping hot. Sprinkle with the remaining spring onions.
title: Yaki Udon

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and pour over chicken.
2. Use a glass dish, not metal or plastic.
3. Cover and place in refrigerator 2 hours.
4. Remove chicken from marinade and cook on grill.
5. Yields 8 servings.
title: Teriyaki Chicken

steps: 1. Marinate beef cubes in sauce for 12 hours, then broil.
2. Great on the outdoor grill.
3. Serves 4.
title: Teriyaki Beef Kabobs

steps: 1. Partially freeze beef; thinly slice across grain into 3-inch strips.
2. For marinade, combine soy sauce, oil, molasses, mustard, ginger, garlic and 1/4 cup water; mix well.
3. Add meat to marinade; let stand 15 minutes at room temperature.
4. Drain meat, reserving marinade.
5. Thread meat strips accordian-style on 12 skewers. Grill skewers over hot coals 5 to 7 minutes or to desired doneness.
6. Turn and baste occasionally with marinade.
7. Serves 6.
title: Beef Teriyaki

ingredients.text: 1 lb. pork tenderloin, cut into bite size chunks

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except pork strips and mix well.
2. Add pork to marinade; cover and marinate in refrigerator at least one hour.
3. Thread meat onto skewers.
4. Broil or grill, turning frequently 4 to 5 minutes.
5. Serve with rice, if desired.
6. Serves 4.
title: Pork Teriyaki

steps: 1. Remove fat and outside membrane from meat.
2. Score both sides. Cut into 3 x 4-inch pieces diagonally across the grain.
3. Combine all ingredients and marinate steak in mixture 1 to 3 hours or more. Put on skewers and grill or broil 4 minutes on one side and 3 on the other.
4. Serves 4.
title: Grilled Teriyaki

steps: 1. Cut steak into 1/8-inch thick slices.
2. Combine remaining ingredients in small bowl.
3. Place meat in crock-pot.
4. Pour sauce mixture over meat.
5. Cover.
6. Cook on low, 6 to 8 hours.
7. Serve with rice.
8. Makes 5 to 6 servings.
title: Teriyaki Steak

steps: 1. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the first six ingredients.
2. Set aside 1/2 cup for basting and refrigerate.
3. Add salmon to remaining marinade; turn to coat.
4. Cover and refrigerate for 1-1/2 hours, turning once.
5. Drain and discard marinade.
6. Broil 3-4 inches from the heat for 5 minutes. Spoon reserved marinade over fish; turn and broil for 5 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.
7. Spoon marinade over fish.
8. Yield: 4 servings.
10. Marinating time is not included in prep time, as I don't consider that "active work time".
title: Teriyaki Salmon

steps: 1. Combine teriyaki sauce, brown sugar, minced green onions and lemon juice together.

2. Marinate pork chops in mixture, then place in the refrigerator for 1 to 2 hours. Remove; keep marinade. Place pork chops on broiler rack. Broil 5 to 6-inches from heat for 12 to 15 minutes. Brush with marinade.
3. Turn once.
4. You'll know they are perfectly cooked when a meat thermometer inserted registers 160°.
title: Broiled Teriyaki Chops

steps: 1. Cut chicken thigh into bite-size pieces. In a small bowl, add sake, soy sauce, rice vinegar and sugar, and mix well.
2. Heat saucepan, place chicken in pan and cook both sides until golden grown.
3. Wipe off excess oil with a paper towel.
4. Add sake/soy sauce mixture. Cook until liquid is mostly gone.
5. Remove chicken from saucepan and place on plate.
6. Cook the sauce in the saucepan for a few more minutes until it thickens. Coat chicken with sauce.
title: Izakaya Sakura Teriyaki Chicken

steps: 1. Combine sugar, soy sauce, and water in an 8-quart pot; stir until sugar is dissolved. Turn heat to medium-high; add ginger, garlic, cinnamon, and black pepper and stir.

2. Bring mixture to a boil and add chicken drumettes. Once mixture begins to boil again, reduce heat to medium-low, and partially cover pot with a lid tilted to allow steam to escape. Simmer until chicken is no longer pink in the center and teriyaki sauce is thickened, at least 1 hour.
title: Teriyaki Drumettes

ingredients.text: 6 ounces frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed

steps: 1. Place chicken in large freezer bag.
2. Mix marinade ingredients and pour in bag with chicken. If using as a stir fry marinade, double the marinade ingredients and put half(just the marinade) in a separate freezer bag.
3. Seal and freeze.
4. To serve:.
5. Thaw chicken overnight in fridge.
6. Grill until juices run clear.
7. If using as a stir fry marinade, remove chicken from marinade.
8. Stir fry with desired veggies until done, adding seperate bag of marinade the last few minutes. Thicken with cornstarch if desired. Serve over rice.
title: Orange Teriyaki Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 (6 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves

steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix together the pineapple juice, soy sauce, ginger, garlic powder, and white pepper. Reserve a small amount of the marinade separately for dipping later.
2. Place chicken in marinade, and add enough water to cover. Cover, and refrigerate for 24 hours.
3. Heat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat.
4. Brush grate lightly with oil. Grill chicken 5 to 7 minutes per side, depending on thickness. Chicken is done when inside is no longer pink and juices run clear.
title: Kevin'S Teriyaki Chicken

steps: 1. Combine ingredients in blender.
2. Marinate meat in closed container for 24 hours.
3. Turn meat several times.
4. Cook on grill until done.
title: Steak Teriyaki

steps: 1. Measure ginger, pepper, garlic, lemon juice and soy sauce into screw-top jar and shake well.
2. Let stand 2 hours; strain. Score meat with 1/4-inch diagonal cuts.
3. Place in shallow 8 x 11-inch baking dish.
4. Pour marinade over meat; cover and refrigerate 24 hours, turning occasionally.
5. Drain meat.
6. Grill over hot coals or broil 5 minutes per side.
7. Slice meat thinly across grain to serve.
title: Steak Teriyaki

ingredients.text: 4 hamburger buns, potato or gourmet style

steps: 1. Place chicken breasts in glass dish and smother with teriyaki sauce; turn breasts over to cover thoroughly.
2. Marinate as long as possible, preferably in the fridge overnight.
3. 15-30 minutes if you're in a hurry.
4. On stovetop or grill, cook chicken about 12 to 14 minutes.
5. (7-8 minutes in a George Foreman grill).
6. Chicken breasts (bone-in and boneless) should be cooked to an internal temperature of 170 F.
7. Exact grilling times will depend on the heat of your grill/pan as well as on the thickness of the chicken breast.
8. Chicken is done if, when pierced, the juices run clear or the breast is no longer pink inside.
9. Spread mayonnaise on each bun, top& bottom.
10. Place each cooked chicken breast on a bun and top with a pineapple slice.
11. Serve alongside a summer salad or veggies and don't forget a tall glass of iced tea!
title: Easy Teriyaki Chicken Burgers

steps: 1. Brush soy sauce and mayonnaise on abura-age then cover with shredded cheese.
2. Top with finely chopped spring onions and toast in the oven for 5minutes.
3. Sprinke Shichimi to finish off.
title: Japanese Tofu Pizza

steps: 1. In a pot, put bouillon cube, water, soy sauce, brown sugar, ginger and garlic.
2. Heat until boiling when sugar and cube are dissolved.
3. Add chicken and cover. Turn down heat but continue a light boil until chicken is cooked thoroughly, about 25 minutes.
4. Take out chicken and serve.
5. **I add a little cornstarch/water mixture to the soy sauce sometimes to thicken it a bit if I want to serve it over rice.

6. Freezer Directions: Prepare marinade and allow to cool. Place chicken in large freezer back. Pour cooled marinade over chicken. Seal, label, and freeze. To Serve: Thaw in fridge and cook as directed.
title: Easy Chicken Teriyaki

steps: 1. Whisk the ingredients together and add the prepared veggies or shrimp into the bowl.
2. Fold to coat evenly.
3. Carefully drop individual pieces into hot oil of choice.
4. Fry until lightly browned.
5. Remove from oil with slotted utensil to paper towels.
6. Season to taste.
title: Favorite Tempura Batter

steps: 1. In a bowl mix/whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar and mustard powder.
2. Place the salmon steaks in a glass dish (I use an 8x8-inch glass baking dish).
3. Pour the marinade over the salmon.
4. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for minimum 1-1/2 hours, turning the steaks occasionally.
5. Grill for 4-5 minutes on each side, depending on how thick the steaks are.
6. Brushing with marinade as they cook.
7. **NOTE** sprinkle with salt if desired when cooking.
title: Easy And Delicious Grilled Teriyaki Salmon Steaks

ingredients.text: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (4 ounces each)

steps: 1. Flatten chicken to 1/2-in. thickness; coat with flour. In a large skillet, cook chicken in butter over medium heat for 4-5 minutes on each side or until a thermometer reads 170°. Remove and set aside.
2. Add the teriyaki sauce, lemon juice, garlic and sugar to the skillet; stir to loosen browned bits. Return chicken to the pan and heat through.
title: Lemon Teriyaki Chicken

ingredients.text: 5 1/3 ounces frozen edamame, shelled, about 1/3 of a 16 oz bag

steps: 1. Place a small saucepan filled with water over high heat.
2. Add edamame to pan and bring to a boil; boil for 3 minutes and drain.
3. Place edamame in a serving bowl and set aside.
4. To make seasoning, mix together sea salt, chili powder, ground cumin and cayenne pepper in a cup; toss with edamame until well-coated.
5. 1 Point yields about 1/3 cup per serving.
title: Ww 1 Point - Mexican-Flavored Edamame

ingredients.text: 18 ounces tofu, extra firm (must be extra firm, this won't work with "silken" or soft)
1/4 cup soy sauce (use more if you like)

steps: 1. Remove tofu from container and drain. In a large bowl, mash the tofu with a potato masher. Place crumbles in a strainer and allow as much excess water to drain out as possible. (This is VERY important! Do not skip this step!).
2. While tofu is draining in strainer, peel and shred carrots and prepare green onions.
3. In a small bowl, combine soy sauce,sugar and mirin.
4. In a large skillet, heat sesame oil. When oil is hot, add carrots and green onions. Saute for 2-3 minutes, add the tofu and mix together, continue to saute.
5. Add soy sauce mixture. Allow to cook until carrots are tender but not over cooked.
6. Serve over cooked rice.
title: Japanese Mom'S Tofu Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 (3 -4 lb) whole frying chickens, washed and dried

steps: 1. Mix all marinade ingredients. Using a culinary food injector, inject chicken absolutely everywhere -- including wings and back. Use up as much marinade as possible. The chicken should be overflowing with marinade. Discard any remaining.

2. Truss chicken (you could put some orange slices and garlic cloves in the cavity first, if desired). Affix chicken securely to rotisserie spit. Roast about 1 hour or until instant-read thermometer reads 170 to 180 when inserted in thigh. If possible, turn heat off rotisserie and let chicken spin 10 to 15 minutes off the heat. Or remove from spit and let rest, covered, breast side down, 15 minutes before carving.
title: Orange-Teriyaki Injected Rotisserie Chicken

steps: 1. Heat oil in a medium skillet, add vegestables. Cook stiring over medium heat 5 minutesor until vegestables are tender but not mushy. Add turkey and soy sauce. Stir intil mixed and heated through. Serve over hot rice.
title: Turkey Sukiyaki

steps: 1. Place chicken, teriyaki sauce, lemon juice, garlic, and sesame oil in a large resealable plastic bag. Seal bag, and shake to coat. Place in refrigerator for 24 hours, turning every so often.
2. Preheat grill for high heat.
3. Lightly oil the grill grate. Remove chicken from bag, discarding any remaining marinade. Grill for 6 to 8 minutes each side, or until juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork.
title: Easy Grilled Chicken Teriyaki

ingredients.text: 2 lbs flank steaks, sliced in strips

steps: 1. Marinade: Combine soy sauce, water, sugar, onions, vinegar, garlic and ground ginger. Add beef to marinade cover and refrigerate for two hours or overnight.
2. In skillet, heat oil and saute mushrooms for 3 minutes.
3. Add cabbage and saute for 2 minutes.
4. Add beef and marinade and stir fry for 5 minutes.
5. Add bean sprouts and water chestnuts and stir fry 5 minutes or until meat is done.
title: Beef & Mushroom Teriyaki Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup lemon juice (To me, the flavor is a little too strong, so I add somewhere between a 1/4 and 1/2 cup- just my pref)

steps: 1. In skillet, combine all ingredients except chicken.
2. Cook over medium heat 3- 4 minutes.
3. Add chicken.
4. Simmer 30 minutes or until thoroughly cooked.
5. Cover the chicken for the first 15 minutes and then take the lid off, flip the chicken over and continue to cook for another 15 minutes or so uncovered.
6. The liquid will start to thicken and develop a nice glaze on the chicken.
7. I think its done with the glaze has thickened and the chicken gets a cripsy brown on the edges.
title: Lemon Teriyaki Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 whole chicken breasts, split, boned and skinned (1 lb.)

steps: 1. Place chicken breasts in shallow 2-quart microwave-safe dish or 10-inch pie plate with meaty portions of chicken toward outer edge of dish.
2. Combine remaining ingredients; mix well.
3. Pour over chicken.
4. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 8 hours, turning chicken over once.
5. Drain and discard marinade.
6. Cover with vented plastic wrap.
7. Cook on High power 8 to 10 minutes, rotating dish once. Let stand 3 minutes.
title: Teriyaki Chicken Breast

ingredients.text: 3 to 4 lb. beef, cubed (can use round steak, chuck or sirloin; amount of meat can vary)

steps: 1. Put soy sauce, vinegar and Worcestershire sauce in 1 cup measuring cup and add water to make 1 cup.
2. Put this mixture into large bowl with the rest of ingredients, except beef.
3. Mix together.
4. Add beef and refrigerate at least 24 hours, stirring occasionally to marinate . Put on skewers and grill or broil to desired doneness.
title: Beef Teriyaki

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon white sugar, or more to taste

steps: 1. Heat a skillet over medium heat; cook and stir beef until cooked through, 5 to 7 minutes. Add ginger and stir well. Stir soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar into beef mixture; bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute more.
title: Japanese Minced Beef

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. round steak, cut into 1/4-inch thick strips
2 tsp. fresh ginger root, finely chopped, or about 1/2 tsp. powdered ginger

steps: 1. Blend all the liquid ingredients and the seasonings. Marinate the steak strips in this sauce for 2 hours (or more). Drain and cook quickly over charcoal or in a small amount of cooking oil in a very hot frying pan. Quickly is the key word; the steak slices should be pink inside and are much better underdone than overdone.
title: Teriyaki Beef

steps: 1. In casserole, mix all ingredients; add chicken breasts.
2. Cover loosely and microwave 25 minutes on High, or bake in conventional oven at 375° for 1 1/2 hours.
title: Teriyaki Chicken

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together in medium bowl, mixing well. Can be used on vegetables for deep frying, onion rings, cauliflower, squash, etc. Also great for fish shrimp or oysters.
title: Tempura Batter

steps: 1. Mix the soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar in a shallow dish; place the salmon fillets in the dish, skin side up. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight.

2. Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Drain the salmon and reserve the marinade. Pan fry the salmon 4 to 5 minutes per side, gradually adding the marinade to the pan, this will intensify the flavor and help to keep the salmon moist. Serve once the salmon is cooked through and is easily flaked with a fork.
title: Salmon Yakitori

steps: 1. Sift together the dry ingredients.
2. Beat egg slightly and mix with the water.
3. Add the dry ingredients. Stir only until mixed; mixture will be slightly lumpy.
4. Dip shrimp, chunky-cut chicken and vegetables, etc. into the batter and deep fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
title: Tempura Fondue Batter

steps: 1. Combine soy sauce, sugar, broth, vegetable oil, ginger and garlic in medium bowl.
2. Cut chicken into strips about 3 x 1/2-inch.
3. Add to marinade and toss to combine.
4. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate several hours or overnight.
title: Chicken Yakitori(Poultry)

steps: 1. Preheat grill.
2. In a shallow dish, combine soy sauce, sherry, oil and ginger.
3. Place chicken in marinade and let stand 5 minutes on each side. Grill until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 7 to 10 minutes a side.
title: Teriyaki Grilled Chicken

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, combine cake flour, cornstarch and baking powder.
2. In a small bowl, mix white white and 1 cup ice cold water.
3. Pour into dry ingredients, leaving batter lumpy and undermixed.
4. If batter becomes too smooth, sprinkle in some extra cake flour.
5. Add extra ice cold water depending on how thick or thin youe desire.
title: Lacy Tempura Batter

steps: 1. Wash chicken in cold water and place in baking dish.
2. Mix all other ingredients and pour over chicken.
3. Preheat oven to 350°. Bake 20 minutes uncovered.
4. Cover and bake 30 minutes more or until chicken is done.
title: Teriyaki Chicken

steps: 1. Trim fat from pork chops.
2. For marinade, combine remaining ingredients.
3. Pour half of marinade into large glass dish.
4. Place chops in marinade; pour remaining marinade over chops.
5. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours or overnight, turning occasionally.
title: Grilled Teriyaki Pork Chops

steps: 1. Blend all ingredients together until the ground beef has a uniform consistency.
2. Separate into 4 equal-sized portions.
3. Roll each portion into a ball, then flatten into a patty.
4. Place in a 10-inch skillet with a lid for 4 minutes over a medium flame.
5. Flip the patties over and cover for an additional 4 minutes.
6. Timing can be adjusted to suit your taste; more for well done, less for rare.
title: Teriyaki Burger

steps: 1. combine oil &egg, beat well
2. add remaining ingredients & whisk until blended
title: Tempura Batter

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Prick your sausages all over so's to aid in the release of the fatty juices.
3. Mix flour, salt and pepper in a small bowl. (I usually just use a cereal bowl.).
4. Roll the sausages in the flour mixture until covered.
5. Place all sausages on a broiling pan and place on middle rack in oven. Bake for about 40 minutes. Turning sausages over after 20 minutes.
6. Put brown sugar in a small bowl. I usually use the same bowl I used for the flour.
7. Add the soy sauce. You want to make the brown sugar into a paste. So you may need to decrease or increase the amount listed.
8. (I usually just pour from the bottle so I am not definite on the measurement.).
9. Mix in the lemon juice.
10. Then add the spices. These can be adjusted according to taste. (I sometimes put as much as double the spices in.).
11. Using a pastry brush, coat the tops and sides of the sausages with the brown sugar mixture. Make sure you leave enough in the bowl to coat the sausages at least once more.
12. Leave the sausages in for another 10 minutes.
13. Then turn them all over. Coat them with some more sauce. Let cook for 10 more minutes.

14. At this point, some would consider the sausages done. You can take them out now and enjoy them. Or you can keep coating and turning the sausages until they are done to your preference. (We like ours cooked to the point where the start to shrivel -- I know, weird.).
title: Candied Sausage (Poor Man'S Teriyaki)

ingredients.text: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into bite size pieces

steps: 1. Heat Teriyaki sauce, water, ginger, onion and garlic powder to a boil.
2. Cook for 2 Minutes.
3. Let cool and pour over chicken.
4. Marinate for at least 20 minutes.
5. Drain Chicken reserving the marinade.
6. Heat wok and add oil.
7. Add chicken stirring quickly to cook.
8. About 5-7 minutes.
9. Add vegetables, cooking until desired crispness.
10. Place chicken and vegetables on a platter.

steps: 1. Sieve ground almond, matcha powder and icing sugar twice.

2. Beat egg white until foamy and sieve icing sugar in batches then change to high speed and beat till peak form (thick and glossy). You may beat egg white to stiffer peak if you prefer a thicker marcaron.
3. Then sieve (again) dry ingredients into egg white in two batches and fold mixture well thoroughly with a rubber spatula.

4. Add batter into piping bag with nozzle tip #1A attached. Then pipe small circles on non-stick baking sheet. (When piping macarons, hold bag straight up from the sheet, with the tip close to the baking sheet. The batter will push itself out in a perfect circle).
5. Once piped use a toothpick to prick any air bubbles that appear. Dry the macaron shells for 30 minutes at room temperature.

6. Preheat oven at 150 degree for 10 minutes. Then bake macaron shells at centre rack with one empty tray placing at the lower rack. This is to avoid excess heat burning the base of the marcaron shells. The feet will start to appear in about 3 minutes.
7. Remove the (hot) empty rack and place another empty rack on top of the macaron shells and bake for another 5-8 minutes.

8. You can test if they are done by touching the tip of a macaron, if its wobbles they are not done. When baking is complete, the shell should not stick to the tray. Put them back to oven for a couple of minutes if you have difficulties removing them from the baking sheet.
9. Dust some matcha powder on macaron shells and leave them to cool on the baking tray. You can store them in an airtight container and refrigerate it until you're ready to use them.
10. Pipe cream of your choice onto one macaron shell and sandwich with another half.

2. Add the beef or chicken and marinate for 2 hours in the refrigerator.

3. Remove the meat from the marinade, and pour the marinade into a medium-sized saucepan. Place over medium heat and reduce until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes. Reserve 2 tablespoons of reduced marinade and set aside.
4. Preheat the broiler.

5. For the beef teriyaki: Slide the beef onto wooden skewers that have been soaked in water for 1 hour and place on a broiler pan. Place the broiler pan on a rack 6 inches from the broiler and broil for 6 minutes. Turn the meat over, check for doneness, checking every minute or two. Brush with the reserved sauce just before serving.

6. For the chicken teriyaki: Place the chicken on a broiler pan skin-side down. Place the broiler pan on a rack 6 inches from the broiler and broil for 3 minutes. Turn the meat over and baste with the reduced sauce. Broil another 5 minutes. The skin should be dark brown in spots and the chicken should be cooked through. Brush with the reserved sauce just before serving.

7. Tip: Teriyaki is often cooked over a grill. For this technique, place the marinated meat directly on a barbecue grill rack situated 6 inches over hot coals. Turn and baste with sauce as directed in the recipe.

steps: 1. Place rice in a strainer and rinse under cold water until run-off turns from cloudy to completely clear, about 2 minutes. Place strainer over a bowl and let drain until almost dry, about 1 hour. Transfer to a heavy bottom saucepan with a tight-fitting lid.

2. Pour water over rice. Place pot over medium-high heat and bring to a simmer without stirring. Remove from heat; lift lid for 1 second and cover again immediately. Let sit another 10 minutes.

3. Transfer rice to a rimmed sheet pan and spread out with a fork, fanning (with a magazine or similar object) to start to cool it. Sprinkle about half the rice vinegar on the rice while gently tossing it. Continue fanning to bring rice to just over room temperature. title: Chef John'S Easy Sushi Rice

ingredients.text: 250 ml sushi rice, must be short-grained

steps: 1. Rinse and swirl sushi rice in a good quality pot that takes about 4 times its volume; drain in a strainer or sieve. Do this three times and return the rice to the pot. Add the cooking water.

2. Bring the rice and water to the boil on high heat. Immediately reduce the heat to the lowest setting, place the lid tightly on the pot, set your timer/cellphone/watch to 20 minutes and DO NOT REMOVE THE LID FOR EVEN A MOMENT.

3. In the meantime make the sushi-su (rice vinegar mix). Mix the rice wine vinegar, sugar and salt in a bowl and microwave for a minute or so. Stir until the sugar and salt have dissolved. Also use this time to prepare your other ingredients.
4. When your timer goes off after 20 minutes turn the heat to zero, STILL DO NOT REMOVE THE LID, and set your timer/cellphone/watch to another 20 minutes.
5. After 20 minutes YOU MAY REMOVE THE LID! and turn the rice out into a large bowl - glass, ceramic, wood or plastic only.

6. When it has cooled for a few minutes use a large blunt implement such as a flat-ended wooden spoon to make some gentle but deep incisions into the rice and pour half the sushi-su all over and into the cooling rice.

7. Gently turn the rice with your implement taking care not to make it stickier. Make a few more incisions, and pour the rest of the vinegar. Turn gently again as you allow the sushi rice to cool to body temperature before starting to make your sushi.

8. Bonus tip 1: While making sushi keep a bowl of clean slightly warm water next to you and frequently wet your hand as you spread the sushi rice onto the nori (with nori rough-side up) to prevent it sticking to your hand.

9. Bonus tip 2: Make everyday sushi with ingredients you already have on hand. Vegetarian maki rolls are fabulous and can include carrot (shavings or fine sticks), avocado (thinly sliced), cucumber (thinly sliced lengthwise, small Mediterranean cucumbers are best with lower water content than English cucumbers), sesame seed (dry-toasted), spring onion (green onion or scallion), sweet red, orange or yellow pepper (pimento, finely sliced lengthwise), firm juicy-fleshed fruit such as strawberry and melon, and of course wasabi and Japanese Kewpie Doll mayonnaise.
10. Bonus tip 3: Only dip in Kikkoman soya sauce. Tens of thousands of sushi chefs around the world can't be wrong.
