3. Place edamame in a food processor; process 1 minute or until finely chopped. With food processor on, slowly pour reserved cooking liquid through food chute; process until smooth.
4. Place edamame mixture, potato mixture, milk, oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl, and mash with a potato masher to desired consistency.
title: Edamame Mashed Potatoes

steps: 1. Pour the oil into a small bowl. Dip a folded up piece of paper towel in the oil and use it to apply a film of oil to a nonstick skillet about 8" in diameter. Heat the pan on medium heat.
2. Scramble the rest of the ingredients together, but try not to introduce too many air bubbles into the mixture.

3. Pour a third of the egg mixture onto the hot pan and swirl it around so that the bottom is evenly covered. You may want to turn down the heat a bit here since you don't want the egg to cook completely through while you are folding it.

4. Starting from one end, fold over about 1/4" of the egg and continue to fold it over and over until all the egg has been rolled up. You want to do this carefully so that you get a tight bundle and end up with a flattened log.
5. Slide this log over towards the end where you started folding and re-oil the bottom of the pan. Pour in half of the remaining egg mixture and swirl the pan again to make another layer.

6. Start folding the egg again in the same direction until it is all folded up. Slide the log back, re-oil, and pour almost all of egg mixture in, reserving about a teaspoon. Repeat the swirling and folding. Once all the egg has been folded up into a flattened log, remove the egg from the pan and place it on a cutting board.

7. Slice off the uneven ends, then cut the rest of the log into 1/2"-3/4" cross sections. Lay each cross section down and make a diagonal slice. Flip one of the halves over and rejoin to make a heart shape.
8. Choose the nicest shaped sides of each heart, and dip that side into the leftover egg mixture. Place dipped side down onto the pan and cook for another 15 seconds. Serve dipped side up.
title: Heart-Shaped Tamagoyaki (Japanese Omelet)

steps: 1. Boil and mix Ramen noodles as directed on package; drain. Scramble eggs in butter.
2. When cooked, add noodles to skillet and stir.
3. Place cheese on top until melted.
title: Ramen Breakfast

steps: 1. Put the eggs and milk into a mixing bowl, add about half a teaspoon of salt and whisk.
2. Next you need to pass this mixture through a fine sieve. This is very important step because it removes the chalaza, so the dish will have a finer texture and it will contain less cholesterol.
3. Add the finely chopped carrots, onions, and freshly ground pepper and stir.
4. Lightly grease the frying pan and turn on the heat.
title: Tamagoyaki - Japanese Rolled Omelette

ingredients.text: 2 Skinless, Boneless Chicken Thighs, Cut Into 1-inch Pieces
4 Tablespoons Ketchup, Plus More For Serving

steps: 1. Heat butter in a large pan. Add chicken pieces and cook for about 2 minutes. Add chopped onion and cook, stirring frequently, for about 5 minutes more, until translucent. Add cooked rice, toss, and cook for a couple of minutes more. Season to taste.
2. Clear a spot in the middle of the pan. Add ketchup in that spot and stir for 30 seconds until lightly caramelized. Mix ketchup with the rest of the pan contents.
3. Add the peas and toss until heated through. Transfer everything to a bowl.

4. Crack eggs into separate containers. Season beaten eggs with some salt (keep them separated). In a skillet, heat some vegetable oil and pour one egg into it, swirling to coat the pan in a thin layer. Cook until the top is set and put half of the rice and chicken mixture in the middle. Fold the sides over the mixture. Repeat with remaining egg.
title: Japanese Omelette Rice (Omurice)

ingredients.text: 2 (3 ounce) packages chicken flavored ramen noodles

steps: 1. Place noodles in a saucepan filled with boiling water, reserving the seasoning packet. Cook until tender, and drain. In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs and seasoning packets from the noodles. Mix in noodles.

2. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the noodle mixture, and cook over medium-low heat until firm, 5 to 7 minutes. Cut into fourths, and turn over to brown the other side for 1 to 2 minutes. Sprinkle cheese over the top, and serve.
title: Ramen Noodle Frittata

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon chopped fresh parsley, or to taste

steps: 1. Bring a pot of water to a boil; add ramen noodles and cook for 3 minutes. Drain water and stir seasoning packet and parsley into noodles.
2. Heat oil a non-stick skillet over medium heat; cook and stir onion until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Add noodles and stir for 2 minutes more.
3. Whisk eggs, water, and salt together in a bowl; pour into same skillet as noodle mixture. Cook and stir eggs until set and cooked through, 2 to 4 minutes.
title: Ramen Scrambled Eggs

steps: 1. Cut up the onions in little pieces and mix it together in bowl with the natto and soy sauce.
2. Crack an egg into a bowl and add a little salt & pepper.
3. Add the onions & natto to the egg mixture.
4. Put oil on the pan.
5. Pour 1/4 of the mixture into pan.
6. Cook the mixture at medium heat.
7. When the omelette is half cooked fold it into an oval shape on the pan.
8. From the far side, turn it back over.
9. Do everything from step 4 to make 4 omelettes.
10. Put everything on a plate together and sprinkle the dried bonito on top.
title: Natto And Dried Bonito Japanese Style Omelette

steps: 1. cut broccoli, blanch and set aside.
2. put rice, dashi, soy sauce, and sake in a saucepan, cover, and place over medium heat. when it starts to boil remove the lid and reduce the heat.
3. add crabmeat and broccoli, stir and cook for 3 minutes. add vinegar and serve.
title: Rice Porridge With Crabmeat

ingredients.text: mirin (if you think fish stinks--it can be obtained at Asian shops)

steps: 1. Wash the rice, and soak it for thirty minutes if desired.
2. Steam it, or cook it.
3. Wash the anchovies and add it into the rice, with water.
4. Steam it, and enjoy it when it's done!
5. You'll have to steam it over again if the rice is not soft enough!
6. You could also add a mushroom, chopped up, into it, or beat an egg in before you put it to steam.
title: Anchovies Rice Porridge

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 ounces kiwi, sliced into long rectangular strips (3/4 of a medium kiwi)

steps: 1. Combine rice, coconut milk, 2 tablespoons sugar, and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a small saucepan and heat over medium-high heat, stirring regularly, until the mixture boils. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender and sticky. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature.
2. Meanwhile, mix butter and remaining 4 tablespoons sugar in a medium bowl until creamed. Add milk, vanilla, and cocoa powder and mix until smooth; stir in flour and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt.

3. Roll chocolate dough into a 12-inch log and place down the middle of a large sheet of waxed paper. Place another piece of waxed paper on top of the log and use a rolling pin to roll the log into a 12x6-inch rectangle. Remove top sheet of waxed paper.

4. Spread room temperature coconut rice on top of chocolate dough rectangle in a 12x5.5-inch rectangle, leaving a 1/4-inch border on both long sides of the rectangle. Line up quartered strawberries horizontally down the center of the coconut rectangle. Line up sliced kiwi below the line of strawberries. Roll up dough into a cylinder like a "sushi roll" by lifting up waxed paper and sealing the ends of the dough together. Roll the roll on the counter and press together firmly. Remove waxed paper from the roll and cut into 16 dessert sushi pieces with a sharp knife. Fill in any gaps with extra fruit, if needed.
5. Place melted chocolate into small soy sauce containers. Serve dessert sushi with chocolate "soy sauce" and eat with chopsticks! Makes 8 servings.
title: Dessert Sushi

steps: 1. Mix together the first five ingredients.
2. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
3. Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.
4. Pie will not be firm when cooked, but will firm up.
5. Makes 8 servings.
title: Japanese Fruit Pie

steps: 1. Combine first 7 sauce ingredients and pour over steak. Marinate 4 hours to 2 days; turn occasionally.
2. Barbecue over hot coals.
3. Baste occasionally with marinade.
4. Carve thin on diagonal. Serves 4.
title: Flank Steak(Teriyaki Barbecue)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Beat eggs, honey and sugar until very thick.
3. Add flour, beating well.
4. Pour into a greased oblong 9 x 12-inch baking pan and bake in a 350° oven for 35 minutes or until cake tester inserted comes out clean.
5. Cool in pan.
6. Serve cut into strips and dusted with confectioners sugar.
7. Serves 6.
title: Kasutera(Japanese Honey Cake)

steps: 1. Mix meat
2. and
3. onion.
4. Combine egg and milk.
5. Add bread crumbs, then
6. combine with meat.
7. Mix soy sauce, sugar, garlic and mayonnaise in bowl.
8. Stir 1/2 sauce into meat loaf.
9. Shape meat loaf.
10. Halfway through cooking, pour remaining sauce over loaf. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
11. Serve with rice!
title: Teriyaki Meat Loaf

steps: 1. Mix sugar, margarine, eggs and vinegar.
2. Mix well.
3. Add coconut, pecans and raisins.
4. Pour in unbaked pie shell.
5. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
title: Japanese Fruit Pie

steps: 1. Cream butter and sugar.
2. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
3. Sift dry ingredients; add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture.
4. Flour raisins and nuts.
5. Add to mixture.
6. Bake in 4 layers at 375° for 25 minutes.
title: Japanese Fruit Cake

steps: 1. Beat eggs.
2. Add other ingredients.
3. Pour into unbaked pie shell.
4. Bake on bottom rack of oven at 300° for 45 to 50 minutes. Also makes nice bars by baking in oblong pan.
title: Japanese Fruit Pie

steps: 1. Mix first 5 ingredients together.
2. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into one 9-inch unbaked pie crust at 350° until done.
title: Japanese Fruit Pie

steps: 1. Melt margarine and chocolate chips together; add other ingredients and stir.
2. Pour into 2 uncooked pie shells.
3. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
title: Japanese Chocolate Pies

steps: 1. Mix eggs, water, soy sauce, and sugar in a bowl with a fork until combined.
2. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Pour egg mixture into skillet and stir with a fork. Cook until omelet begins to set and liquid is no longer visible, 3 to 5 minutes. Fold in half twice.
title: Japanese Sweet Omelet

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients well and pour into tube pan and bake at 300° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
2. Test for doneness by inserting cake tester or case knife, should come out clean and dry.
title: Japanese Fruit Cake

steps: 1. Beat eggs slightly.
2. Add other ingredients (except pie shells). Pour into pie shells.
3. Bake at 300° for 50 to 55 minutes.
title: Japanese Fruit Pie

steps: 1. Mix milk, flour and eggs together.
2. Melt butter in pie plate in oven.
3. When melted, remove plate and immediately add mixture. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and place in oven.
4. Edges will rise.
5. It is cooked when rising stops and cake is golden brown (not golden crisp), about 10 minutes or so.
6. Serve with syrup or powdered sugar or jams.
title: Japanese Puff Pancakes(Serves 2 To 4)

steps: 1. Divide equal parts of the batter. Add to one part, 1 tsp. allspice, 1/4 tsp. cinnamon, 1 tsp. nutmeg, and 1 cup raisins. Bake at 325° until done.
title: Japanese Fruit Cake

ingredients.text: 3 c. self-rising flour (White Lily), sifted 3 times

steps: 1. Cream sugar and Crisco; add eggs one at a time, beating well after each egg.
2. Add flour one cup at a time, alternately with milk.
3. Add vanilla; add third cup of flour as last ingredient. Keeps cake from falling.
4. Bake 2 layers at 375° until light brown in a greased and floured cake pan.
5. Grease bottom of pan only.
title: Mama Matthew'S Japanese Fruit Cake(4 Layer Cake)

steps: 1. Cover raisins with water.
2. Bring to a boil, then drain and cool by running cold water over them.
3. Let drain while mixing the sugar, margarine (softened), flour, egg (unbeaten) and coconut. Place raisins in unbaked pie shell.
4. Pour mixture over raisins and bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until brown.
title: Raisin (Japanese Fruit) Pie

steps: 1. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
2. Add eggs, beating well.
3. Sift flour, measure and sift 3 times again with baking powder and salt.
4. Add dry mixture alternately with milk, beating well after each addition.
5. Add vanilla.
6. Divide batter in half.
7. With one part, cook two light-colored layers.
8. To the other half of the batter, add raisins, pecans, cloves and cinnamon. Using this batter, bake two more layers.
9. It is optional to use white or yellow cake mix.
title: Japanese Fruit Cake

steps: 1. Beat the eggs.
2. Add margarine and sugar; stir well.
3. Add vinegar, water and vanilla, then add pecans, coconut and raisins. Bake in an 8-inch pie pan at 350° until brown and set.
title: Japanese Fruit Pie

steps: 1. Cream margarine with sugar.
2. Add milk and beat well.
3. Add beaten eggs.
4. Combine dry ingredients and mix into batter.
5. Stir in nuts and raisins.
6. Reserve
7. 1 1/2 cups batter for filling. Bake in 3 (9-inch) greased and floured cake pans for 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.
title: Japanese Fruit Cake

steps: 1. Whisk together the rice vinegar, soy sauce, red pepper flakes, garlic, ginger, green onions, and sesame oil in a bowl; allow to sit 15 minutes before serving. Store in refrigerator up to 1 week.
title: Gyoza Sauce

steps: 1. 1. Mix all ingredients using a stick blender.
2. 2. Refrigerate over night
3. 3. Enjoy.
title: Japanese Steakhouse Yum Yum Sauce

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon honey (try to get as good as possible quality)

steps: 1. Gently stir all ingredients together over a medium heat until the honey is dissolved.
2. Ready for use straight away, or bottle and refrigerate for future use.
title: Traditional Teriyaki Sauce

steps: 1. Wash fresh ginger root and rub off skin.
2. Slice the ginger thinly.
3. Sprinkle salt on ginger.
4. Leave salted ginger slices in a bowl for 1 hour.
5. Dry the ginger slices with paper towels, and put them in a sterilized container/jar.
6. Mix rice vinegar and sugar in a pan, and bring to a boil.
7. Pour the hot mixture of vinegar and sugar over the ginger slices. Cool.
8. The ginger will change color to light pink.
9. Cover the jar, and store it in the refrigerator.
title: Japanese Pickled Ginger

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid.
2. Shake well to combine.
3. Store in refrigerator until use.
title: Japanese Peanut Salad Dressing

steps: 1. For beef, pork or chicken, cooked on grill.
title: Teriyaki Marinade

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, mix water, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic, and cinnamon. Place desired meat in the mixture. Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator at least 2 hours before grilling as desired.
title: Easiest Teriyaki Marinade Ever

steps: 1. In a small saucepan, combine garlic, soy sauce and sugar. In a small dish, whisk together mirin and cornstarch until the cornstarch is dissolved. Add cornstarch mixture to the small saucepan, mixing thoroughly. Then heat it over medium-low heat until the sugar has dissolved.
2. Serving suggestions: Serve over chicken or tossed in a stir-fry.
title: Homemade Teriyaki Sauce

ingredients.text: 1/2 pound snow peas, halved crosswise (3 cups)

steps: 1. Cook the rice according to the package directions.
2. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine the chicken, scallions, and ginger. Shape into 16 meatballs.
3. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the meatballs, turning, until cooked through, 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
4. Wipe out the skillet. Heat the remaining oil over medium-high heat. Add the peas and edamame. Cook, tossing, for 2 minutes. Return the meatballs to skillet.
5. In a small bowl, combine the soy sauce and sugar. Add to the skillet and simmer until slightly thickened, 2 to 3 minutes. Serve over the rice.
6. To keep the ground chicken from sticking to your fingers, wet your hands before forming the meatballs.
title: Chicken Teriyaki Meatballs With Edamame And Snow Peas

steps: 1. Dip chicken in egg and then in flour.
2. Fry in butter until brown and crisp.
3. Place in a shallow roasting pan and pour sauce over chicken.
title: Japanese Chicken Wings

steps: 1. Mix with beef or chicken and refrigerate at least 3 hours.
title: Teriyaki Marinade

steps: 1. Mix all together.
2. Let meat marinate for at least 1/2 to 1 hour; longer if necessary.
3. Great for beef:
4. kabobs, chuck steaks, family steaks.
5. Also good for chicken.
title: Teriyaki Marinade

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
2. Great for marinating chicken for barbecue.
3. Can also brush on chicken while cooking.
title: Teriyaki Sauce

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon honey, or more to taste

steps: 1. Combine 1 cup water, soy sauce, brown sugar, honey, ginger, and garlic powder in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook until nearly heated through, about 1 minute.
2. Mix cornstarch and 1/4 cold water together in a cup; stir until dissolved. Add to the saucepan. Cook and stir sauce until thickened, 5 to 7 minutes.
title: Simple Teriyaki Sauce

steps: 1. Place soy sauce , sugar , ginger and pepper flakes in 2 quart sauce pan. Bring to simmer and make sure all sugar is dissolved. Lower heat and add blueberries. Simmer for 10 minutes and bring up to slow boil. Mix cornstarch and water to make slurry. Add to sauce while stirring. Should thicken up instantly. Ready to use hot or could refrigerate to use later. Reccomend using at room temperature after initial preperation. Good in refrigerator for 2 weeks.
title: Blueberry Teriyaki

steps: 1. Set 6 quarts of salted water to boil in a large pot.
2. Meanwhile, chop red pepper and slice the smoked sausage into 1/4 inch-thick rounds.
3. Stir-fry red pepper and sausage together until heated through -- about 5 minutes.
4. Add tortellini to boiling water and cook for 5 minutes.
5. Add edamame to water and boil for another 2 minutes. Drain tortellini and edamame well.
6. Mix Italian dressing, ginger and teriyaki sauce.
7. Toss everything together with the Italian dressing mixture and heat through one final time.
title: Tortellini With Edamame And Smoked Sausage

steps: 1. Mix ingredients together.
2. Marinate flank steak at least one hour in sauce.
3. Broil steak until medium rare.
4. Heat remaining sauce; pour over steak and serve.
title: Steak Teriyaki

ingredients.text: 6 uncooked jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: 1. Combine the first seven ingredients in a large resealable plastic bag; add shrimp. Seal bag and turn to coat. Refrigerate for 1 hour, turning occasionally.

2. Drain and discard marinade. Thread shrimp onto two metal or soaked wooden skewers. Using long-handled tongs, moisten a paper towel with cooking oil and lightly coat the grill rack. Grill, covered, over medium heat or broil 4 in. from the heat for 3-4 minutes on each side or until shrimp turn pink.
title: Grilled Lime-Teriyaki Shrimp

steps: 1. Mix the brown sugar, soy sauce and dry mustard in bottom of a 9 x 12-inch pan.
2. Put pork chops on top and then put pineapple on top of pork chops.
3. (Do not use pineapple juice.)
title: Teriyaki Pork Chops

steps: 1. Cut steak into serving pieces.
2. Make a sauce from ginger, garlic, onion, sugar, soy sauce and water.
3. Pour over meat and let stand 1 to 2 hours.
4. Spread out on shallow pan and broil 3 to 5 minutes on each side.
5. Serve hot.
6. Serves 6.
title: Teriyaki Steak

ingredients.text: 4 lb. meaty pork spareribs, sawed in half across bones

steps: 1. Cut meat into 2 rib portions.
2. For marinade, mix soy sauce, oil, lemon juice, brown sugar, garlic, ginger and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
3. Place ribs in a shallow baking dish.
4. Pour marinade over. Cover.
5. Refrigerate 4 to 6 hours, occasionally spooning marinade over.
title: Teriyaki Ribs

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, thinly sliced
1 None red pepper, cut into matchsticks

steps: 1. Combine chicken and ginger. Heat an oiled wok. In batches, stir-fry chicken until browned. Remove from wok.
2. Stir-fry carrots and pepper in wok until tender. Return chicken to wok with teriyaki sauce; stir-fry until hot. Season to taste and serve sprinkled with cilantro.
title: Ginger Teriyaki Chicken

steps: 1. Mix together and baste over chicken as it cooks on the grill.
title: Chicken Teriyaki

steps: 1. Sprinkle tenderizer on all sides of meat and let stand.
2. Cut into small pieces.
3. Marinate overnight in refrigerator.
4. Turn occasionally; drain.
5. Grill about 10 minutes.
title: Teriyaki Beef

steps: 1. Drain tofu and remove from package.
2. Cut tofu into 3/4 inch slices and lay out flat between paper towels.
3. Put a weighted cooking sheet on top and press tofu for 30 minutes. This will remove the water from the tofu and allow it to soak up the marinade.
4. While tofu is draining, mix together Tamari, rice vinegar, sesame oil, honey, and ground ginger.
5. Marinade drained tofu in the mixture for at least one hour, preferably overnight.
6. Spray pan with cooking spray.
7. Put slices of marinated tofu onto pan, wait for first side to brown (about five minutes) and then cook on other side until browned.
8. Enjoy!
title: Marinated Teriyaki Tofu

steps: 1. Cut meat into serving pieces; score on both sides.
2. Place meat in shallow pan.
3. Mix soy sauce, onions, garlic, sugar, oil, sherry and pepper.
4. Pour over beef and let stand 1 hour at room temperature.
5. Turn once; drain.
6. Place meat over medium coals. Grill until desired doneness (allow 15 minutes for medium). Garnish with additional green onion, if desired.
7. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Grilled Marinated Beef(Korean)

steps: 1. Combine soy sauce, sugar, ginger, vinegar, sesame oil, crushed red pepper, garlic.
2. Marinate pork in zip lock bag overnight.
3. Reserve the marinade. Boil it then simmer for 5 minutes and use as a sauce for the meat.
4. Grill on direct heat approx 6 min per side. Do not overcook.
5. OR brown on all sides about 6 minutes then bake at 425 for 15 min. (160
6. degrees)
7. Serve with marinade.
title: Korean Pork Tenderloin

steps: 1. Mix together the first 7 ingredients in a large heavy-duty plastic zip-lock bag; add pork.
2. Seal bag and marinate in refrigerator for 8 hours or overnight, turning every now and then.
3. Heat a large ovenproof skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat.
4. Remove pork from bag; reserve marinade.
5. Add pork to pan; cook 6 minutes, browning on all sides.
6. Place pan in oven, bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until meat thermometer read 160°; let stand 5 minutes before slicing.
7. Bring reserved marinade to a boil in a saucepan; lower heat, and simmer 5 minutes.
8. Cut pork into 1/4-inch slices; serve with sauce.
title: Korean-Style Pork Tenderloin

ingredients.text: 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs, 1/4 lb. each
1/2 cup reduced-sodium chicken broth, reduced sodium

steps: 1. Combine the scallions, mirin, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, 1 tspl. of the oil, and the crushed red pepper flakesin a zip closed bag; add the chicken and seal (removing all the air in the bag).
2. Turn to coat the chicken; refrigerate, turning the bag occasionally, at least 2 hours or up to overnight.
3. Lift the chicken from the marinade and pat dry with paper towels.
4. Discard the marinade.
5. Heat the remaining 1 teaspoons of oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
6. Add the chicken and cook until lightly browned, about 2 minutes per side.
7. Add the broth; bring to a boil.
8. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and the liquid is syrupy, about 10 minutes.
9. Turn the chicken to coat in the liquid.
title: Korean-Style Chicken Ww

ingredients.text: 6 eggs (or as many as will fit in a single layer in the bottom of your Instant Pot insert)
1 cup water (enough to cover the eggs)

steps: 1. Let the eggs come to room temperature for about an hour-this will help prevent cracking during cooking-then place them in the Instant Pot insert.
2. Cover them with water, add the salt, and close the pot, making sure the release valve is set to "sealing".
3. Press "Manual" or "Pressure Cook," make sure you're set to "high pressure," and set the time to 90 minutes.

4. After the cooking time has elapsed, release the pressure manually, (quick release) remove the hot eggs from the insert-use tongs or a spider-and set them in an ice bath until they are fully cool to the touch.
5. Peel 'em, eat 'em.
title: Seven Hour Eggs - Korean Sauna

ingredients.text: 1 pound pork loin, cut into strips
4 stalks celery, cut into strips and leaves reserved

steps: 1. Mix 2 tablespoons soy sauce, tomato paste, green onions, rice wine, 1 tablespoon sugar, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, and 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes in a bowl. Add pork; cover with plastic wrap and let marinate in the refrigerator, at least 1 hour.

2. Heat 1 tablespoon canola oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the pork in batches, being sure not to overcrowd the pan, until slightly pink in the center, about 10 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 145 degrees F (63 degrees C).

3. Heat 1 teaspoon canola oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add celery, remaining 1 tablespoon sugar, and remaining 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes. Saute for 1 minute. Add remaining 2 tablespoons soy sauce; cook and stir for 1 minute more. Add celery leaves; cook and stir until celery is crisp-tender, about 3 minutes more. Serve alongside pork.
title: Korean Fried Pork With Stir-Fried Celery

steps: 1. Wrap bacon around tenderloins; fasten with toothpicks.
2. Place meat in a baking dish.
3. combine remaining ingredients; pour over meat.
4. Let stand in refrigerator for 4 to 5 hours, turning meat at least once while marinating.
5. Roast in a preheated 300 degrees oven 1 1/2 hours or until meat thermometer reaches 170 degrees; baste occasionally, turning meat once. Serve pan juices separately to spoon over meat.
title: Korean Pork Tenderloin

ingredients.text: 2 pounds Russet potatoes, peeled and grated

steps: 1. Peel the potatoes, make sure to remove any green parts.
2. Grate the potatoes with hand grater on the finest setting (or you can use the thicker setting for a more hash brown appearance).
3. Grate the onion and garlic with hand grater on the finest setting into the same bowl with the potatoes and stir them together. The onion juice will help keep the potatoes from turning brown.
4. Drain as much moisture from the mixture as possible. Add the cornstarch and season with the salt and pepper.
5. Heat your favorite high temperature oil (I used grapeseed oil) in a cast iron skillet over medium high heat.
6. Use a spoon to quickly drop the potato batter into the skillet. Form up to 6 pancakes, approx. 3 1/2 inches in diameter.
7. Cook for approximately 4 minutes or until you begin to see the edges turn golden brown. Flip them over and allow them to cook for a few minutes more.
8. Transfer the cooked pancakes to a tray and repeat the process until all the batter is cooked.
title: Korean Latkes

steps: 1. Combine soy sauce, garlic powder, salt and peppers.
2. Slowly whisk in the oil.
3. Place beef in a plastic bag.
4. Pour sauce over meat.
5. Seal bag and refrigerate for 6 hours.
6. Turn bag occasionally.
7. Drain meat and discard marinade.
8. Cook meat as you desire.
title: Spicy Korean Beef

steps: 1. Rinse soy bean sprouts. Boil covered in salted water for 10 minutes. Drain and cool. While sprouts cool, wisk rest of ingredients together in a bowl. Toss sprouts with sauce and enjoy!
title: Korean Bean Sprouts Via Amidon'S

ingredients.text: 3 heads napa cabbage, cored and cut into quarters lengthwise
1 bunch green onions, cut into 2 inch pieces
2 teaspoons red pepper flakes, or to taste

steps: 1. Cut the cabbage leaves into 2 inch long pieces. Spread 1/4 of the leaves into a large, non-metallic bowl and sprinkle with 1/4 of the salt. Repeat layering all of the cabbage has been salted. Let stand at room temperature until a lot of liquid has been pulled from the leaves and the cabbage is tender, 3 to 4 hours; drain. Rinse the cabbage in 2 or 3 changes of water. Drain again very well and return the cabbage to the mixing bowl.

2. Sprinkle the cabbage with the minced garlic, green onions, MSG, and red pepper flakes. Season to taste with additional salt and toss until evenly combined. Pack the mixture into a sterilized gallon-sized glass jar. Cover the jar with wax paper and a loose fitting lid so the seal is not airtight.
3. Allow the cabbage to ferment at room temperature until it reaches the desired degree of sourness, 2 to 5 days. Store in an airtight jar in the refrigerator.
title: Korean Kimchi

steps: 1. Cut the meat into 3-in long strips with the fibers running from end to end. Cook the beef in the water until it is tender. Drain off the water. Add the soy sauce, sugar and ginger to the beef in a small pan, cover and simmer very gently until only a small amount of liquid remains. Be careful that the meat does not burn.
