steps: 1. Heat a medium skillet over medium heat; add all ingredients. Cook 2 minutes or until toasted, stirring frequently. Place spice mixture in a spice or coffee grinder; process until finely ground.
title: Garam Masala

ingredients.text: 2 1/4 pounds skinless, boneless chicken thighs, cut into chunks

steps: 1. Rub chicken thighs with curry powder, garam masala, salt. Cover and set aside. Place onion, garlic, ginger, cayenne pepper, and paprika in a blender with 2 tablespoons of water and blend into a smooth paste.

2. Heat the oil in a large, lidded skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir onion mixture until darkened, about 7 minutes. Stir in chicken thighs and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, then add tomatoes, lemon grass, and fish sauce. Cook for 2 minutes. Stir in 1 cup of water and bring the curry to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to low and cook until the chicken begins to fall apart, stirring occasionally, 25 to 35 minutes. Remove lid and increase heat. Cook until the sauce is reduced, about 5 minutes. Skim off excess oil from the top and discard.
title: Burmese Chicken Curry

steps: 1. Whisk together the mustard, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, cumin, ginger, and turmeric in a large bowl. Add the chicken to the bowl and toss until they are evenly coated. Scatter the minced garlic over the chicken and toss again. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours.
2. Preheat oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).
3. Arrange the chicken pieces with the skin side facing up in a single layer in baking dishes or roasting pans. Pour the remaining marinade over the chicken. Cover with aluminum foil.
4. Bake in preheated oven until the juices run clear, 40 to 45 minutes.
title: Baked Chicken Curry Flavor-Fest

ingredients.text: 1 small red chili pepper, thinly chopped

steps: 1. Mix the garlic with ginger, onions, vinegar, curry, chilli and lemon grass and grind into a rough paste.
2. Heat the oil in a wok and add the olive oil until hot then mix in the ground paste.
3. Drop the heat to a simmer and add the coconut milk and water.
4. Add the potatoes and cook for about 15 minutes before adding the tofu.
5. Cook for another 15 minutes or until the potato is tender and season with sugar and salt.
6. Season with salt and pepper.
title: Laotian Mild Coconut Tofu Curry

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine all ingredients. Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place for up to 6 months.
title: Curry Blend

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Saute onion, garlic, ginger, and green chile pepper in hot oil until onions are translucent, about 10 minutes.

2. Season onion mixture with cumin, paprika, coriander, garam masala, turmeric, and cayenne pepper; stir. Cook onion with spices until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Add tomatoes, chickpeas, and tomato sauce; stir and simmer until the tomatoes soften, about 5 minutes.
3. Stir yogurt into the mixture until the color of the mixture is even; simmer until again hot, about 5 minutes more. Remove pan from heat; stir lemon juice and salt into the mixture.
title: Delicious Chana Masala

ingredients.text: salt and black pepper to taste

steps: 1. Using a large pot, boil chicken for 1 hour, then add potatoes, carrots, onions and curry; boil 15 minutes, then add butter, salt and pepper.
2. Boil 15 minutes.
3. Enjoy with rice or French bread.
title: Chicken Curry

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. boneless chicken cutlets, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: 1. In a large bowl, heat the oil.
2. Add onions, garlic and ginger. Saute for a minute.
title: Indian Curried Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. fryer chicken, cut up

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in Dutch oven or large, heavy pan. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low.
2. Cover and simmer for 1 hour or until chicken is done, stirring occasionally.
3. Serve with hot rice.
4. Makes 6 servings.
title: Kurma(Quick Chicken Curry From South Africa)

ingredients.text: 3 large skinless, boneless chicken breast, cut into cubes

steps: 1. Mix curry powder, seasoned salt, and onion powder in a bowl; add chicken and toss to coat chicken in seasoning mix.

2. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir onion and garlic in hot oil until tender, about 5 minutes; add chicken, potato, and spinach and stir. Pour coconut milk over the mixture and stir. Place a lid on the skillet, bring the mixture to a simmer, and cook, stirring occasionally, until the potato is tender and the chicken is no longer pink in the center, about 30 minutes.
title: Delicious And Fast Chicken Curry

steps: 1. Spray the bottom of a roasting pan with cooking spray, then place 1/2 of the onions, carrots, celery and garlic in pan.
2. Wash and dry chicken. Stuff with remaining vegetables and half of the curry leaves, coriander, allspice and cumin. Rub graham masala under chicken skin onto meat.
3. Place chicken into roasting pan. Place remaining curry leaves, coriander, allspice and cumin on top of and around chicken.
4. Roast chicken in 350°F oven for about 85 minutes to 1.5 hours or until done.
5. Remove chicken from oven and let rest for 30 minutes.
title: Roasted Chicken With Curry Leaves And Spices

ingredients.text: 2 pounds salmon fillets, cut into 2-inch cubes

steps: 1. Stir together first 9 ingredients in a large shallow dish. Add fish, tossing gently to coat. Cover and chill 30 minutes.
2. Alternately thread salmon, onion, and tomatoes on 8 (6- to 8-inch) skewers. Grill, covered with lid, over medium-high heat (350° to 400°) 4 to 6 minutes on each side or until done.
title: Tandoori Seafood Kebabs

ingredients.text: 1/2 tsp. curry powder or to taste

steps: 1. Cook rice according to directions.
2. Stir in almonds, parsley and butter.
3. To serve, ladle sauce over rice.
title: Mom'S In-A-Hurry Curry

ingredients.text: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into bite-size pieces

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Finely chop the onions and garlic in a blender or food processor, and cook in the skillet until tender. Puree the tomatoes and green bell pepper in the blender or food processor, and mix into the skillet. Season with salt, garam masala, and chili powder. Stir in the cream and butter, and continue cooking until heated through.
2. Mix the chicken into the skillet. Cover, and simmer 20 minutes, or until chicken juices run clear.
title: Wendy'S Indian Butter Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 (5 ounce) can tuna, drained and flaked

steps: 1. Over medium-low heat melt butter in a large saucepan. Add garlic, onions and green pepper. Cook slowly, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft.
2. Stir in tuna, sour cream, curry powder, salt and pepper. Heat until warm and serve.
title: Tuna Curry In A Hurry

steps: 1. Heat canola oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion to pan; saute 4 minutes. Add flour and curry powder; saute 1 minute. Stir in chicken broth; bring to a boil. Stir in turkey and salt. Reduce heat, and simmer 5 minutes or until thickened. Sprinkle with cilantro.
title: Turkey Curry

steps: 1. In a food processor put the prawns, garlic ginger, chilli, onion, turmeric, pepper and salt. Give a quick blitz. DO NOT LIQUIDIZE THE INGREDIENTS, chop them and mix.
2. Add the egg and mix.
3. Form the mixture into balls the size of a golfball. Coat with breadcrumbs. Refrigerate for half an hour.
4. Melt the butter in a pan and fry the prawn balls till golden, drain on kitchen paper and serve garnished with the chopped parsley.
title: Minced Prawn Curry Balls

steps: 1. Cut the chicken in small pieces. Make a paste of all the ingredients including oil and marinate chicken in this paste. Leave for 1/2 hour.
2. Heat the saucepan then Add chicken and stir fry on high heat until chicken is tender. Serve hot.
title: Hara (Green)Masala Chicken

steps: 1. On medium-high heat, saute onions in oil until soft (about 4 minutes).
2. Add everything except the lentils and water. Cook out bitterness of dried spices for 1-2 minutes.
3. Add lentils and water.
4. Simmer on medium heat for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Enjoy with rice or on its' own.
title: Daal Curry

steps: 1. Cut the onions and zucchini into thin strips.
2. Heat the peanut oil in a wok and saute the onions for 1 minute.
3. Add the red curry paste and stir for 1 minute.
4. Add the coconut cream, nuoc mam sauce, sugar, and continue to stir until the curry paste is completely diluted for about 5 minutes.
5. Add the scallops and zucchini and simmer on low heat.
6. Pour in the lemon juice, stir, and serve immediately with Chinese noodles.
title: Scallop Curry

ingredients.text: 2 to 4 c. diced turkey or chicken

steps: 1. Simmer onion and celery in butter until tender.
2. Add flour, curry powder and salt.
3. Blend well and add tomato juice, cook over medium heat.
4. Stir constantly until mix comes to a boil.
5. Add turkey and let come to a boil again.
6. Reduce heat to a simmer for about 30 minutes.
7. Serve over rice.
title: Curry

steps: 1. Place the first 6 ingredients in a large skillet over medium-high heat; cook until spices smoke, becoming fragrant and turning dark, shaking pan constantly (about 5 minutes). Stir in nutmeg. Remove from heat; cool completely. Place spice mixture in a spice or coffee grinder; process until finely ground. Store in an airtight container.
title: Garam Masala

ingredients.text: 1 pound okra, ends trimmed, cut into 1/4-inch rounds

steps: 1. Microwave the okra on High for 3 minutes.

2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add cumin, once it swells and turns golden brown stir in the okra. Cook and stir on medium heat for 5 minutes. Gently mix in the curry powder, chickpea flour, and salt; cook 2 minutes more. Serve immediately.
title: Okra Curry

ingredients.text: 3 1/3 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, thickly sliced

steps: 1. Toss chicken with yogurt in large bowl. Cover; refrigerate 1 hour.
2. Meanwhile, place coconut in heatproof bowl; cover with 1/2 cup hot water. Let stand 1 hour. Drain. Blend or process coconut and cashews to a fine paste.

3. Heat oil in large saucepan on medium-high heat. Cook bay leaves, cinnamon, cardamom and cloves until fragrant. Add onion; cook, stirring, until lightly browned. Add ginger, garlic and spices; cook, stirring, until fragrant. Add chopped tomatoes and 1/3 cup water; cook, stirring, about 5 mins or until mixture thickens and tomatoes break down. Add ground coconut paste and 3 cups water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low; simmer, uncovered, about 20 mins.
4. Add chicken mixture; simmer, uncovered, a further 30 mins or until chicken is cooked through. Serve garnished with fried fresh curry leaves, if desired.
title: Chicken Korma

steps: 1. Saute the garlic, ginger, onions and green chili together until the onion starts to brown. Then add the cilantro and spinach and cook until the spinach wilts. Place in a blender and puree to desired consistency. Cook the potatoes (boil, or microwave) until almost done. In a deep pan heat the butter and fry the cumin seeds for about 20 seconds till they start to lightly brown. Add the turmeric and other spices and fry for about 30 seconds. Add the spinach-onion mixture, salt, and potatoes and cook for a few minutes for the flavors to meld and the potatoes to fully cook.
title: Aloo Palak

steps: 1. Wash poultry very clean.
2. In a skillet, add butter until melted, then add oil.
3. Put chicken in large bowl.
4. Add other ingredients, tossing chicken in seasoning.
5. Put chicken in hot skillet.
6. Turn until brown or well done.
7. Drain oil and serve. Good with spicy rice and salad.
title: Curry Chicken

steps: 1. Melt butter in a flat baking dish (10-inch square Corning Ware skillet).
2. Add brown sugar and curry powder.
3. Stir to make a sauce.
4. Add raisins.
5. Place peach halves in pan; spoon sauce over peaches.
6. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
7. Spoon sauce over peaches once during baking.
8. Serve hot.
title: Curry Peaches

steps: 1. Put the cumin, coriander, cardamom, peppercorns, cinnamon, and cloves in a dry heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Toast the spices, stirring occasionally, until they turn several shades darker and give off a sweet smoky aroma, about 10 minutes. Do not raise the heat to quicken the process, or the spices will brown prematurely, leaving the insides undercooked. Cool completely.

2. Working in batches if necessary, transfer the mixture to a spice mill or coffee grinder and grind to a powder. Stir in the nutmeg and saffron. Use immediately or store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.
3. Garam Masala keeps for 3 months.
title: Garam Masala

steps: 1. Bone and slice the chicken breasts.
2. Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat.
3. Add strips of chicken; sprinkle with salt and cook, stirring constantly, for 3 minutes.
4. Add onion, green pepper, nuts, curry and nutmeg.
5. Cook 2 minutes longer, stirring constantly.
6. Add drained pineapple with 1/2 cup of syrup, water and bouillon cube. Reduce heat, cover and cook 4 minutes. Blend cornstarch with 2 tablespoons cold water.
7. Stir all at once into skillet.
8. Cook, stirring rapidly until thickened.
9. Serve with rice.
title: Pineapple Chicken Curry

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste

steps: 1. Heat canola oil in a wok over medium heat. Cook and stir cumin and mustard seeds in the hot oil until they begin to dance, 1 to 2 minutes. Add coriander, turmeric, and cayenne pepper; cook about 1 minute.

2. Stir cabbage, potatoes, ginger-garlic paste, and salt into spice mixture; stir to coat. Pour enough water into wok to steam vegetables; cover and cook, stirring occasionally and adding more water as needed, until potatoes and cabbage are very tender, about 45 minutes. Remove from heat; sprinkle vegetables with cilantro.
title: Indian Sabji Recipe

steps: 1. In a bowl, mix mayonnaise, curry powder, grated lemon peel, lemon juice, paprika, and salt to taste.
title: Lemon-Curry Aioli

steps: 1. Skin chicken.
2. Slash chicken flesh.
3. Combine ingredients in bowl.
4. Add chicken, turning to coat.
5. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight, turning occasionally.
6. Let chicken stand 1 hour at room temperature before cooking.
7. Preheat oven to 450°.
8. Arrange in shallow baking pan.
9. Bake 15 minutes; turn and coat with marinade.
10. Bake until chicken is fork-tender.
title: Tandoori Chicken

steps: 1. Wash the lentils in cold water until the water runs clear. Put lentils in a pot with enough water to cover; bring to a boil, place a cover on the pot, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer, adding water during cooking as needed to keep covered, until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat; cook and stir onions in hot oil until caramelized, about 20 minutes.

3. Mix curry paste, curry powder, turmeric, cumin, chili powder, salt, sugar, garlic, and ginger together in a large bowl; stir into the onions. Increase heat to high and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.
4. Stir in the tomato puree, remove from heat and stir into the lentils.
title: Red Lentil Curry

steps: 1. Place frozen rolls on a greased cookie sheet.
2. Let rise until nearly double.
3. In the meantime, brown the ground beef, drain, add taco mix and 1/4 cup water.
4. Heat about 2" cooking oil in skillet or frying pan.
5. Stretch the dough quite thin, fry until golden brown, turning once.
6. Drain on paper towel.
7. Top each taco with seasoned meat mixture, layer with lettuce, tomatoes and cheese.
8. You may garnish with black olives, taco sauce and sour cream.
title: County Fair Indian Tacos

ingredients.text: 4 chicken breasts, skinned, boned and cubed

steps: 1. Saute chicken and onion in margarine and spices.
2. Add all remaining ingredients.
3. (Add chicken stock as needed if the curry sauce gets too dry.)
4. Bring sauce to boil. Reduce and simmer until tender, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
title: Chicken Curry(Serves 4 To 6)

steps: 1. Preheat a grill to medium-high.

2. In a large bowl, mix together the mint, ginger, sugar, garam masala, salt, and tamarind pulp. Add the chicken and mix it well. Cover the bowl and allow to marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to 2 hours.

3. Thread the chicken onto the 4 skewers. Oil the grill and place the skewers onto it. Grill the skewers, turning frequently and basting with the remaining marinade for about 7 to 8 minutes per side, until the chicken is done and the juices run clear.
title: Grilled Chicken-Indian Style

ingredients.text: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken to pan; saute 3 minutes. Add onion and jalapeno; saute 3 minutes. Add ginger, garam masala, cumin, salt, and garlic; saute 30 seconds. Add tomato, rice, raisins, and broth; bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 15 minutes or until rice is tender. Stir in cilantro. Sprinkle with almonds; serve with lime wedges.
title: Chicken Biryani

steps: 1. Place the chicken, onion, celery, apple, chicken broth, milk, curry powder, and paprika into a slow cooker; stir until mixed. Cover, and cook on Low for 4 to 5 hours. Stir in the quinoa during the final 35 minutes of cooking. Serve when quinoa is tender.
title: Slow Cooker Chicken Curry With Quinoa

ingredients.text: 1 small onion, halved and thinly sliced
2 medium Granny Smith apples, cut into 3/4-inch pieces

steps: 1. Sprinkle chicken with 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper. In a large skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Brown chicken on both sides; remove from pan.
2. Add red pepper and onion to skillet; cook and stir 5 minutes. Stir in curry powder and garlic; cook 1 minute longer. Stir in apples, peas, coconut milk and remaining salt.
3. Return chicken to pan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, covered, 8-10 minutes or until a thermometer inserted in chicken reads 170°. Serve with rice.
title: Apple Chicken Curry

steps: 1. Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl with your hands until well combined.
2. Put into the fridge for about 10 minutes to allow the mixture to firm up a bit.
3. Take out of the fridge and form into four equal sized patties.

4. Fry the burgers as you would any other burger for about 5 minutes each side or until cooked through. (I do mine on my Foreman Grill brushed very lightly with some canola oil to save me having to fry them and add extra fats).
5. Put on buns and top with your choice of toppings (I go simply with crisp lettuce and a bit of extra mango chutney) and serve.
title: Turkey Curry Burgers

steps: 1. Cut the crabs in small pieces and use the lime juice for washing them. Use the ginger, minced chive, garlic, thyme to season the crabs. Pour the oil into a preheated pot.
2. Make a paste by mixing the curry, salt and the pepper and add it to the hot oil. Next add the crab meat along with the coconut milk when the mixture thickens.
3. Next allow the curry crabs to simmer for about 25 minute covered. When the curry crabs are done serve them with cassava dumplings.
title: Caribbean Curry Crab

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

2. Place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Melt butter in a medium skillet over medium heat. Saute onion, then stir in beer, soup, curry powder, basil and pepper. Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 10 minutes, then pour over chicken.
3. Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 1 hour; sprinkle with cheese for last 10 minutes of baking.
title: Tomato Curry Chicken

ingredients.text: salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 tablespoon curry paste, or more to taste

steps: 1. Place the chicken breasts between two sheets of heavy plastic (resealable freezer bags work well) on a solid, level surface. Firmly pound the chicken with the smooth side of a meat mallet to a thickness of about 1/2 inch. Sprinkle the chicken on both sides with salt and pepper.
2. Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over high heat, and pan-fry the chicken breasts until the meat is no longer pink, about 4 minutes per side. Transfer the chicken breasts to a plate.

3. Reduce the heat to medium; stir the green onions and curry paste into the skillet, and cook for 1 minute, stirring frequently. Pour the broth into the skillet, and scrape up and dissolve any brown flavor bits in the skillet with a spoon. Bring the mixture to a full boil, and cook until the mixture has thickened into a glaze, about 10 minutes; pour in the coconut milk, bring back to a boil, and cook until thickened, about 10 more minutes. Mix the lime juice into the sauce, and stir in any juices that have collected from the chicken. Return the chicken breasts to the pan, spoon sauce over the chicken, and simmer until heated through, about 2 minutes. Sprinkle with cilantro to serve.
title: Coconut Curry Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb cooked chicken, then cubed (or whole)

steps: 1. Start preparation for pasta.
2. Cook chicken to your liking in olive oil or If you will be using cooked chicken as I did you will add it later.
3. Add vegetables, almonds and sesame oil and cook for 3 minutes over medium heat.
4. Add curry powder and mix well.
5. Add olive oil (unless you used it to cook chicken) and cooked chicken, mix well.
6. Let the mixture simmer thoroughly for about 10 minutes.
7. Toss with warm pasta and serve.
title: Curry Chicken And Pasta

ingredients.text: 2 lbs Boneless Chicken Breast, cut in 1/2" chunks

steps: 1. Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a large pan. Add the curry and cayenne. Cook for 1 minute. Add the onion and garlic. Cook 5 minutes, until onion is soft. Add the chicken, cook 7-10 mins until no longer pink. Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, and potatoes. Add curry, cayenne, salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil and simmer for 30-40 minutes until the potatoes are soft. Serve over rice.
title: Coconut Chicken Curry

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 300F.
2. Place cardamom pods in a spice grinder or coffee mill and pulse lightly.
3. Sift out husks, removing any stray seeds inside; discard husks.
4. Place cardamom seeds, cinnamon,cloves, peppercorns, cumin seeds, and coriander seeds on a baking sheet.
5. Roast the spices in the oven for 12-15 minutes, stirring once or twice, until spices become fragrant and slightly darker, but not burnt.
6. Cool spices, and grind in a spice grinder or spice mill to a fine powder.
7. Add the nutmeg and stir well.
8. Store mixture in an airtight container until needed, no more than three months.
title: Garam Masala

steps: 1. Heat oil in a medium skillet.
2. Add the onions and cook over medium heat until softened, but not browned.
3. Drain fat from skillet and add remaining ingredients, except turkey and rice.
4. Mix well, bring to JUST a boil, add the turkey and simmer for 4-5 minutes to heat through.
5. Place turkey over rice and pour sauce over turkey. Serves 4.
title: Bridget Jones'S Turkey Curry

steps: 1. Combine everything in a zip-lock bag and marinate in the refrigerator for 2-6 hours.
2. Grill or cook in oven.
3. If using oven; brown chicken in oven-proof pan and transfer pan to 350 degree Farenheit oven. Cook for 11-13 minutes.
4. Enjoy!
title: Penzeys Tandoori-Style Grilled Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 None carrot, halved lengthwise, thinly sliced on a bias
5.25 oz snow peas, trimmed, halved diagonally
16 oz fresh rice noodles, soaked in boiling water for 30 mins, drained
1 None fresh long red chili, thinly sliced

steps: 1. Place 4 - 10x10 inch squares of parchment paper on a clean work surface. Distribute carrot, snow peas and chicken between parchment paper. Whisk together curry paste, coconut milk and lime juice then drizzle over top. Fold paper over, tucking in edges, to enclose and form parcels.
2. Place, seam-side down, in a large bamboo steaming basket over a pot of simmering water. Cover with a bamboo lid and steam parcels for 12-15 mins, or until chicken is cooked through.
3. Toss noodles with cilantro, sesame oil and chili. Serve with chicken and vegetables.
title: Chicken Curry Parcels

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. lean cooked lamb, cut in small chunks

steps: 1. Coat skillet with no stick cooking spray.
2. Brown onion while you slice apples.
3. Add apples and raisins to skillet and brown lightly.
4. Add water and curry powder.
5. Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
6. Add lamb.
7. Continue to cook for 5 minutes.
8. Add peanuts and stir.
9. Remove from heat for a minute.
10. Then serve with rice.
11. Each person takes assorted condiments to mix with individual bites of curry.
12. Makes 4 servings.
title: Quick Lamb Curry

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless chicken breast, sliced into 1/2 x 3 inch strips
8 ounces mushrooms, stemmed and halved if large
5 ounces evaporated milk (or may use cream)

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat; add chili pepper, cloves and cinnamon stick and heat until fragrant.
2. Add the chopped onion and cook for 1-2 minutes then add the ginger and garlic and cook for 1 min more.

3. Add the chicken slices and cook for 4 minutes; then add the mushrooms, cayenne, coriander, cardamom, cumin, turmeric, and cook for 4-5 minutes more; add a little oil if necessary to prevent burning.
4. Add tomato sauce and paste and mix well and lower heat and cook until chicken is cooked through, about 3-5 minutes.
5. Stir in evaporated milk or cream and simmer on low heat for about 5 minutes then add garam masala and chopped cilantro to the dish.
6. Serve with rice, if desired.
title: Indian Chicken And Mushrooms In Spiced Tomato Cream

steps: 1. Stir tomatoes, onion, garam masala, garlic, ginger, salt, brown sugar, cumin, and coriander together in a slow cooker until well-mixed. Place chicken thighs in tomato mixture.
2. Cook on High for 3 to 4 hours (or on Low for 6 to 8 hours). Stir yogurt and cilantro into chicken mixture.
title: Slow Cooker Chicken Tikka Masala

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lbs country-style boneless pork ribs, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps: 1. Place the ginger in a small bowl with 1/3 cup of hot water and set aside until needed.
2. Cook the pork with the curry paste and brown sugar in a large deep skillet, stirring to coat meat, for about 15 minutes, until pork is nicely browned.
3. Meanwhile, mix the turmeric, and soy sauce into the water and add to the pork.
4. Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until meat is tender and sauce has thickened, about 45 minutes.
5. Add the ginger (with its water), the shallots, garlic, and lime juice.
6. Simmer for 5-7 more minutes, allowing the flavors to blend through.
7. Check seasoning, adding more sugar, lime juice, or even a little salt, if necessary.
8. Serve at once with steamed jasmine rice.
title: Burmese-Style Pork Curry

steps: 1. Place onion and curry paste in 3 ltr casserole dish.
2. Cook on full power 2 minutes.
3. Add vegetables, chick peas, coconut milk, lemon juice and soy sauce.
4. Cook full power 6-8 minutes.
5. Sprinkle with chopped nuts.
6. Serve with jasmine rice.
title: Vegetable Curry (Microwave)

ingredients.text: 3 medium size white onions, ground or chopped

steps: 1. Prepare chickens for saute.
2. Heat butter in a large skillet until bubbly and add cut up, salted and peppered chicken.
3. Brown well on both sides.
4. When nicely browned, add 1/4 cup dry white wine, reduce the heat and continue cooking.

5. After 10 minutes, add the white onions, put through the grinder or chopped very fine. To this, add a tablespoon, or more if you like strong flavor of curry, of good curry powder, mixed with 2 tablespoons of white wine.
6. Cover and cook for 10 to 12 minutes.
7. Remove the cover and test for tenderness, turning the chicken again so that all sides of the pieces are bathed in the curry sauce.
8. When the chicken is tender, remove the pieces to a hot platter to keep hot.
title: Quick Curry Of Chicken

steps: 1. Melt butter in skillet. Saute garlic, add curry powder, tumeric to make a paste. Add onions and saute until clear. Mix with rice, raisins, walnuts, and apple.
2. Prepare chicken for stuffing. Stuff with rice mixture.
3. Place chicken in roaster; arrange remaining stuffing around the outside of the chicken.
4. Prepare a glaze of 3 tbs butter, 1 tbs honey, and 2 tsp curry powder. Note: amount of curry varies according to taste and quality of powder.

5. Glaze chicken, cover and bake at 350 F for 20 minutes per lb of bird or until it passes your favorite test for doneness. You may want to uncover to brown during the last few minutes. *The glaze usually browns nicely with the cover on.
6. *Leftovers make a great soup base.
title: Stoneware Roast Chicken With Curry

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro, plus small cilantro leaves

steps: 1. Dip tomatoes in a pan of boiling water until skins pull off easily with a knife tip, 15 seconds. Cool, peel, core, quarter, and seed.
2. Warm oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add spices and stir until fragrant, 1 minute. In a blender, puree onion, garlic, chile, ginger, 1 cup coconut milk, the tomato paste, and spice mixture.

3. Add half of tomatoes and their juices and whirl until very smooth. Pour into a stainless steel bowl. Set aside 2 tomato pieces. Puree remaining tomatoes and stir into bowl with the lemon juice, sugar, and salt.
4. Nest bowl in ice water; stir often until cold, 15 minutes. Stir in chopped cilantro and more coconut milk if you like. Chop reserved tomato. Garnish bowls with tomato and cilantro leaves.
5. Note: Nutritional analysis is per 1-cup serving.
title: Spicy Indian Tomato Shorba

steps: 1. In a medium saucepan, melt butter or margarine over medium heat. Add onion, ginger, cumin, coriander, cinnamon and red pepper flakes. Cook, stirring 3 minutes.
title: Indian Pilau

ingredients.text: 5 tablespoons curry powder, or more to taste
1 sheet puff pastry, cut into 6 squares

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
2. Cook and stir beef and onion in a nonstick skillet until beef is browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in curry powder until heated through and fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.

3. Cut puff pastry squares diagonally to create 12 triangles. Fold each triangle in half, pressing the edges of one side together, and leaving an opening for the filling. Fill each triangle with curried beef and press edges to seal.
4. Coat each triangle with beaten egg using a pastry brush. Arrange triangles on a baking sheet.
5. Bake in the preheated oven until puffed up and golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes.
title: Baked Curry Triangles

ingredients.text: salt and ground black pepper to taste
3 slices Swiss cheese, torn into pieces
1 tablespoon curry powder, or more to taste

steps: 1. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a casserole dish.

2. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil; partially cook the cauliflower, potatoes, and garlic cloves in the boiling water for 5 to 7 minutes. Drain. Spread into the bottom of the prepared casserole dish; season with salt and pepper. Scatter the peas over the mixture. Set aside.

3. Combine the vegetable stock, butter, and flour together in a small saucepan over medium heat; bring to a simmer. Slowly stir the milk into the mixture; continue cooking until hot. Slowly add the Swiss cheese to the mixture and allow to melt into the liquid; cook and stir until a cheesy white sauce forms. Season with the curry powder, salt, and pepper. Pour the sauce over the vegetable mixture. Cover with aluminum foil.
4. Bake in the preheated oven until the vegetables are cooked through and tender, about 20 minutes. Serve hot.
title: Veggie Curry Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon ground red chile pepper, or to taste

steps: 1. Whisk coriander, cumin, turmeric, cardamom, mustard seed, ginger, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, chili powder, and ground cloves together in a bowl. Store in a glass air-tight jar or container.
title: Diva Curry Blend

ingredients.text: 1 cup raw (i.e. not roasted) rice flour
1 cup water (hot water preferred by some)

steps: 1. Mix rice flour with hot water and salt.
2. Knead it into a smooth dough.

3. Press the dough through an idiyappam presser or sieve onto banana leaves on which a little grated coconut has been sprinkled. Alternatively, press it directly onto an idli pan without banana leaves.
4. Steam for 5–10 minutes. Some people add a little grated coconut on top before steaming.
title: Idiyappam (South Indian Rice Noodles)

ingredients.text: ⅛ cup grated cucumber (about 1 inch of cucumber)
1–2 tbsp finely chopped or minced onions (optional)

steps: 1. Squeeze the grated cucumber to remove and discard excess liquid.
2. Stir the cucumber into the yogurt.
3. Add chopped mint, cilantro, and onion.
4. Add salt to taste.
5. Sprinkle a little ground cumin on top.
6. Sprinkle with chili powder if desired.
7. Refrigerate and serve cold.
title: Raita

ingredients.text: 3 potatoes, chopped (Yukon gold are good, but use whatever you like)

steps: 1. Chop the onion and mince the garlic. Sauté them in olive oil in a saucepan for approximately 5 minutes.
2. Add the curry powder and fry for a couple minutes more.
3. Add the coconut milk and the potatoes. Simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes.
4. Drain the chickpeas, add them to the pot, and simmer for about 20 minutes more, or until the potatoes are cooked.
5. Serve with basmati rice or whatever you prefer.
title: Potato-Chickpea Curry

steps: 1. Combine chicken, celery and raisins in large bowl.
2. Blend together the mayonnaise, lemon juice, 1/4 teaspoon salt, curry powder and dash of pepper.
3. Toss lightly with chicken mixture. Chill.
4. Just before serving, add cashew nuts and toss.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Curry Chicken Salad

ingredients.text: 3/4 c. sour cream or plain yogurt

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine mayonnaise and sour cream or yogurt; stir in curry powder,
2. Fold in remaining ingredients.
3. Chill at least 2 hours before serving.
4. Yield:
5. 4 to 6 servings.
title: Turkey Curry Salad

steps: 1. In 3-quart casserole dish, combine onion and butter.
2. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap; microwave on High for 3 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover and microwave on High for 5 minutes.
3. Stir well.
4. Cover and microwave for another 20 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed.
5. Let stand 4 to 5 minutes.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Curry Spiced Rice

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons slivered almonds, toasted and chopped

steps: 1. Combine apple and lemon juice in a large bowl; toss well to coat apple. Add chicken, celery, and raisins; toss well.
2. Combine mayonnaise and next 5 ingredients in a small bowl; pour over chicken mixture, and toss well. Sprinkle with chopped almonds. Cover and chill at least 1 hour.

3. Note: If you don't have 3 cups of leftover chicken, cook 1 pound of skinned, boned chicken breast halves on a baking sheet in the oven at 450° for 12 to 14 minutes or until the juices run clear. Toast the almonds on the same baking sheet during the last 3 minutes of cooking.
title: Curry Chicken Salad

steps: 1. Put tomatoes, curry paste, apricots and lentils in large pot.
2. Bring to the boil,cover, simmer gently for 15 minutes.
3. Add vegetables and simmer 35 - 45 minutes till vegies are tender.
4. Top up with water if mixture looks too dry.
5. Serve with brown rice and chutney.
title: Aubergine And Cauliflower Curry

steps: 1. In a large pan heat oil over medium heat and saute onions and cumin until onions are tender, but not browned. Rinse the rise several times and drain well. Add the rice to the pan with the onions and pour in the 2 cups of water. Stir in salt, garam masala and vegetables. Cover the pan and increase the heat to high.

2. Bring the mixture to a boil and then reduce the heat to low, keeping the rice covered at all times. After cooking for about 10 minutes, gently stir the rice to distribute the spices evenly. Cook 25 to 30 minutes, or until all of the water has evaporated and the rice is tender.
title: Indian Vegetable Rice

steps: 1. Make the cashew cream by combining the cashews, water and lemon juice in a blender. Puree until it attains a yogurt like consistency. If the cashews are really dry, let them soak in the water and lemon juice for an hour or two before blending.
2. Spoon the cashew cream into a bowl and add the cucumber, corn and salt. Mix well.
3. Serve cold with Indian food.
title: Vegan Raita - Made With Cashew Cream

ingredients.text: 1 medium head cauliflower (about 1 1/2 lb.), trimmed and quartered

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450°F. Stir together yogurt, garlic, lime juice, tandoori spice, ginger, and salt. Brush yogurt mixture over all sides of cauliflower pieces.
2. Place coated cauliflower pieces on a parchment paper-lined baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until browned and tender, 30 to 35 minutes.
title: Tandoori Cauliflower

steps: 1. Melt the butter in a large saucepan. Cook onions and beef cubes until beef is browned and onions are tender.
2. Add the beef stock, curry and bay leaves. Cook over low heat for 30 minutes.
3. Add the potatoes, vinegar and salt. Simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour until all is tender. Remove bay leaves, and serve hot.
title: Curry Beef Soup

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup chopped pistachios (plus a little extra)

steps: 1. Sautee coconut in butter until toasted, stirring well.
2. Add 1/4 cup pistachios, sauteing a little longer.
3. Add honey and spices and stir.
4. Add milk and coconut milk, stirring slowly.
5. Heat but don't boil.
6. Froth individual servings in blender or espresso machine if desired.
7. CAUTION: Be careful not to put more than one serving at a time in the blender or it may overflow and scald you.
8. Serve garnished with pistachios.
title: Indian Coconut Soup

steps: 1. Combine first 6 ingredients in a small bowl; add cucumber. Cover and chill 30 minutes.
title: Feta-Cucumber Raita

steps: 1. Put yogurt in bowl.
2. Mix with fork to make it smooth.
3. Grate cucumber in a small bowl.
4. Let stand for 1/2 hour.
5. Squeeze out liquid.
6. Blend into yogurt.
7. Add salt, dill and mint.
8. Put into refrigerator for at least an hour or two.
9. Sprinkle dill on top before serving.
title: Raita

steps: 1. Melt butter in a medium saucepan.
2. Add onion, and saute until tender.
3. Add curry powder and rice; cook 2 minutes.
4. Stir in remaining ingredients.
5. Bring to a boil; cover, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Remove bay leaf.
6. *Note: Equal parts regular coconut milk and water may be substituted for light coconut milk.
title: Coconut Curry Jasmine Rice

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°. With a sharp knife, cut each potato into 1/8-in. slices, leaving slices attached at the bottom; fan potatoes slightly and place in a greased 13x9-in. baking dish. In a small bowl, mix butter, salt and pepper; drizzle over potatoes.
2. Bake 50-55 minutes or until potatoes are tender. In a small bowl, toss cheeses with herbs; sprinkle over potatoes. Bake about 5 minutes longer or until cheese is melted.
title: Cheese And Herb Potato Fans Susan Curry West Hills, Ca

steps: 1. Peel the cucumber and slice as thin as you can, peel and cut the onions as thin as you can. Add both to a serving dish.
2. Sprinkle with salt and add the juice - stir to combine.
3. Cover and chill for 1 hour.
title: Indian Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. Heat oil in a saucepan and fry onion until soft and golden. Stir in pepper, chili, garlic, ginger, turmeric and salt. Continue cooking for 2-3 minutes then add the potatoes; stir.
2. Add the remaining ingredients and hot water. Simmer until vegetables are cooked, thicken if necessary.
3. Serve with rice and accompaniments.
title: Nepalese Potato, Tomato And Pea Curry

steps: 1. Melt butter in a large skillet placed over medium-high heat. Add the onion and barley; cook, stirring frequently, until the onion begins to soften, about 5 minutes. Stir in the allspice, turmeric, curry powder, salt, and black pepper. Pour in the chicken broth, and bring to a simmer.
2. Cover skillet with lid, and reduce heat to low; simmer until the barley is tender, about 30 to 40 minutes. Fluff the pilaf with a fork, and gently stir in the slivered almonds and raisins.
title: Indian Curried Barley Pilaf

ingredients.text: 2 bananas, ripe medium sized peeled and cut into bite size pieces

steps: 1. Roast/dry fry coconut in a small pan or in a microwave, until a nice aroma rises and it changes colour to slightly brownish pink. You can toast the coconut in a microwave. Spread on a plate and cook on full for 3 (2+1) minutes. Keep aside.
2. Squeeze a little lemon juice over bananas, to keep them from discolouring.
3. Mix yogurt with honey and half the coconut.
4. Add bananas and stir lightly.
5. Garnish with remaining coconut.
6. Serve chilled.
title: Banana Raita With Coconut

ingredients.text: 340 g chicken breasts, boneless, skinless (12 oz)

steps: 1. Cut chicken crosswise into strips. In large skillet, heat 1 tbsp of the oil over medium-high heat; brown chicken, in batches and adding more oil as necessary. Transfer to bowl. Drain fat from skillet.
2. In same skillet, fry onion, jalapeno pepper (if using) and salt, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes.
3. Add curry paste; cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
4. Drain tomatoes and add to skillet.
5. Return chicken to pan. Stir in cauliflower florets, diced apple and raisins; cover and simmer until cauliflower is tender, about 10 minutes.
6. Add peas and half of the cilantro. Simmer, covered, until steaming, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cilantro.
title: Chicken Cauliflower Curry

steps: 1. Rinse lentils and soak for 20 minutes.

2. In a large saucepan, bring water to a boil and stir in salt, lentils, turmeric and chili powder. Cover and return to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in the spinach and cook 5 minutes, or until lentils are soft. Add more water if necessary.

3. In a small saucepan over medium heat, melt butter and saute onions with cumin and mustard seeds, stirring often. Cook until onions are transparent, and then combine with lentils. Stir in garam masala and coconut milk and cook until heated through.
title: Indian Dahl With Spinach

steps: 1. Place cabbage in a large bowl. In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sugar, salt, curry and pepper. Pour over cabbage and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate. Sprinkle with bacon just before serving.
title: Curry Coleslaw

steps: 1. Mix the cabbage, carrots, onions and peppers together.
2. Take out 1 tablespoon sugar, then sprinkle rest over cabbage mixture. Bring oil, vinegar, celery seed, salt and the 1 tablespoon of sugar to a rapid boil and pour over the cabbage.
3. Refrigerate for 9 days.
4. (May be eaten sooner, but is better after 9 days.)
title: Indian Slaw

steps: 1. Boil cleaned potatoes until tender.
2. Remove skin and mash potatoes.
3. Mash mixed potatoes and yogurt.
4. Cut jalapeno pepper into two halves.
5. In a skillet, warm the oil and add pepper.
6. This makes a sizzling sound.
7. Add this to the potato-yogurt mixture. Add salt and mix again.
8. Wash cilantro, dry and mince.
9. Add cilantro to potato mixture.
10. Refrigerate or serve at room temperature.
11. (Substitute cut tomatoes or peeled, grated cucumbers for the potatoes.
12. Or use steamed bell pepper, omitting jalapeno pepper.)
title: Raita

ingredients.text: 800 g lean beef, cut into chunks
1 bunch spring onions, cut into rings

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a Dutch oven and fry the beef chunks, turning, until they are browned and sealed all over. Add the onions and the carrots and saute for a few minutes more in the meat juices. Next, stir in the curry paste and season. Sprinkle in the flour and mix thoroughly. Next, deglaze the pan with the stock, then pour in the coconut milk and 1 cup of water. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and cook for 1 1/2 hours.
2. Stir the lime juice and zest into the curry, then add the peas and simmer for 5 mins more.
3. Cook the rice in boiling, salted water according to the package instructions. Meanwhile, dry roast the sesame seeds in a non-stick frying pan, turning, until they are toasted all over.
4. Drain the rice. In a bowl, beat the butter with the eggs. Add a teaspoon of sesame seeds and season, then mix with the rice.
5. Heat the ghee in a large frying pan, and saute the rice (you may need to do this in batches), and keep warm in a serving bowl.

6. Just before serving, sprinkle the remaining sesame seeds over the rice, and sprinkle the scallion and parsley over the curry. Serve the curry with the rice and some mango chutney and yogurt if desired.
title: Coconut Beef Curry And Sesame Rice

ingredients.text: 1-1/4 cup Water (or More Depending On Desired Consitency)

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, heat olive oil. Add fennel and saute 5 minutes, stirring as needed.

2. Add garlic, salt and pepper and cook over moderately low heat, stirring frequently, until softened, 5-6 minutes. Add zucchini and spices and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, about 10 minutes.
3. Add almond milk, basil and water and bring to a simmer. Cook until zucchini is very soft, about 10 minutes.
4. Working in 2 batches, puree the soup in a blender until smooth. Return the soup to the saucepan and season more as needed. Let soup simmer for a few minutes.
5. Serve hot or chilled.
title: Zucchini Soup With Basil And Curry

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons curry powder, preferably hot Madras

steps: 1. Heat a Dutch oven over medium heat.
2. Add curry powder, garam masala and mustard seeds and toast, stirring, until the spices begin to darken, about 1 minute.
3. Transfer to a small bowl.
4. Add oil, onion, garlic, ginger and salt to the pot and cook, stirring, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
5. Stir in eggplant, cauliflower, tomatoes, chickpeas, water and the spices.
6. Bring to a simmer.
7. Cover, reduce heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
8. Top each serving with optional dollop of yogurt; serve with basmatti rice & a loaf of 7 grain bread.
9. **Garam masala is a flavorful, fragrant blend of dry-roasted ground spices. It's in the spice section of most supermarkets and specialty stores.
title: Indian-Spiced Eggplant & Cauliflower Stew

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon curry powder, or to taste

steps: 1. In a 2 quart saucepan, bring pineapple juice to a boil. Stir in curry powder and celery salt, and then add rice and butter. Stir until butter melts and rice does not stick together. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes.
2. Stir rice with a fork to loosen from bottom of pot. Simmer another 3 to 5 minutes, or until done.
title: Pineapple Curry Rice

steps: 1. Toss carrots, chopped cilantro, and crushed peanuts together in a large bowl.
2. Stir lemon juice, sugar, and salt into carrot mixture.
3. Set aside long enough to allow the sugar to dissolve, about 10 minutes.
4. Garnish with cilantro to serve.
title: Easy Carrot Salad (Indian-Style)

steps: 1. Cut acorn squash in half and remove seeds. Place both halves, cut side down, on an oiled cookie sheet. Peel rutabagas and cut into 1/2 inch rounds. Place on oiled cookie sheet. Roast vegetables at 400 degrees for 35 minutes.
2. Thinly slice onion and saute in a tablespoon of olive oil, over low heat, until caramelized, about 20 minutes.
3. Scoop out squash and put into stock pot with 4 cups of chicken broth. Add cooked rutabagas and onions; add spices. Put in blender and blend until smooth. Heat through and serve.
title: Indian-Spiced Squash Soup

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and mix until evenly distributed.
2. Store in a cool dry place.
3. Use within 6 months.
4. Cooking directions: for 8 (1/2 cup) servings.
5. Boil 3 cups water in a covered pan.
6. Add 1 1/3 cups of rice mix; stir.
7. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
title: Curry Flavored Rice Mix

steps: 1. Brown onion and all spices in butter.
2. Add meat and brown. Add water to cover.
3. Simmer.
4. Cook rice.
5. Serve over rice.
title: Curry Chicken And Rice

steps: 1. Peel potatoes and dice as evenly as possible.
2. Heat oil and add spices when warm.
3. Let simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, then add potatoes and stir well to coat with oil and spices.
4. Continue for 5 to 10 minutes so potato cubes are slightly crisp.
5. Add water, lower heat and simmer slowly for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender.
6. Add yogurt and peas, heat for another 5 minutes and serve.
title: Potato Curry

ingredients.text: 1 clove garlic, peeled and finely diced
3/4 cup green lentils, soaked overnight in cold water
5 oz carrots, peeled and grated (about 1 1/3 cup)
10 None fresh mint leaves, cut into strips

steps: 1. Heat 3 tbsp vegetable oil in a saucepan and saute the leek, garlic, curry powder, coriander and garam masala for 1 min. Drain and add the lentils, then stir in the stock. Simmer over medium heat for 15 mins, or until the liquid has been absorbed. Add 1 cup of the carrots and season to taste.
2. Meanwhile, in a bowl, mix the olive oil, lemon juice, yogurt and honey. Season to taste, then stir in the mint and remaining carrot.

3. In a bowl, knead the flour, butter and 3/4 cup water to a smooth dough. Divide into 4 equal pieces. On a work surface sprinkled with flour, roll out the dough into 4 circles, about 8 inches in diameter. Spoon the lentil mixture on one side of each circle and fold over, pressing the edges down. Gently roll the dough pockets to about 1/4 inch thick.

4. Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large non-stick frying pan and fry 2 dough pockets for 4 mins on each side, until golden brown. Remove from the pan and keep warm. Add 1 tbsp oil to the pan, heat and fry the remaining pockets. Serve with the yogurt dip.
title: Lentil Pockets With Carrot Raita

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup grated seeded cucumber, squeezed dry (1 small)

steps: 1. Spoon yogurt into a wire mesh strainer lined with several layers of heavy-duty paper towels. Cover with additional paper towels; let stand 10 minutes. Scrape drained yogurt into a bowl using a rubber spatula. Stir in tomato and remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Stir before serving.
title: Cucumber-Tomato Raita

steps: 1. Cut up first 3 ingredients and then mix together in large salad bowl.
2. Fry crisp bacon and crumble.
3. Mix bacon, mayonnaise, cheese and sugar and "ice" salad as you would a cake.
4. Cover completely with the dressing and refrigerate and it will stay fresh several hours.
5. Stir to mix vegetable with dressing to serve.
title: Curry Salad

steps: 1. Cut squash in half; discard seeds. Place squash cut side down in a 15x10x1-in. baking pan. Add 1/2 in. of hot water to pan. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 minutes. Drain water from pan; turn squash cut side up. Bake 20-30 minutes longer or until tender. Cool slightly.
2. Carefully scoop out squash into a blender or food processor; cover and process until smooth. Set aside.

3. In a large saucepan, saute onion and apple in butter until tender. Add the garlic, curry powder and ginger; cook 1 minute longer. Stir in broth and pureed squash. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to low. Add the cream, salt, pepper and cayenne if desired; heat through (do not boil).
title: Curry Spiced Squash Soup

steps: 1. Combine ingredients; stir into a thick batter. Grease a heavy skillet. Drop batter in a hot skillet, divided into 4 pones. Brown to golden brown on both sides. Serve hot with butter.
title: Indian Corn Pone

steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix cabbage, onions and peas.
2. In a separate bowl, mix sour cream, mayonnaise, vinegar, curry powder, ginger, and cayenne pepper.
3. Toss with the slaw to coat.
4. Cover and refrigerate.
title: Curry Coleslaw

steps: 1. In a salad bowl, combine the spinach, pine nuts, cranberries and sesame seeds. In a small bowl, whisk the remaining ingredients. Drizzle over salad and toss to coat. Serve immediately.
title: Curry-Cranberry Spinach Salad

ingredients.text: 2 None red peppers, deseeded, sliced into fine rings
1 lb pineapple, peeled, cored, and cut into chunks

steps: 1. Cook the rice and curry powder in boiling salted water according to package instructions. Allow to cool.
2. Mix the yogurt, cilantro, and lime juice. Season with salt and black pepper. In a separate bowl, mix the lemon juice, oil and sugar. Season with salt and black pepper.
3. Add the rice and peanuts to the lemon juice mixture and stir well. Layer the rice mixture, peppers, green onions and pineapple alternately in 4 jars, drizzling the yogurt dressing between layers.
title: Layered Indian Rice Salad

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
2. Mix the olive oil, curry powder, sugar, lemon juice, salt and pepper in a small mixing bowl.
3. Place the washed and well drained cauliflower florets in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish; pour the oil mixture over the florets and toss gently.
4. Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes; remove from oven and stir in almonds mixing lightly.
5. Return to oven and bake uncovered for an additional 10 to 15 minutes or until cauliflower is browned and almonds are toasted.
title: Curry Roasted Cauliflower

steps: 1. Place oil in Dutch oven, add mustard seeds.
2. Fry until seeds pop.
3. Add vegetables and fry on low heat for about 5 minutes, with cover on pan.
4. Add turmeric.
5. Wash and dry rice.
6. Add rice to vegetables and fry for a minute.
7. Do not brown.
8. Add curry powder, salt and water.
9. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.
title: Indian Rice Pilaf

steps: 1. 1. Saute celery, onion, carrots and apple in oil for 5 minutes. Mix with remaining ingredients.
2. 2. Spread mix in a lightly oiled 9x13 pan. Sprinkle with additional curry powder.
3. 3. Bake at 350F for 40 minutes.
title: Curry Chicken & Rice Casserole

steps: 1. Layer lettuce, peas, chicken, tomatoes and cucumbers into 5 quart salad bowl.
2. Combine mayonnaise, sugar and curry powder; mix well.
3. Spread over salad.
4. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
5. Immediately before serving, sprinkle with croutons.
title: Chicken Curry Layer Salad

ingredients.text: 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric (I had run out, so used a bit of curry powder to give some colour instead)
1 kg pumpkin, peeled and cut into small pieces
1 1/2 cups water, with a masel stock cube
150 g baby spinach leaves, coarsely chopped

steps: 1. Coat the pan with cooking spray, heat and add the onion. Cook, stirring until softened. Stir in the garlic, ginger, chili, coriander, cumin and turmeric. Stir for 30 seconds.
2. Add the pumpkin, water and stock cube. Simmer, covered about 15 minutes or until pumpkin is tender. Stir in the spinach and fresh coriander. Cook, stirring, until spinach is just wilted.
title: Pumpkin And Spinach Curry

ingredients.text: 1 piece Fresh Ginger (approximately 1-inch Long), Finely Grated

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut squash in half and remove seeds. Place, cut side down, on a baking sheet covered in aluminum foil. Peel onions and cut into quarters; add them to the baking sheet. Cut the top off the garlic clove and place on sheet with the onions and squash. Brush vegetables with olive oil if you'd like.
2. Roast vegetables for approximately an hour until squash is tender.

3. While vegetables are roasting, measure out the rest of the ingredients (minus 1 cup of vegetable broth) into a soup pot and whisk together. With a hand grater, finely grate fresh ginger into the coconut milk mixture. More ginger may be added for a spicier soup.

4. When vegetables are finished roasting, scoop squash meat into a food processor or blender along with the onions. Push garlic meat out of the peel and into the processor/blender. Blend vegetables until smooth.

5. Add vegetable puree to coconut milk mixture (using final cup of vegetable broth to help remove puree from the container) and whisk together over medium or medium-high heat until simmering. Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes, then add salt and pepper to taste.
6. Serve hot and enjoy! It goes wonderfully with corn bread and sour cream garnish!
title: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup With Ginger And Curry

ingredients.text: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cubed

steps: 1. Heat ghee in a large pot over medium heat; cook and stir onion until tender, about 5 minutes. Stir garlic, curry powder, cumin, ginger, salt, turmeric, cardamom, cinnamon, cayenne pepper, and nutmeg into onion; cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute.

2. Stir chicken into onion mixture; cook for 2 minutes. Stir carrots, coconut milk, cashews, and tomato paste into chicken mixture; simmer for 5 minutes. Stir cauliflower into chicken mixture; simmer, covered, until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes.
3. Stir peas, red bell pepper, and cream into chicken mixture; reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until heated through, about 10 minutes.
title: Chicken Cauliflower Korma

ingredients.text: salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps: 1. Bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Add potatoes; reduce heat to medium. Cook until tender, 15 to 20 minutes.

2. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add mustard, cumin, and coriander seeds. Cook, stirring constantly, until lightly browned, about 1 minute. Stir in sesame seeds; cook until golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes. Add potatoes, lemon juice, lemon zest, chile peppers, and turmeric. Stir until well combined. Season with salt and pepper.
title: Spicy Potato Curry

ingredients.text: 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper (or other Ground red pepper)
1 medium yukon gold potato, Cut into 1/2 inch chunks
1 cup lentils (I used regular brown or green ones)

steps: 1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
2. Add onion, saute until translucent.
3. Add garlic and ginger, saute a 1-2 minutes.
4. Add salt, tumeric, coriander, cumin, mustard powder, Cayanne Pepper and cook for 1-3 minutes until fragrant.
5. Add water, scraping to loosen browned bits from the bottom.
6. Stir in tomato, potato, and lentils.
7. Bring to a boil; cover, reduce heat, and simmer until potato mixture is tender (About 30 minutes).
8. Remove from heat and stir in Parsley & Red Wine Vinegar.
9. Serve over rice or with Naan.
title: Lentil Potato Dal

ingredients.text: 1/2 kg fresh salmon, boneless and skinned, cut into chunks (but save the skin!)
1 large yellow bell pepper, cut into strips
1 medium butternut squash, cut into 1 inch cubes
1 piece lemongrass, bruised with back of knife (whacked and bruised but not hacked to pieces)
30 ml curry paste (if you like more have fun!)

steps: 1. In a heavy pot heat up oil and put in mustard seeds and cover the pot until they pop like popcorn (that makes them taste nutty).
2. Toss in the onions, bell pepper, and garlic and sautee until slightly soft.
3. Toss in the Squash.
4. Add in the can of coconut milk, the chicken stock, the fish sauce, the lemongrass and the curry paste.
5. Bring to a boil turn down heat and simmer/cook until the squash JUST starts to fall apart (about 15-20 minutes).
6. Remove the lemongrass.
7. Stir the pot and taste then add salt if needed, bring heat back up to a simmer.
8. Place the salmon in the pot, but not in one big heap, but so the pieces are all laying on top evenly.
9. Cover the pot and turn off the heat.
10. Let stand for at least 5 minutes and check to see if the salmon is done (it doesn't have to have been cooked to death; salmon is moist and lovely at about 'medium').
11. Serve over Rice (basmati is nice).
12. You can cook the salmon skin in a hot skillet and munch on it later-- mmmmm.
title: Butternut Squash Salmon Curry

ingredients.text: 1 white onion, halved and sliced into 1/2-inch rings

steps: 1. Heat oil in a heavy pan over medium heat. Cook and stir onion in the hot oil until beginning to turn golden brown, about 10 minutes. Add minced garlic to onion; cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute more.

2. Mix chicken broth, lentils, 1/2 cup water, crushed garlic, coriander, salt, cumin, chili powder, ginger, cinnamon, turmeric, cinnamon, cloves, cayenne pepper, and bay leaf into onion mixture; bring to a boil. Cover pan, lower heat to medium-low, and simmer until lentils are soft, about 35 minutes.

3. Place spinach in a microwave-safe bowl and add 1/4 cup water; heat in microwave for 5 minutes. Stir spinach and continue cooking in microwave until heated through, about 5 minutes more. Let spinach cool, about 5 minutes; drain water and squeeze excess water from spinach.
4. Mix spinach into lentils; cover pan and simmer until heated through, about 10 minutes.
title: Indian Lentils And Spinach

steps: 1. Boil the rice in lots of water till it is cooked but slightly underdone.
2. Drain and rinse to stop the cooking process.
3. You can add a tblsp of oil so that the grains do not stick together.
4. (optional).
5. Chop onions, cut tomatoes into large pieces.
6. Deseed and cut the green peppers into chunks.
7. Roast the chillies in a fry pan for the few minutes and pound coarsely with the garlic.
8. Heat 1 tblsp oil in a vessel and add the onions and fry till translucent.
9. Add the garlic- chilli paste and saute for 3 minutes more.
10. Add the green pepper, tomatoes and cover and cook till the capsicum softens.
11. Add the rice and salt and garam masala and mix gently.
12. Simmer for 3 more minutes till the rice is heated through.
13. Garnish with cilantro if you wish.
title: Spanish Rice Indian Ishtyle!!!??

steps: 1. In large pan, simmer pork chop cubes in salted water (enough to cover) 45 to 60 minutes.
2. Add more hot water; enough to make as much curry as you want; then put in onions, carrots and potatoes. Salt and pepper to taste.
3. Bring to boil, lower heat and simmer 2 hours, stirring occasionally, covered.
4. Add the green pepper and simmer another 15 minutes.
5. Add flour to water to make sauce for thickening.
6. Stir into vegetables.
7. Add curry powder.
8. Serve over regular cooked rice, not instant.
9. Leftovers freeze nicely.
title: Curry Rice

ingredients.text: 1 whole Butternut Squash, Peeled, Deseeded And Chopped Into 1/2 Inch Cubes
3 whole Carrots, Chopped Into 1/2 Inch Cubes
2 whole Parsnips, Chopped Into 1/2 Inch Cubes

steps: 1. 1. Preheat the oven to 390 F. Put the chopped butternut squash into a large roasting tin, in a single layer. Drizzle half of the olive oil over the chopped butternut squash and roast for 45 minutes. While this is roasting, you can continue making the rest of the soup.
2. 2. Melt the remaining olive oil in a large soup pot over a medium heat. Add the shallots and garlic, stir and cook for 2-3 minutes.
3. 3. Add the carrots and parsnips and cook and stir for a further 5 minutes.

4. 4. Add the stock, coconut milk, bay leaves and spices. Mix together well and bring to a simmer. Leave this to bubble away while the butternut squash roasts. Once the parsnips and carrots have softened, and the squash is also done, you can stir the squash into the soup.
5. 5. Remove from the heat, and using a hand blender or food processor, blitz until smooth (you'll probably need to do this in batches if using a food processor). Serve and enjoy!
6. Optional: Serve with a dollop of natural yoghurt and some chopped herbs. Or in my case, a wedge of bread!
title: Vegetable Curry Soup

ingredients.text: 3/4 teaspoons Curry, Adjust According To Taste

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat.

2. Rinse the outside of the acorn squash and then chop it in half lengthwise. Seed the squash and chop off the stem but leave the peel on. Next, carefully slice it into one-inch wedges. I like to use the natural grooves on the squash as a guide for thickness.
3. Place the sliced acorn squash in a medium-sized bowl. Add the rest of the ingredients to the bowl and stir until everything is well incorporated.

4. Lay the acorn squash in a single layer on top of the lined baking sheet, cut side down. Bake for about 15 minutes. Flip the acorn squash slices to the other side so that both sides will be browned equally.
5. Bake the squash for another 10 to 15 minutes or until the pieces can be easily pierced with a fork.
title: Maple & Curry Acorn Squash

steps: 1. Prepare Cucumber-Tomato Raita.

2. . Combine lemon juice and next 8 ingredients in a small bowl, stirring well to form a paste. Cut 3 diagonal 1/4-inch-deep slits across each chicken breast half. Rub spice paste in slits and on all sides of chicken. Cover and let stand 15 minutes.
3. . Prepare grill.
4. . Place chicken on grill rack coated with cooking spray; grill 6 minutes on each side or until done. Serve with Cucumber-Tomato Raita.
title: Grilled Tandoori Chicken With Cucumber-Tomato Raita

ingredients.text: 125 g beans, cut into short lengths
250 g pumpkin, cut into small cubes

steps: 1. Place rice in a large microwave-safe bowl with 3 cups boiling water and the salt. Cook on HIGH 12 - 14 minutes.
2. (Do not cover the rice or it will boil over.) Set aside. Place the oil and onion in a large dish and cook on HIGH for 2 minutes.
3. Stir in the curry powder and cook on HIGH 30 seconds.
4. Pour coconut milk into the dish so that it is well combined.
5. Add the vegetables, cover and cook on HIGH for 10 minutes; stir after 5 minutes.
6. Reheat the rice and fluff up with a fork.
7. Serve the curry over the rice. Cheers, Doreen Doreen Randal, WAnganui.
8. New Zealand
title: Creamy Vegetable Curry With Rice

ingredients.text: salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps: 1. Combine chicken with celery and almonds in a bowl.
2. Mix Greek yogurt, honey, lemon juice, curry powder, salt, and pepper together in a small bowl. Pour dressing over the chicken salad and stir to combine.
title: Curry Chicken Salad With Greek Yogurt

steps: 1. Saute onion in butter until transparent.
2. Add in curry powder, stirring over low heat for a few minutes to blend flavors.
3. Add tomatoes and chicken stock.
4. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer about 15 to 20 minutes.
title: Tomato Curry Soup

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the yogurt, sour cream and salt. Add the cucumbers, onion, tomato and jalapeno; stir until blended. Garnish with cilantro if desired.
title: Indian Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. In
2. a casserole dish or a nonstick 9-inch square baking pan, arrange
3. in
4. layers
5. as
6. follows:
7. 1 cup potatoes, eggs, chicken and remaining 1 cup potatoes.
8. In a small bowl, blend flour, milk,
9. salt,
10. pepper
11. and curry powder (using a shaker bottle with lid is easier).
12. Pour mixture over casserole.
13. Dot butter
14. over the top of all (by 1/2 tablespoon or whatever is easiest).	Bake, uncovered,	at
16. for
18. hour, or until potatoes are tender.
title: Chicken Potato Curry

steps: 1. Wash beans and place in a 6-quart kettle with 3 quarts of water and bring to a boil.
2. Cover and simmer for 4 hours until tender.
title: Indian Pinto Beans

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup golden raisin, plumped in orange juice

steps: 1. Stir together the first 5 ingredients in a saucepan. Cover pan and simmer mixture over low heat until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender, about 30 minutes. Meanwhile, saute onion in oil until tender. Add onion and remaining ingredients (except chives) into rice and toss well. Sprinkle top with minced chives.
title: Curry Rice Indienne With Raisins & Almonds

ingredients.text: 1 head cauliflower, separated into small florets
salt, pepper, and nutmeg to taste

steps: 1. peel and grate the apples and set aside. Grate the ginger (if desired) and set aside with the apples. Separate the head of cauliflower into small florets and set aside.
2. Finely chop the onion.
3. Melt the margarine into a large soup pot, at somewhere between low and medium heat. When the butter is melted, add the curry and the onions, and cook for about 2 minutes.

4. Add the grated apples, ginger, cauliflower, parsley, salt, pepper, and nutmeg. I eyeball the nutmeg -- I'm a big fan of nutmeg so I add probably about 1 tbsp, but if you aren't too keen on nutmeg then I obviously wouldn't add as much.
5. Cook for about 15 minutes, stirring regularly.
6. After 15 minutes, add the vegetable broth . Let this sit on the stove at a soft boil for about 20-30 minutes, or until the cauliflower gets soft.
7. Puree the soup with a blender. Taste test the final product, and feel free to stir in some more curry or nutmeg if you desire!
8. This puree also makes a very good sauce on a baked potato.
title: Curry Cauliflower Soup

steps: 1. Combine eggs, flour and sugar; beat well.
2. Add cheese and corn.
3. Stir in 3/4 of the bacon.
4. Pour mixture into ungreased 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish.
5. Sprinkle remaining bacon over top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
6. Yields 8 servings.
title: Indian Corn Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. pork (boneless shoulder, loin or chops), cubed
1 red or green bell pepper, seeded and diced

steps: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons oil over medium heat in large saucepan. Add curry powder and garlic; cook and stir 1 to 2
2. minutes until garlic is golden. Add pork; stir to coat completely with curry and garlic.
3. Cook and stir 5 to 7 minutes or until pork cubes are barely pink in center. Add bell pepper and vinegar; cook and stir 3 minutes or until bell pepper is soft. Sprinkle with salt.
title: Pork Curry Over Cauliflower Couscous(Makes 6 Servings; Carb Count: 2 Grams)

steps: 1. Steam cauliflower until tender; set aside.
2. Peel potatoes; chop into 1/2" cubes.
3. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet; add 1 teaspoon cumin seed, 3/4 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp cayenne, and 2 tsp ground coriander; heat briefly until mixture becomes fragrant.
4. Add onions to pan and cook until onions are tender.
5. Add potatoes and 1/2 tsp salt to pan, mixing spices onto potatoes; then add 1 cup water.
6. Cook over medium heat for 30-40 minutes, or until potatoes are tender, adding more water if necessary.
7. When cauliflower is steamed, heat 1 tbsp of oil in another skillet; add 1 1/2 tsp ground coriander, 1/2 tsp cumin seed, and 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper.
8. Heat spices until they sizzle, then stir in 1/4 cup of tomato sauce and 1/8 tsp salt.
9. Cook until mixture becomes pasty, then stir in cauliflower, coating vegetables with sauce.
10. Continue cooking both cauliflower and potato mixtures until they have a fairly dry consistency.
11. Stir cauliflower into potatoes; mix in chopped cilantro; sprinkle top with garam masala and serve.
title: Indian Potatoes With Cauliflower - Aloo Gobi

steps: 1. Cut squash in half. Scoop out seeds and stringy pulp. Place squash halves on cookie sheet, flesh-side down. Roast for 45-60 minutes at 425, until flesh is very soft. Actual cook time will depend on the squash's size. (I actually roast mine flesh-side up, because I prefer the top a little crusty.).
2. Wait until squash only has about 15 minutes bake-time remaining, then saute ground beef with onion. Drain grease if necessary. Sprinkle with salt, curry powder and (optional) cumin, stir well.
3. Mound beef mixture into the fully-baked squash bowls and serve. YOU'RE DONE!
4. VARIATIONS & IDEAS.
5. Add mild red Anaheim chiles (roasted, de-skinned, de-seeded and chopped), to the ground beef & onions.
6. Sprinkle grated cheese on top just before serving, broil for about 2 minutes.

7. Reserve the seeds, rinse them and place in a small baking dish. Roast for about 15 minutes (in oven along with the squash halves). Toss with 1 tsp oil or butter and a pinch of salt, roast another 2 minutes. Scatter around the squash plate when serving. Or just snack on them!

8. Next time, I'm going to try baking the acorn squash whole first, then halving. I think I'll have to bake it just a little more after halving, un-stuffed and flesh side up, because I like a little bit of crustiness on the surface.
title: Curry Beef In An Acorn Squash Bowl

ingredients.text: 2 medium cucumbers, peeled, seeded, and finely chopped
1 medium tomato, seeded and finely chopped

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl; stir well. Cover and chill 1 hour.
title: Cucumber And Yogurt Raita

steps: 1. Heat some oil in a saucepan on medium heat. Pour in the rice and brown gently for 2 minutes. Add 450ml of vegetable stock and cook on high heat for 15-20 minutes until rice is cooked and the stock is completely absorbed.
2. In the meantime, take another pan, heat some olive oil and brown the onion, garlic, currants and apple.

3. Once the rice is cooked, drain well and add to the apple-currant mixture. Add the yoghurt, coconut milk, shredded coconut, salt, pepper and curry powder. Simmer for at least 5 minutes. The longer it cooks, the ticker the consistency will be.

4. Peel and cut the banana in dices and add to the rice. Cook for 1-2 minutes on low heat.
Serve hot.
title: Rice With Curry And Fruits

steps: 1. Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the garlic, and cook for 20 seconds until fragrant, then stir in the onion, green onion, bell pepper, and salt. Cook for a minute or two until the vegetables soften. Sprinkle with coriander, cumin, and turmeric; cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
2. Spread the vegetables evenly over the bottom of the skillet. Pour in egg, and cook gently until set, then turn over, and cook for an addition 30 seconds to firm. Roll omelet onto a plate to serve.
title: Mild Curry Omelet

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup shredded Cheddar cheese, or more to taste

steps: 1. Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Beat eggs and cream together in a bowl. Stir garlic, Cheddar cheese, curry powder, and cumin into egg mixture.
3. Cook and stir egg mixture in the hot oil until eggs are set and scrambled, about 5 minutes.
title: Indian-Style Scrambled Eggs

steps: 1. Fry the onion, garlic and chilli until the onions are translucent.
2. Add mustard seeds, turmeric and garam masala and stir fry for 2-3 minutes.
3. Add the chopped tomatoes and keep cooking, stirring regularly, until tomatoes start to break up.
4. Pour beaten eggs into the pan, season with salt and cook, stirring constantly, until they are done.
5. You can serve this garnished with fresh, finely chopped coriander leaves.

6. Note: You can use less garlic than the recipe indicates if you don't like it that much, or even cut it out. I don't always have chillies on hand, so I leave them out - all this means is that the eggs will be slightly less spicy, but will still taste really nice.
title: Indian Spicy Scrambled Eggs

steps: 1. In skillet, fry onion in bacon grease until tender, add diced hot dogs.
2. Continue frying until browned.
3. Add more bacon grease if needed.
4. Tear up tortillas into bite size pieces and add to skillet.
5. Continue frying until tortillas are pliable.
6. Add more bacon grease if needed.
7. Break eggs over entire mixture and stir everything together until eggs are fried.
8. Note: Do not deviate from recipe. This is a delicacy that originated in the refrigerator, better known as left overs. Pay day was still a ways off.
title: Aztec Indian Omelette

steps: 1. Heat a non-stick crepe pan over medium-high heat.
2. Whisk flour and water together in a bowl. Add egg and mix well. Whisk butter, salt, and caraway seeds into flour mixture to form a smooth batter.

3. Pour about 1/4 cup batter into heated pan. Tilt the pan around so the batter forms a nice round shape. Cook until bubbles form throughout the batter, 2 to 4 minutes. Flip the crepe by using spatula to loosen it from the pan. Flick your wrist upwards to give the crepe a toss, flipping it, and landing it back in the pan. Cook the second side until lightly browned, about 30 seconds. Repeat with remaining batter.
title: Indian Crepes

ingredients.text: 1 -2 tomatoes, cored, and thinly sliced (for garnish)

steps: 1. Whisk eggs, cream, and salt in a bowl until just blended.
2. Sprinkle the curry powder and cardamom into a large nonstick skillet over medium-low heat.
3. After about 20 seconds, add the butter.
4. When the butter begins to sizzle, add the eggs all at once.
5. Cook the eggs, stirring slowly with a flat wooden spatula or heatproof rubber spatula, just until the edges are set, about 2 minutes.
6. Transfer to plates and garnish with the tomato and a sprinkling of cilantro.
7. Serve immediately with the toast.
title: Creamy Scrambled Eggs With Curry And Cardamom

steps:
1. Wash moong daal with water and keep aside.
Heat oil in the pressure cooker and add daliya ,1/2 tsp cumin and green chilis and saute till the daliya change its colour and become slightly whitish (for about 2 minutes)
Add washed daal, tomato, carrot, peas and french beans and stir.
Add salt,turmeric,chili powder and 3 cups of water and mix.
Pressure cook on medium heat for 3 whistles.
Open the cooker when cool down completely.

2. Add 2 cups of warm water and chopped ginger in the cooker and mix well.
Let it come to a boil on medium heat and then simmer for 3-4 minutes.
Heat ghee in a small pan and add cumin and asfoetida.
When cumin become red then add it in the khichdi and switch off the flame.
Add lemon juice and fresh coriander and mix.
Serve hot with a tsp of ghee on top.
Serving suggestions-taste best with plain yogurt, raita, salad and roasted popadam

3. My Notes-
I have used yellow moong daal but you can also make this with green moong daal, masoor daal or tuvar daal but avoid using urad daal or chana daal if you are making this for kids or patients as these two daals are quite heavy and not so easy to digest.
Can add any vegetable of your choice like chopped potato,cauliflower,corn ,squash, bottle gourd,spinach etc.
I have used 1/2 cup of each vegetable but you can increase the amount of vegetable if you wish.
If you want to make it little watery then add 3 cups or 3.5 cups of water at step-7
title: Vegetable Lentil And Broken Wheat Porridge

steps: 1. Beat eggs and milk together adding salt and pepper.
2. Heat the ghee in fry pan and add the spring onions chillies and ginger and saute until soft.
3. Add the turmeric, coriander and tomato and fry a further 2 minutes
4. Turn heat low and add the eggs and cumin and cook as for scrambled eggs but do not cook to dry, the eggs should just be cooked.
5. Serve with chapatis and sprinkle with chopped coriander.
title: Akoori - Parsi Scrambled Eggs

steps: 1. Melt the ghee in a skillet over medium-low heat. Stir in the shallots, and cook until the shallots begin to soften, about 3 minutes. Season with the curry powder, and cook 5 minutes more. Add the tablespoon of water if needed to keep the shallots from burning.

2. Meanwhile, place the cream cheese into a microwave-safe bowl, and cook in the microwave until the cream cheese is fairly soft, about 30 seconds on High. Whisk in the eggs and Dijon mustard until the cream cheese is mostly mixed in (a few lumps are fine). Stir the egg mixture into the skillet with the shallots, and cook slowly, stirring occasionally, until the eggs have firmed. They will still be softer than normal scrambled eggs because of the cream cheese. Season to taste with salt and pepper just as the eggs are ready to come out of the pan.
title: Creamy Curried Scrambled Eggs

steps: 1. Combine flour, egg, baking powder, powdered sugar, and vanilla to make a moist but not sticky dough.
2. Flatten teaspoon-sized balls of dough on the back of a fork (preferably with rounded tines) and roll off, forming small snail-shell-like curls.
3. Deep fry in hot oil (~350°F/180°C), six at a time, until golden brown.
4. Roll in more powdered sugar while still hot to coat.
title: Kal Kals (Sweet Curled Fritters)

steps: 1. Mix wheat flour and salt together. Add ghee and mix well so that there are no lumps and the ghee is evenly absorbed.
2. Add water in small amounts and knead well until the dough becomes soft and pliable.
