title: Herbed Couscous

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
1 small tomato, seeded and finely chopped

steps: 1. Combine couscous and 2 tbsp boiling water in small heatproof bowl. Stir, using fork, until the water is absorbed, cool.
2. Combine couscous, parsley, tomato, onion, lemon juice and mint in medium bowl, mix well.
title: Couscous Tabbouleh

ingredients.text: 8 None chicken thighs, on the bone
1 cup fresh cilantro leaves, coarsely chopped

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450°F. Combine spices and oil. Add chicken thighs and toss to coat. Place chicken, skin-side up, on a lined baking tray and roast for 25-30 mins, or until chicken is cooked through and skin is crispy.
2. Meanwhile, for lemon yogurt, combine yogurt, lemon juice, chives and pinch of salt. Cover with plastic wrap and chill until needed.

3. Bring stock to a boil then pour over couscous. Add butter, cover with plastic wrap and set aside for 5 mins. Fluff with a fork to separate grains. Mix in pistachios and cilantro. Season. Serve with chicken and lemon yogurt.
title: Moroccan Chicken With Pistachio-Cilantro Couscous

steps: 1. Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat; add onion and almonds, and saute 7 minutes or until onion is tender and almonds are golden. Stir in rice and next 4 ingredients; saute 2 minutes. Add broth, and bring to a boil; cover, reduce heat, and simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until rice is tender.
2. Prep: 10 min., Cook: 35 min.
title: Persian Rice Pilaf

ingredients.text: 2 c. plain yogurt (1 large and 1 small)

steps: 1. Soak raisins in water for 10 minutes.
2. Drain; save water and combine with yogurt, cream, cucumber, walnuts and scallion.
3. Stir in raisins, salt and pepper.
4. Chill soup covered for 3 hours. Serve in bowls garnished with minced parsley and snipped dill.
title: Iranian Yogurt Soup

ingredients.text: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, flattened slightly
1 bunch green onion, trimmed (green & white parts sliced separately)

steps: 1. Cook couscous using the chicken broth and 1 tablespoon of the butter, following directions on the package.

2. Melt remaining tablespoon of butter and oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Saute the chicken, turning once, until golden and firm to the touch. This should take 5-6 minutes. Remove chicken from pan and cover with foil to keep warm.

3. Add the white part of the green onions, orange juice, cream and salt to skillet. Boil over high heat, scraping up any brown bits from the bottom of the pan. Cook 2 minutes to reduce sauce, stirring constantly. Add the.
4. orange slices and remove from heat.

5. Stir the green part of the onions into the couscous and spoon on to a serving platter. Arrange the chicken with orange slices on top of the couscous. Spoon the orange sauce over the chicken and serve.
title: Tampa Chicken With Couscous

ingredients.text: 1 lb lean meat, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
3 cups basmati rice, soaked in water for 15 minutes, then drained (or long grain rice)

steps: 1. Brown meat,on all sides in 1 tbsp butter.

2. Add seasoning to meat and stir. Pour three cups boiling water over the meat. Cover and let cook for one hour on a medium high heat, 'til the meat is done. Measure the broth left in a measuring cup. Add enough water to make up 3 cups of liquid.
3. Stir onions and garlic with 1/2 tablespoon hot melted butter, till slightly brown.
4. Add the meat and the liquid to the onion mixture. Stir tomato paste over. Bring to boil then add the rice and raisins.
5. Cover the pan and reduce heat to low. Let cook for 30 minutes. Open the pan and stir just the top layer. See if rice is cooked. You may need to cook, covered, a few minutes longer.
6. Serve rice and garnish with the meat and nuts.
7. Serve with plain Yogurt and mixed green salad.
title: Riyadh Rice - Middle Eastern Favourite!

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large pan on your stove top. Add carrots and celery and saute until softened, about 8-10 minutes. Add garlic and cook just until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
2. Add chicken broth, scraping up any brown bits from the pan. Let come to a simmer, then turn off the heat and add couscous. Place a lid over the pan and let sit for 5 minutes.
3. Fluff couscous with a fork and serve warm.
title: Copcycat Near East Couscous

ingredients.text: 27 ounces black beans, canned (I like Margaret Holmes)

steps: 1. In a hot dutch oven or deep pot, add olive oil and after it begins to shimmer, add in onion, green pepper, celery and garlic and sweat over medium heat until translucent. Remove to a bowl and set aside.

2. Add sausage and brown and break up until cooked through. Remove excess fat. Add vegetables back to the pot and stir in tomatoes, spices, black beans and '2' cups of the broth. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 10 minutes until bubbly.

3. When ready to serve, bring remaining 2 cups of the broth to boil in a saucepan then stir in couscous. Cover and remove from heat. Let sit 5 minutes. If you are a salt lover, add salt but I usually don't.

4. Ladle one sixth of the couscous into the bottom of a bowl then cover with black bean soup. If desired sprinkle some shredded cheddar cheese or sour cream on top (we like it just as well without it).
title: Quick Black Bean And Sausage Soup With Couscous

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Cut tops off of green peppers and discard the tops. Boil the peppers in water for about 5 minutes; drain and set aside.
3. Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and then add onions and garlic. Saute 2-3 minutes or until tender.
4. Add chicken broth and bring to a boil. Stir in couscous, zucchini, parsley and pepper. Remove from heat.
5. Cover and let stand 5 minutes. Stir in cheddar cheese. Spoon mixture into green peppers and top with a little more cheese.
6. Bake in a casserole dish covered loosely with foil for 25-30 minutes.
title: Cheesy Couscous Stuffed Peppers

steps: 1. Bring broth and quinoa to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until quinoa is tender and water has been absorbed, about 15 minutes.

2. Combine cucumber, tomatoes, parsley, green onions, mint, and garlic in a large bowl. Add quinoa, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt to cucumber mixture; toss to combine. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate until flavors combine, at least 1 hour.
title: Quinoa Tabbouleh Salad

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup plain yogurt, stirred to loosen

steps: 1. Melt butter in large saucepan over medium-high heat. Add onion, saute 2 minutes. Mix in carrots. Add broth, bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until carrots are very tender, about 20 minutes.
2. Stir cumin seeds in small skillet over med-high heat until fragrant, 4-5 minute. Cool and then finely grind in spice mill.
3. Remove soup from heat. Puree in batches in blender until smooth. Return to same pan. Whisk in honey, lemon juice and allspice. Season with salt and pepper.
4. Ladle soup into bowls. Drizzle yogurt over, sprinkle generously with cumin.
title: Moroccan Carrot Soup

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

2. Heat olive oil in a heavy, oven-safe skillet over high heat. Cook chicken breasts on both sides until golden brown, about 5 minutes per side. Remove chicken breasts from skillet and set aside. Add onion and ground beef to the skillet; cook until onions are starting to brown, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Season with cinnamon, allspice, salt, and cayenne pepper. Cook and stir for 2 minutes.
3. Stir rice into the skillet until fully coated with oil and spices. Place chicken breasts on top of the rice and pour in broth. Cover skillet with a tight-fitting lid or aluminum foil.
4. Bake in the preheated oven until rice has absorbed all liquid, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with parsley before serving.
title: One-Pot Lebanese Chicken And Rice

ingredients.text: 1 lb fresh green beans, washed and ends trimmed

steps: 1. Cut beans into or leave whole. Steam beans for about 5 minutes, or until tender. Drain well.
2. Place beans in a large bowl with all remaining ingredients and toss well to combine.
3. Chill at least 2 hours before serving.
title: Lebanese Green Bean Salad

steps: 1. Bring stock to a boil in a large saucepan. Remove from heat, add couscous and butter and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 5 mins, or until liquid is absorbed, fluffing with a fork occasionally.
2. Stir spring onions into couscous to serve.
title: Spring Onion Couscous

ingredients.text: 1 lb potato, peeled, boiled until tender

steps: 1. Mash potatoes with butter and salt.
2. Heat oil in skillet, add onion, beef and pepper.
3. Saute for 5 minutes.
4. Drain beef mixture.
5. Butter a 1 quart casserole.
6. Put half of the potatoes in the bottom of the dish.
7. Add the meat mixture and cover with the remaining mashed potatoes.
8. Smooth the surface.
9. Cover with the beaten egg and sprinkle with cheese.
10. Bake in 350 degree oven until the surface is golden about 30 minutes.
title: Batata Merhiya (Algerian Mashed Potatoes Layered With Beef )

steps: 1. Saute the onion, carrots and celery with a glug of olive oil until soft. Add the garlic, spices and tomatoes and cook for a further 2 minutes.
2. Add the lentil, stock, salt and pepper, cover and simmer for 30 mins or until lentils are soft.
3. Squeeze on the lemon and add the chopped Corriander.
title: Algerian Lentil Soup (Chorba Adas)

ingredients.text: 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, cut into small pieces

steps: 1. Place the rice in a large bowl and add cold water to cover by 3 inches. Swirl around with your fingers until the water becomes cloudy, then pour through a strainer to drain. Repeat this process until the water remains clear. This will take 4 to 6 rinsings.

2. Place the rice, salt and the 6 cups water in a deep, nonstick saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer the rice gently, uncovered, for about 18 minutes. When the rice has absorbed all the water, reduce the heat to the lowest possible setting and sprinkle the butter pieces over the top.

3. Wrap a clean kitchen towel around the pot lid, piling any excess cloth on top of the lid. (You want to keep the cloth away from the heat) Place the cloth-covered lid over the rice and steam for 20 minutes. Remove the pot from the heat and let stand, covered, 5 minutes.
4. Gently fluff the rice with a fork and serve immediately.
title: Persian Style Steamed Rice

ingredients.text: 2 large oranges, peeled and sectioned, then cut into pieces
1/2 cup onion, cut into thin slices

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, combine carrots, oranges and raisins.
2. Toss to combine.
3. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients.
4. Spoon over carrot mixture. Mix well.
5. Chill several hours or overnight.
6. Mix before serving.
7. Note: preparation time does not include chilling time.
title: Lebanese Carrot And Orange Salad

steps: 1. Bring broth and water to boil in a medium saucepan.
2. Remove from heat.
3. Stir in couscous.
4. Cover.
5. Let sit for 5 minutes.
6. DRESSING: Whisk sugar, dijon mustard, lemon juice, and red wine vinegar together.
7. Whisk in olive oil slowly.
8. Transfer couscous to a large bowl and fluff with fork to separate the grains.
9. Add tomatoes, cucumbers, green onion and feta cheese.
10. Add dressing and toss.
11. Serve at room temperature.
title: Couscous Salad

ingredients.text: 1 lb butternut squash, peeled, deseeded, diced
2 None large zucchini, cut into chunks
1 None red bell pepper, deseeded, cut into thick strips

steps: 1. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large saucepan over high heat. Cook vegetables, stirring, for 5 mins. Add 1 cup water and simmer, covered, for 10 mins, until just tender. Remove lid and cook for another 5 mins, until liquid evaporates and thickens slightly.

2. Meanwhile, heat remaining oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Toast cumin for 1 min, until fragrant. Add 1 cup water. Season. Add couscous then set aside, covered, for 5 mins. Fluff with a fork and season.
3. To serve, arrange vegetables over couscous. Drizzle with pan juices. Season.
title: Cumin-Spiced Couscous With Sautéed Vegetables

ingredients.text: 1 medium zucchini (halved lengthwise and thinly sliced, 2 cups)

steps: 1. Place instant couscous in a large bowl and add 2 cups boiling water. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for 5 minutes. Uncover and fluff with a fork. Add lemon juice, kosher salt, olive oil, zucchini, tomato, fresh mint, raisins. Toss until well combined.
title: Mint Couscous With Zucchini And Tomato

ingredients.text: 1/2 pound medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
2 tablespoons finely chopped unsalted, dry-roasted peanuts

steps: 1. Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add shrimp; cook 3 minutes or until done. Drain and rinse with cold water; cut shrimp in half. Bring 1 1/4 cups water to a boil in saucepan; gradually stir in couscous. Remove from heat; cover and let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork; cool.

2. Combine vinegar, vegetable oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, and garlic in a large bowl; stir well with a whisk. Add shrimp, couscous, lettuce, bell pepper, peas, and cilantro; toss well. Sprinkle with peanuts.
title: Sesame Shrimp-And-Couscous Salad

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup green bell pepper, finely diced
1/4 cup red bell pepper, finely diced

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients EXCEPT couscous in a pot. Bring to a boil uncovered.
2. Remove from heat and immediately stir in couscous. Let stand 5 minutes, covered.
3. Fluff with a fork **Important** or it turns to a brick!
4. Can be served hot or chill to make a wonderful salad.
title: Mediterranean Couscous

steps: 1. Bring water to boil.
2. Stir in salt and add couscous.
3. Remove pan from heat and cover.
4. Let stand 5 minutes.
5. Transfer couscous to a large bowl and break up any clumps.
6. Toss couscous with remaining ingredients.
7. Add couscous dressing and mix well.
title: Couscous Salad

steps: 1. Cover rice with cold water and salt.
2. Soak overnight. Boil 3 quarts of cold water.
3. Drain soaked rice and add to fast boiling water.
4. Boil 5 to 7 minutes or until one grain of rice tastes half-cooked, but not soft.
5. Pour rice into colander and rinse with cold water.
6. Preheat oven to 325°.
7. Use some of the butter for bottom of roasting pan with cover.
8. Pour rice over butter.
9. Add remaining butter.
10. Cover and bake 45 minutes, shaking roasting pan twice during baking to mix butter with rice.
title: Assyrian Baked Rice(Serves 4)

ingredients.text: 1 1/3 cups fat-free, less-sodium chicken broth, divided

steps: 1. Combine 1/3 cup chicken broth, onion, and raisins in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil; reduce heat, and simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Add remaining chicken broth and salt; bring to a boil. Stir in couscous. Remove from heat; cover and let stand 5 minutes.
2. Fluff couscous mixture with a fork. Add parsley and remaining ingredients to couscous mixture; toss gently. Serve immediately.
title: Couscous With Golden Raisins And Herbs

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a medium pan. Add the ground and fresh coriander, onions and cauliflower florets, stir well and add the water. Bring to the boil, then reduce heat to very low, cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.

2. Take 1 and 1/2 tablespoons of the cauliflower "stock" from the pan and stir into the flour to make a smooth paste, then add back to the cauliflower in the pan. Simmer for a few minutes, then season with ginger, cumin and lemon juice.
3. Leave for 1 to 2 minutes for the flavours to develop, then serve warm or at room temperature. (Or see description for variation to make salad.).
title: Moroccan Cauliflower With Spices

steps: 1. *Can be found in pasta section of grocery.
title: Syrian Rice

ingredients.text: 10.5 oz sweet potatoes, peeled, cut into 3/4 inch cubes

steps: 1. Combine couscous with 1/2 cup boiling water. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for 5 mins, or until liquid is absorbed. Using a fork, fluff and separate grains. Let cool then mix with ground pork, carrot, cilantro and garlic. Shape into 4 patties.
2. Heat 1/2 the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Cook patties for 3 mins per side, or until browned and cooked through. Drain on paper towels.
3. Meanwhile, steam sweet potatoes for 5-6 mins, or until tender. Let cool slightly then mix with spinach, pine nuts, ricotta, lemon juice and remaining oil. Season.
4. Serve patties with salad.
title: Pork And Couscous Patties With Spinach Salad

steps: 1. Place chicken, water and spices in large heavy kettle (Dutch oven).
2. Boil over high heat, skimming fat for 5 minutes.
3. Reduce heat; simmer 1 hour.
4. Drain chicken; reserve stock. Debone chicken.
title: Dajaj Pilaf (Chicken)(Middle Eastern Feast Dish)

ingredients.text: 4 1/2 cups russet potatoes, peeled, cut in 1/2 inch dice

steps: 1. Grease and lightly flour a 13 X 9 inch baking dish. Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
2. In a large bowl, combine the sunflower oil, yogurt, and eggs. Add the vegetables and spices. Slowly add the flour and mix until combined. Spread in the prepared pan.
3. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until top browns. Remove from oven and serve warm for breakfast, as a snack or as a side dish.
title: Potato Borek

ingredients.text: 1 3/4 cups asparagus, diagonally cut into 1 inch slices
1 1/4 cups chicken broth, fat and salt-free
1 cup couscous, such as Israeli couscous
2 tablespoons cashew nuts, chopped and lightly salted

steps: 1. To cook asparagus place water in a medium saucepan; bring water to a boil. Add asparagus, and cook 2 minutes or just until crisp-tender; drain. Place asparagus in ice water 1 minute; drain. Set aside.

2. Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Add onion and garlic; saute 3 to 4 minutes or until tender. Stir in chicken broth and salt; bring to a boil. Add couscous; bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and cook 5 minutes.
3. Stir in asparagus, black pepper, red bell pepper and cashews. Cook an additional 3 to 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
title: Israeli Couscous With Asparagus

ingredients.text: 1 cup chickpeas, drained and rinsed if canned
2 red bell peppers, split lengthwise, seeds and membranes removed

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Over medium heat, saute the onion and carrot in the olive oil until tender but not browned, 4-5 minutes. Add the spices and stir, cooking for about two minutes to allow the flavors to marry.
2. Arrange the pepper halves in a baking dish so they are snug. Pour the remaining broth in the bottom of the dish.

3. Spoon 1/4 cup of the couscous mixture into each pepper half, then nestle an ounce of goat cheese into the center. Distribute the remaining couscous mixture amongst the peppers, pressing down to fill the corners, and top with the remaining goat cheese.
4. Cover the dish tightly with tinfoil and bake until steamed and tender, about 30 minutes. Remove the foil and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or broil briefly to brown the tops.
title: Dinner Tonight: Couscous-Stuffed Peppers Recipe

steps: 1. Saute the onion in olive oil until golden.
2. Add tomato; cook.
3. Add garlic; cook.
4. Add turmeric, ground cumin, salt and pepper.
5. Add parsley.
6. Add cilantro; cook.
7. Add 1 cup water.
8. Add beans.
9. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring so it doesn't burn.
title: Moroccan White Beans Loubia

steps: 1. Bring water and quinoa to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until quinoa is tender and water has been absorbed, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let quinoa rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Uncover the saucepan and cool to room temperature.
2. Stir quinoa, carrots, currants, mint, parsley, and green onions together in a bowl.

3. Combine olive oil, lime juice, agave nectar, cumin, and salt in a jar; seal the jar with a lid and shake vigorously until dressing is well-blended. Pour dressing over quinoa mixture and toss to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate until flavors blend, at least 30 minutes.
title: Quinoa Tabbouleh Salad (Gluten-Free)

steps: 1. Slice carrots into about three pieces.
2. Cook carrots in boiling water until crisp-tender, about five minutes.
3. Drain, rinse with cold water and drain again.
4. While carrots cool, in medium bowl, combine lemon juice, sugar, paprika, cumin, cinnamon, salt and cayenne pepper.
5. Stir to dissolve sugar and salt.
6. Stir in olive oil, parsley and raisins.
7. Add carrots and toss to combine.
8. Cover and chill for at least one hour to blend flavors, stirring occasionally.
9. Serve on a leaf of lettuce, if desired.
title: Carrot And Raisin Salad---Moroccan Style

ingredients.text: 1 head cauliflower, cut into large chunks

steps: 1. Process cauliflower in batches by pulsing in a food processor until it has the consistency of rice.

2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Saute red bell pepper in hot oil until hot, about 2 minutes; add shallots and garlic and saute until soft, about 2 minutes. Stir cauliflower with the vegetables in the skillet; cook and stir until the cauliflower is hot, 3 to 5 minutes.

3. Pour chicken broth over the cauliflower mixture; season with salt and thyme. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the liquid is absorbed, about 5 minutes. Stir lemon zest and lemon juice into the mixture; continue cooking until the lemon flavor penetrates the cauliflower, about 2 minutes more.
4. Remove skillet from heat, add olives and parsley, and toss to mix.
title: Paleo Cauli Couscous

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup hot milk, or to taste
1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or to taste (optional)

steps: 1. Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a saucepan. Add wheat berries. Cover and remove from heat. Let soak, 6 hours to overnight. Drain.
2. Combine soaked wheat berries with remaining 4 cups water; bring to a boil. Simmer over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from heat; let stand until berries pop open, 10 to 15 minutes more.
3. Divide wheat berries among serving bowls. Add a few spoonfuls of hot milk, a handful of almonds, and a sprinkle of cinnamon to each bowl before serving.
title: Egyptian Wheat Porridge (Belila)

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 cups water (substitute milk or soymilk if desired)
1/2 teaspoon cinnamon (substitute or add extra spices of your choice)
1/4 cup almonds, chopped (substitute with any other nut)

steps: 1. Set aside two bowls and divide the dry couscous between them (pouring half in each).
2. If using dried fruit, set aside a third bowl and fill with the fruit.

3. Add the water and 1 tbsp honey to a small saucepan. Bring the water to a boil and pour 1/2 cup boiling water over each bowl of couscous. Pour the remaining water over the dried fruit (this will allow the fruit to plump and become tender and even more delicious).
4. Cover each bowl of couscous and let sit for 5-10 minutes until the water has been fully absorbed. Fluff with a fork.

5. Drain the water from the bowl of fruit. Add half the yogurt to each bowl. Divide the fruit in half between the bowls. Divide the chopped almonds between the bowls. Drizzle each bowl with 1 tbsp honey. Sprinkle 1/4 tsp cinnamon on each bowl. Mix, if desired. Enjoy, it's delicious!

6. Notes: I love a combination of dried fruit with this dish. I have used dried apricots, pears, cherries, raisins, blueberries, goji berries, currents and dates (not all at once, but hey why not?). Raisins are by far the easiest as they are a staple in many kitchens (and they're great in this dish).

7. Notes (for serving an adult and a young child): Divide the dry couscous between two bowls: 1/2 cup and 1/4 cup. Make sure to chop the dried fruit into bite-sized pieces. When dividing the water between the bowls, add 5-oz boiling water to the adult portion and 3-oz to the child portion (using a measuring cup makes this easy). Skip the nuts if your child hasn't been introduced to them yet or if the pieces are large enough to present a choking hazard. Also, make sure your child has gotten an OK from the doctor to eat honey (typically given at 1 year).
title: Fruit And Yogurt Breakfast Couscous

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, whisk eggs well.
2. Add salt and whisk again.
3. In a frying pan, heat butter and saute the vegetables, except parsley, until almost done.
4. Add the eggs to the sauteed vegetables.
5. Add more salt if required.
6. Garnish with more parsley and serve hot.
title: Menhaden (Turkish Omelette)

steps: 1. Melt the butter in a large skillet and sautee the onion until soft. Add the peppers and sautee for 2 to 3 minutes, then add the tomatoes and cook for 2 or 3 minutes more.
2. Meanwhile, beat the eggs with salt and pepper, to taste, and the paprika powder. Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables. Keep stirring with a fork or whisk until set, then serve.
title: Menemen (Spicy Turkish Scrambled Eggs)

ingredients.text: 1 (16 ounce) can fava beans (you can find at any middle eastern store, maybe even like a trader joe's or organic store)
3 tablespoons canola oil (or any oil you prefer)
1 onion (Small size and chopped- optional, if you don't want to use just skip step number 1)

steps: 1. Chop up a small onion with a bit of oil and saute in small pot until tender, remove from heat.
2. Open can of fava beans and dump into pot, along with juices, do not drain.
3. Take a potato smasher and smash up the fava beans. I leave a few whole, but basically smash up most of them.
4. Add salt, ground cumin and cayenne pepper to your liking.
5. Squeeze juice of lemon into pot.
6. Add a splash of olive oil.
7. Heat just to boil and then that's it.
8. Spoon some beans into a flat bowl, splash some oil on top of them. I like to add the following garnish, but you can leave garnish out and just eat that way they are just as yummy too.

9. This is something I do sometimes to this dish as well-MY SPECIAL GARNISH. 1. Chop a few slices of red onion fine. 2. Chop a small (or half) green bell pepper finely. 3. Chop a handful of black olive slices finely. 4. Chop a small tomato finely. 5. A little bit of chopped parsley 6. Drizzle of tahina.
10. Okay now you add all these finely chopped veggies around the bowl edge and finish off with a drizzle of tahina in middle of bowl. Looks beautiful! Then i mix all together and eat it mixed up!
title: Egyptian Fool (Fava Beans) Traditional Breakfast

ingredients.text: 2 green peppers, cleaned and cut into strips
5 red potatoes, washed, unpeeled and sliced

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a pan, add the onions, potatoes and the green peppers.
2. Season with salt, pepper, cayenne pepper and cook over low heat until softened.
3. Add the tomatoes.
4. Increase heat to Medium.
5. Break the eggs in a bowl and beat.
6. Pour the eggs into a pan, scramble eggs to your preference of doneness.
7. Serve hot.
title: Simple And Easy Tunisian Scrambled Eggs With Veggies

steps: 1. Combine all of the ingredients in a 1-qt. microwaveablecasserole dish.
2. Cover and microwave on high until liquid is absorbed and the couscous is tender, 5 to 6 minutes.
3. Let stand, covered, for 1 minute more.
title: Orange Breakfast Couscous

ingredients.text: 1 lb (450 g) nuts (any type, but preferrably pistachios or walnuts)

steps: 1. Combine the nuts and cinnamon in a blender. Blend the nuts into a fine powder, being careful not to form a paste.
2. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat, then set aside.
3. Line a baking pan with parchment paper.
4. Count the number of sheets of phyllo dough and divide it by eight. Arrange one-eighth of the sheets in the bottom of the pan, on the parchment paper.
5. Divide the chopped nuts into seven equally sized portions.
6. Brush the phyllo dough with melted butter, and evenly distribute one portion of chopped nuts over the dough.
7. Arrange another eighth of the phyllo sheets on top of the nut layer.
8. Repeat the buttering and layering of nuts and phyllo until you have used up all the phyllo sheets and chopped nuts.
9. Using a sharp knife, radially cut the baklava into eight equally sized portions shaped like the British flag.
10. Bake the baklava for 25 minutes at 350°F (180°C). Remove from the oven, and let cool slightly.

11. Mix the vanilla extract, honey, sugar, and water in a clean saucepan. Boil over medium heat until it becomes a very thick and viscous syrup of slightly over 1 cup (240 ml). Remove from the heat, and let cool slightly.
12. Pour the syrup on top of the baked baklava, coating each portion of the baklava evenly with syrup.
13. Let everything cool fully before serving.
title: Baklava II

steps: 1. Combine all dry ingredients in a large bowl.
2. Add water and whisk vigorously until you get a thin batter.
3. Cover bowl and let sit for 1 hour.
4. Heat a frying pan over medium heat, and lightly grease it.
5. Add a ladleful of batter, and spread it out in the bottom of pan. Cook over medium heat until air bubbles form on the top of the batter.
6. Remove from frying pan and let cool.
title: Lahoh (Spongy Flatbread) II

steps: 1. Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Drain well.
2. In the saucepan, combine the rinsed rice, milk, sugar, vanilla extract, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Stir well to combine the ingredients.
3. Place the saucepan over medium heat and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, stirring occasionally to prevent the rice from sticking to the bottom of the pan.
4. Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, for about 30–40 minutes or until the rice is tender and the mixture thickens to a creamy consistency.
5. Remove the saucepan from the heat and let the roz bel laban cool for a few minutes.
6. Once the pudding has cooled slightly, divide it between serving bowls or cups.
7. If you prefer to enjoy the pudding warm, it can be served immediately. If you prefer it chilled, refrigerate the pudding for at least 2 hours or until it is cold and set.
8. Before serving, garnish with chopped pistachios or almonds for added texture and flavor.
title: Roz bel Laban (Egyptian Rice Pudding)

steps: 1. Mix butter with sugar until creamy.
2. Add oil flour and semolina and mix.
3. Add warm milk and don't knead too much
4. Cover and leave aside for an hour or less until you prepare the filling

5. For the dates filling, fry some sesame in a pan then add butter. Add the dates paste and mixed well with sesame and butter. Then add a little bit of water until it's mushy. Be careful don't make it too mushy.
6. Take it of the pan, put in a plate until it's cool. Then start to shape balls that weigh 15 gm.
7. Refrigerate for 1/2 an hour.
8. Get back to the dough and shape it as balls that weigh 30 gm.
9. Take the date filling out of the fridge and start to stuff each dough ball with dates ball.
10. Then use the mamoul mould to give it this shape.
11. In a preheated oven 180 degrees, put it for 20 minutes until golden from below and little bit golden from above.
title: Mamoul (Eid biscuits)

steps: 1. Mix 1/2 cup plus 2 tablespoons semolina, 2 tablespoons sesame seeds, sugar, yeast, and salt together in a large bowl. Whisk in oil, egg, and egg white. Stir in warm milk slowly until a liquid dough forms.
2. Cover the bowl with a plate or plastic wrap; let stand at room temperature until frothy, about 1 hour.
3. Stir in 2 3/4 cups flour with a wooden spoon until a sticky dough forms. Cover again and allow to rest for 30 minutes.
4. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a baking mat.

5. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon flour over the dough and your hands. Mix dough, adding flour as needed, 1 tablespoon at a time, until it pulls away from the sides of the bowl. Shape into a round loaf and place on the prepared baking sheet. Cover loosely with a towel and let rise for 1 hour in a warm place until loaf doubles in volume.
6. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
7. Beat egg yolk and water in a bowl with a fork; brush over the entire surface of the loaf. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon sesame seeds on top.
8. Bake in the preheated oven until loaf is golden brown, about 20 to 25 minutes.
title: Khobz el Dar (Algerian Semolina Bread)

steps: 1. Sieve flour and add baking powder,salt,sugar,oil nd mix together
2. Add water nd knead the dough for like 10mins
3. Cover the mixture and allow it to rise
4. After it rised transfer it to a work surface and form a round (you can use a plate or pot's lid)
5. Heat ur pan and put it
6. It'll start puffing then you turn it
7. And lastly put it in in a warm place, then you'll see it has pocket
title: Shawarma bread

ingredients.text: 4 1/2 c. cooking apples, peeled and chopped

steps: 1. Stir first 3 ingredients together and let stand one hour. Sift together the flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves; pour over apple mixture.
2. Stir in pecans or walnuts.
3. Pour into greased, floured Bundt pan.
4. Bake at 350° for one hour or until pick comes out clean.
title: Syrian Apple Cake

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400-degrees F.
2. Stir together cumin, salt, paprika, and olive oil.
3. Split each pita into 2 rounds and brush the rough sides (the inside sides) with the oil mixture.
4. Cut the rounds into 8 pieces each, and place rough side up onto baking sheets.
5. Bake in 400-degree F oven until golden brown and crispy, about 8 minutes.
6. Cool and store in airtight containers at room temperature. Keeps about 5 days.
title: Spiced Pita Cumin Crisps

steps: 1. Dissolve the yeast in 1 cup warm water.
2. Sift together the flour and salt and mix the yeast and water.
3. Work the mixture into a dough and knead for several minutes.
4. Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let rise in a warm place for 3 hours.
5. Preheat oven to 350°.
6. Divide the dough into 6 equal portions and roll into balls.
7. With either your hand or a rolling pin, pat and press each ball of dough into a 5-inch circle about 1/2-inch thick.
8. Place on an ungreased baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes, or until the pita are light golden brown.
title: Egyptian Onion Pita Bread

steps: 1. Dissolve chocolate in 5 teaspoons boiling water.
2. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, mixing well.
3. Mix flour and baking powder.
4. Add alternately with milk; mix thoroughly.
5. Stir in vanilla.
6. Grease three layer cake pans.
7. Bake at 350°
8. until done for 25 to 30 minutes.
title: Egyptian Cake

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon rose water (or less to taste)

steps: 1. Add ground rice to 1 cup of milk.
2. Dissolve sugar in the remaining milk and bring to a boil.
3. Add the rice-milk mixture, lower heat, and cook-stirring occasionally-until the pudding thickens like thin custard.
4. Remove from flame, stir in the rosewater, and pour into a shallow serving dish. Sprinkle top with nuts.
title: Egyptian Milk Pudding (Mihallabiya)

steps: 1. Combine first 6 ingredients in large bowl; mix well.
2. Trim 8 sheets phyllo dough to fit 10 x 15-inch baking pan.
3. Keep unused phyllo covered with damp cloth. Arrange in baking pan, brushing each sheet generously with melted butter.
4. Spread half the apple mixture over phyllo dough.
5. Arrange 6 trimmed buttered sheets of phyllo dough over apple mixture.
6. Spread with remaining apple mixture.
7. Top with 8 buttered sheets phyllo dough.
8. Tuck in the buttered phyllo neatly around.
9. Cut into squares or diamond using a sharp knife.
10. Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes or until golden brown.
11. Heat honey in small saucepan.
12. Drizzle over hot baklava.
title: Apple Rum Baklava

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes, divided evenly over 4 breads
1/8 teaspoon garlic powder, divided evenly over 4 breads
1 tablespoon olive oil, divided into 1/4 teaspoon amounts

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Place breads on baking sheet - ungreased.
3. Sprinkle cheese on each pita and add Italian seasoning to each.
4. Top with rest of ingredients divided equally on the four breads.
5. Drizzle 1/4 teaspoon (olive oil) on each pita.
6. Bake in oven for 10-12 minutes.
7. Cut in half and let rest for 4 minutes before serving.
title: Pita With Feta

steps: 1. Spread bottom of dish with apples
2. Add cinnamon
3. Add sugar and flour and then mix eggs and last the butter
4. Bake in over at 375 degree for 45min.
title: Apple Cobbler (Milopita)

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line an 11-inch round baking pan with parchment paper.

2. Combine sliced apples, 1/2 cup white sugar, butter, and brown sugar in a large bowl. Mix together gently, being careful not to break apple slices. Pour sugary juice from the apple mixture into the prepared baking pan. Arrange sliced apples on top in a circle. Sprinkle raisins on top of apples and pour any remaining juice over all.

3. Combine olive oil and cinnamon in a large mixing bowl. Add egg yolks, flour, grated apples, baking powder, and remaining white sugar. Stir well to combine. Beat egg whites to a light froth in a separate bowl and stir into the olive oil mixture carefully. Pour over the apples in the baking pan.
4. Bake in the preheated oven until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean, about 45 minutes. Cover cake with foil if the top browns before the cake is done baking.
5. Remove cake from oven and allow to cool, about 30 minutes. Invert cake onto a serving plate.
title: Milopita (Greek Apple Upside-Down Cake)

steps: 1. Clean and cut apples into almond-size pieces and leave in a mixing bowl. Chop walnuts into large chunky pieces and add to apples then set aside.
2. Mix all the dry ingredients (flour through lemon peel on the above list) together in a separate mixing bowl and set aside.
3. Beat eggs, vanilla and water together, add oil then add to the dry ingredients. Fold in the apples and walnuts and combine everything and mix well.
4. Pour into a 9 x 12 baking pan, place in a preheated oven at 350 degrees (F) and bake for 1 hour. Cool and cut into desired pieces.
5. If you prefer to make muffins, the recipe yields 24 muffins at 350 degrees (F), baked for 20 to 25 minutes.
6. - Good appetite!
title: Milopita

steps: 1. Chop fine and mix all.
2. Break large pita bread into pieces. Cover with mix and broil 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes.
3. (Cook the bacon first.)
title: Mary Jane Pita Snacks

steps: 1. Mix all of the dry ingredients together in a large sturdy bowl (hard plastic or stainless steel). Form a little well in the center.
2. Heat the water in a microwave safe dish for one minute.
3. Pour the water into the flour well and mix the ingredients with a spatula as far you can. Place a dish of cool water in a bowl next to you as you begin to knead by hand.

4. Knead the dough in the bowl by hand for at least 5-10 minutes, dipping your fingertips into the bowl of water as you knead. This will help create a smooth, elastic finish. You know your dough is ready when the surface is smooth and doesn't have pock-marks. The dough will feel slightly sticky as you knead it, but should not stick to your hands.

5. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and cut with a knife (or separate by hand) into equal sized pieces - 8 for larger rounds or 20 for small pitettes. Roll each piece into a smooth ball and lay on clean dish cloth or floured cutting board or surface, keeping them covered with another cloth.

6. Once all of the balls are rolled and resting, cover them with a clean cloth and lightly pat the cloth with water on your finger tips to keep them moist, or spray lightly with a water mister. Let the balls rest for 30 minutes.
7. After 30 minutes rest, preheat oven to 450 degrees with a baking stone or pizza pan on bottom rack inserted.

8. As the oven preheats, roll each ball on a lightly floured surface into a flat round, no thicker than 1/4". The thinner the round, the better your pocket. Turn them over to roll them, trying to keep the round as best you can. If the dough sticks to the rolling pin, dip your finger tips in a little flour and coat the surface of the round as you roll. Make sure the edges are rolled out equally and not thicker than the center. Lay each round on the cloth or floured surface to rest again as the oven preheats. Keep them in the order your rolled them.

9. Once the oven is ready, bake each round (or several at a time depending on size) on your baking stone, being careful to place them BOTTOM SIDE UP for 90 seconds to 2 minutes. The rounds should start to bubble on top and will "poof" up with the pocket. Once the pocket is formed, remove them from the oven and place onto clean surface to cool. The bottoms will be just starting to brown as you remove them from the oven.
10. Once completely cooled, they can be stored in a freezer bag and frozen until ready to use - they will thaw quickly on the counter.
title: Quick And Easy Syrian-Lebanese-Pocket-Pita Bread!

steps: 1. To make the starter, combine 1/2 tsp yeast with milk and 1/4 cup warm water in a small bowl. Whisk until yeast has dissolved then stir in 1 cup flour. Cover and let stand in a warm place for at least 6 hours or overnight.
2. Combine remaining yeast with sugar and 1 2/3 cups warm water in a small bowl. Whisk until yeast has dissolved. Cover and let stand in a warm place for 10 mins, or until slightly foamy.
3. Turn starter out onto a floured work surface and knead for 2 mins, or until smooth. Cut into 3/4 inch chunks.

4. Sift salt and remaining flour into a large bowl. Add foamy yeast mixture, starter pieces and oil and mix until combined. Turn out onto a floured work surface and knead for 2 mins, or until almost smooth. Place in a greased bowl, cover and let proof in a warm place for 40 mins, or until doubled in size.
5. Turn dough out onto a floured work surface and knead until smooth. Cut dough into 2 portions. Knead each portion for 5 mins, or until smooth and elastic.
6. Place each portion into a separate greased bowl, cover and let proof in a warm place for 40 mins, or until almost doubled in size.

7. Preheat oven to 450°F. Roll each piece of dough into an oval about 14 inches long. Make indents evenly over dough with your fingers. Dust with a little flour then sprinkle with sesame seeds. Cover with greased plastic wrap to prevent drying out while baking trays are being heated.
8. Place 2 lightly greased baking trays in oven for 3 mins. Quickly remove plastic wrap from dough and place dough on hot trays. Bake for 12 mins, or until browned.
title: Turkish Bread

ingredients.text: 2 cups raw pumpkin seeds, soaked in distilled water for 1-2 hours (pepita)
1/2 cup tomatoes, seeded and chopped (1/8-inch pieces)

steps: 1. Grind pepita, jalapeno, oil, lime juice, and seasonings in food processor.
2. Add water as needed, about 1/2 cup.
3. When it's smooth, remove from processor.
4. Fold in cilantro, scallions and tomato.
5. Enjoy with crackers, as a dip, spread, or a tasty filling.
title: Kauai Pepita Pate

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).
2. In a large bowl, blend together the butter or margarine and the sugar. Separate 3 of the eggs; add the yolks and the 2 remaining whole eggs to the butter mixture. Stir in the vanilla and water.
3. In another bowl, sift together the baking powder and flour. Add these dry ingredients to the creamed mixture.
4. Whip 3 egg whites until they are foamy. Add 1 tablespoon sugar. Continue to whip the whites until they are stiff, but not dry. Fold whipped whites into batter.

5. Pour the batter into a greased 10 x 4 inch tube pan. Wrap a large coin in foil, and place the coin in the batter. Press the coin down; it should be completely hidden. Sprinkle the nuts and seeds on top of the batter.
6. Bake the cake for about 70 minutes, or until done. Cool on a wire rack.
title: Vasilopita

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 355 degrees F (180 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with waxed paper.

2. Mix flour, sugar, and baking powder together in a large bowl; add butter and tahini and mix until dough is crumbly. Roll dough into small balls and press each ball into a flattened cookie shape using your palms. Arrange cookies in the prepared baking sheet and press with a fork.

3. Place the baking sheet on the middle rack of the oven and bake until cookies are golden, about 10 minutes. Cool cookies on baking sheet for 2 to 3 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
title: Fast And Easy Israeli Tahini Cookies

ingredients.text: 8 tart apples, peeled cored and sliced in 8-10 wedges

steps: 1. Begin by removing the yellow part of the lemon peel from the lemons and cutting it into small strips.
2. Juice the lemons and reserve 1/2 cup for later use.
3. Peel and core apples, cutting into 8 - 10 wedges depending on the size of your apples.
4. Place sugar, water, and cinnamon in a large saucepan and bring to a low boil.

5. Once the mixture boils, add the apples, lemon rind, lemon juice and orange blossom water to the pot. (I find orange blossom water to be quite potent and would start with the lower amount and add more to suit personal taste.)
6. Cook until the mixture is dry and the apples and lemon rind are tender.
7. Remove from heat and allow the dessert to cool.
8. Serve at room temperature.
title: Tfah - A Moroccan Apple Dessert

steps: 1. Using a pair of sharp kitchen scissors, cut each wing at the knuckle into two pieces. Mix the garlic, lemon zest and juice, cumin and oil with plenty of seasoning, then tip into a dish with the chicken wings and toss to coat. Cover and put in the fridge to marinate for at least 1 hr, or overnight if you have time.

2. Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6, or heat an outdoor barbecue. Bake the chicken wings on an oven tray for 45-50 mins until crisp, or barbecue for 20 mins, drizzling over the honey for the final 10 mins of each method. Serve on a platter with plenty of paper napkins. Fill small bowls with olives, pistachios or almonds, dates and pickled chillies and flatbreads to serve alongside, along with the dishes below.
title: Chicken wings with cumin, lemon & garlic

steps: 1. Preheat your oven's broiler. Place red bell peppers and tomatoes on a baking sheet, and roast under the broiler for about 8 minutes, turning occasionally. This should blacken the skin and help it peel off more easily. Cool, then scrape the skins off of the tomatoes and peppers, and place them in a large bowl. Remove cores and seeds from the bell peppers.

2. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the jalapenos and garlic, and cook until tender, stirring frequently. Remove from heat, and transfer the garlic and jalapeno to the bowl with the tomatoes and red peppers. Using two sharp steak knives (one in each hand), cut up the tomatoes and peppers to a coarse and soupy consistency. Stir, and set sauce aside.

3. Place the semolina in a large bowl, and stir in salt and 4 tablespoons of olive oil. Gradually add water while mixing and squeezing with your hand until the dough holds together without being sticky or dry, and molds easily with the hand. Divide into 6 pieces and form into balls.

4. For each round, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large heavy skillet over medium heat. Roll out dough one round at a time, to no thicker than 1/4 inch. Fry in the hot skillet until dark brown spots appear on the surface, and they are crispy. Remove from the skillet, and wrap in a clean towel while preparing the remaining flat breads.
5. To eat the bread and sauce, break off pieces of the bread, and scoop them into the sauce. It will slide off, but just keep reaching in!
title: Algerian Bouzgene Berber Bread with Roasted Pepper Sauce

steps: 1. Heat 2 tsp oil in a pan and soften the onions for 5 mins. Add the garlic and spices and cook for a few mins more. Spoon half the onion mixture into a bowl and set aside to cool. Add the tomatoes, sugar and seasoning to the remaining onions in the pan and simmer for about 10 mins until reduced.
2. Meanwhile, add the mint, lamb, apricots and breadcrumbs to the cooled onions, season and mix well with your hands. Shape into little meatballs.

3. Heat the rest of the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the meatballs until golden (in batches if you need to). Stir in the sauce with a splash of water and gently cook everything for a few mins until the meatballs are cooked through. Serve with pitta bread and salad.
title: Lamb & apricot meatballs

steps: 1. For the marinade, toast cinnamon, pepper, coriander, cumin, cloves and cardamom in skillet over medium-high heat until very fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes; cool.
2. Transfer to small bowl. Stir in paprika, garlic, sugar, salt, pepper flakes, oil, juice.
3. Cut wing tips off chicken; halve wings at joint. Combine wings with marinade in plastic bag. Chill in refrigerator 45 minutes.
4. Heat oven to 450 degrees F.
5. Spread wings in large rimmed baking sheet.
6. Bake in oven 25 minutes, turning occasionally. Increase heat to broil. Cook wings under broiler 10 minutes or until skin is crisp. Enjoy!
7. Note: If you have mortar and pestle, substitute seeds for ground, and grind together. Use 1/2 teaspoon coriander seeds, 1/4 teaspoon cumin seeds, 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seeds.
8. Makes 8 servings.
title: Moroccan Chicken Wings

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup finely chopped flat leaf parsley

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except salt and pepper in a bowl and toss to mix.
2. Add salt and pepper and toss again.
3. Best served within 2 hours of being made.
title: Moroccan Shallot Relish

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. tahini (canned ground hulled sesame seed)

steps: 1. In an electric blender, whirl together the tahini, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic salt and pepper until smooth.
2. With blender running, tip center cap in the cover and gradually add the chickpeas, blending until smooth and a pale color.
3. Stop blender as necessary and, with a rubber spatula, push the mixture towards the blades, to make sure all the chickpeas are crushed.
4. Chill, tightly covered.
5. Serve as a spread with crackers or small wedges of hot pita.
6. Makes a generous 2 cups.
title: Hummus(Middle Eastern Spread)

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley, or to taste

steps: 1. Combine chickpeas, tahini, water, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, and salt in food processor or blender; puree until smooth. Transfer hummus to a flat dish. Sprinkle parsley over the hummus to serve.
title: Tao Hummus

steps: 1. Combine all components together in a a large salad bowl.
2. add the young and washed salad leaves and toss carefully 20x.
title: Lebanese Salad Dressing

steps: 1. Heat all together over medium heat and bring to a boil, 8 to 10 minutes. Cool 5 minutes. Stir in lamb and marinate 15 minutes or longer. Grill 10 to 15 minutes until done. Pour remaining marinade over lamb before serving.
title: Lamb Shish Kebab Marinade

steps: 1. Stir all ingredients together, until combined. Cook uncovered over medium heat for two minutes.
title: Moroccan Spice Glaze

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together.
2. Add meat (chicken, pork, beef or venison) and vegetables (cut into bite size pieces) (I use green pepper, onion, mushrooms and cherry tomatoes).
3. Marintate in refrigerator for at least a couple hours.
4. Thread onto skewers and grill.
title: Shish Kabob Marinade

steps: 1. Boil up the water and sugar in the pot until it becomes a syrup
2. Add the ground almonds and boil again, then cook for 5 more minutes.
3. and remove from heat.
4. Let the mixture sit for 21/2 hours.
5. Put the mixture in the cheesecloth and squeeze the fluids into a big.
6. bowl.
7. Filter the mixture with new cheesecloth into another big bowl, and try to.
8. squeeze and filter the remaining mixture as much as you can.
9. Move the mixture into a jar and refrigerate for 3 hours before using.
title: Tunisian Almond Syrup

ingredients.text: 1 lemon, juice and zest of, finely grated

steps: 1. The crust- Place the sesame seeds and spices in a pestle and mortar or spice grinder and lightly crush.
2. Mix with the oil, lemon zest and juice and season to taste.

3. Rub the mixture all over the food, cover and marinate for 4 hours or overnight in the fridge for meats and poultry. Fish needs only 30 minutes. Allow the food to return to room temperature for 20 minutes before cooking.
4. To cook- If barbecuing, turn frequently and baste with any excess marinade. To roast a whole chicken, rub all over and roast at 400F for 1-11/2 hours.
title: Za'Atar Crust

steps: 1. Rinse and cut pork into 1 1/2-inch cubes. Cut pepper into chunks, wipe mushrooms clean and mince garlic. In a deep dish, combine oil, garlic, oregano, wine and teriyaki sauce; add pork and vegetables; toss to coat. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Alternately thread pork, mushrooms and pepper onto skewer(s). Discard marinade. Grill or broil; turn every 5 minutes until well done, about 15 minutes. Serve.
title: Pork Kabobs

ingredients.text: salt, pepper, cinnamon and red pepper

steps: 1. Core tomatoes; reserve what is inside.
2. Fry onions, garlic and pine nuts with 1 tablespoon vegetable oil.
3. Add over the meat and seasoning.
4. Stir over medium heat until brown.
5. Fill tomatoes with meat mixture; arrange in the bottom of a pan.
6. Add the reserved tomato juice mixed with 2 tablespoons vegetable oil.
7. Bake in 325° oven for 15 minutes, until tomatoes are done.
8. Fry green peppers with 2 teaspoons vegetable oil until tender.
9. Add over 2 1/2 cups water with pinch of salt.
10. Let water boil before adding rice. Cover pan and cook at a very low heat for 1/2 hour, until rice is done.
11. Add mixed vegetables to rice; stir gently.
12. Cover pan and let it cook for 15 minutes longer.
13. Serve mixed rice with Mahshy Bandora.
title: Mahshy Bandora (Stuffed Tomatoes)(Lebanese)

steps: 1. Cook the couscous in vegetable broth according to pack instructions. Trim the ends off the zucchini, then cut into slices.

2. Heat a griddle pan or broiler. Drizzle the zucchini slices with oil, then season. Cook for 2 mins, then turn over and cook 1-2 mins more until softened and golden brown. Tip into a large bowl along with the cooked couscous, then mix through the remaining ingredients. Serve at room temperature.
title: Tangy Couscous Salad

steps: 1. In a saucepan, saute onion in oil for 1 minute. Stir in the mushrooms, carrot, garlic and ginger. Cook and stir until vegetables are almost tender. Stir in the broth, soy sauce and lemon juice. Bring to a boil. Stir in couscous. Remove from the heat; cover and let stand for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
title: Quick Vegetable Couscous

steps: 1. Rinse and drain chickpeas.

2. Mix chickpeas, olive oil, apple cider vinegar, and salt in a shallow baking dish (shallow so that the liquid can soak more of the chickpeas). Set in refrigerator to marinate for 4 hours or overnight. (If not marinating, mix in a bowl.).
3. After marinating, stir chickpeas with all other ingredients (except for feta) in a bowl.
4. Just before serving, sprinkle crumbled feta over the salad.
title: Turkish Chickpea Salad (Nohut Salatasi)

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 cups water (or broth, or water or white wine mix)

steps: 1. Cook chicken, mushrooms, onion, garlic, sage in oil over medium heat.
2. Add tomatoes to chicken mix.
3. set aside.
4. Boil water, add butter, and remove from heat.
5. Add couscous.
6. Add couscous to chicken mix and mix well or serve chicken mix over a bed of couscous.
title: Chicken Couscous With Sun-Dried Tomatoes

ingredients.text: 1/3 cup finely chopped sweet red pepper

steps: 1. Combine bulgur and boiling water in a large bowl; cover and let stand 30 minutes or until water is absorbed.
2. Add zucchini and next 3 ingredients to bulgur; toss well.
3. Combine lemon juice and oil; stir well with a wire whisk. Add to zucchini mixture, tossing well. Serve at room temperature or chilled.
title: Zucchini Tabbouleh

steps: 1. In a large frying pan with a lid, heat 1 tablespoon of the oil over moderately low heat. Add the garlic, couscous, cumin, cayenne, and 1/2 teaspoon of the salt to the pan.
2. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the couscous starts to brown, about 3 minutes.
3. Stir in tomato juice and water. Bring to a simmer.
4. Cover, remove from the heat and let stand for 5 minutes.
5. Transfer the couscous to a platter or large glass bowl to cool.
6. Meanwhile, heat the broiler. Coat the sausages with 1/2 tablespoon of the oil.
7. Broil the sausages, turning occasionally, until completely cooked through, about 10 minutes.
8. Remove from the heat. When the sausages are cool enough to handle, cut them into thin slices.
9. Toss the cooled couscous with the lemon juice and the remaining oil, salt and tomato. Top with the sausages and cilantro.
title: Tunisian Couscous Salad With Grilled Sausages

ingredients.text: 1 medium cucumber, peeled, seeded and sliced
1/2 cup fresh basil leaves, thinly sliced

steps: 1. Cut tomatoes and mushrooms in half; place in a large bowl. Cut onions and peppers into 1/2-in.-thick slices; add to bowl. Drizzle with 4 tablespoons oil and sprinkle with garlic salt; toss to coat.
2. Place bread cubes in another large bowl. Drizzle with remaining oil. Sprinkle with thyme, oregano, salt and pepper; toss to coat. Thread on metal or soaked wooden skewers.

3. Transfer vegetables to a grill wok or basket. Grill, uncovered, over medium heat for 8-12 minutes or until tender, stirring frequently. Grill bread cubes, covered, over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes or until toasted, turning occasionally.
4. Coarsely chop the tomatoes, onions and peppers; place in a large bowl. Add the mushrooms, bread cubes, cucumber and basil; drizzle with vinegar and gently toss to coat.
title: Grilled Lebanese Salad

steps: 1. Pre-heat the oven to 350.

2. Boil the cabbage in a large pot for about 5 minutes. Drain and put the pieces in a lightly greased baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the cabbage. Bake for about 20 minutes and serve.
title: Moroccan Baked Cabbage And Tomatoes

steps: 1. Place chicken in shallow baking dish.
2. Combine remaining ingredients; pour over chicken and let marinate in fridge for a minimum of 2 hours.(preferably longer or overnight)
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees; bake for approximately 40 minutes or until done. Serve with rice.
title: Syrian Chicken With Rice

steps: 1. Cut the cabbage in half. Cut away the hard core and slice the cabbage crosswise into 1/2-inch strips, then crosswise into 3/4-inch pieces. There should be 4 cups; if there is extra, set it aside to add to soup or another salad. Place the cabbage in a mixing bowl.
2. Add the tomatoes, parsley and scallions, and toss with a fork to combine.
3. In a small bowl, whisk the lemon juice, garlic and salt until the salt dissolves. Mix in the oil.
4. Season the dressing to taste with pepper. Pour the dressing over the salad, toss for 1 minute to coat it well, then let sit 10 minutes for flavors to meld. Serve immediately.
title: Lebanese Cabbage Salad

steps: 1. Cook pasta according to package instructions in a large pot of boiling water and salt. Add heavy cream and butter to a large skillet over medium heat until the cream bubbles and the butter melts. Whisk in parmesan and add seasoning (salt and black pepper). Let the sauce thicken slightly and then add the pasta and toss until coated in sauce. Garnish with parsley, and it's ready.
title: Fettuccine Alfredo

steps: 1. Heat oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat.
2. Cook mushrooms, onion and bacon in oil over medium heat, 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender.
3. Stir in rice; cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
4. Stir in water, soy sauce and bouillon.
5. Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally.
6. Reduce heat.
7. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.
8. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and let stand 5 minutes before serving.
9. Makes 6 servings.
title: Fruity Chicken Risotto

steps: 1. Dip chicken in melted butter.
2. Then dip in mixture of sour cream and the beaten egg.
3. Then dip in mixture of Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs (add salt and pepper, if desired).
4. Place in buttered oblong baking dish.
5. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown and tender.
6. Serves 4.
title: Parmesan Chicken #1

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Combine tomato sauce, basil, oregano and garlic.
3. Spray an 8 x 5-inch baking dish.
4. Arrange vegetables in layers in baking dish as follows:
5. zucchini, onion, tomato, tomato sauce, 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese.
6. Repeat twice more. Bake 30 to 35 minutes, covered.
7. Let cool a few minutes before serving.
8. Serves 2 as main dish or 4 as side dish.
title: Italian Vegetable Bake

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Cut onions in half, crosswise. Trim ends so they stand flat.
3. Scoop out centers and reserve. Pour 1 tbsp. olive oil into baking dish.
4. Add onions, turn to coat.
5. Arrange cut sides up, drizzle with vinegar.
6. Cover and bake 45 minutes or until tender.
7. Mince reserved onion, mix with remaining ingredients.
8. Mound in the centers and bake uncovered 20 minutes or until golden.
9. Serves 4.
title: Italian Baked Onions

steps: 1. Saute onion in margarine until tender. Add remaining ingredients except chicken and wine.
2. Simmer, uncovered, 30 minutes. Stir in chicken and wine. Simmer, covered, 30 minutes. Serve on hot cooked spaghetti.
3. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Easy Chicken Cacciatore

ingredients.text: 3 large chicken breasts, split, boned and skinned

steps: 1. In large skillet, heat butter.
2. Brown garlic until golden and discard.
3. Saute chicken breasts in flavored butter until well browned on all sides.
4. Add mushrooms and Marsala.
5. Cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender.
6. Remove chicken breasts to warm platter.
7. Over high heat, heat sauce in skillet to boiling, scraping up any brown bits from the bottom of the pan. Cook until sauce thickens slightly.
8. Stir in parsley and pour over.
9. Makes 6 servings.
title: Chicken Marsala

steps: 1. Mix ingredients and spoon over chicken.
2. Bake for 45 minutes at 375°.
3. Serves 4 to 6.
4. My gang loves this!
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Crush garlic and saute for 10 minutes in oil.
2. Strain garlic remnants from the oil after 10 minutes and add some (your call) oregano, basil and parsley to oil.
3. Add flavored oil to the well-drained spaghetti and toss well.
4. Top with grated Parmesan cheese.
5. Serves 4.
title: Spaghetti Aglia D'Olio

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. shredded part skim Mozzarella cheese

steps: 1. Stir together bread crumbs, milk, onion, parsley, Parmesan cheese, garlic and pepper.
2. Add meat; mix well.
3. Shape into 4 patties 3/4-inch thick.
4. Place patties on unheated rack of a broiler pan (or grill).
5. Cook 6 minutes; turn for 6 to 8 more minutes until done.
6. Top each burger with a slice of tomato; sprinkle with oregano and Mozzarella.
7. Broil 1 to 2 minutes more. Makes 4 servings at 202 calories each.
title: Italian-Style Burgers

ingredients.text: 3 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned

steps: 1. Cut chicken into bite size pieces.
2. Mix flour, salt, paprika and white pepper in bag.
3. Shake pieces of chicken in bag to coat. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat.
4. Brown chicken in oil. When chicken is almost browned, add onion and cook 5 minutes longer.
5. Add tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar and garlic.
6. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until tender, about 30 minutes.
7. Add a little water if it becomes dry.
8. Serve hot with cooked spaghetti. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Cacciatore

ingredients.text: 1 lb. chopped or ground turkey breast
1 1/2 lb. spaghetti, cooked (without salt or fat)

steps: 1. Heat margarine in large skillet on medium heat. Add chopped or ground turkey breast. Cook about 5 minutes. Add garlic, onion and bell pepper. Cook 5 minutes. Add salt, pepper and tomatoes. Cook slowly on low heat about 20 minutes. Serve over spaghetti. Makes 6 servings.
title: Turkey Spaghetti

steps: 1. Heat oven to 375°.
2. In saucepan, heat spaghetti sauce and water.
3. Combine Ricotta, Mozzarella and Parmesan.
4. Pour 3/4 cup sauce in baking dish; arrange 3 lasagne noodles on sauce (pasta will expand while cooking).
5. Pour 1/2 cup sauce over pasta; spread with half cheese mixture.
6. Cover with 1/2 cup sauce.
7. Repeat layers.
8. Top with pasta and remaining sauce.
9. Sprinkle with additional Parmesan.
10. Cover with foil and bake 60 minutes.
11. Let stand 10 minutes.
12. Makes 8 servings.
title: Easy Lasagne

steps: 1. Combine bread crumbs, cheese, garlic salt and pepper.
2. Dip each piece of chicken in butter, then roll in dry mixture.
3. Place in greased baking pan.
4. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
5. Serves 4.
title: Parmesan Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. dry breadcrumbs (Pepperidge Farm or Progresso Italian)

steps: 1. Combine breadcrumbs, cheese, parsley and paprika in a plate. Press each chicken breast in crumb mixture on both sides. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Put breasts in. Sprinkle chicken with remaining crumbs. Dot butter over tops of chicken. Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes. Pour wine over chicken and bake 15 minutes covered and 15 minutes uncovered.
2. Serve with spaghetti and sauce and good salad. Yum! Serves 4 to 6. Can freeze. Can do ahead.
title: Cheesy Chicken Marsala

steps: 1. Brown beef and onion in skillet over medium heat.
2. Drain. Stir oregano and salt into beef.
3. Lightly brush tortillas with oil.
4. Bake on two large baking sheets at 400° for 3 minutes. Spoon beef mixture evenly over tortillas. Top with equal amounts of tomato.
5. Sprinkle with basil and cheeses.
6. Return to oven and bake 12 to 14 minutes or until tortillas are lightly browned. Serves 4.
title: Tortilla Pizzas

ingredients.text: 1/2 pint Whipping Cream (do not use ultra-apasturized cream)

steps: 1. Reduce cream at medium boil for 7 minutes. Mix cream, butter, garlic, and cheeses on low heat until cheese is melted. Boil Fettuccini for 5 mnutes at high boil (do not overcook). Sprnkle a pinch of minced basil on each serving to garnish and season. Serves 2 as an entree, four as a side dish. Note: oregano and rosemary are an interesting alternative to the traditional basil.
title: Fettuccine Alfredo

steps: 1. Place butter in saute pan.
2. Melt and add carrots, mushrooms, peppers, scallions and broccoli.
3. Saute about 3 to 5 minutes.
4. Once cooked, add heavy cream.
5. Bring mixture to a low boil.
6. Add fettuccine and stir.
7. Add garlic and some of the Parmesan cheese. Stir until Parmesan cheese disappears and then add more cheese. Sauce should be thick, then add seasonings.
8. Serve immediately. Serves 2 to 4.
title: Pasta Primavera

steps: 1. Cook ground sausage or diced ham (cook's choice).
2. Mix with egg mixture.
3. Pour in pie pan and bake at 350° about 30 minutes or until golden brown.
4. Serves 4 to 5.
title: Italian Kish

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. In small bowl, combine cheeses, mixing well.
3. Using a sharp knife, cut halfway around edge of pita.
4. Open to form pocket.
5. Spread cheese mixture inside pita.
6. Wrap in foil and bake about 15 to 20 minutes until cheese melts.
7. Makes 1 serving.
title: Quick Cheese Calzone(Low Calorie)

steps: 1. Combine oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, oregano and sugar.
2. Pour over tomatoes and peppers.
3. Let set to marinate 1/2 hour to 3 hours.
4. Serve chilled.
5. Yields 3 to 4 servings.
6. Can be served over spaghetti noodles.
title: Italian Tomatoes

steps: 1. In 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan, spread 1 cup sauce and 1 layer uncooked lasagne.
2. Top with some sauce, Ricotta, Mozzarella and Parmesan. Repeat.
3. End with sauce, Mozzarella and Parmesan.
4. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes or until light brown and bubbling.
5. Allow to stand for 15 minutes before cutting.
6. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Unbelievable Lasagne

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients, except chicken.
2. Place chicken in baking dish.
3. Spoon mixture over chicken and bake for 45 minutes at 375°. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Cook macaroni according to package directions.
2. Drain and place in bowl.
3. Add remaining ingredients and toss gently.
4. Turn into a 2 1/2-quart casserole greased with 1 teaspoon butter.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
6. Serves 4.
title: Italian Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. Cook macaroni; brown ground beef and combine both with spaghetti sauce.
2. Put 1/2 into large baking dish.
3. Cover with 1/2 pint cottage cheese.
4. Cover with 1 cup Mozzarella cheese.
5. Repeat and bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.
6. Yield:
7. 6 servings.
title: Quick Lasagna

ingredients.text: 8 ounces mozzarella cheese, shredded (or an Italian cheese blend)
1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated and divided in half
14 ounces pizza sauce (or lower carb spaghetti sauce)

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees.Beat together cream cheese and eggs until smooth. Add cream, first 1/4 cup of Parmesan cheese, and spices; mix again.

2. In a 9 x 13 inch baking pan [sprayed with oil (Pam)] sprinkle 8 oz. Mozzarella cheese. Pour egg/cream cheese mixture over the top of the Mozzarella. Bake at 375 for 40 minutes (until it is golden brown). This will look like focaccia and is the crust for the pizza. Remove from the oven and let it stand for 5 minutes.

3. Spread on pizza sauce; sprinkle on 1 cup Mozzarella cheese and pile high with your chosen toppings! Then sprinkle on 2nd 1/4 cup Parmesan. Return to oven and bake until bubbly and browned (about 15 minutes). Allow to stand 10-15 minutes before cutting. Serves 8.
title: Low Carb Deep Dish Pizza

steps: 1. Mix spaghetti and sauce together.
2. Spread cooked spaghetti noodles and sauce in 13 x 9 x 2-inch casserole dish.
3. Cover with cheese.
4. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
5. Makes 5 to 6 servings.
title: Spaghetti Casserole

steps: 1. Cook the zucchini in boiling, salted water until tender. Drain.
2. In saucepan, saute the onion and celery in butter until soft.
3. Combine all the ingredients and mix well.
4. Salt and pepper to taste.
5. Transfer to a lightly buttered casserole and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
6. Serves 8.
title: Italian Zucchini

steps: 1. In a greased 2 1/2-quart casserole, layer 1/3 of the zucchini, onion and tomatoes.
2. Squeeze 1 lemon quarter over all.
3. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning and 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes.
4. Repeat layers.
5. Dot with butter.
6. Squeeze remaining lemon over all.
7. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.
8. Serve immediately.
9. Yields 4 servings.
title: Italian Zucchini

steps: 1. Combine first five ingredients; set aside.
2. Dip chicken in salad dressing and dredge in bread crumb mixture.
3. Place chicken in baking dish, coated with vegetable cooking spray.
4. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until tender.
5. Serves 6.
title: Baked Parmesan Chicken Breasts

steps: 1. In 13 x 9-inch pan, spread 1 cup of sauce.
2. Arrange a layer of lasagne.

3. Top with sauce, Ricotta, Mozzarella, Parmesan and sauce. Repeat, gently pressing lasagne pieces into cheese mixture below. End with a final layer of lasagne; pour remaining sauce on top, making sure all of pieces are covered.
4. Top with remaining Mozzarella and Parmesan.
5. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbling.
6. Allow to stand 15 minutes. Cut into squares.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Unbelievable Lasagne

steps: 1. Boil potatoes with jackets on until fork-tender.
2. Drain.
3. Peel and rice them (mash them if you don't have a ricer).
4. Gradually add the remaining ingredients and knead until smooth and manageable.
5. Roll dough into long rope-like strips about 3/4-inch pieces.
6. Dip your fingers in flour and dent each piece.
7. Boil 8 quarts water rapidly adding 2 tablespoons salt.
8. Boil 10 minutes and drain.
9. Add favorite sauce.
10. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Italian Gnocchi

steps: 1. Cook ziti according to package directions; drain. Meanwhile, combine sauce and pepper flakes in a medium sized saucepan; heat through. Combine ziti, sauce mixture, Ricotta and Mozzarella in a large serving bowl. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Makes 6 servings. Preparation time: 3 minutes. Cook time: 10 to 12 minutes.
title: "Bakeless" Ziti

ingredients.text: 4 oz. lasagna noodles, cooked and drained

steps: 1. In a large skillet brown meat and remove from skillet with slotted spoon.
2. Pour off fat, reserving 1 teaspoon in skillet. Add onion and garlic, saute 3 to 4 minutes, stirring frequently until softened.
3. Add tomato sauce and paste, along with salt, pepper and oregano.
4. Mix in the hamburger and simmer mixture for 15 minutes.
5. Heat oven to 350°.
6. Place 3 noodles in a 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish.
7. Top with about a third of each of the following:
8. sauce, Mozzarella and cottage cheese.
9. Spread again with sauce, Mozzarella and cottage cheese.
10. Top this with 3 noodles and complete with remaining third of the sauce and cheeses.
11. Bake for 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.
12. Serves 8.
title: Lasagna

ingredients.text: 4 -6 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut in half lenthwise

steps: 1. Saute mushrooms in butter in a large skillet until tender.
2. Remove from heat and set aside.
3. Transfer mushrooms to bowl so that you can use same skillet to saute chicken.
4. Flatten chicken to 1/8 inch thickness.
5. Dredge chicken lightly in flour.
6. Saute chicken (saute a few at a time) in skillet using 2-3 tablespoons butter.
7. Saute 3-4 minutes on each side.
8. Repeat with remaining chicken and butter.
9. Place chicken in 13x9 inch pan, overlapping edges if need be.
10. Sprinkle mushrooms over chicken.
11. Reserve pan drippings in skillet.
12. Add wine and chicken broth.
13. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer uncovered 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
14. Sauce will reduce by half.
15. Stir in salt and pepper.
16. Pour sauce evenly over chicken.
17. Combine cheese and green onions; sprinkle over chicken, Bake uncovered at 375 for 20 minutes.
18. Broil 1 to 2 minutes or until lightly browned.
19. Serves 4-6.
title: Fancy Chicken Marsala

ingredients.text: 1/3 to 1/2 c. light virgin olive oil
1 medium zucchini, cut into 2-inch thin strips
1 medium red pepper, cut into thin strips
1 1/2 lb. medium shrimp, peeled and cleaned

steps: 1. Heat oil in skillet.
2. Cook and stir garlic and lemon peel 30 seconds.
3. Add vegetables and shrimp and cook about 4 minutes over medium heat or until shrimp turn pink.
4. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, lemon juice, basil and parsley; stir well.
5. Spoon over hot, cooked spaghetti and toss.
6. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese, if desired.
7. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Scampi Primavera

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and simmer 45 minutes.
2. Remove bay leaf before serving.
3. Makes 4 servings.
title: Lo-Cal Chicken Cacciatore

steps: 1. Place 1 tablespoon oil in a heavy saucepan.
2. Add 1 medium chopped onion, the ground beef and 1 teaspoon salt.
3. Brown the meat well; set aside.
4. Cook together the tomato juice and seasonings.
5. Simmer 15 minutes.
6. Add the cooked meat; pour over drained spaghetti.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Spaghetti

ingredients.text: 2 cups of warm water (100 to 110° F)
4 1/2 teaspoons (2 packets) of rapid rise yeast
4 tablespoons of extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for greasing bowl
6 cups of all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 200° F. Once the oven has preheated, immediately turn the oven off.

2. Combine water, yeast and sugar in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a hook attachment. Gently stir to dissolve the yeast. Let the yeast bloom for 5 to 10 minutes (once the top of the mixture begins to get foamy from one side of the bowl to the other, I know it's done). On the lowest speed, turn on the mixer and add olive oil and salt. Slowly add in the flour (I usually add half the flour, let it incorporate slightly, then pour in the other half.)

3. Increase to medium speed and mix the dough until it begins to form a ball and wrap itself around the hook, this step should take about 2 minutes. Allow the mixer to knead the dough for another 5 to 8 minutes. Make sure the dough is smooth and elastic.

4. Form the dough into a ball and place into a large bowl coated with olive oil. Flip the dough in the oil a few times to make sure the dough is evenly coated. Cover the dough with a tea towel to discourage a skin forming on the dough. Let the dough rise for 1 hour in the warm oven.

5. Once the dough has risen and doubled in size, punch down and cut into 8 equal-sized pieces (or cut the dough in half for 2 large pizzas, which serves 6 to 8 people total.) Use the dough immediately or freeze up to 3 months.

6. To Freeze: Whenever the dough has finished rising, cut the dough into 8 equal pieces (each piece is 1 serving), wrap each piece in cling wrap and stack the covered pieces of dough into a labeled gallon-sized freezer bag. The dough will stay good for 3 months. When ready to use just take out however many individual balls of dough that you may need and let them come to room temperature for 2 to 3 hours on the counter.
title: Homemade Pizza Dough

steps: 1. Wash zucchini, slice thin.
2. Heat oil in 10-inch skillet.
3. Add onion; saute until golden.
4. Add zucchini, sprinkle with salt. Toss.
5. Cover.
6. Braise about 5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
7. Yield: 4 servings.
title: Zucchini Italiano

ingredients.text: 4 boneless chicken breasts, halved and skinned

steps: 1. Beat egg with 1 tablespoon lemon juice.
2. Combine flour, garlic powder and paprika.
3. Dip chicken into egg mixture, then into flour mixture.
4. In a skillet, brown chicken in butter or margarine. Dissolve bouillon cubes in water.
5. Add bouillon broth and the 2 remaining tablespoons of lemon juice to skillet.
6. Cover skillet and simmer 30 minutes or until chicken is tender.
7. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Piccata

steps: 1. Remove stems from spinach; wash leaves thoroughly.
2. Cook spinach covered in large Dutch oven over medium heat 4 minutes or until tender (do not add water).
3. Drain well; finely chop leaves and set aside.
4. Cook linguine; drain.
5. Combine linguine and olive oil in large bowl; toss gently.
6. Add spinach, cheese and pepper; toss gently.
7. Sprinkle with walnuts.
8. Yields 9 servings.
title: Linguine Florentine

steps: 1. In a large saucepan over medium-high heat, saute zucchini and shallot in oil until almost tender. Add garlic; cook 1 minute longer. Add the orzo, broth and milk. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low; cook and stir for 10-15 minutes or until liquid is almost absorbed.

steps: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together the bread flour, salt, and yeast.

Slowly add the water and mix with a wooden spoon just to combine. Once the mixture is moistened, lightly flour a countertop or large cutting board and remove the dough from the bowl with lightly oiled or wet hands (to discourage sticking). Knead for 2 to 3 minutes to remove clumps. The dough won't become elastic but should easily form a loose ball.
3. Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl and cover with a damp, clean kitchen towel or plastic wrap to prevent it from drying out.
4. . Place the bowl on the counter and let sit 24 hours at room temperature. It will double in size and you may see bubbles forming on the surface.
5. Lightly flour a large cutting board or your kitchen countertop and place the dough on it. Wet or lightly oil your hands again.
6. Divide dough into 4 equal portions for 10-inch pies or 3 portions if you're making slightly larger pies.
7. Place the dough balls into oiled, cylindrical airtight containers (deli-takeaway containers are ideal), date them, and place in the fridge for 48 to 96 hours.
8. Remove from refrigerator at least 1 hour before use to allow the dough to come to room temperature; this lets the gluten relax and makes the dough malleable.
title: Seventy-Two Hour Pizza Dough

steps: 1. Combine the first 6 ingredients in a large mixing bowl and blend well. Gradually add flour. Mix well. Roll dough into 1-inch balls.
