ingredients.text: 1/4 teaspoon salt (or Lawry's Seasoned Salt if you have it!)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350.
2. Cook the bacon in a medium frying pan. If you use turkey bacon I recommend spraying the pan with cooking spray.
3. After you have removed the bacon from the pan, use the same pan to saute the onion and garlic over medium heat until softened.
4. While the onion and garlic cook, chop up the bacon.
5. In a large bowl beat the eggs and milk until just blended.
6. Add to that mixture the Bisquick, onion, garlic, salt and pepper. Mix by wire wisk for about 1 minute (some small Bisquick lumps are fine).
7. Spray pie plate or muffin tins with cooking spray.
8. Pour Bisquick mixture evenly into the pie plate or muffin tins.
9. Sprinkle bacon and cheese on top of egg mixture; gently press below surface with fork.

10. Bake the quiche until the top is golden-brown and a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. If you have a thermometer the internal temperature of the quiche should be between 165 - 185 degrees Fahrenheit. Let stand at least 10 minutes before cutting.
11. Baking time: Pie plate - 40-50 minutes or Muffin tin - 20-25 minutes.
12. Makes 8 servings: 1 slice of quiche or 2.5 muffin size quiches.
title: Low Fat Bisquick Crust Bacon And Cheese Quiche

ingredients.text: 12 slices bacon (about 1/2 lb.), crispy fried and crumbled

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Lightly grease 9-inch or 10-inch pie plate.
3. Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion evenly over bottom of pie plate.
4. Place remaining ingredients in blender.
5. Cover and blend on high speed for 1 minute.
6. Pour into pie plate.
7. Bake until golden brown and knife comes out clean, 50 to 55 minutes.
8. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
9. Refrigerate any leftovers. Yield:
10. 6 servings.
title: Impossible Quiche

steps: 1. Saute bacon in skillet until partially cooked.
2. Add onion and cook until onion is tender but not browned.
3. Pour off most of the fat.
4. In a separate bowl, combine eggs, salt, pepper and nutmeg; beat well.
5. Add milk and blend well.
6. Spread onion mixture in 4 pie pans or 2 (13 x 9-inch) pans.
7. Sprinkle evenly with cheese.
8. Pour egg mixture over cheese.
9. Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean.
10. Serves 24.
title: No Crust Quiche

steps: 1. Mix together salt, bread crumbs, grated cheese and 1 cup scalded milk with 1 tablespoon butter, melted in milk.
2. Add 3 slightly beaten egg yolks.
3. Beat whites stiff and fold into cheese mixture.
4. Pour into well-greased 2 quart casserole.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
6. Serve immediately.
7. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Cheese Souffle

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375 F. Butter a large rectangular baking dish (or 6 smaller baking dishes).
2. Combine the egg yolks and 1/3 cup of the sugar in a large bowl. Whisk until ribbons form and add the flour, vanilla extract, and cream. Beat the mixture until completely blended.
3. In another bowl, beat the egg whites together with the salt until foamy, about one minute. Then add the beaten egg whites into the batter, mixing lightly until incorporated.
4. Preheat the prepared baking dish in the oven for 4 to 5 minutes.

5. In a medium bowl, stir together the cherries, the remaining 1/3-cup sugar and the lemon zest. Remove the baking dish from the oven, pour in the cherries and top with the batter. Bake until the clafoutis is set in the middle, 30 - 35 minutes (or considerably less for smaller baking dishes). Serve warm.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Cherry Clafoutis

steps: 1. Cook carrots in small amount of water until tender, then drain. Combine carrots and butter in container of electric blender. Blend until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Blend well. Spoon mixture into a lightly greased 1 or 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Carrot Souffle

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together.
2. Refrigerate for 12 hours or overnight.
3. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
4. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Serves 6 to 10.
title: Egg And Sausage Souffle

ingredients.text: 8 slices day old bread, cut in 1-inch sq.

steps: 1. Butter baking dish (9 x 13-inch).
2. Place bread pieces in bottom of dish.
3. Mix onions and ham, then place over bread.
4. next, spread grated cheese over ham, then sprinkle with flour.
5. Beat together eggs, mustard, milk and garlic salt; pour over cheese. Refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
7. Serves 8 people.
title: Egg Quiche

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Spray a pie plate with cooking spray.
2. Place the shredded potatoes in the pie plate. Press them down into the plate so that it is molded into the plate like a crust. Sprinkle the salt and pepper around on the potatoes.
3. Place in the oven for 20 minutes. The potatoes will become crispy and golden. (If they are not golden and crispy enough for you at this point, leave in for a few minutes longer.)
4. Place the mushrooms evenly around on the potato crust. Place the ham on top of the mushrooms. Pour the eggs over the top of the potatoes, ham and mushrooms. Evenly spread the cheese on top.

5. Place in the oven and bake for approximately 30 minutes. Test the center to be sure it is almost set. Remove from oven and let it sit for 5 minutes. It will finish cooking and set perfectly before cutting.
6. Serves 8.
title: Crustless Quiche

steps: 1. Brown beef and onions; drain fat.
2. Mix other ingredients in. Add beef and onions.
3. Put in uncooked pie shell.
4. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
5. You can freeze it or you can warm it and eat.
6. Serves 6.
title: Hamburger Quiche

steps: 1. Sprinkle ham, cheese and onion in a greased 9-inch pie pan. Blend remaining ingredients in blender or food processor.
2. Pour into pie pan.
3. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.
4. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
5. Yields 6 servings.
title: Quick Ham Quiche

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Sprinkle caraway seed over pie crust. Prick crust.
3. Bake for 7 minutes.
4. Fill pie shell with corned beef. Spread mustard over meat.
5. Top with sauerkraut and cheese.
6. Mix together eggs, cream, onion and dry mustard.
7. Pour into pie shell and bake for 40 minutes.
8. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
9. Put together in 1 hour.
10. Makes 8 servings.
title: Reuben Quiche

ingredients.text: 1 lb. eggplant, unpeeled and cut into strips
2 green peppers, cut in thin strips

steps: 1. In a 12-inch skillet, over medium-low heat, heat oil. Add garlic, onions and green peppers. Cook, uncovered.

2. Stir occasionally until lightly brown (10 to 15 minutes). Add remaining ingredients and cook, covered, stirring now and then, until eggplant is tender but holds its shape and only a small amount of liquid is left in pan.
3. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Inez Ratatouille(Eggplant)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. In pan, cook onion and garlic in margarine until tender.
3. In medium bowl, toss cheese with flour; add egg and milk mixing well.
4. Add broccoli, onion and carrot. Pour into greased 9-inch pie plate.
5. Bake 40 to 45 minutes, or until set and golden brown.
6. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting and serving.
7. Serves 6.
title: Cheesy Vegetable "Un-Quiche"

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp.
2. Drain on paper towel; reserve drippings in skillet.
3. Set aside.
4. Saute garlic, onion and mushrooms in skillet until tender.
5. Stir in reserved bacon, flour and seasoned salt.
6. Set aside.
7. Cut tomatoes in 1/2-inch slices. Place half of the slices in a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish.
8. Spoon half of bacon/onion mixture over tomatoes.
9. Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons Parmesan cheese.
10. Repeat layers.
11. Dot with butter.
12. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
13. Yields 6 servings.
title: Tomatoes Provencale

steps: 1. Spread French bread with softened butter on both sides. Arrange slices in a single layer in a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish.
2. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
3. Bake at 350° until golden brown, about 15 minutes.
4. (Makes 2 servings.)
title: Toasted French Slices

steps: 1. Cut unpeeled eggplant, squash and zucchini into 3/4-inch pieces.
2. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat.
3. Add squash, eggplant, zucchini and onion.
4. Cook 5 to 7 minutes or until vegetables are almost tender, stirring frequently.
5. Add seasonings.
6. Continue cooking, stirring frequently, 1 minute or until vegetables are tender.
7. Sprinkle with tomato.
8. Makes 8 servings.
title: Ratatouille(Pronounced Rah-Tah-Too-Ee)

ingredients.text: 1 c. (8 oz.) cooked or canned salmon, flaked

steps: 1. Melt butter, stir in flour and seasonings.
2. When well blended, slowly add milk, stirring constantly over low heat until mixture thickens and boils.
3. Remove from heat and stir in well-beaten egg yolks.
4. Fold in salmon; cool.
5. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
6. Bake at 425°
7. for 20 to 25 minutes.
8. Yields 6 servings.
title: Salmon Souffle Ala Pittaluga

steps: 1. Butter a glass dish.
2. Add the following in layers: half cranberries, half apples, half of each kind of sugar, half of oatmeal and nuts.
3. Repeat.
4. Pour melted margarine over.
5. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.
6. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Cranberry Souffle

steps: 1. Grease pie plate, sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in plate. Beat remaining ingredients together until smooth.
2. Pour into plate.
3. Bake in preheated 400° oven for about 40 minutes until knife comes out clean.
4. Serves 6.
title: Quiche

steps: 1. Sprinkle 1 1/2 cups cheese into lightly greased 9 x 12-inch baking pan.
2. Beat eggs at medium speed for 2 minutes.
3. Add milk, flour, baking powder, salt, pepper and onions.
4. Mix for 4 minutes on low speed.
5. Pour mixture over cheese and sprinkle remaining 1 cup cheese over liquid mixture in pan.
6. Bake at 400° for 45 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Surface will be lightly browned and puffy.
7. Serves 12.
title: Quiche With Self-Forming Crust

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a large Dutch oven.
2. Bring to a boil; cover, reduce heat and cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
3. Yield: 8 servings.
title: Ratatouille

steps: 1. Place chicken in covered casserole.
2. Mix liquids and spices and pour over chicken. Bake, covered, for 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Serves 4.
title: Easy Coq Au Vin

steps: 1. In skillet, saute onion in 2 tablespoons margarine until tender.
2. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Blend in milk.
3. Cool slightly.
4. Stir in salmon and pepper.
5. Add 2 tablespoons bread crumbs; mix thoroughly.
6. Shape into patties or logs.
7. Roll in remaining crumbs.
8. Saute in remaining margarine until evenly browned on all sides.
9. Yields 3 servings.
title: Salmon Croquettes

steps: 1. Make a white sauce of melted butter, flour and milk.
2. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored.
3. Add to the white sauce. Beat the egg whites until stiff, but not dry.
4. Fold into the white sauce-yolk mixture.
5. Bake in an ungreased casserole at 325°, starting with a cold oven, for 1 hour.
6. Remove immediately for eating or it will collapse.
7. Serves 4.
title: Basic Souffle Recipe

steps: 1. Blend first 4 ingredients.
2. Grease casserole.
3. Pour mixture over bread.
4. Refrigerate overnight.
5. Put in dish of water and bake 1 hour at 350°.
6. Serves 4.
title: Golden Cheese Souffle

steps: 1. Beat the eggs and 1/4 cup sugar in a 1-quart casserole.
2. Mix the pineapple and flour; add to the egg mixture, stirring slightly.
3. Melt the butter in a saucepan.
4. Add the bread cubes. When the bread has absorbed all of the butter, place on top of the casserole.
5. Lightly sprinkle with 1/4 cup sugar and the cinnamon mixture.
6. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.
7. Serves 4.
title: Pineapple Souffle

steps: 1. Brown chicken in butter and bacon.
2. Add onion.
3. Drain off some fat.
4. Push aside in pan and add seasonings.
5. Add sherry and simmer 45 minutes.
6. Remove chicken.
7. Add mushrooms and flour (if you like thick gravy) and simmer for 10 minutes.
8. Pour gravy over chicken (and rice, too!).
9. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Coq Au Vin

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Use a food processor fitted with a steel blade.
3. Place half of each of the ingredients in the bowl and process until smooth.
4. Mound this batch into a greased loaf pan.
5. Repeat process with remaining portion of the ingredients and add to the loaf pan.
6. Bake 45 minutes or until cake is spongy to the touch.
7. Cool and unmold.
8. Slice and serve.
9. Serves 4.
title: Fresh Lemon Tartelettes

steps: 1. Brown sausage; drain and cool.
2. Crumble sausage into bowl. Beat eggs in another bowl.
3. Add milk, salt, mustard and bread cubes; mix well.
4. Add cheese and sausage; mix again.
5. Spoon into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch glass baking dish.
6. Cover; refrigerate overnight. Remove dish from refrigerator.
7. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes, or until egg mixture is set.
8. Cut into squares to serve. Makes 8 servings.
title: Brunch Souffle

steps: 1. Melt butter in small saucepan.
2. Add flour, stir and cook until smooth.
3. Add cream cheese, stir until smooth.
4. Beat eggs; add milk, cheese, baking powder, salt and sugar, stir until well blended. Add flour/cream cheese mixture, blend well.
5. Pour into a well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
6. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes at 350°.
7. Serves 8.
title: Crustless Quiche

steps: 1. Cut
2. eggplant, yellow squash, zucchini and peppers into 1/2-inch cubes.
3. Heat oil in large skillet and saute onion and garlic
4. until
5. onion is tender.
6. Add vegetables and stir for 2 to 3
7. minutes.
8. Add
9. remaining
10. ingredients.
11. Heat to boiling point and reduce heat.
12. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, until tender, 30 to 40 minutes.
13. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Zucchini, Eggplant Ratatouille

ingredients.text: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch slices
1 clove garlic, minced through a press

steps: 1. Sprinkle the sliced chicken with 2 tablespoons flour (or put both into a bag and shake).
2. Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
3. Add the chicken and flour and saute until lightly browned (about 4 to 5 minutes).
4. Remove chicken from pan and keep warm. Combine garlic, ginger, vinegar, chicken stock, honey and soy sauce.
5. Add to the same pan and bring to a boil; stir until thickened, fragrant and reduced by about half (about 5 minutes). Add chicken to the pan, stirring well.
6. Sprinkle with scallions and heat through.
7. Serve over steamed rice.
8. Serves 4.
title: Cheater'S Cheese Souffle

ingredients.text: 1 lb. pork sausage, cooked, crumbled, drained and cooled

steps: 1. Butter bread; cut into cubes.
2. Place in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch greased baking dish.
3. Sprinkle bread with sausage, then cheese. Beat eggs, salt, cream and mustard together.
4. Pour over bread mix. Chill overnight.
5. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. Serves 6.
title: Sausage Souffle

steps: 1. Prick the pie shells and cook for 6 minutes at 400°.
2. Saute the green onions in 4 tablespoons butter until soft.
3. Sprinkle onions and bacon bits in equal portions over the bottom of pie shell. Top pies with grated cheese.
4. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden and puffy. Serves 8.
title: Quiche

steps: 1. Combine egg, flour, Parmesan cheese, 1/2 cup milk and seasonings.
2. Beat until smooth.
3. Blend in remaining milk; stir in half of Swiss cheese.
4. Pour into pan.
5. Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.
6. Sprinkle remaining cheese over top.
7. Bake until cheese is melted, about 2 minutes.
8. Yield: 4 servings.
9. Carbohydrate 23 g, protein 14 g, fat 11 g, calories 247.
10. One serving = 2 meat medium fat exchange, 1 bread starch exchange, 1 fruit exchange.
title: Quiche

steps: 1. Peel, halve, and core the pears.
2. Grill the pears on medium heat, turning once, until they are heated through and have nice grill marks on both sides. 5-7 minutes.
3. Alternately, you can saute the pears in a little butter or apple juice to heat them through and soften them up a bit.
4. Place one pear half on each plate.
5. Top each pear half with a slice of prosciutto, followed by a slice of parmesan (use a potato peeler to get a nice, thin slice), and then a mint leaf.
6. Drizzle a tablespoon of balsamic vinegar around each pear half.
7. Season with salt and pepper if desired.
title: Grilled Pear And Prosciutto Starter

steps: 1. Crumble and cook sausage; drain well.
2. Mix with all other ingredients.
3. Pour into 9 x 13-inch ungreased glass dish.
4. Cook at 350° for 1 hour.
5. This tastes best when covered and refrigerated overnight before cooking.
6. A great breakfast dish!
title: Sausage Souffle

steps: 1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer 7 minutes. Stir in cream; simmer 3 more minutes or until reduced to 1 cup.

2. Strain sauce into a bowl, discarding solids. Return sauce to saucepan; place pan over low heat. Add butter, 1 tablespoon at a time, whisking just until melted. Remove from heat; whisk in lemon juice and chives. Stir in salt and pepper. Serve warm.
title: Beurre Blanc

steps: 1. Blend Bisquick, butter, milk, eggs, salt and pepper. Blend well. Pour into pan. Sprinkle crabmeat on top and push it down. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
title: Impossible Crab Quiche

steps: 1. Soak soft bread crumbs in scalded milk.
2. Add salt, dry mustard and cheese.
3. Mix until cheese is melted.
4. Let cool as you clean salmon; remove skin and bones.
5. Add egg yolks.
6. Fold in 2 cups flaked salmon (1 pound).
7. Fold in 3 egg whites, beaten stiff.
title: Salmon Souffle

ingredients.text: 4 cups all-purpose flour, or as needed

steps: 1. Place yeast into the bottom of a large mixing bowl and stir with water; mix in salt. Beat flour into yeast mixture with a wooden spoon until dough is thick and sticky and pulls flour from the side of the bowl, 5 to 10 minutes.
2. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and let stand in a turned-off oven until doubled in size, 12 to 14 hours. Dough will be bubbly and very sticky.
3. Place a silicone baking mat onto a baking sheet and dust generously with cornmeal.
4. Use a floured spatula to scrape dough out onto a well-floured work surface and dust dough with flour. With well-floured hands, pat dough into a rectangle and cut into 4 equal-size pieces.

5. Dust a piece of dough with flour and use your floured fingers to gently roll and stretch it out into a log about 10 inches long and 1 1/2 inches around. Gently transfer to prepared baking sheet. If desired, wipe off excess cornmeal with a damp paper towel. Repeat with another piece of dough. (Reserve remaining dough to bake later or prepare 2 baking sheets to bake all 4 at once). Dust loaves lightly with flour. Dust a large piece of plastic wrap with flour and drape plastic lightly over the baking sheet with floured side down.
6. Let loaves rise, covered, until doubled, 1 to 1 1/2 hour.

7. Move oven racks to the bottom and middle positions. Preheat oven to 500 degrees F (260 degrees C) or as high as your oven will go. Place an oven-safe baking dish full of water into bottom rack of the oven.
8. Use a sharp kitchen shears to cut 4 or 5 angled slashes into the top of each loaf. Poke down the little sharp tips of dough left by the scissors. Spray loaves with water, using a spray bottle.
9. Bake in the preheated oven until baguettes are browned, about 15 minutes, spraying loaves with water after 5 minutes and 10 minutes. Turn the pan around on the second spraying.
10. Transfer baguettes to a cooling rack and let cool to room temperature before slicing with a serrated knife.
title: How To Make French Baguettes

steps: 1. Combine mayonnaise, flour, eggs and milk.
2. Mix until blended. Stir in crab meat, cheese and onions.
3. Pour into 9-inch pie plate or quiche pan.
4. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
title: Crab Quiche

steps: 1. Combine flour and salt; cut in shortening until crumbly. Gradually add ice water, tossing with a fork until dough holds together when pressed. Shape into a disk; wrap in plastic. Refrigerate 1 hour or overnight.
2. Preheat oven to 425°. On a lightly floured surface, roll dough to a 1/8-in.-thick circle; transfer to a 9-in. pie plate. Trim pastry to 1/2 in. beyond rim of plate; flute edge.
3. For filling, sprinkle pastry with bacon. Whisk eggs, cream, salt and nutmeg until blended; stir in cheese. Pour over top.
4. Bake on a lower oven rack for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 325°; continue to bake until a knife inserted in center comes out clean, 30-40 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.
title: Quiche Lorraine

steps: 1. Lightly saute garlic, onion and broccoli.
2. Meanwhile, mix eggs, milk and cheese, then add seasonings.
3. Mix in veggies and pour into an oiled casserole dish.
4. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
title: Vegetable Quiche

steps: 1. Beat eggs with oil in bowl.
2. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Stir in zucchini, onions and shredded cheese.
3. Pour into greased pie plate and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
title: Zucchini Quiche

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Cook bacon and drain.
3. Crumble bacon and mix all ingredients together and bake in a 9-inch greased deep dish pie pan for 35 minutes.
4. (Cooked broccoli florets or cauliflower may be added in place of bacon.)
title: No Crust Quiche

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup granulated sugar, for caramelized topping,approx

steps: 1. Heat oven to 325 degrees.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, whole egg and 1/4 cup sugar until smooth.
3. Chop the white chocolate; set aside.
4. Heat cream and half and half over medium heat just until it begins to bubble.
5. Turn the heat to low and add chocolate, stirring until melted.
6. Start to laddle chocolate cream into the eggs slowly, whisking well with each addition.
7. When the mixture is incorporated, strain into clean bowl.
8. Stir in vanilla and nutmeg.
9. Ladle mixture into 12 (1/2 cup) ramekins.
10. Place in large baking pan, add enough hot water to come halfway up the sides of the dishes.
11. Cook 45 minutes.
12. They will have a light gold top and be slightly wobbly in the center.
13. Remove from pan, transfer to rack to cool.
14. Cover loosely and refrigerate until chilled.
15. Several hours before serving: start to caramelize the custards.
16. Place oven rack on 2nd rack from the broiler.
17. Sprinkle 1 1/2 tsp sugar on top of each ramekins, arrange on baking sheet.
18. Place under broiler 5 to 6 minutes.
19. Rotate 1/2 way through.
20. Cool on racks and then refrigerate again until chilled.
title: White Chocolate Creme Brulee

steps: 1. Spray Pam into a 9x13 dish.
2. Line with crackers.
3. *Put grated cheese, cheese slices, or Cheez Whiz, or a combination of all three if you're short with one or another. (I don't think Cheez Whiz by itself would be good so mix and match with that).
4. Continue layering cheese and crackers ending with cheese.
5. Crack 4-5 eggs into a four cup measuring cup. Beat eggs.
6. Fill measuring cup with milk (I use skim but any milk will do) to the four cup mark.
7. Carefully pour over cheese and crackers.
8. Let sit for at least a 1/2 hour.
9. Put into a 350 degrees F oven for about 40 minutes.
10. Serve with salad.
title: Poor Man'S Souffle

steps: 1. Cook rice in about 3 c water (drain excess).
2. Heat oil and butter then slowly add onion.
3. Cut the chicken into pieces while the veggies cook and add to pan.
4. Core and slice apples and add to skillet. Add mushrooms and cook 2 minutes.
5. Add juice, wine, and sugar. Crush bouillion cube and add. Bring to a boil and cook until chicken is no longer pink.
6. Stir in salt, mustard, and milk, then stir in cooked rice.
title: Apple Dijon Chicken Skillet

steps: 1. Melt butter in medium saucepan over medium-low heat.
2. Add onion, garlic, and cumin seeds and cook until onions are soft.
3. Whisk in flour and cook 3 minutes and flour has turned a lovely shade of gold.
4. Do not let it brown.
5. Whisk in milk & half-and-half and bring to boil, stirring.
6. Add salt and chopped cilantro.
7. Reduce heat to low simmer until thick enough to coat back of spoon.
8. Serve with your favorite pasta and enjoy!
title: Cilantro-Cumin Bechamel

steps: 1. Mix together all ingredients.
2. Pour in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
3. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
title: Zucchini Quiche

steps: 1. Melt margarine; stir in flour.
2. Add milk.
3. Cook until thick. Remove from heat.
4. Add ham, onion, horseradish and mustard. Refrigerate for 30 minutes or longer.
5. Shape in ball.
6. Roll in crumbs, then into beaten eggs and then back in the crumbs.
7. Cook in hot oil (375°) until brown, about 4 to 5 minutes.
title: Ham Croquettes

ingredients.text: 1 lb. pork sausage, fried and crumbled

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients.
2. Add sausage last.
3. Refrigerate overnight (approximately 12 hours).
4. Bake 60 minutes at 350° in a casserole dish.
title: Sausage Souffle(For Brunch)

steps: 1. Flake salmon in a mixing bowl.
2. Put in eggs after beating well with rotary eggbeater.
3. Add flour to mixture and stir until well mixed.
4. Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk and add to salmon mixture.
5. Drop from a spoon into hot fat.
6. Cook until brown on each side.
title: Salmon Croquettes

ingredients.text: 2 c. chopped meat (turkey, chicken, beef, pork or ham)

steps: 1. Make thick white sauce by melting butter over low heat; blend in flour, salt and pepper and stir until bubbly.
2. Remove from heat and stir in milk.
3. Bring to boil.
4. Boil 1 minute, stirring constantly.
5. Mix in onion, parsley and meat.
6. Spread out on plate. Chill thoroughly.
7. Shape into balls and then roll in flour, egg slightly beaten with 2 tablespoons water, then roll in dry bread crumbs.
8. Fry in hot oil, 365°, for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes.
9. Drain on paper towel.
title: Meat Croquettes

steps: 1. Put initial starter in refrigerator for 3 to 5 days; you can feed on the third, fourth or fifth day with listed ingredients. Mix well; add to starter and let stand out of refrigerator for 8 to 12 hours (all day).
2. When bubbly, take out one cup for bread. Return starter to refrigerator.
3. Wait 3 to 5 days to feed again. If you don't make bread after feeding 3 times, discard one cup or give to a friend.
4. This is to avoid deflating starter. supper time and then bake.
title: Sourdough Starter

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp.
2. Drain and crumble into pie crust. Arrange Swiss cheese over bacon.
3. Beat eggs in bowl slightly with rotary beater; add half and half, salt and pepper.
4. Blend together.
5. Pour ingredients over bacon and cheese in pie crust. Bake in moderately hot 400° oven for approximately 40 minutes.
6. Do not overbake.
7. Remove while center still appears soft and allow to cool slightly before cutting.
title: Quiche Lorraine

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. bacon, fried until crisp and crumbled

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Beat eggs.
3. Add half and half and cream; beat.
4. Add the rest of the ingredients; beat.
5. Pour into a quiche dish or deep pie plate.
6. Bake at 350° for approximately 35 to 45 minutes, or until a knife blade comes out clean.
7. This recipe may be halved or doubled.
title: Quiche

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients.
2. Put in glass pie plate or Corning dish. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes until top is golden brown.
title: Zucchini Quiche

ingredients.text: 4.5 lbs beef stew meat, trimmed, cut into chunks
1/2 cup flat-leaf parsley, roughly chopped, to serve

steps: 1. Heat oil in large Dutch oven and cook beef, in batches, until browned all over. Remove beef from pan.
2. Add butter to same pan; cook shallots, bacon, mushrooms and garlic, stirring, until shallots are lightly browned.
3. Sprinkle over flour and cook, stirring, until mixture thickens and bubbles. Gradually add stock and wine and stir until mixture boils and thickens.
4. Return beef and any juices to pan, add bay leaves and thyme and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until beef is tender, stirring every 30 mins.
5. Discard bay leaves. Serve beef bourguignon sprinkled with parsley.
title: Beef Bourguignon

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Arrange tomatoes and zucchini in rows in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
3. In a small bowl, combine oil, parsley, shallots, garlic, basil, thyme, salt and pepper.
4. Pour over vegetables.
5. Bake for 30 minutes, basting occasionally with the liquid in the pan.
title: Zucchini Provencale

steps: 1. Heat oven to 425°.
2. Sprinkle onion, cheese and bacon in unbaked pie crust.
3. Beat eggs and other ingredients; pour over bacon and cheese.
4. Bake for 15 minutes; reduce heat to 300° and bake 30 minutes.
5. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.
title: Quiche

steps: 1. In a bowl, whisk together 1/3 cup sugar, eggs, egg whites, milk, vanilla and salt; pour into five 6-oz. custard cups. Place cups in a baking pan. Fill pan with boiling water to a depth of 1 in. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 25-30 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean. Remove from water bath. Cool for 10 minutes and refrigerate.

2. Before serving, in a heavy saucepan over medium heat, heat water and remaining sugar until sugar is melted. Do not stir. When sugar is melted, continue to cook until syrup is golden, about 5 minutes, swirling pan occasionally. With a spoon, quickly pour over custards, tilting cups to coat custard with syrup. Serve immediately. Refrigerate leftovers.
title: Creme Brulee

steps: 1. Saute onion in butter until transparent (but not brown).
2. Add potatoes and chicken broth; cook over moderate heat, until potatoes are mushy.
3. Remove from heat; mash potatoes (and juice) with potato masher, until very smooth (no lumps).
4. Put potato mixture into strainer and stir (and push it down) into large saucepan, until all mixture is completely through strainer.
5. Add milk; mix with wire whip.
6. Blend in salt, pepper and paprika.
7. Heat mixture over medium-high heat until very hot (but not boiling).
8. Add heavy cream and heat to very hot.
9. Serve immediately after garnishing with parsley.
title: Vichyssoise(Hot)

steps: 1. Line pie crust with sliced cheese.
2. Place scrambled sausage over this.
3. Spread with grated cheese on top of sausage.
4. Beat eggs and milk and pour over top.
5. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
title: Sausage Quiche

ingredients.text: 2 tomatoes, peeled and cubed (I use canned tomatoes)

steps: 1. Saute onion and eggplant in 1/2 pound butter and garlic powder.
2. Add vegetables.
3. Season with salt (I don't use salt) and pepper to taste.
4. Cook for 25 minutes.
title: Ratatouille

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
2. Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Add onion and saute until soft, about 3 to 5 minutes.
3. In a large bowl, beat together eggs, cream, basil, oregano, salt and pepper.
4. Spoon the onions into the pie crust. Pour the egg mixture over the onions. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top.
5. Bake in preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into center of the quiche comes out clean, about 30 to 40 minutes. Let cool slightly before serving.
title: Donna'S Cheesy Quiche

steps: 1. Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Fry the onions and thyme sprigs in the oil until softened and lightly coloured (about 5 mins).

2. Spread a layer of potatoes over the base of a 1.5-litre oiled gratin dish. Sprinkle over a few onions (see picture, above) and continue layering, finishing with a layer of potatoes. Pour over the stock and bake for 50-60 mins until the potatoes are cooked and the top is golden and crisp.
title: Boulangère Potatoes

steps: 1. Melt the butter with the oil in a large heavy-based pan. Add the onions and fry with the lid on for 10 mins until soft. Sprinkle in the sugar and cook for 20 mins more, stirring frequently, until caramelised. The onions should be really golden, full of flavour and soft when pinched between your fingers. Take care towards the end to ensure that they don’t burn.

2. Add the garlic for the final few mins of the onions’ cooking time, then sprinkle in the flour and stir well. Increase the heat and keep stirring as you gradually add the wine, followed by the hot stock. Cover and simmer for 15-20 mins.

3. To serve, turn on the grill, and toast the bread. Ladle the soup into heatproof bowls. Put a slice or two of toast on top of the bowls of soup, and pile on the cheese. Grill until melted. Alternatively, you can complete the toasts under the grill, then serve them on top.
title: French Onion Soup

steps: 1. Heat butter in skillet. Add ingredients, except cheese.
2. Cover and cook about 15 minutes. Add cheese.
3. Heat until cheese is melted.
4. Serves 4 or more.
title: Zucchini Au Gratin

steps: 1. Cut potatoes into thin slices. In a saucepan, cook onion in margarine until tender. Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in milk and 1 1/2 cups of cheese. Heat to boiling and boil for 1 minute. Place potatoes in ungreased 4-quart casserole pan and pour cheese sauce over potatoes.
2. Cook uncovered at 350° for 1 hour. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top and bake until melted. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Au Gratin Potatoes

steps: 1. Cook and drain broccoli.
2. Beat eggs and add mayonnaise.
3. Add butter, flour and milk.
4. Blend all ingredients in blender, until smooth.
5. Bake a 2 1/2 quart casserole at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.
6. You may wish to place dish in a pan of water while baking.
7. Serves 4.
title: Never Fail Broccoli Souffle

steps: 1. Combine the first 5 ingredients.
2. Spoon into shallow baking dish.
3. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and cheese.
4. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
5. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Au Gratin

ingredients.text: 1 lb. baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/8-inch slices

steps: 1. In a large skillet, cook onions with salt and pepper to taste in 3 tablespoons butter over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until they are golden. Spoon half the onions into a buttered 2-quart gratin dish, cover them with the potato slices and sprinkle the potatoes with salt and pepper. Cover the potatoes with the remaining onions.
2. Pour the cream over the mixture and sprinkle the mixture with Parmesan and Gruyere.
3. Dot the top with 3 tablespoons butter and bake in preheated 400° oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
4. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Onion And Potato Gratin

ingredients.text: 5 c. thinly sliced, peeled potatoes (about 6 medium)

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, melt butter over low heat. Stir in the flour, salt and pepper until smooth. Gradually add milk. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Remove from the heat; stir in cheese until melted. Add potatoes and onion; stir well. Transfer to a greased 2-quart baking dish. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Uncover; bake 30 to 40 minutes longer or until the potatoes are tender. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.
title: Au Gratin Potatoes

ingredients.text: 4 or 5 medium potatoes, sliced and parboiled

steps: 1. Place parboiled potatoes in casserole dish. In a boiler, melt butter; stir in flour, salt and milk. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly. Add cheese and cook until cheese melts. Pour sauce over potatoes. Place in 350° oven for 30 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Au Gratin Potatoes

steps: 1. In a medium skillet, over medium-high heat, combine turkey and onion. Cook 5 minutes or until turkey is no longer pink.
2. Add potato, breaking up larger pieces of potatoes with spoon, if necessary. Cook 2 to 3 minutes. Add salt and pepper.
3. Into 1-quart ovenproof casserole, lightly coated with vegetable cooking spray, bake turkey
4. mixture in a 375° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
5. Top casserole with cheese and continue baking until cheese melts. Serves 4.
title: Turkey Hash Au Gratin

title: Potato Cheese Souffle

steps: 1. Slice onions into 1/2-inch thick rings.
2. Saut in butter until tender.
3. Place in greased 8-inch square baking dish.
4. In a bowl, stir the broth, cream, flour and pepper until smooth.
5. Pour over onions.
6. Sprinkle with the cheeses.
7. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for approximately 30 minutes or until cheese is golden brown and mixture is bubbly.
8. Makes approximately 8 servings.
title: Onions Au Gratin

steps: 1. Melt butter and blend in flour.
2. Add milk. Cook until thick. Beat egg yolks.
3. Add corn.
4. Combine sauce, corn mixture, cheese and salt.
5. Beat egg whites stiff and fold in.
6. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serve immediately. Serves 4.
title: Corn Souffle

steps: 1. Peel and cut potatoes into slices.
2. Place in 6 cups of water, along with butter and salt.
3. Bring to boil, then reduce heat and cook until tender.
4. Drain.
5. Place potatoes in baking dish.
6. Add Cheddar cheese and bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Potatoes Au Gratin

steps: 1. Place cooked and drained carrots in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Blend soup and cheese.
2. Pour over carrots.
3. Top with buttered crumbs.
4. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until bubbling.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Carrots Au Gratin

ingredients.text: 4 slices toasted French bread (each about 1/4-inch thick)

steps: 1. In large heavy saucepan, melt the margarine over moderate heat; add onions and cook, uncovered, until golden, 8 to 10 minutes.
2. Blend in sugar and flour and cook, stirring, 3 minutes longer.
3. Add beef broth, wine, thyme, bay leaf and pepper; heat to moderately high and bring to a boil, stirring constantly, about 6 minutes.
4. Adjust heat so the mixture bubbles gently; simmer, partly covered, for 30 minutes.
5. Remove and discard bay leaf; stir in brandy, if desired.
6. Preheat broiler; rub each piece of bread with the garlic and sprinkle with cheese.
7. Ladle the soup into 4 ovenproof bowls and float a piece of bread, cheese side up, in each one.
8. Place bowls in the broiler 4 to 6 inches from the heat and broil until the cheese is golden brown, about 2 minutes. Serves 4.
title: Hearty French Onion Soup

steps: 1. Cook the shrimp in salted water 3 minutes. Drain.
2. Saute mushrooms, garlic and onion in butter for 5 minutes. Stir in flour, pepper and dill, then stir in milk.
3. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat.
4. Add half of the cheese. Stir until melted.
5. Add white wine.
6. Mix lightly the crab and artichokes with the other mixture and the rest of the cheese.
7. Pour into a 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with crumbs.
8. Bake at 350° until bubbly. Serves 6.
title: Crab And Shrimp Au Gratin

steps: 1. Saute cabbage and onions in butter until tender.
2. Stir in flour, caraway, salt, pepper and paprika.
3. Remove from heat; gradually stir in milk.
4. Bring to boil over medium heat and add cheese.
5. Stir until melted.
6. Return to heat if necessary to melt cheese but do not boil.
7. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Cabbage Au Gratin Soup

steps: 1. Scrub and dry potatoes.
2. With an apple corer, remove a cylinder from the center of each potato.
3. Fill each cavity with cheese.
4. Seal ends with tiny pieces of cylinders which have been removed.
5. Bake in moderate oven (350°) until tender, about 45 to 55 minutes.
6. Serves 6.
title: Au Gratin Stuffed Potatoes

steps: 1. Cook potatoes; cool well, then peel and shred.
2. Set aside. Melt butter; add the rest of the ingredients and heat until cheese is melted, stirring constantly.
3. Add to potatoes; stir well and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
4. Yields 6 to 7 servings.
title: Potatoes Au Gratin

ingredients.text: 4 or 5 medium yellow squash, sliced and cooked

steps: 1. Heat milk and pour over bread crumbs. Add eggs, pepper, butter and onions, mixing well. Stir in squash and cheese. Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until firm. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Ruth'S Squash Cheese Souffle

ingredients.text: 3 medium-size red potatoes (1 1/2 lb.), peeled and sliced

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in boiling salted water to cover 8 minutes or until tender.
2. Drain and mash potatoes.
3. Add sour cream; beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until smooth.
4. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored.
5. Add yolks, cheese, onion, chives and pepper to potato mixture; stir well.
6. Beat egg whites (at room temperature) and baking powder until stiff peaks form.
7. Fold into potato mixture.
8. Spoon into a buttered 1 1/2-quart souffle dish. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until set.
9. Serve immediately. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Cheesy Potato Souffle

ingredients.text: 1 c. chopped, cooked chicken or turkey

steps: 1. Arrange chicken and broccoli in pie shell.
2. Toss cheese with flour, pepper (and salt, if desired).
3. Sprinkle over chicken and broccoli.
4. Combine eggs and milk.
5. Pour over filling. Sprinkle with cheese.
6. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
7. Let stand for 5 minutes.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
9. Great with a tossed salad and white wine.
title: Chicken And Broccoli Quiche

ingredients.text: 10 ounces frozen spinach, thawed (water squeezed out)

steps: 1. Saute onions in cooking spray until limp and golden; cool slightly.
2. In a blender combine sour cream and eggs until well mixed.
3. Add the last six ingredients of the recipe; stir to mix well.
4. Pour into a well-greased 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to an hour, until the edges are slightly browned.
title: Spinach Onion Souffle

ingredients.text: 5 to 6 medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced (about 6 c.)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°.
2. In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan in oven, melt butter.

3. Remove from oven. Add potatoes and salt. Toss together and arrange potatoes in even layer in pan. Sprinkle with cheese and bread crumbs. Cover with foil. Bake 20 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more until potatoes are tender.
title: Potatoes Au Gratin

steps: 1. Saute onions in butter until golden.
2. Stir in flour and sugar. Put mixture in crock-pot and add all remaining ingredients.
3. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.
4. Put soup in bowls.
5. Add croutons; top with Mozzarella cheese and put in oven or microwave to melt cheese.
title: Crock-Pot French Onion Soup

steps: 1. In large pot, cover potatoes with water and boil until tender (about 30 minutes).
2. Drain, peel and slice while potatoes are still warm.
3. Dissolve instant chicken bouillon in water and pour over potatoes.
4. Mix together olive oil, white wine vinegar, dry mustard, salt and pepper and pour over potatoes.
5. Mix together, add onions and let stand at room temperature to develop flavors.
title: French Potato Salad

steps: 1. Put oven rack in middle position and preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Peel potatoes and cut into 1/8-inch-thick slices with a knife or an adjustable-blade slicer, spreading slices out on a large kitchen towel. Sprinkle with sea salt (1 1/2 teaspoons).
3. Stir together cream and milk.

4. Dot bottom of a 3-quart shallow baking dish (13 by 9 inches) with half of butter and pour in 1/3 cup cream mixture. Without rinsing or drying potatoes, divide into 5 piles. Layer potatoes in baking dish, 1 pile per layer, spreading 1/3 cup cream mixture and one fourth of cheese between layers. Drizzle remaining cream mixture over potatoes and dot with remaining butter.
5. Bake, uncovered, until potatoes are very tender and top is browned, about 2 hours. Let stand at room temperature 10 minutes before serving.
title: Potato And Parmesan Gratin

ingredients.text: 3 medium potatoes (18 oz. total), cut into 1-inch cube (unpeeled)
1 1/2 c. leeks (white part only), sliced 1/2-inch thick
6 oz. shredded low-fat Cheddar cheese (1 to 1 1/2 c.)

steps: 1. Place cabbage, potatoes, carrots and leeks in 4-quart Dutch oven.
2. Sprinkle spices over vegetables and mix well.
3. Add water.
title: New England Dinner Au Gratin

steps: 1. Boil and grate potatoes.
2. Add mustard, salt, pepper, milk and cheese.
3. Place grated potatoes in casserole and pour hot cheese over all.
4. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
title: Potatoes Au Gratin

ingredients.text: 2 (10 oz.) frozen chopped spinach, thaw and squeeze to drain liquid

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients.
2. Mix well.
3. Pour into greased crock-pot.
4. Cook on low 4 to 6 hours.
5. May be doubled for 5-quart crock-pot.
title: Spinach Souffle

ingredients.text: 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded, room temperature

steps: 1. Fry the onions and peppers in the butter until the onions are a light, golden brown. Add the rice, salt, and boiling water and cook until the rice is nearly done.
2. Add the tomato soup.
3. Once the rice has absorbed all the liquid, gently fold in the cheese. Stir to mix.
4. Transfer to a well greased casserole and bake at 350°F for about 25 minutes.
title: Elswet'S Scalloped Rice Au Gratin

steps: 1. Dice eggplant into 1-inch cubes and slice zucchini in 1/2-inch rounds.
2. Chop onion coarsely and cut green pepper into squares. Use a heavy bottomed saucepan with lid and saute onion, garlic and green pepper until soft.
3. Stir in eggplant and zucchini; saute a few minutes more.
4. Crush garlic with a fork.
5. Add tomatoes and seasonings.
6. Cover and simmer gently for about 30 minutes or until the vegetables are well cooked.
title: Ratatouille(The Word Means Stew Or Soup In French.)

ingredients.text: 3 tablespoons All-purpose flour (can substitute gluten free flour)
5 cups Thinly sliced potatoes (about 6 medium size)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°. In a large saucepan, melt butter over low heat. Stir in flour, salt and pepper until smooth. Gradually add milk. Bring to a boil; cook and stir 2 minutes or until thickened. Remove from heat; stir in cheese until melted. Add potatoes and onion. Transfer to a greased 2-qt. baking dish. Cover and bake 1 hour. Uncover; bake 30-40 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
title: Au Gratin Potatoes

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
2. Mix all of the ingredients except 1 cup bread crumbs.
3. Shape mixture into 8 balls.
4. Flatten croquettes to 3/4 inch thick.
5. Roll croquettes in remaining bread crumbs.
6. Place on non-stick pan and bake for 20 minutes turning once.
title: Loaded Potato Croquettes

steps: 1. Cook asparagus in salted water until tender; drain.
2. Cool and cut into 1/2-inch pieces.
3. Place Swiss cheese in bottom of raw pie crust.
4. Arrange asparagus on top of cheese.
5. Blend eggs, half and half, salt and pepper.
6. Pour slowly over asparagus and cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
7. Test with knife for doneness. Cool 5 to 7 minutes before cutting.
title: Asparagus Quiche

steps: 1. Cook squash and onion in salted water until tender. Drain and cool. Add beaten eggs and mix well. Add sugar and cheese. Place in a greased casserole dish. Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top and dot with butter. Sprinkle with black pepper and paprika. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
title: Fluffy Squash Souffle

steps: 1. Heat saucepan over medium heat with butter and oil. When butter has melted stir in onions, cover pan and cook slowly until tender and translucent (about 10 minutes). Blend in salt and sugar, raise heat to medium-high. Let onions brown, stirring frequently, about 25-30 minutes. Sprinkle in flour and cook slowly, stirring another 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool, then whisk in 2 cups hot beef stock. When well blended, bring to simmer and add in rest of stock. Cover loosely and simmer very slowly 1 1/2 hours, adding a little water if liquid reduces too much. Top soup cheese and bake at 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes.
title: French Onion Soup

steps: 1. Cook and dice potatoes.
2. Make white sauce with butter, flour and milk.
3. Add cheese until it is melted and well mixed.
4. Pour over potatoes.
5. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
title: Potato Au Gratin

steps: 1. Add first four ingredients to your crockpot.
2. Cover and cook on High for 4-6 hours.
3. Here comes the difference between most soups like this. Place a slice of cheese on the bottom of your bowl.
4. Add the soup followed by your croutons.
5. As you stir your soup all that good cheese gets swirled around.
title: Crock Pot French Onion Soup

ingredients.text: 1 lb asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1-inch lengths, tips reserved for garnish (optional)

steps: 1. Coat 4 ramekins or a 9-inch-square baking pan with cooking spray.
2. Toss asparagus in oil in bowl, and season with salt and pepper, if desired.
3. Place ramekins in oven, and preheat oven to 425°F.

4. Meanwhile, place shallots and garlic in bowl of food processor, and process until finely minced. Add goat cheese, and process until creamy; then add eggs and egg whites, and puree until smooth. Season with salt and pepper, if desired.
5. Pour egg mixture over asparagus in ramekins once oven is preheated, stirring to evenly distribute vegetables.
6. Bake 15 minutes, or until tops are light brown and tester inserted in centers comes out clean. Garnish with asparagus tips.
title: Goat Cheese-Asparagus Crustless Quiche

steps: 1. Pre-heat the oven to 350 degrees F.
2. Blanch the broccoli, saving the stems for soup (If you are using frozen broccoli, thaw it).
3. Beat eggs and cream, then add the cheese and mix well.
4. Stir in the broccoli, salt, garlic powder (Whole Foods has an excellent organic variety), and pepper.
5. Pour into a nine inch quiche pan and bake for about 30 - 35 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.
title: Simple Crustless Broccoli Quiche

steps: 1. In a mixing bowl, combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder, nutmeg, and salt.
2. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients.
3. In another bowl, Beat egg slightly; stir in milk and 1/3 cup melted butter or margarine, add egg mixture to flour mixture.
4. Stir just until moistened (the batter may be lumpy). Lightly grease muffin cups.
5. Fill cups about 2/3 full with batter. Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes or until muffins are golden. Meanwhile, in a shallow bowl combine the 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon.
6. Immediately dip tops of hot muffins into the 1/4 cup melted butter or margarine, then into the cinnamon-sugar mixture until coated.
7. Serve warm.
8. Serves 12.
title: French Breakfast Puffs

steps: 1. Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt into bowl.
2. Stir in remaining ingredients.
3. Beat with electric mixer until smooth. For each crepe, butter an 8-inch skillet; heat over medium heat until butter is bubbly.
4. Pour scant 1/4 cup batter into skillet. Immediately rotate pan until batter covers bottom of pan.
5. Cook until light brown; turn and brown on other side.
6. Makes 10 servings.
title: Crepes

steps: 1. Crumble the bread in baking dish. Beat together the eggs and milk. Add the cheese and sausage. Pour in baking dish. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° until firm. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Breakfast Quiche

steps: 1. Brown meat; may add bacon bits.
2. Mix all together.
3. Put in refrigerator overnight.
4. This can be frozen before being baked. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
5. Allow extra time if frozen.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Breakfast Quiche

steps: 1. Cook sausage until done; crumble, drain and combine with the rest of the ingredients.
2. Pour into well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Refrigerate overnight.
3. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
4. Serves 12 to 15.
title: Breakfast Souffle

ingredients.text: 4 slices wheat bread, cubed (can use white)

steps: 1. Brown sausage; drain.
2. Mix remaining ingredients and add to sausage.
3. Pour into a 9-inch square pan.
4. Can be refrigerated overnight or baked same day.
5. Bake, uncovered,
6. for 1 hour until set. Bake at 350°.
7. Serves 8.
title: Breakfast Souffle

steps: 1. Brown sausage over medium heat in skillet, stirring until crumbly.
2. Drain well on paper towels.
3. Combine with remaining ingredients in large bowl, mixing well.
4. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
5. Cover; chill in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
6. Yields 8 servings.
title: Breakfast Souffle

steps: 1. Brown sausage and drain.
2. Mix all ingredients together.
3. Add sausage to mixture.
4. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
5. Chill overnight.
6. Bake at 325° for about 1 hour.
title: Breakfast Souffle

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour (Linda also adds flax seed and wheat germ. The kids will never know.) (optional)

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in a blender, or mix really well with a whisk. You don't want any lumps.

2. Spread thinly in HOT skillet (use olive oil). Use a cast iron or stainless steel frying pan that is really HOT. Then it won't stick and you won't need teflon. In fact, get rid of the teflon! It's so dangerous!
3. Cover with lid.
4. Flip.
5. Cover with lid.
6. Makes 3 pancakes - enough for one person. (Four if you use a smaller pan.) Multiply recipe accordingly.

7. Roll pancake with various fillings: butter, icing sugar, lemon juice / nutella and manderine orange or blueberries / sausage and applesauce / spinach, cherry toms, goat's milk feta, bit of shredded edam, pepper / syrup / ham & cheese / strawberries and sugar -- and the list goes on -----.
title: Anytime Crepes

steps: 1. Brown sausage and onion in skillet.
2. Combine with entire ingredients and pour in buttered 9 x 13-inch dish.
3. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
4. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes to 1 hour.
title: Breakfast Souffle

ingredients.text: 3 cups frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded

steps: 1. Press hash brown between paper towels to remove excess moisture.
2. Grease a 9":pie plate with 2 teaspoons butter.
3. Press hash browns onto the bottom and up the sides of plate.
4. Drizzle with remaining butter.
5. Bake, uncovered, at 425 for 20 to 25 minutes or until edges are browned.
6. Combine cheeses and ham and spread on top of hash browns.
7. Whisk eggs, whipping cream, and seasoning salt until combined and pour over ham and hashbrown mixture.
8. Reduce heat to 350. Bake uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.
9. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
title: Hash Brown Ham Quiche

steps: 1. Lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup; level with a knife. Combine flour, sugar, cinnamon, and salt in a small bowl. Combine milk, water, melted butter, and eggs in a blender. Add the flour mixture to milk mixture, and process until smooth. Cover batter; chill for 1 hour.

2. Heat an 8-inch nonstick crepe pan or skillet over medium heat. Pour a scant 1/4 cup batter into pan; quickly tilt pan in all directions so batter covers pan with a thin film. Cook about 1 minute. Carefully lift the edge of the crepe with a spatula to test for doneness. The crepe is ready to turn when it can be shaken loose from the pan and the underside is lightly browned. Turn crepe over, and cook for 30 seconds or until center is set.
3. Place crepe on a towel; cool completely. Repeat procedure with the remaining batter, stirring batter between crepes. Stack crepes between single layers of wax paper to prevent sticking.

4. Although you'll only need about three tablespoons batter to make each cinnamon crepe, we found a 1/4-cup dry measuring cup is the best tool to scoop and pour the batter into the pan so the crepes cook evenly. The small amount of sugar gives the crepes a golden appearance and crisp edges without adding noticeable sweetness, so this recipe works in both savory and sweet applications.
title: Cinnamon Crepes

steps: 1. Whisk together eggs, milk, water, salt, sugar, and vanilla until combined. Add the flour and whisk until smooth.

2. Heat a small nonstick pan to medium-high heat. Add 1 teaspoon of butter to coat. Pour 1/2 cup of batter on to middle of pan and work the batter around to spread it out on the pan. Cook until top is dry, then flip over and cook for about 15 seconds more. Remove from pan and start stacking them on a plate as you cook them.
3. Butter the pan and repeat with remaining batter (batter can be refrigerated for 24 hours, mix well before use). Keep covered with a piece of tin foil until ready to use.
4. Serve with your choice of maple syrup, powdered sugar, fruit, and whipped cream.
title: World’S Best Crepes

steps: 1. Melt the butter in a glass dish in the microwave and let cool. You don't want it to curdle the eggs.
2. Use a blender to make this easier.
3. Toss in the four eggs and swirl a few times to lightly beat them.
4. Add vanilla, butter (no margarine, it compromises the flavor) and milk and whirl a few times.
5. Sift together salt and flour, and add to eggs and milk along with brown sugar.

6. If you'd like, pour batter into a bowl and let sit in the refrigerator for an hour (or up to two days if you're not making them right away). This allows the batter to settle and removes the bubbles. I use this time to prep the fruit filling.
7. Heat a crepe pan (I prefer the small ones so we can have more than one kind of crepe) over med heat.

8. Spray with Pam or swirl a VERY small amount of butter in the pan. Heat pan. Add about 2 Tbs (I use a small ladle) of batter and swirl to coat the pan until it stops swirling. Put over heat and cook until the edges start to brown slightly. You can turn them if you'd like, or simply turn out onto a plate.
9. Can be kept up to a week in the fridge or two months in the freezer. They freeze very well!
10. You could omit the vanilla and sugar and make savory crepes.
title: Simple Delicious Crepes

steps: 1. Brown sausage.
2. Cube or break bread in an oblong baking dish. Place sausage on top of bread.
3. Mix eggs, salt and milk in a bowl. Pour mixture over the bread and sausage.
4. Top with cheese. Mixture will be soupy.
5. Cover and put in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes the following morning.
title: "Breakfast The Morning After" Quiche

steps: 1. In a large bowl, sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Stir in the remaining ingredients; mix until smooth.

2. Heat a lightly oiled griddle or frying pan over medium high heat. Pour or scoop the batter onto the griddle, using approximately 1/4 cup for each crepe. Tilt the pan with a circular motion so that the batter coats the surface evenly.

3. Cook the crepe for about 2 minutes, until the bottom is light brown. Loosen with a spatula, turn and cook the other side. Stack the finished crepes by putting wax paper between each one. Keep covered with a dry cloth until ready to eat.
title: Regular Crepes

steps: 1. Heat together, over medium heat, the milk and butter JUST until the butter has melted.
2. Remove from heat.
3. Add a little of the butter/milk to the beaten eggs.
4. Continue adding more of the butter/milk to the egg, slowly to avoid cooking the eggs.
5. Mix flour, baking powder and salt.
6. Add wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and whisk well or blend with an electric hand blender.
7. Heat skillet with a little butter on medium high until a few drops of water sprinkled on the surface sizzle.
8. Pour 1/4 cup of crepe mixture into middle of pan and swirl it around to make a thin crepe.
9. Loosen edges with a spatula and flip as desired - if you want a lighter golden crepe or browned and crisper crepe.
10. Cook no more than 20 seconds on the second side.
11. Stack in 200 degree oven, if you want to make a lot at once.
12. Batter can be stored in the refrigerator for up to a day or 2.
13. These are great with just melted butter and sugar sprinkled lightly over them.
14. or with fillings - such as apples with cinnamon and sugar and melted gruyere cheese.
15. or with emmenthal cheese and asparagus or broccoli or mushrooms.
16. or for a quick sweet snack for kids.
17. HINT: no need to buy a sifter - just shake the flour through a sieve.
title: Try Mine 15 Minute Crepes!

steps: 1. Combine sweet potatoes, sugar, eggs, milk, salt and vanilla and mix well.
2. Pour into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
3. Combine brown sugar, flour, pecans and butter and mix well.
4. Spread over sweet potato mixture.
5. Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes.
6. Serves 8.
title: Sweet Potato Souffle

ingredients.text: 4 medium cooking apples, peeled, cored and sliced

steps: 1. Place apples in a 9-inch deep pie dish.
2. Sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon and brandy.
3. Let stand for 1 hour.
4. Beat together the butter and sugar.
5. Add eggs and vanilla and beat for 2 minutes. Fold in the flour and baking powder.
6. Pour this mixture over the apples and bake, uncovered, at 375° for 35 minutes.
7. Dust with confectioners sugar.
8. Serve hot with vanilla ice cream or sweetened whipped cream.
9. Serves 4. Can easily be doubled.
title: Generon(French Apple Cobbler)

2. Pour into baking dish and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
3. Top with marshmallows and bake until just melted.
4. Yields 8 servings.
title: Sweet Potato Souffle

6. Spoon into buttered 3-quart baking dish.

9. Bake at 375° until golden brown.

title: Sweet Potato Souffle

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together, spoon into greased 1-quart baking dish and cover with topping.
2. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Yields 4 servings.

steps: 1. Cream oleo (or butter) and sugar. Add other ingredients in order. Mix and place in an uncooked 8-inch pie crust. Cook in an oven for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 300° and continue cooking for approximately 45 minutes. Remove from oven and cool before serving. Serves 6. Can do ahead.
title: French Coconut Pie

2. Combine flour, baking powder and salt; add to eggs and mix well.

2. Chill.

title: French Cherry Tart

steps: 1. Combine sweet potatoes, celery and salt; mix well and stir in milk.

3. Dip in melted butter and roll each in corn flakes.

title: Sweet Potato Croquettes

title: Gaufrettes(French Waffle Cookies)

steps: 1. Mix first 3 ingredients and divide into halves.

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
2. Mix flour, sugar, and salt together in a bowl; add milk and eggs in that order. Stir until just a few lumps remain in the batter.
3. Melt butter in a 9- or 10-inch oven-proof skillet over medium heat. Pour batter into skillet and wait for 1 minute.

2. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise. Scoop out the pulp; discard shell. In a large bowl, mash pulp with butter. Stir in the remaining ingredients.

steps: 1. Thoroughly mix spices with meat. Form meat into balls 1 1/2 to 2-inches.
2. Roll each ball in flour, packing firmly.
3. Brown balls on all sides in Dutch oven. Cover with water.

steps: 1. Into mayonnaise, beat oil.

steps: 1. Cream butter or margarine.
2. Gradually add confectioners sugar, creaming well.
3. Add egg; mix thoroughly.
4. Blend in melted chocolate and vanilla.
5. Beat until of spreading consistency.
6. Thin with milk, if necessary.

steps: 1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl; set aside.
2. Peel beets under running water to prevent hands from staining; shred beets.
3. Combine cabbage and beets in a bowl; add oil mixture, and toss. Serve immediately.
title: French Vinaigrette Slaw

steps: 1. In large saucepan,melt butter. Whisk in flour; add milk and broth slowly and whisk to avoid lumps. Add nutmeg, black pepper, sea salt, and lemon juice. Thicken this cream sauce over low heat, then remove from heat to cool.

2. In a large bowl, combine the minced turkey with 1 cup of the cooled cream sauce, grated onion, poultry seasoning, italian seasoning, and hot sauce. The mixture should just hold together. Add salt and pepper to taste and chill 15 minutes.
3. While turkey is chilling, add thawed package of peas to the rest of the cream sauce. Cover and simmer on very low heat.
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

5. With wet hands form the individual croquettes. I use a 1/4 cup scoop per croquette. Form a ballish shape; roll lightly in flour, then in beaten egg (with just a little water) and roll in breadcrumbs. Form the shape of a large gumdrop or "haystack" and place on a cookie sheet coated with non-stick spray.
6. Bake croquettes in middle rack of the oven approximately 25 minutes. Serve hot with cream sauce on top (about 2-3 per person) and a dash of paprika.
7. NOTE: Extra peas and cream sauce can be used as an elegant vegetable dish the next day by adding cooked baby carrots and pearl onions.
title: Turkey Croquettes With Cream Sauce

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
2. Whisk egg yolks and 1 tablespoon sugar together in a bowl until sugar is dissolved. Whisk in eggnog, cream, and vanilla extract until thoroughly combined.
3. Pour eggnog mixture into 4 ramekins. Place ramekins in baking dish; pour in enough boiling water to come half way up the sides of ramekins.
4. Bake in the preheated oven until set, about 1 hour. Cool slightly, cover ramekins with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 4 hours.
5. Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler.

6. Remove plastic wrap from ramekins. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of sugar in a thin layer over top of each ramekin. Brown the sugar using a kitchen torch or under a broiler until golden and caramelized, 30 seconds to 1 minute.
title: Easy Eggnog Creme Brulee

steps: 1. Mix cocoa and sugar well.
2. Blend into milk.
3. Add nuts and vanilla and mix well.
4. Roll into small balls, then roll in the cocoa and powdered sugar.
title: French Cocoa Balls

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well.
2. Pour into pie shell and bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.
title: French Cocoa Pie

ingredients.text: 2 large baking potatoes, peeled and sliced

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Butter a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass baking dish.
3. Overlap 1/3 of potatoes in dish.
4. Season with salt and pepper.
5. Sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon dill weed and 1/3 of cheese. Repeat everything.
6. Whisk cream, broth and mustard in bowl.
7. Pour over potatoes.
8. Bake until tender and top is crusty and brown, about 1/2 hour.
title: Potato Gratin With Mustard And Gruyere Cheese

steps: 1. Heat the grill to high. Brown the beef in a deep ovenproof frying pan over a high heat for 5 mins. Meanwhile, prick the aubergine with a fork, then microwave on High for 3-5 mins until soft. Mix the yogurt, egg and parmesan together, then add a little seasoning.

2. Stir the tomatoes, purée and potatoes in with the beef with some seasoning and heat through. Smooth the surface of the beef mixture with the back of a spoon, then slice the cooked aubergine and arrange on top. Pour the yogurt mixture over the aubergines, smooth out evenly, then grill until the topping has set and turned golden.
title: Moussaka

steps: 1. Pour the honey, brandy, and orange blossom water into a large saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Stir, reduce the heat, and gently boil until the mixture is the color of burnished mahogany and spins off a spoon, 240°F on a candy thermometer, about 30 minutes.

2. Stir in the almonds and bring to a boil again. Remove the pan from the heat and let the mixture cool until it is no longer bubbling. Turn it out onto a large plate, allowing the almonds to spread out evenly. Cool until the mixture is thick enough to spoon up in "globs," several hours or overnight.

3. To serve, offer each diner a clean spoon or knife as you pass the platter of koufeta around. Each person slides the knife or spoon into the taffy and spins the implement until a scoop of the koufeta takes hold. The koufeta is then eaten off the knife or spoon. Serves 10 to 20.
4. NOTES: Koufeta will keep, covered at room temperature for up to 2 days.
5. Some villages add a little toasted sesame seed in the koufeta mixture or sprinkle it on top once the mixture is poured onto the platter.
6. Adventures in Greek cooking.
title: Greek Koufeta (Wedding Almond “Taffy” From Cyclades Islands)

steps: 1. Cook carrots and garlic in salted water until tender; drain well.
2. Make carrots into a smooth mixture with a masher or stick blender until smooth while adding butter and broth.
3. Add olives and cook over low heat just until warm.
4. Yield:
5. 4 to 6 servings.
title: Carrot Puree With Kalamata Olives

steps: 1. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the lemon juice, oil, mustard, 1-1/4 teaspoons garlic and oregano; add the pork. Seal bag and turn to coat; refrigerate for 2 hours.
2. In a small bowl, combine the cucumber, yogurt, salt, dill and remaining garlic; cover and refrigerate until serving.
3. Drain and discard marinade. Using long-handled tongs, moisten a paper towel with cooking oil and lightly coat the grill rack. Prepare the grill for indirect heat using a drip pan.

4. Grill tenderloin, uncovered, over direct medium-high for 2-3 minutes on each side. Place meat over drip pan and grill, covered, over indirect medium-hot heat for 10-15 minutes longer or until a thermometer reads 160°. Let stand for 5 minutes.

5. Meanwhile, wrap tortillas in foil; place on grill for 1-2 minutes on each side or until warmed. Slice tenderloin into strips; place on tortillas. Top each with 3 tablespoons yogurt sauce and 1 tablespoon green onions.
title: Greek Pork Wraps

ingredients.text: 1 small lemon, in wedges, for garnish

steps: 1. In large pot, saute onion in olive oil until translucent.
2. Add chicken and brown on all sides.
3. Add garlic and saute 30 seconds.
4. Add tomato paste, water, salt and pepper.
5. Simmer 30 minutes, covered.
6. Add orzo and stir regularly until orzo is tender.
7. Serve sprinkled with parsley and lemon wedges on the side.
title: Greek Chicken And Orzo - Kota Manestra

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 cups tomatoes, peeled chopped or 1 1/2 cups canned tomatoes

steps: 1. In a pot of boiling water, add shrimp and cook for 1 minute. Drain well. Place shrimp on bottom of greased baking dish in single layer. Set aside.
2. In a skillet heat oil. Add garlic, onion and red pepper flakes. Cook until veggies are soft.
3. Add oregano, basil, salt and pepper. Stir and cook one minute.
4. Add wine and bring to boil. Cook for 2 minutes.
5. Add tomatoes and stir well. Reduce heat to low and simmer 8 minutes. Most of liquid should evaporate.
6. Pour mixture over shrimp in baking dish. Top with feta cheese.
7. Bake, uncovered, at 325 degrees for 15 minutes.
8. Serve.

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Lightly grease a shallow 8-cup ovenproof dish. Place beets, onion, thyme, vinegar and sugar in a roasting dish. Drizzle with oil and toss to coat. Season to taste. In a bowl, combine breadcrumbs, feta, oil and lemon zest. Season to taste. Sprinkle evenly on beet mixture. Roast 20-25 mins, until topping is golden and crisp. Sprinkle with extra thyme to serve.

3. Place pepper halves, skin sides up, on a foil-lined baking sheet; flatten with hand.
4. Broil 15 minutes or until blackened. Place in a zip-top plastic bag; seal. Let stand 15 minutes. Peel and finely chop.

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350.
2. Spread the breads with the pesto.
3. Top with desired amounts of black olives, red onion, tomatoes, and feta cheese.
4. Lastly, cover with mozzarella.

6. Note: You can substitute the sun dried tomatoes with fresh, diced tomatoes if you prefer.

1 pound can peeled chopped tomatoes (or fresh, 1 lb.)

2. In med. saucepan, combine next 2 ingredients. Gradually stir in milk. Cook and stir over med. heat until mixture thickens (DO NOT BOIL).

4. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes.
title: Greek Macaroni Bake

ingredients.text: 4 (4 ounce) boneless skinless chicken breast halves

steps: 1. Place each chicken breast half between 2 sheets of plastic wrap; flatten to 1/4 inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin.
2. Combine the flour and oregano in a shallow dish, dredge chicken in flour mixture.
3. Heat oil in a large nonstick fry pan over medium high heat.

steps: 1. Pre heat the oven to 200c. Peel and de seed the squash, chop into chunks and place into a baking tray. Add the coconut oil and bake for 40 - 45 minutes till soft. Set aside but leave the oven on.
2. Add the lentils, chopped tomatoes and Italian seasoning to a large pan. Add the butternut squash and simmer.
3. Prepare a large baking dish. Thinly slice the courgette length ways. You could also use a vegetable peeler to create long wide ribbons or use a mandolin.

4. Layer the courgette slices to cover the bottom of the dish. Follow with half the lentil mixture. Cover with another layer of courgette slices. Add the rest of the lentil mixture, and if you like, add a few more slices of courgette in a criss cross pattern over the top.
5. Turn the oven down to 180 and bake for 30 minutes. Take out of the oven and crumble over the feta cheese. Turn the heat up to 220 and bake for a further 5-10 minutes until the feta is a bit melt
6. Serve with a fresh green salad.
title: Butternut, Lentil & Feta Pasta Free Lasagne

steps: 1. In a glass dish, mix the olive oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, oregano, and lemon juice. Place the chicken pieces in the mixture, cover, and marinate in the refrigerator 8 hours or overnight.
2. Preheat grill for high heat.
3. Lightly oil the grill grate. Place chicken on the grill, and discard the marinade. Cook chicken pieces up to 15 minutes per side, until juices run clear. Smaller pieces will not take as long.

steps: 1. In a small container, stir the yeast into 1/2 cup of warm water, then whisk in 1/4 cup of flour to make the sponge. Leave it in a warm place for 1 hour or until it has doubled in size.
2. When sponge is ready, in a large mixing bowl whisk together the remaining flour & the salt, then make a well in the center.
3. Into the well, add the sponge, along with 3-4 tablespoons water, the oil & sugar, gradually incorporating the flour into the other ingredients.
4. Knead for 10-15 minutes or until the dough is smooth & elastic, then leave it in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
5. When ready, punch the dough down & divide it into 8 pieces. Lightly flour a working surface AND hands & roll each piece into a sausage shape, then let rest 10-15 minutes.
6. After that, roll the dough into a longer sausage shape ~ You will probably have to let the rolls rest once more in order to stretch them to the length they need to be, 20-25 inches long.

7. During the 15 minutes that the dough is resting for the last time, line a large baking sheet with parchment paper, then spread the sesame seeds in a large baking dish & have the egg whites ready in a wide, shallow bowl.

8. Dip the long rolls into the egg white & then roll them in the sesame seeds. Twist 2 of them together & join the ends to form a ring about 4-5 inches in diameter. Shape the remaining rolls in the same way, then let them rise for about half an hour.
9. About half way through this rising, preheat the oven to 400 degrees F.

10. When ready, bake the galettes for 15-20 minutes or until golden & slightly crisp on the outside. Let cool on a wire rack & serve at room temperature the same day OR freeze for later use. Simply reheat before serving any that have been frozen & then defrosted.
title: Koulouria -- Greek Sesame Galettes

Add the scallions and cook over moderately high heat, stirring frequently, until softened, about 2 minutes. Add the garlic and cook, stirring for 1 minute longer. Spread the mixture in the prepared baking dish and arrange the shrimp on top. Sprinkle with the tomato and feta. In a bowl, beat the eggs with the dill, hot pepper sauce, salt and black pepper. Beat in the cream. Spoon the custard over the shrimp. The shrimp should be at least halfway covered with the custard. Sprinkle with the Parmesan cheese. Bake for 17 minutes, until the custard is set and the shrimp are cooked through. Let the casserole stand for 5 minutes before serving.

Garnish each serving with 1/2 teaspoon sliced basil, if desired. Serve immediately.

steps: 1. Pour milk into a large sauce pot over medium-high heat.
2. Heat the milk, stirring occasionally, until it reaches 180 degrees.
3. Remove from heat and cool to between 110-120 degrees, still stirring occasionally.
4. Once the temperature reaches that range, add the yogurt and milk powder.
5. Whisk until smooth and then pour into a bowl with a lid.
6. Wrap in thick kitchen towels and place in a preheated oven. (You can preheat it to any temp, you just want the oven to be warm to keep the yogurt warm).
7. Allow it to sit undisturbed in the oven for 8-12 hours (I left it for a little over 13 hours with no problem).
8. Remove it from the oven and strain in a mesh strainer or colander lined with a coffee filter or paper towels (you can also use cheese cloth, I just never have any).
9. Drain for about an hour or two depending on how dry you like your yogurt.
10. Place in a lidded storage container and keep in the fridge for up to a week.

steps: 1. Heat milk and cream until almost boiling, stirring regularly, about 5 minutes.
2. Fill a large bowl halfway with ice and water. Place a smaller, sterilized bowl over the ice bath for the milk.
3. Pour hot milk into the smaller bowl. Cool until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the milk reads 110 to 120 degrees F (43 to 49 degrees C).

4. Place yogurt in a separate bowl; mix in enough of the cooled milk until smooth. Pour mixture back into the bowl of milk; remove from ice. Let yogurt rest in a warm place while maintaining a temperature between 110 to 120 degrees F (43 to 49 degrees C), until firm, 6 to 8 hours.
5. Line a strainer with a coffee filter and place over a bowl. Place yogurt in the filter and cover top loosely. Refrigerate until desired thickness is achieved, 6 to 8 hours.

4. Add eggplant to same skillet and saute for 5-6 minutes or until eggplant starts to soften.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup plain yogurt, at room temperature

steps: 1. Heat 2 quarts milk in a saucepan over medium heat until a candy thermometer inserted in the liquid reads between 180 and 190 degrees F (82 to 88 degrees C), 8 to 12 minutes. Remove from heat.
2. Whisk powdered milk and honey into the warm milk. Let cool until the thermometer reads between 115 and 120 degrees F (46 to 49 degrees C), about 1 hour and 15 minutes.

3. Whisk a small portion of the warm milk mixture into the yogurt; stir mixture back into the saucepan. Transfer mixture into a warm slow cooker. Wrap slow cooker in a bath towel and tuck it away into a microwave or oven. Let sit until thickened into yogurt, 6 to 9 hours.
4. Line a colander with cheesecloth or coffee filters and set over a bowl. Pour the yogurt into the colander and refrigerate colander and bowl until desired consistency is reached, 4 to 8 hours.
title: Homemade Honey Greek Yogurt

2. Preheat oven to 350°F.
3. Combine ground walnuts and orange peel in a medium bowl. Stir in 1/4 cup syrup; set aside.

4. In a large mixing bowl, beat butter for 30 seconds or until softened. Add half the flour. Add remaining 1/2 cup sugar, remaining 1/4 cup orange juice, brandy, baking powder, baking soda, ground cinnamon, ground cloves and ground nutmeg. Beat until well blended. Beat or stir in remaining flour.

5. Form dough into 1-1/4" balls. Using finger, press hole in center of ball of dough. Place about 1/2 teaspoon ground nut filling in hole. Bring dough up around filling, enclosing completely. Place seam side down on greased baking sheet. With knife, crisscross top, forming an "x," scoring surface only. Repeat with remaining dough and filling.
6. Bake at 350 F for 18 to 20 minutes, or until set.
