Cook for 10-15 mins, turning with tongs every time a side becomes charred, until the peppers are black all over. Tip into a bowl and cover until cool. Peel off the skin with your fingers, then tear the peppers in half, scrape away the seeds with a knife and discard the stem. Cut into thick strips and set aside.

2. 2. Peel the potatoes and thinly slice into discs. Put half the oil and all the potatoes in a large, non-stick frying pan and place on a very low heat. Cook the potatoes very gently for 10-15 mins so they are just sizzling quietly. Use a wooden spatula to turn them occasionally while they are cooking. The potatoes are ready when they are tender and starting to break up. Set the potatoes aside.

3. 3. Crack the eggs into a bowl, season, then whisk together until the whites and yolks have mixed. Tip potatoes and peppers into the eggs and stir. Put the pan on a low heat with the remaining oil. Pour in the egg mixture and cook gently for about 5 mins, using a wooden spatula to ripple the cooked egg from the outside into the middle. Remove from the heat.

4. 4. Crumble the feta over the tortilla and place the pan under the grill. Cook for 4-5 mins until the top no longer wobbles and the cheese has browned. leave the tortilla to relax for a few mins, then use the spatula to lift it onto a board. Cut into wedges and serve.

steps: 1. Put all the minced herbs in a heavy saucepan.

3. Bring it to a simmer over medium heat, stirring every now and again.

10. Keep in the fridge at least 1 day to develop the flavors.
11. Keep this oil in the fridge.

ingredients.text: 3 pounds potatoes, peeled and cut into thick wedges

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
2. Put potato wedges into a large bowl. Drizzle olive oil and lemon juice over the wedges and toss to coat. Season potatoes with salt, oregano, and black pepper; toss again to coat.
3. Spread potato wedges in a single layer in a 2 inch-deep pan. Pour chicken broth over the potatoes.
4. Roast potatoes in preheated oven until tender and golden brown, about 1 hour.
title: Greek-Style Lemon Roasted Potatoes

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F.
2. Cut the potatoes lengthwise into thick wedges; place in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish.
3. Wisk together the remaining ingredients and pour over the potatoes, coating evenly.
4. Bake for approximately 2 hours or until tender, turning occasionally. Add water as needed if the pan is getting dry.
5. I like my potatoes to have some colour, so I will broil them for a few minutes at the end until I get my desired result.
title: Greek Roasted Potatoes

ingredients.text: 5 cups romaine lettuce, washed and roughly chopped
1 None onion, peeled and sliced into thin rings
1/2 None avocado, peeled, stoned and sliced
2 tbsp shredded fresh basil leaves, plus extra leaves, to garnish
1 2/3 cups reduced fat feta cheese, cubed

steps: 1. Toss the lettuce, onion, tomatoes, olives, avocado, basil and feta cheese in a large bowl. In another bowl, mix together the vinegar and stock with the sugar and season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Pour over the salad and toss gently to mix.
2. Divide the salad between four serving bowls and sprinkle with more freshly ground black pepper and garnish with basil leaves.
title: Greek Salad With Avocado

steps: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together the lemon juice oil and salt.
2. Add the lettuce, dill and scallions, tossing well. Add the feta and toss again.
title: Greek Style Romaine Salad With Lemon And Fresh Dill

ingredients.text: 1-1/2 cups uncooked long grain brown rice
6 ounces fresh baby spinach (about 8 cups), coarsely chopped

steps: 1. In a saucepan, combine rice and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, covered, until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 35-40 minutes.
2. Meanwhile, place vinegars, garlic, pepper and salt in bowl and whisk together. While whisking, gradually add oil in a steady stream. Stir in basil.
3. Place spinach in a large bowl; add cooked rice. Stir in tomatoes, green onions and dressing; toss until spinach is wilted. Gently stir in feta. Loosely cover and refrigerate 2 hours or until cold.
title: Mediterranean Brown Rice Salad

steps: 1. Combine flour, salt, pepper and sugar in large bowl; rub in butter.
2. Stir in cheese, spinach, buttermilk and enough water to make a soft sticky dough.
3. Turn dough onto floured surface, knead until just smooth.
4. Divide dough in half, place in greased disposable baking dish, press each half into a 10cm round.
5. Cut a cross in dough, about 1cm deep.
6. Brush with a little extra buttermilk, then sift a little extra flour over dough.
7. Cook in covered barbecue, using indirect heat, following manufacturers instructions for about 40 minutes.
title: Peppered Spinach And Feta Damper

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, bring 4 cups water to a boil. Add green beans; cook, uncovered, 4-5 minutes or until beans turn bright green. Remove beans and immediately drop into ice water. Drain and pat dry.
2. In a large skillet, heat butter over medium heat. Add onion; cook and stir 6-8 minutes or until tender. Add garlic; cook 1 minute longer.
3. Add green beans and almonds; cook and stir 3-4 minutes or until beans are crisp-tender. Sprinkle with lemon zest, lemon juice, salt and pepper; toss to combine. Top with cheese.
title: Lemony Almond-Feta Green Beans

ingredients.text: 8 ears of fresh sweet corn, ends of husks trimmed and silk removed

steps: 1. grill corn in husks for about 10 minutes or until husks start to brown. Peel back the husks, but do not remove. Combine Hellmann's mayonnaise with cayenne pepper and brush on each ear of corn. Put corn back on heat and grill until bubbly and brown. Take off grill and roll in crumbled feta cheese. Squeeze on fresh lime juice. Eat while hot. Absolutely delicious---
title: Grilled Corn With Feta And Lime

ingredients.text: 1 head iceberg lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
1 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped

steps: 1. Rub interior of large wooden salad bowl with cut side of garlic.
2. Add and toss remaining ingredients.
title: Vegetable Salad With Feta Cheese(Makes 6 To 8 Servings)

steps: 1. In a medium saucepan, bring the chicken stock, salt, garlic and oil to a boil. Add long-grain white rice; return to a boil.
2. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat.
3. Stir in remaining ingredients. Serve hot.
title: Greek Rice For Lovers Of Greek Cuisine

steps: 1. Chop green onion, bell pepper and parsley; slice cooked potatoes.
2. Toss with mayonnaise.
3. Use more mayonnaise if needed.
title: Greek Potato Salad

ingredients.text: 2 large cooked chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces

steps: 1. Combine water and garlic in a pot over high heat. Bring to a boil. Stir in quinoa; reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and simmer until quinoa is tender and water has been absorbed, 15 to 20 minutes.
2. Scrape quinoa into a large bowl. Stir in chicken, green bell pepper, red onion, olives, parsley, chives, and salt.
3. Mix lemon juice, olive oil, and vinegar together in a separate bowl. Drizzle dressing over the quinoa mixture; stir until salad is evenly mixed.
title: Ltf Dtox: Mediterranean Chicken Quinoa Salad

steps: 1. Bring water to a boil. Peel the carrots and cut them in half and lengthways. Peel the potatoes and cut them in one quater of the size. Boil the veggies for 10 min.
2. Toss the veggies in olive oil. Place them in the oven-safe dish. Sprinkle rosemary and season with sea salt and pepper.
3. Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 min until the carrots and potatoes are lightly gold and crispy.
title: Weekday Vegetarian Roast And Mediterranean Salada

steps: 1. Slice tomatoes, paprika and cucumbers into small cubes (about 1,5 to 2 cm large). Put them in a salad bowl and rasp feta cheese over it.
title: Quick And Easy Mixed Salad With Feta Cheese

steps: 1. Wash the lettuce thoroughly and blot dry. Cut the cucumber into quarters lengthways, then into bite-size pieces. Halve the pepper, if using, remove core and seeds and cut into thick slices.
2. Tear the lettuce into bite-sized pieces and place in serving bowl with cucumber, pepper, feta cheese and olives.
3. Combine the oil, lemon juice, crushed/minced garlic, and black pepper, whisking until thick. Pour over salad, toss gently, serve immediately.
title: Greek Country Salad

steps: 1. Place whole chicken in a large pot. Add enough water to cover. Add garlic powder, oregano, salt and pepper. Cover pot and bring to a rolling boil over medium high heat.
2. Lower heat to medium low and let chicken simmer for 3 to 3 1/2 hours to make a nice, rich chicken stock. Remove chicken from pot and strain broth.
3. Return broth to medium high heat and add celery and carrots. Bring to a low boil and cook for about 20 minutes or until celery and carrots are tender.

4. Finely dice chicken breast until you have about 1 cup chicken. Save the rest of the cooked chicken for another recipe. Ideally, you do not want chunks of chicken for this recipe, so dice and shred the chicken. Add to the soup. Stir in rice and cook an additional 20-25 minutes or until the rice is done.
5. Remove from heat and let cool a bit. Stir with a wooden spoon to cool the soup slightly.
6. Juice lemons and remove seeds; set aside in a bowl.
7. Separate the eggs. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. With the beater running, pour in yolks and mix lightly. Pour 1/2 cup hot broth into the beaten eggs and stir.

8. Keep stirring while you add the lemon juice. While stirring the broth (you may need to enlist someone's help with this), slowly pour in egg-lemon mixture. Stir gently, you want the eggs to stay on top.
9. Cover and let simmer for about 10 minutes over low heat. Sprinkle some black pepper on top. Serve and enjoy!
title: Avgolemono Soup (Greek Egg Lemon Soup)

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, add the tomatoes, onion, celery and garlic with the oil.
2. Cover and cook over a low heat for around 40-45 minutes, gently shaking or moving the pan every now and then, until very soft.
3. In a blender or food processor, add the vegetables and process until smooth.
4. Press firmly through a sieve.
5. Return veggies to pan.
6. Stir in stock and the tomato puree, bring to the boil.
7. Add the pasta shapes and simmer on low heat for 7-10 minutes or until pasta is tender (al dente).
8. Serve hot.
title: Mediterranean Tomato Soup

ingredients.text: 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, divided
1 yellow squash, cut into thick sticks

steps: 1. Bring water and wild rice to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender, 30 to 45 minutes. Drain excess liquid, fluff rice with a fork, and cook uncovered 5 minutes more.

2. Heat 1 tablespoon sesame oil in a heavy skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat; cook and stir onion until lightly browned and tender, about 10 minutes. Add raisins, honey, cinnamon, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper to onion; reduce heat to medium-low and cook until raisins are tender, about 4 minutes. Transfer mixture to a bowl and keep warm.

3. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon sesame oil and olive oil in the same skillet over medium-high heat; add squash, turnips, and carrots. Cook and stir squash mixture until squash is just tender, 5 to 10 minutes. Reduce heat to medium; add poblano pepper, cilantro, cumin, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper. Cook and stir mixture until turnips and carrots are tender, 5 to 10 minutes more.
4. Stir onion mixture and wild rice into turnip mixture and cook until heated through, 2 to 3 minutes.
title: Mediterranean Rice

steps: 1. Cook your Bow tie pasta about 11 minutes (firm but not al dente) drain and toss in large bowl with the olive oil to keep from sticking together. Put aside and let cool to room temperature.

2. While pasta is cooking combine sugar and red wine vinegar in small sauce pan and boil until sugar has completely dissolved. you may want to reduce just a little to syrupy stage. Put aside and let cool to room temperature.
3. Trim asparagus, cut into about 1" to 2" pieces and steam for about 6 minutes or to desired firmness. Put aside and let cool to room temperature
4. Cube feta into small to medium size chunks.
5. Dice peppers into small to medium sized pieces
6. Slice the sun dried tomatoes into fine slices.
7. Toss all ingredients together in large bowl and serve at room temperature.
title: Feta Pasta Salad

ingredients.text: 1.5 oz pitted black olives, thinly sliced

steps: 1. Slice the squash lengthways as thinly as possible. Cut the feta into 3 in x 1 inch pieces and wrap each piece in a slice of squash.
2. Place the squash wraps on a foil lined grill pan, add the tomatoes and olives and half the thyme. Drizzle with olive oil, season and grill for 15-20 minutes. Serve sprinkled with extra thyme.
title: Grilled Veggies And Feta

ingredients.text: 1 small cucumber, peeled, seeded, and finely chopped

steps: 1. In a medium saucepan, bring 2 1/2 cups water to a boil. Add 1/2 tsp. salt and the rice. Turn heat to low, cover, and simmer 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let sit 5 minutes. Uncover and fluff with a fork.
2. In a large bowl, whisk lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, oregano, pepper, pepper flakes, and remaining tsp. salt.

3. Add rice to dressing and toss to combine. Add spinach, toss, and let sit until no longer steaming, about 20 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and toss to combine. Serve at room temperature or cold.
4. Note: Nutritional analysis is per serving.
title: Mediterranean Rice Salad

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon fresh thyme, or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 400°.

2. Place a 10- to 12- inch oven-safe skillet (or saute pan!) on the stove over medium-high heat. Coat the bottom with olive oil. When the oil is hot, add the onions and a pinch of salt, and saute until the onions are translucent and starting to turn brown. Add the potatoes and another pinch of salt, and cook, stirring every few minutes, until the potatoes are browned and cooked through. Add the red peppers and the thyme - I like the red peppers still crunchy, but cook them for longer if you like softer peppers. Taste to adjust the seasonings.

3. Pour the eggs into the pan and stir the vegetables until the eggs are evenly distributed. Sprinkle the feta over the top of the frittata. Cook without stirring for 3-5 minutes until the eggs are set on the bottoms and sides, but the middle is still runny.

4. Put the entire pan in the oven and bake for 5 - 10 minutes until the eggs are completely set and beginning to pull away from the sides. Let the frittata cool for a few minutes and then slice it into wedges.
5. We like to serve frittatas with a simple green salad and a crusty piece of bread. Leftovers are also excellent eaten hot or cold!
title: Potato Red Pepper And Feta Frittata

ingredients.text: 1 (10 ounce) potato, peeled and coarsely chopped

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Lightly grease a 10-inch square baking dish and line it with parchment paper.

2. Place the pumpkin in a microwave-safe bowl; cover and cook in microwave on full power, stirring halfway through cooking time, until tender, about 5 minutes. Place the potato in a microwave-safe bowl; cover and cook in microwave on full power until tender enough to pierce with a fork, about 4 minutes.
3. Combine the pumpkin and potato in a large bowl. Add the spinach, feta cheese, Cheddar cheese, and eggs; stir. Transfer mixture to prepared dish; top with sliced onion.
4. Bake in preheated oven until firm, about 25 minutes. Allow to rest 5 minutes before serving.
title: Pumpkin, Spinach, And Feta Frittata

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons feta cheese (I used low fat feta)

steps: 1. In a small bowl combine first 5 ingredients (egg - salt).
2. Spray a small skillet with Pam and head over medium heat.
3. Add egg mixture to skillet, cooking until bottom of eggs is firm (5-10 minutes). Flip omelet and cook other side until set (3-5 minutes).
4. Put cheese on one half of omelet and flip over other half.
5. Cut in half to serve.
title: Spinach And Feta Omelet (Ww)

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a large, non-stick frying pan, add the peppers and cook over a medium heat for 15 mins until softened and lightly coloured. Scatter over the feta.

2. Combine the eggs, cream and herbs, then season well. Pour over the pepper mixture, reduce the heat and cook for 15-20 mins until just set. Cook the top under a pre-heated broiler for 5 mins until just golden. Cut into thick wedges and serve.
title: Feta And Pepper Frittata

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 200°F. Preheat waffle maker.
2. Add flour, baking powder, sugar and cornstarch to a large bowl. In a medium bowl, combine eggs, Greek yogurt, vanilla and milk. Whisk to combine.
3. Make a well in the dry ingredients and at the wet to the dry. Whisk batter until combined. (Make sure not to over-mix.)
4. Add batter to the waffle maker and cook in batches. Store cooked waffles in the oven to stay crisp. I place mine directly on the oven rack.
5. Serve waffles immediately with whipped cream, fruit and syrup.
title: Greek Yogurt Waffles

steps: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a small pan over medium heat.
2. Mix the egg whites and paprika together; pour mixture into pan.
3. After one minute, place the basil leaves over the egg whites.
4. Once the egg whites start to form, spread out the sliced avocado on top and sprinkle with feta cheese.
5. Let cook for 3 minutes and then remove from heat.
6. Fold half of omelet over and serve.
title: Avocado & Feta Omelet

steps: 1. Preheat broiler to high. Combine egg whites, eggs, salt, pepper, and milk; stir with a whisk.
2. Heat a 9-inch cast-iron skillet over -medium heat.
3. Layer in asparagus, shallots, and green onions.
4. Sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese.
5. Carefully pour egg mixture over cheese. Cook over medium heat 5 to 6 -minutes or until eggs are partially set; then broil 5 inches from heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until browned and almost set.
title: Feta, Green Onion, And Asparagus Frittata

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup spinach leaves, coarsely chopped (a few chopped basil leaves perks it up even more)
2 tablespoons reduced-fat feta cheese (the tomato-basil flavor is really good)

steps: 1. Melt 1 teaspoon of butter in a shallow frying pan.
2. Add the onion and saute until crisp tender.
3. Add the tomato and saute until heated through, about 1 minute.
4. Add the spinach and toss until wilted, about 1 minute.
5. Remove veggies from pan and keep warm.
6. Melt another teaspoon of butter in the frying pan.
7. Lightly whip the eggs with the water. Add seasonings to taste.
8. Pour eggs into the skillet and cook over medium heat until the edges start to set.
9. Lift up the edges, letting the uncooked eggs run underneath.
10. When the eggs are ALMOST set, top with the feta cheese.
11. Spread reserved vegetables over 1/2 of omelet and fold it over.
12. Slide it onto a plate and dig in!
title: Greek Omelet For 1

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons whipping cream (or use half-and-half or 2 tablespoons cold water)
1/8 teaspoon dried oregano (or use 2-3 teaspoons chopped fresh)
1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper (or to taste)

steps: 1. In a bowl whisk eggs with whipping cream, baking powder, oregano and black pepper until well combined; allow to sit for 5 minutes.
2. In a medium skillet melt butter over medium heat until sizzling.

3. Whisk/stir the egg mixture one more time then pour into hot skillet; cook without stirring for 3 minutes or until almost set, gently lifting the edge of the eggs with a spatula to allow any uncooked egg to flow underneath.
4. On one side of the ometette sprinkle the feta cheese and olives.
5. Lift the uncovered half over the cheese and olives and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
6. Slide onto a plate.
title: Kittencal'S Greek Feta And Olive Omelette

steps: 1. Combine oats, banana, cinnamon, and salt in a microwave-safe bowl; add water and stir. Cook in microwave until water is absorbed, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir to evenly distribute cinnamon; let stand until slightly cooled, about 3 minutes.
2. Spoon Greek yogurt, strawberry jam, and peanut butter over oatmeal; stir.
title: Greek Yogurt Oatmeal

steps: 1. Toast pecans with 1/2 stick oleo.
2. Mix together the sugar, milk and syrup.
3. Boil for 3 minutes.
4. Remove from heat and add pecans. Add 1/2 stick of oleo and vanilla.
5. Beat until stiff.
6. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper.
7. Cool, then peel clusters off paper. Store in airtight container.
title: Greek Island Candy

ingredients.text: 1 lb confectioners' sugar (sifted to remove lumps)

steps: 1. Cut almond paste into 1/2 inch pieces.
2. In an electric mixer with a paddle, mix the almond paste for a few minutes and then slowly add the confectioner sugar.

3. With the mixer still on add the rose water, continuing to mix until you have a thick dough. Then slowly add the egg whites one at a time until mixture is loose enough to pipe out a pastry bag but not soupy (the consistency of a brownie batter). Depending on the humidity, you will need more or less egg whites.
4. Put mixture into pastry bag and pipe onto a non stick cookie sheet, making small cookies.
5. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven until golden brown, about 20 minutes.
title: Greek Almond Macaroon Cookies (Amygdalota)

steps: 1. Put the warm water in a medium bowl, sprinkle the yeast over the water and stir. When it starts to bubble, add the flour and start to stir with a wooden spoon (or by hand). Add the olive oil slowly until the dough is pliable and smooth. Work in the feta cheese, kneading until evenly distributed throughout the dough. Cover the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes.

2. Place the dough on a lightly oiled cookie sheet and flatten with the palms of the hand. The dough shouldn't be any higher than about 1 1/4 inches. Score the top lightly in squares or diamond shapes. Cover with a towel and allow the dough to rise for one hour.
3. Preheat the oven to 340F (170C).
4. Bake for approximately 30-40 minutes. It should be done on the bottom and nicely browned on top.
title: Feta Cheese Bread

steps: 1. Combine oil, sugar and eggs.
2. Mix well.
3. Sift together flour and baking powder in a separate bowl.
4. Add dry mixture to liquid. Add vanilla and nuts.
5. Mix well.
6. Place batter in 2 aluminum ice cube trays or bread pans.
7. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. After baking, cool, slice and place on a cookie sheet.
8. Bake at 350° until brown (about 5 minutes on each side).
title: Greek Cookies

ingredients.text: 750 g sweet potatoes, cut into 2cm pieces (kumara)
1 red onion, cut into thin wedges
100 g reduced-fat feta cheese, cut into 1cm pieces

steps: 1. Preheat over to 200°C or 180°C fan-forced. Line 2 large baking trays with baking paper. Arrange sweet potato on 1 prepared tray and lightly spray with oil. Bake for 20minutes. Add onion to tray. Bake for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender and lightly browned. Cool for 5 minutes.
2. Place tomatoes on remaining prepared tray and lightly spray with oil. Bake for 30 minutes or until tender and lightly browned.

3. Meanwhile, place sweet potato mixture into a large bowl. Add feta and rosemary and season with freshly grown black pepper. Toss to combine. Lightly spray a 20cm (base measurement) round ovenproof baking dish with oil. arrange sweet potato mixture over base of dish. Poor over egg, pressing vegetables down with a spatula to cover with egg. Bake in oven with tomatoes for 25-35 minutes or until golden and set.
4. Set frittata aside for 5 minutes. Cut into wedges and serve with roasted tomatoes.
title: Sweet Potato, Red Onion & Feta Frittata

steps: 1. In a large bowl, mash the cheese, honey and salt together until well combined.
2. Add the flour and mix until a dough forms.
3. Turn the dough out onto a work surface and knead briefly.
4. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to rest at room temperature for about 20 minutes.
5. Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces.
6. Lightly flour a work surface and roll each piece into a very thin circle about 3 inches in diameter.
7. Lightly oil a nonstick griddle and heat over medium-low heat.
8. Grill each circle until golden or about 1 minute per side.
9. Oil the griddle after each use.
10. Serve warm topped with a dash of honey.
title: Phthois - Honey-Feta Griddle Bread

steps: 1. Coat 12 muffin cups with no-stick spray.
2. Place the onions in a small bowl.
3. Microwave on high for 1 minute.
4. In a medium bowl, mix the buttermilk, egg, honey and oil.
5. In a large bowl, mix the flour, cornmeal, baking soda, cumin, pepper, coriander, oregano and baking powder.
6. Stir in the feta and onions.
7. Pour the buttermilk mixture over the flour mixture.
8. Mix with a rubber spatula until the dry ingredients are moistened.
9. Spoon the batter into the prepared muffin cups, filling them about 3/4 full.
10. Bake at 450 degrees for 15 minutes.
title: Feta Corn Muffins

steps: 1. Sift together flour and baking powder and set aside. In large bowl, cream together butter and sugar. Add 4 egg yolks one at a time, beating well after each one. Add milk and flour.
2. Work with the hands until dough is smooth. Add grated orange rind. Dough should be stiff so add additional flour if needed.
3. Break off small portions of dough and roll out into pencil-size strips about 11 inches long. Fold each strip into thirds, sideways, and press lightly together at ends.
4. Place cookies on ungreased baking sheet. Brush tops with beaten egg. Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 18 to 20 minutes.
title: Greek Easter Cookies From Smyrna

steps: 1. Cream butter. Add sugar gradually.
2. Add eggs one at a time alternately with orange juice.
3. Add flour that has been sifted with soda and baking powder, a little bit at a time. Should be a soft dough.
4. Shape as desired and brush with egg and milk mixture. Traditional Greek cookies are 2 small strands of dough twisted together and brushed with egg-milk mixture and sprinkled with sesame seed.
5. Use greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375 degrees to 400 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes.
title: Sesame Greek Easter Cookies (Koulourakia)

ingredients.text: 8 cups Milk (you may use low fat as it does not affect the taste or consistancy; I used 2 1/2%)

steps: 1. In a 4 quart sauce pan, bring the water to a boil over medium high heat. Add rice. Stir and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the water has evaporated.
2. Lower heat to low and stir in milk, butter and sugar. Cover and cook over low heat for 1 to 1-1/4 hours, stirring occasionally
3. Whip eggs with a fork or whisk. Stir two to three tablespoons of the hot rice mixture into the eggs (so that the eggs do not curdle).
4. Pour the egg mixture slowly into the rice, stirring constantly. Add vanilla. Stir for 2 to 3 minutes and remove from heat.
5. Pour into dessert dishes and sprinkle with cinnamon. Refrigerate when cooled. This recipe makes 10 to 12 one cup servings
title: Rizogalo-Greek Rice Pudding

steps: 1. Mix and layer over each half of bread and let sit overnight in the refrigerator.
2. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted.
title: Greek Bread

ingredients.text: 3 lbs chicken wings, prepared frozen pieces, thawed, rinsed and dried

steps: 1. Place thawed chicken wings into gallon size zip top bag.

2. Combine olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, garlic, salt and pepper in a small mixing bowl. Pour over chicken pieces and seal bag. Refrigerate chicken pieces for at least two hours, turning over at least once during this time.
3. Preheat gas grill on high for five minutes.
4. Remove chicken pieces from marinade and place onto baking sheet lined with paper towels. Discard excess marinade.

5. Turn inside burners to medium low while leaving outside burners on high. Place chicken pieces on middle of grill skin side up. Cover and cook for 7 minutes. Turn pieces over and cook for another 5-7 minutes or until meat thermometer indicates 170 degrees F.
6. Serve while hot and juicy! Enjoy!
title: Grilled Greek Lemon Oregano Chicken Wings

steps: 1. Combined water 1 1/2 c sugar 1 tsp vanilla and lemon juice boil for 10 minutes; cool and set aside.
2. Cream butter and 1 c sugar, add one egg at a time beating after each addition. Add flour, baking powder and salt; beat well then add vanilla and walnuts.
3. Bake in an 8-inch square pan 30 minutes on 350°.
4. As soon as cake is taken from the oven, pour cooled syrup over the cake.
title: Greek Syrup Cake

steps: 1. Put all the ingredients in a jar and cover.
2. Shake thoroughly and chill.
3. Store in refrigerator.
title: Greek Dressing

ingredients.text: 1 kg green beans, ends cut off

steps: 1. Sautee the onion in the olive oil. Add the tomatoes and then the beans and sautee for a minute or two. Add water (sauce should cover beans) and bring to a boil. Stir in the parsley. Reduce heat, cover, and cook on low for 45 minutes.
2. Sauce should have a thick and slightly oily consistency. Feel free to add potatoes or carrots to beef up the dish a bit!
title: Greek Green Beans In Tomato Sauce

steps: 1. Blend all ingredients. Serve in a coffee mug.
title: Greek Iced Coffee

steps: 1. Mix Feta cheese, mayonnaise, spices, herbs and cream cheese in food processor.
2. Serve with crackers.
3. Makes about 1 1/2 cups. Great on baked potatoes!
title: Feta Cheese Spread

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Cream butter gradually beating in sugar. Beat eggs until light; add to butter mixture and beat thoroughly. Add vanilla extract.
3. Add lemon rinds.
4. Sift together flour and baking powder.
5. Carefully blend into butter-egg mixture to make soft dough.
title: Koulourakia(Greek Butter Cookies)

steps: 1. Clean the meat from the veins if there are some and cut it into smaller pieces, 3 × 3 cm. Marinate the meat in the mustard and spices and let it sit in the refrigerator for one hour

2. Heat one tablespoon of pork fat or vegetable oil in a pot and fry the meat on all sides until it gets browned. Once the meat is cooked, transfer it to a plate and add another tablespoon of fat to the pot
3. Cut the onions very fine, peel the carrots and shred it using a grater. Cook the onions and carrots over low heat for 15 minutes. You can salt the vegetables a little to make them soften faster

4. Once the vegetables have browned and become slightly mushy, add the meat and bay leaves and garlic. Pour over with wine and simmer for 10-15 minutes to allow the alcohol to evaporate. Now is the right time to add 2/3 the amount of liquid
5. Cover the pot and cook over low heat for an hour, stirring occasionally. After the first hour, pour over the rest of the water or stock and cook for another 30-45 minutes
6. Allow the stew to cool slightly and serve it with a sprinkle of chopped parsley and few slices of fresh hot pepper if you like to spice it up a bit
7. Slice ​​some fresh bread, season the salad and simply enjoying these wonderful flavors
title: Traditional Croatian Goulash

steps: 1. 1. Prepare the Potatoes
2. Start by peeling and finely grating the potatoes. To ensure extra crispiness, use a clean kitchen towel to squeeze out as much moisture as possible.
3. 2. Mix the Ingredients
4. In a large mixing bowl, combine the grated potatoes, chopped onion, minced garlic, eggs, flour, marjoram, salt, and black pepper. Stir well until the mixture forms a thick, consistent batter.
5. 3. Heat the Oil
6. In a large frying pan, heat a generous amount of oil over medium heat. The oil should be hot but not smoking.
7. 4. Fry the Pancakes
8. Spoon portions of the batter into the pan, flattening each into a thin pancake. Fry until golden brown and crispy on one side, then flip and cook the other side until equally golden and crispy.
9. 5. Drain & Serve
10. Transfer the cooked pancakes onto a plate lined with paper towels to remove excess oil. Serve immediately while hot, with sour cream, garlic dip, or as a side dish.
title: Zemiakové Placky

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

2. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the bacon and kielbasa; cook and stir until the bacon has rendered its fat and sausage is lightly browned. Use a slotted spoon to remove the meat and transfer to a large casserole or Dutch oven.

3. Coat the cubes of pork lightly with flour and fry them in the bacon drippings over medium-high heat until golden brown. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the pork to the casserole. Add the garlic, onion, carrots, fresh mushrooms, cabbage and sauerkraut. Reduce heat to medium; cook and stir until the carrots are soft, about 10 minutes. Do not let the vegetables brown.

4. Deglaze the pan by pouring in the red wine and stirring to loosen all of the bits of food and flour that are stuck to the bottom. Season with the bay leaf, basil, marjoram, paprika, salt, pepper, caraway seeds and cayenne pepper; cook for 1 minute.

5. Mix in the dried mushrooms, hot pepper sauce, Worcestershire sauce, beef stock, tomato paste and tomatoes. Heat through just until boiling. Pour the vegetables and all of the liquid into the casserole dish with the meat. Cover with a lid.
6. Bake in the preheated oven for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, until meat is very tender.
title: Bigos (Hunters Stew)

steps: 1. Cook macaroni in salted water 7 minutes; drain.
2. In a large casserole dish, place tomatoes, salt and macaroni.
3. Cook onion, green pepper and ground chuck until meat is lightly browned.
4. Add to casserole with a large can of tomato sauce.
5. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
6. Serves 8.
title: Goulash

steps: 1. Melt shortening in pan. Brown meat on all sides. Stir in onion. Combine mustard, paprika, salt and sugar. Combine Worcestershire, vinegar, ketchup and 3 cups of water. Add to the mustard mixture. Add combined ingredients to meat. Blend. Cover. Reduce heat. Cook 2 1/2 hours or until meat is very tender. Stir occasionally. Blend flour with remaining water. Add to meat mixture. Stir until thickened. Serve over cooked noodles. Serves 14 to 16.
title: Hungarian Goulash

steps: 1. Fry beef and onions in pan.
2. Drain off fat.
3. Chop tomatoes. Add tomatoes, kidney beans, chili powder, macaroni and liquids to beef mixture.
4. Simmer, covered, about 20 minutes, until macaroni is tender, stirring occasionally to keep from sticking.
5. Thin with a little water during cooking, if necessary.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Goulash

ingredients.text: 2 lb. beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 green bell pepper, seeded and chopped

steps: 1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a zip-top plastic bag.
2. Seal bag.
3. Shake until meat is coated.
4. Remove meat from bag.
5. Reserve remaining flour mixture.
6. Brown meat in hot oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat, stirring constantly.
7. Add onion and garlic. Cook, stirring constantly, until onion is tender.
8. Add remaining flour mixture, green bell pepper and next 4 ingredients.
9. Bring to a boil.
10. Cover.
11. Reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 hours or until tender, stirring often.
12. Uncover and simmer 10 minutes, stirring often.
13. Serve over noodles with a dollop of sour cream and sprinkle of paprika.
14. Makes 6 servings.
title: Hungarian Goulash

steps: 1. Cook and stir
2. beef
3. in 2 tablespoons butter in skillet over low heat
4. until
5. brown.
6. Reserve
7. 1/3 cup bouillon.
8. Stir remaining bouillon,
9. ketchup,

11. and
12. salt into skillet. Heat to boiling;
13. reduce heat.
14. Cover and simmer until beef is tender 1 to 1
15. 1/2 hours.
16. Stir in mushrooms and onion.
17. Cover and simmer until onion is tender.
18. Shake reserved bouillon and flour in

22. Reduce heat and stir in sour cream. Toss
23. noodles
24. with 1 tablespoon butter and poppy seed.
25. Serve over noodles.

title: Beef Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 2 lb. sauerkraut, washed well and drained
1 lb. can tomatoes, drained and chopped (reserving the juice)
1 1/4 c. firmly packed dark brown sugar

steps: 1. Spread the sauerkraut in a buttered ovenproof serving dish 12 x 9 x 2-inch.
2. Cover it with tomatoes, including the reserved juice.
3. Sprinkle the mixture with brown sugar.
4. Arrange the bacon on top and bake in a preheated oven at 300° for 2 hours.
5. Remove from oven, cut the bacon into pieces and stir it gently into the sauerkraut mixture.
6. Bake the dish, adding water as necessary to prevent it from drying out for 1 more hour.
7. Serves 8.
8. Always a hit at covered dish suppers and cookouts!
9. Nice vegetable with pork or beef.
title: Baked Sauerkraut Wirth

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in salted boiling water until fork-tender; peel and slice and

2. add onion. In a large skillet, cook bacon and remove from heat; remove bacon and set aside. Pour off fat. Return 1/4 cup to skillet. Add flour and sugar and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add sour cream. Add potatoes, onions and half of the bacon. Toss gently. Add rest of bacon and parsley. Serves 10.
title: Warmer Kartoffel Salat(Variation With Sour Cream)

steps: 1. Cook all ingredients together, except flour and 1/4 cup water. Cook until meat is tender.
2. Make a thickening of flour and 1/4 cup water; add thickening.
3. Pour over the hot noodles to serve. Serves 6.
title: Hungarian Goulash

steps: 1. Brown meat in skillet; pour off fat.
2. Brown onions in oil until tender.
3. Add macaroni to meat mixture.
4. Add salt and pepper; stir well.
5. Add tomatoes, catsup, mushrooms, bay leaf and water.
6. Simmer for 30 minutes over low heat, stirring frequently.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Goulash

ingredients.text: 8 oz. egg noodles, cooked and drained

steps: 1. Place broccoli and carrots in a steamer basket.
2. Cover and steam over 1-inch boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes or until crisp-tender.
3. Drain and set aside.
4. In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
5. Add onion and garlic; saute until onion is tender, about 2 minutes.
6. Stir in flour and blend until smooth. Gradually add milk; cook, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 8 to 10 minutes.
7. Remove from heat.
8. Stir in sour cream, Parmesan cheese and mustard.
9. Add broccoli and carrots.
10. Serve over hot noodles.
11. Makes 4 servings.
title: Garden Stroganoff

steps: 1. Melt margarine in large skillet.
2. Saute onion until golden brown.
3. Stir in sauerkraut and apple slices.
4. Pour in bouillon and place bacon slices on top.
5. Cover; simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Add grated potato and continue to simmer until mixture thickens, stirring constantly.
6. Remove bacon and serve hot.
7. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Braised Sauerkraut

steps: 1. Sprinkle mushrooms with lemon juice.
2. Simmer, lightly covered, with onion and 3 tablespoons of the butter.
3. Season with salt and pepper, stir in flour and cheese.
4. Cook for about 3 minutes. Place in buttered baking dish.
5. Beat together cream and egg yolks.
6. Pour over mushrooms.
7. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and dot with remaining butter.
8. Bake in preheated oven at 375° for about 15 minutes.
9. Makes 6 servings.
title: Polish Mushrooms

ingredients.text: 1 to 2 c. sliced zucchini (when in season)

steps: 1. Brown ground chuck.
2. While meat is cooking, add onion.
3. When in season, add zucchini.
4. Add tomatoes and macaroni, cooked.
5. (If you like, you can also add 1 cup cubed Velveeta cheese.)
6. Cook about 20 minutes to blend flavors.
7. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Zucchini Goulash

steps: 1. Make ground beef into patties about the size of half dollars. Place in skillet with onion; cook until meat is done.
2. Drain well. Add tomato juice, macaroni, chili powder, salt and pepper.
3. Let simmer for 15 minutes.
4. Makes about 4 servings.
title: Jessica'S Goulash

steps: 1. Rinse sauerkraut with warm water 2 times; drain well.
2. Cook onion and bacon in butter until onion is soft.
3. Add the drained kraut, caraway seed and sugar.
4. Cover tightly.
5. Cook 1/2 hour. Add bouillon and wine.
6. Simmer 1/2 hour longer or until kraut is cooked to your taste.
7. Serve as vegetable with sauerbraten of Kalbshaxe, or top with a selection of pork products such as boiled thick slabs of bacon, Bratwurst, frankfurters or Regensburg sausage.
8. On such a plate, Ernspuree and mashed potatoes are always served.
9. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Sauerkraut Auf Bayische Art(Bavarian Style Sauerkraut)

ingredients.text: 1 lb. round steak, cut in thin strips

steps: 1. Cook noodles about halfway through meat process in 2-quarts salted, boiling water until al dente.
2. Drain and toss with 1 tablespoon margarine.
3. Keep warm over hot water.
4. Combine 1 tablespoon flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
5. Coat meat with flour mixture.
6. Heat skillet, then add 2 tablespoons margarine.
7. When melted, add meat and brown quickly.
8. Add mushrooms, onion and garlic.
9. Cook 3 or 4 minutes or until onion is clear.
10. Remove meat mixture from pan.
11. Add 2 tablespoons margarine to pan drippings. Blend in 3 tablespoons flour.
12. Add 1 tablespoon tomato paste.
13. Stir in beef broth.
14. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly.
15. Return browned meat mixture to skillet.
16. Stir in sour cream and white wine (if desired).
17. Cook slowly until heated through.
18. Do not boil.
19. Serve over hot buttered noodles.
20. Makes 4 or 5 servings.
title: Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Brown steak over medium heat in butter; salt and pepper.
2. Stir in 1 cup beef broth, mushrooms, garlic, onion, pimento, salsa and sour cream.
3. Simmer 20 minutes.
4. Mix flour and remaining 1/2 cup broth, then stir into mixture to thicken.
5. Serve over hot egg noodles.
6. Serves 4.
title: Beef Stroganoff(With Zip)

steps: 1. Brown meat in heavy casserole at 450° for about 25 minutes on each side. Combine remaining ingredients and mix well.
2. Reduce heat to 325° and pour mixture over meat and cover casserole with foil.
3. Bake 3 hours or until tender, basting occasionally. Slice brisket thinly.
4. Spoon over pan juices.
5. Serves 6 to 8.
title: German Baked Brisket

ingredients.text: 1 lb. round steak, cut in strips

steps: 1. Saute first 3 ingredients.
2. Set aside.
3. Brown meat.
4. Add next 5 ingredients.
5. Simmer until tender.
6. Combine mushrooms and onions.
7. Fold in remaining ingredients.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Beef Stroganoff Nerelli

steps: 1. Brown onions and garlic in butter; remove from skillet.
2. Add chicken and brown.
3. Put chicken in covered dish.
4. Return onions and garlic to skillet.
5. Add paste and broth; bring to boil and pour over chicken.
6. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
7. Serve over rice.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Hungarian Broilers

steps: 1. Cook onion in butter in a saucepan over medium heat until transparent.
2. Add turkey and cook, stirring until light brown.
3. Add flour, salt, pepper, mushrooms and soup; cook for 5 minutes.
4. Add sour cream and simmer for 15 minutes longer.
5. Serve over rice and garnish with paprika.
6. Yields 4 servings.
title: Turkey Stroganoff

steps: 1. Brown beef, onion and peppers.
2. Add salt, pepper and garlic. After meat is thoroughly cooked, add 1 quart whole tomatoes. While meat is browning, bring the water to a boil for the macaroni in another pot.
3. Cook macaroni.
4. Add cooked macaroni to meat mixture.
5. Simmer for 20 minutes.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Skillet Goulash

steps: 1. Mix all together.
2. Bake at 275° for 5 hours.
3. Serve over noodles, rice or mashed potatoes.
4. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Easy Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until tender. Meanwhile, prepare the following sauce of other ingredients:
2. Melt butter in heavy skillet, then saute onion, green pepper, celery and hamburger in it.
3. Separate meat into small pieces.
4. When meat is browned and onion tender, add seasonings and chili powder.
5. Add the tomato sauce, mixing well; sprinkle with cheese and allow to simmer about 15 minutes.
6. When macaroni is tender, blanch in hot water; add to simmering sauce and cover for a few minutes longer. Serves 4.
title: Macaroni Goulash

steps: 1. Beat eggs until lemon colored and creamy.
2. Stir in cream (I think 1/2 and 1/2 here), milk, sugar, and salt.
3. Sift in flour to make a stiff dough.
4. Turn out on a floured board and knead 7 minutes until elastic and smooth.
5. Cover and let rest 10 minutes.
6. Roll out half the dough at a time.
7. Cut a center in each piece.
8. Fry a few at a time in hot fat 400 degrees Fahrenheit to a golden brown.
9. Drain on paper towels.
10. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
title: Czech Listy Celestial Crust

ingredients.text: 1/2 ounce yeast (2 packs Fleischman's is good)

steps: 1. Dissolve yeast with 1 T sugar in 1/4 c warm water.
2. Let stand about 10 minutes.
3. Scald milk.
4. Stir in butter and sugar and let cool.
5. Add salt and eggs.
6. In a large bowl combine milk and yeast mixtures.
7. Start adding flour 1 c at a time till you begin to work the dough with your hands (you should have used about 5 1/2 cups).
8. Knead the dough working in the rest of the flour.
9. Clean and grease your bowl; place dough in bowl grease the top with a little oil let rise until double in bulk.
10. Sausage kolaches: Boil sausage till done cut in lengths desired wrap in dough (make sure it is sealed shut) let rise 1 hour bake at 400 18-20 minutes.

11. Cinnamon rolls: I always make these with the left over dough. Roll out into a rectangle pour melted butter over the surface mix sugar and cinnamon and evenly spread over butter roll up dough and cut into slices place in greased pan about 1/2 inch apart. Let rise 1 hour. Bake at 400° 18- 20 minutes. Top off with a simple powdered sugar icing (I like to add cinnamon to that as well).
12. You can add cheese to the sausage kolaches or ham and cheese, fruit filling and cream cheese, the possibilities are endless -- let me know what you guys try.
title: Sylvia'S Kolache Dough

ingredients.text: 8 oz. noodles, cooked ahead and kept warm

steps: 1. Mix the flour, salt and pepper.
2. Coat the chicken pieces. Heat the oil and then brown and cook chicken until cooked well. Remove chicken from pan and set aside and keep warm.
3. Add the onions and garlic to the frying pan and stir in the paprika, cooking for one minute.
4. Stir in the chicken broth and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until thickened.
5. Stir in the sour cream and cook for 2 minutes or until heated through. Arrange chicken on top of the noodles and top chicken with the sauce.
title: Chicken Paprikash

ingredients.text: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes

steps: 1. Place meat in crockpot and cover with sliced onion.
2. Combine garlic, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, sugar, salt, paprika and mustard Stir in water, mix well, and pour over meat.
3. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.
4. Turn control to high.
5. Dissolve flour in a small amount of cold water and stir into meat mixture.
6. Cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes or until slightly thickened.
7. Serve over noodles or rice.
title: Crock Pot Hungarian Goulash

ingredients.text: 1/8 teaspoon fresh black pepper, to taste
2 eggs, room temperature (seasoned with salt and pepper, to taste)

steps: 1. Place onions in a dark 9 inch round pan.
2. Season onions with salt and pepper.
3. Drizzle with olive oil.
4. Combine mixture.
5. Place butter on top.
6. Put pan in solar cooker.
7. Solar cook until onions are caramelized (about 3 hours).
8. After cooking the onions for 3 hours, crack the eggs over a small bowl and season with salt & pepper, to taste.
9. Add eggs to the onions (keep yolks intact).
10. Continue to solar cook for another 15-20 minutes until the eggs are cooked or "hard boiled" (about 20 minutes).
11. Serve on slices of toasted bread.
12. Drizzle olive oil and butter drippings over eggs and toasts.
title: Solar Cooked Russian Yaichnitsa Eggs

ingredients.text: 1 lb. lean pork (bite-sized cubes), cut from shoulder and fat discarded
1/4 c. chicken broth, beef broth or water

steps: 1. Cut pork into 3/4 to 1-inch cubes.
2. Heat bacon in heavy skillet.
3. Cook until crisp.
4. Add onion.
5. Saute for 2 minutes until onion is wilted.
6. Add pork cubes to pan along with green and red peppers, tomato, paprika, garlic, caraway seed and salt.
7. Cook, stirring over high heat for 5 minutes.
8. Turn heat down to low; cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
9. Meanwhile, stir cornstarch and broth together until smooth.
10. Pour mixture into pan with meat and peppers.
11. Heat to boiling; stir and cook until juices are thickened.
title: Pork And Pepper Goulash

ingredients.text: 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/4-inch thick slices
1 small green bell pepper, cored, seeded and thinly sliced
2 cups sauerkraut, rinsed and well drained

steps: 1. Heat oil in large skillet.
2. Add sausage, onion & bell pepper.
3. Cook over medium heat 5-10 minutes or until vegetables are tender and sausage is lightly browned, stirring occasionally.
4. Drain Fat.
5. Add sauerkraut, mustard, caraway seeds, salt & pepper to skillet.
6. Cook over medium heat 3-5 minutes or until heated thru.
title: Kielbasa & Sauerkraut Skillet Dinner

steps: 1. Place in an enamelled saucepan 150 g sugar and put on fire (but not directly on the flame) and stir with a wooden spoon until it caramelizes. Then tilt the pan from side to side and round to coat with sugar caramelized edges.

2. Place eggs and sugar in a bowl and mix until a homogeneous content. Gradually thins with milk added. Add the content over the caramelized sugar and pop into a preheated oven at 180 degrees C for about 45min. Keep the fire small so as not to burn the surface. If you do notice that the color becomes darker, covered with paper.
3. Once ready, remove to a platter and let cool.
title: Crème Brulee (Romanian Style)

steps: 1. Cut pork tenderloins into 1-inch cubes.
2. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a 5-quart Dutch oven.
3. Stir in pork, onions and garlic; cook until pork is browned.
4. Stir in broth, vinegar, sugar, seasonings and vegetables.
5. Bring to a boil.
6. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes or until meat and vegetables are tender.
7. In a medium bowl, slowly add light cream to flour; mixing until well blended.
8. Stir into pork mixture.
9. Heat until thickened, stirring constantly.
10. Just before serving, stir in sour cream. Heat until warm.
title: Bavarian Pork Tenderloin Stew

ingredients.text: 5 lbs ground pork (we grind our own from whatever happens to be on sale -- roast, butt, chops, etc)
1 tablespoon fennel seed (or use caraway seeds)

steps: 1. Peel the garlic.
2. If you are using a meat grinder, run the peeled garlic through the grinder. Otherwise mince very finely.
3. If you are grinding your own pork, don't trim the fat! It helps keep the sausage from drying out when cooking.
4. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well by hand to distribute the seasoning evenly throughout the meat.
5. Cook and enjoy! This sausage greatly enhances Eastern European soups or stews.
title: Hungarian Sausage

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup olive oil (or olive and corn mixed)

steps: 1. Mix everything together except the paprika, which should be added at the end.
2. Mix everything together except the paprika, which should be added at the end.
3. Mix up with mushrooms.
4. Turn the mushrooms around every few hours - leave overnight in the refrigerator, or at least leave them to marinate for about three hours. (The longer the better.).
5. Note: olive oil may get hard in the refrigerator. Before serving keep at room temperature for a few minutes and stir for the oil to melt.
title: Griby Marinovannye (Russian Marinated Mushrooms)

steps: 1. Dredge meat in flour.
2. In large skillet, heat oil and brown meat well.
3. Add onions; cook lightly.
4. Stir in water, paprika, salt and garlic.
5. Cover and simmer until meat is tender, about 2 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.
6. Cook noodles according to package directions; drain.
7. Serve goulash over noodles.
title: Beef Goulash

steps: 1. Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt, and pepper together in a bowl. Whisk together the egg and milk in a separate bowl; stir in the flour mixture until a smooth dough is formed.

2. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, cut the dough into bite sized pieces with scissors into the boiling water. Boil for 20 minutes; drain well.
3. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat; add the knefla and potatoes. Stirring occasionally, cook until the potatoes are tender and the knefla are golden brown, about 20 minutes.
title: German-Russian-Dakota Knefla

steps: 1. Place the tenderloin in crockpot with the salt & peppercorns. Pour apple cider over. Turn to 300 degrees for 3 hours.
2. Pour in brandy, add sauerkraut, test for salt, add more to taste, reduce heat to 200 degrees for another 3 to 4 hours.
3. Remove lid if necessary to boil off extra liquid before shredding with 2 forks.
4. Serve as a main dish, with beans or mashies or on a toasted roll with melted swiss cheese. Sooo good!
title: Crock Pot Pulled Pork With Sauerkraut

ingredients.text: 2 lb. sirloin steak, cut in cubes

steps: 1. Brown meat in oil.
2. Add salt.
3. Remove meat.
4. In same skillet, cook onions and mushrooms; cover for 3 to 4 minutes.
5. Put to side. Blend flour and paprika in drippings.
6. Add Worcestershire sauce. Stir and cook until thick.
7. Return meat
8. and stir in sour cream. Serve over noodles or rice.
title: Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

2. In a medium bowl, cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each. Dissolve the baking soda in the hot water, add it to the egg mixture. Stir in the flour and cinnamon until well blended. Finally, stir in the dates and walnuts so they are evenly distributed.
3. Drop by heaping spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden.
title: German Rocks

ingredients.text: 2 lb. boneless sirloin, thinly sliced into bite size pieces

steps: 1. Pat meat dry with paper towel. Season with salt and pepper. Heat 2 tablespoons butter or oleo in a large skillet or wide pot. Saute meat quickly in single layer until browned on all sides. Transfer to platter. Brown remaining meat, adding more butter or oleo as needed.
2. Saute mushrooms in same skillet over low heat, adding additional butter or oleo, if needed. Transfer to a separate plate.
3. Melt additional 1 tablespoon butter or oleo in same skillet. Saute onions until clear, about 5 minutes.
4. Add to mushrooms. Add mustard and tomato paste to skillet. Stir to mix. Slowly stir in 2 cups beef broth to make a smooth sauce, scraping browned bits from bottom of skillet.
5. Stir in sherry and paprika. Return onions and mushrooms to skillet. Simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes.
6. Gradually stir 1 cup beef broth into sour cream bowl until mixture is smooth.
7. Pour into skillet, stirring constantly. Simmer 3 minutes. Add beef and noodles. Heat slowly to serving temperature.
title: Magyai Beef(Hungarian)

ingredients.text: 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour, or more as needed

steps: 1. Combine lukewarm milk and 2 tablespoons sugar in a large bowl and stir to dissolve sugar. Mix 3 tablespoons flour with fresh yeast in a small bowl and add to milk mixture. Let rest in a warm place until mixture is frothy, 15 to 30 minutes.

2. Beat 3 eggs and 3 tablespoons sugar together in a small bowl. Add to the yeast mixture; stir in melted butter. Add 8 cups flour and salt. Mix until well combined and a soft dough forms; no kneading is necessary.
3. Place dough in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, 1 to 2 hours.
4. Punch down dough. Cover and let rise until doubled in volume once again, about 40 minutes.

5. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface. Divide dough into 24 equal pieces, or according to your preferred pirozhki recipe, and form into rolls. Place rolls on a lightly greased baking sheet. Beat the remaining egg in a small bowl and glaze rolls with the beaten egg. Cover with a clean kitchen towel and let rest, 20 to 30 minutes.
6. Preheat oven to 475 degrees F (245 degrees C).
7. Uncover and bake rolls in the preheated oven until golden, about 15 minutes.
title: Russian Yeast Dough

ingredients.text: 1 cup beer (preferably dark, but any beer will do)
1/2 teaspoon paprika (we use Smoked Spanish Paprika)
1 teaspoon horseradish (more or less, to taste)
12 slices French bread (Thick cut, we buy whole loaves and slice, on the diaganol, into 3/4-inch slices)

steps: 1. Combine beer, oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Place Flank Steak in marinade. (A gallon Ziploc bag works great). Refridgerate overnight, turning occassionally.
2. In a skillet, melt butter; add paprika and a dash of salt, then add onions and saute until tender. In a small saucepan, mix sour cream and horseradish and heat on low until sour cream is warm.
3. Drain steak and barbeque (or broil) 5 - 7 minutes per side for medium rare. Cover and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

4. Toast French Bread slightly. (I toast them under the broiler with door slightly open , but you have to WATCH carefully. Don't think you can do anything else, or you'll forget about them and have burned toast!).
5. Slice meat very thin across the grain, and on an angle. Pile meat on toast, cover with onions, some sour cream and a sprinkle of paprika, then top sandwich with other toast.
title: Stroganoff Steak Sandwiches

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and place in an uncovered baking dish.
2. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 300°.
title: Barbecued Sauerkraut

steps: 1. Cook cut up kielbasa in water to remove excess grease.
2. Drain and add ingredients.
3. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
title: Baked Kielbasa

steps: 1. steam meat (anykind) until almost done, throw in onions and carrots, steam until tender, pour in rice on the meat and pour water over it so that it covers the rice and meat about 1 to 2 cm.
2. bring to boil and turn on low temperature, let cook for about 30 minutes.
title: Russian Ploff

steps: 1. Mix butter and sugar.
2. Add remaining ingredients and press into bottom of 9 x 9-inch pan.
3. Bake for 10 minutes at 350°, cool.
title: Bavarian Torte

steps: 1. Beat eggs, milk, flour and salt in a large bowl.
2. Can allow mixture to sit until ready to cook.
3. Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
4. Add salt liberally to boiling water.
5. Force dough through large holes of a colander/drainer directly into boiling water.
6. Make in batches and do not overload the pot.
7. Bring each batch back to a boil.
8. Noodles are done when they float.
9. Remove with a strainer and keep warm while cooking remainder.
10. Toss each batch with a little of the butter.
11. Serve with gravy.
title: Spatzle

steps: 1. Cream butter and sugar.
2. Sift flour, baking powder, cinnamon and allspice.
3. Add 3 eggs to the butter and sugar mixture.
4. Add all other ingredients.
5. Use a teaspoon to drop the cookies onto a greased cookie sheet.
6. Keep the spoon moist so the batter will not stick.
7. Bake in 350° oven for 15 to 18 minutes or until the cookies are brown.
title: Russian Rocks

ingredients.text: 500 g beef, cut in thin strips
2 cups rice, cooked (illegal, for other family members only)

steps: 1. Cook Rice (for other family members).
2. Brown Beef in olive oil.
3. Add onions & saute
4. simmer in tomato juice until tender
5. Add mushrooms and simmer for five minutes
6. Add spice & yogurt.
7. Serve.
title: Scd Gluten Free Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Brown meat in large skillet with onion.
2. Add 5 cups water, bouillon, salt, paprika, garlic, mustard and mushrooms.
3. Cook until meat is tender.
4. Mix flour, cornstarch, water and sour cream.
5. Dip cup of hot mixture into cold.
6. Mix. Add back slowly to beef mixture.
7. Heat until bubbly.
8. Enjoy.
title: Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Pack cabbage tightly into quart jars.
2. Add salt and red pepper. Pour tap water over until full.
3. Seal and set aside to sour.
title: Sauerkraut

ingredients.text: 10 oz. can cream of chicken soup

steps: 1. Brown meat and drain off fat.
2. Add flour, salt and sauteed mushrooms.
3. Cook 5 minutes.
4. Add soup and simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes.
5. Stir in sour cream.
6. Heat through.
7. Sprinkle with parsley.
8. Serve with Chinese noodles or rice.
title: Hamburger Stroganoff

steps: 1. Cook onions in oil.
2. Cut beef into cubes and sprinkle with vinegar.
3. Add salt, paprika and cooked onions. Cover and simmer about 3 hours.
title: Beef Goulash

steps: 1. Saute onions in butter or margarine about 5 minutes.
2. Add beef and rest of ingredients.
3. Simmer, covered, for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
title: Hungarian Goulash

steps: 1. Cut beef across grain into strips.
2. Cook and stir beef in margarine in 10-inch skillet over low heat until brown.
3. Reserve 1/3 cup of broth, stir in remaining broth, catsup, salt and garlic into skillet.
4. Heat to boiling and reduce heat.
5. Cover and simmer until beef is tender, 45 minutes.
6. Stir in mushrooms and onion. Cover and simmer until onion is tender.
7. Shake reserved broth and the flour in a tightly covered container.
8. Gradually stir into beef mixture.
9. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
10. Boil and stir 1 minute.
11. Reduce heat, stir in sour cream and heat through. Serve over noodles or rice.
title: Beef Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 2 tsp. instant coffee, dissolved in 1 Tbsp. hot water

steps: 1. Sift dry ingredients together and set aside.
2. Cream butter with sugar.
3. Add eggs, beating well.
4. Add mint extract and dissolved coffee.
5. Add flour mixture and mix well.
6. Stir in chips and almonds.
7. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets.
8. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.
title: Bavarian Mint Chippers

steps: 1. Saute onion and bell pepper in margarine.
2. Add ground beef; lightly brown.
3. Add salt, pepper, garlic, tomatoes and macaroni. Cook for about 30 minutes on medium heat, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
4. Add water if necessary.
title: Goulash

steps: 1. Combine sugar, flour, cornstarch and salt. Gradually stir in milk.
2. On med-high heat (turning down to med, if necessary), cook and stir until mixture thickens and boils.
3. Cook and stir 2-3 minute.
4. Stir a little of the hot mixture into egg yolk.
5. Stir egg mixture into the rest of the hot mixture and bring it just to boiling.
6. STIRRING CONSTANTLY.
7. Add vanilla.
8. cover entire surface with plastic wrap or waxed paper.
9. Cool.
10. beat smooth.
11. Fold in whipped cream.
title: Bavarian Cream

ingredients.text: 10 1/2 oz. can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)

steps: 1. Brown onion and garlic in butter.
2. Stir in meat and brown. Stir in flour, salt and pepper.
3. Add soup and stir.
4. Simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes.
5. Stir in sour cream and heat thoroughly.
6. Sprinkle on parsley and serve over noodles or rice.
title: Hamburger Stroganoff

steps: 1. Brown hamburger and onion; add flour and salt and pepper to taste.
2. Boil spaghetti.
3. Mix and pour into casserole.
4. Bake at 300° about 1 hour.
title: Goulash

steps: 1. Place kielbasa in bottom of skillet and brush with BBQ.
2. Place 1/2 c water in bottom of skillet and cover.
3. Cook on med low for 15 min or until skin splits.
4. Also great to throw a ring of kielbasa on the grill with or without BBQ sauce and cook until skin splits.
5. Serve with potatoes and corn.
title: Skillet Bbq Kielbasa

steps: 1. Mix the first 6 ingredients well and form into 1 1/2-inch meat balls.
2. Bring water, onion, spices and 1/4 teaspoon of salt to a boil.
3. Add meat balls and simmer until done, about 25 minutes. Remove meat balls and thicken broth with flour paste.
4. Bring to a boil.
5. Add sour cream and heat through, but do not boil.
6. Return meat balls to gravy and heat.
7. Serve with boiled potatoes.
title: German Sauer Klopps (Sour Meat Balls)

steps: 1. Cream shortening.
2. Mix in 1 package cream cheese at a time. Add flour.
3. Continue mixing by hand until mixture works away from side of bowl. Cover with waxed paper.
4. Place in refrigerator overnight.
5. Roll a small portion at a time in a cool place on powdered sugar until 1/8-inch thick.
6. Cut in squares or rounds. Fill with favorite filling (Solo in cans works well).
7. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 325°.
title: Cheese Kolacky(Polish)

ingredients.text: 12 hot dog buns, split and toasted (buttered, if desired)
1 cup chopped onion, cooked if desired

steps: 1. Slice each hotdog almost in half lengthwise, but not quite through to the other side. Press open. Spread 1/2 tsp mustard evenly on both cut side of each hotdog. Place 1 hotdog, cut-side up, on each of 12 individual sheets of heavy-duty (or double layer of regular) foil. Spoon about 2 tbsp sauerkraut onto each hotdog. Spread evenly. Fold edges of foil to enclose each hotdog. Preheat grill to medium. Place packets on ungreased grill. Close lid. Cook for about 5 minutes, turning once, until heated trough. Remove and discard foil.
2. Spread 1/2 teaspoon ketchup evenly on top half of each bun. Place 1 hotdog on botton half of each bun. Top each with onion, if desired. Cover each with top half of bun.
title: Frankly Sauerkraut (Cooked On The Grill)

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. sirloin steak, cut into 1/2-inch strips
4 oz. can mushrooms, cut into pieces
1 bouillon cube, dissolved in juice of mushrooms

steps: 1. Roll steak in 1/4 cup flour and salt. Brown onions, garlic and mushrooms in oil for 5 minutes. Add steak and brown evenly. Remove meat, onions and mushrooms from pan. Add flour to drippings. Add bouillon and Worcestershire sauce. Cook until thick. Add sour cream and heat to simmer. Add beef and vegetables. Serve on hot cooked rice, toast or noodles, cooked or chow mein.
title: Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F Mix cream cheese, 1/4 cup of the sugar, vanilla and egg yolk with wire whisk until well blended. In separate bowl, mix remaining 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon; set aside.

2. Flatten each bread slice with rolling pin. Spread 1 side of each side evenly with 1 rounded tablespoons cream cheese mixture. Starting at short end, tightly roll up. Brush each roll with butter; roll in reserved cinnamon-sugar. Slice each roll into 3 pieces.
3. Place each piece, seam-side down, on baking sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minute or until edges are lightly browned. Serve immediately.
4. For an extra special treat, baked rolls can be dipped halfway into melted dipping chocolate.
5. For Freezing: Freeze uncooked on cookie sheet for 30 minutes, and then put in plastic bags. When ready to bake remove from bag and place on cookie sheet and bake frozen for about 10 to 15 minutes.
title: Cinnamon Toast Blinis

steps: 1. Place chops in casserole.
2. Put in apples, onion and kraut. Place in a 350° oven.
3. Cook for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
4. Cover with lid or foil while cooking.
title: Pork Chops And Sauerkraut

steps: 1. Brown round steak in oil in electric frying pan or heavy skillet.
2. Add salt and pepper.
3. While browning, dissolve bouillon cubes in 2 cups boiling water.
4. Add hot bouillon to browned beef. Add bay leaf, cloves, garlic powder and cayenne pepper.
5. Cook slowly (simmer) for 2 hours.
6. Add water as needed.
7. Add potatoes and carrots.
8. Add water, if needed.
9. Simmer 45 minutes.
10. In a separate bowl, cream together softened butter, flour and paprika until smooth.
11. Slowly stir into meat and vegetables.
12. Stir gently until liquid is thickened.
title: Hungarian Goulash(Serves 6 To 8)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.
title: Russian Pitter

ingredients.text: 1/2 pound sliced bacon, cooked and crumbled
6 pork chops (1 inch thick and 7 ounces each)

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the sauerkraut, applesauce, broth, bacon, brown sugar and seasonings; spoon into an ungreased 13x9-in. baking dish.
2. In a large skillet, brown pork chops in oil; drain. Place chops over the sauerkraut mixture. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 to 1-1/4 hours or until a thermometer reads 160°.
title: Sauerkraut And Pork Chops

ingredients.text: 2 lbs lean boneless chuck roast, cut into 3/4 inch pieces
16 ounces wide egg noodles, uncooked (10 cups)

steps: 1. In 3 1/2 to 4- quart cooker, combine beef, carrots, onion and bell pepper. Add flour, paprika, salt, thyme and pepper; toss to coat. Add chili sauce and broth; mix well.
2. Cover; cook on low setting for 7 to 8 hours.

3. Allow 35 minutes before serving, stir mushrooms into stew. Cover; cook on low setting an additional 20 to 30 minutes or until mushrooms are tender. Meanwhile, cook noodles to desired doneness as directed on the package. Drain.
4. At serving time, stir sour cram into stew until well mixed. Spoon noodles into individual shallow bowls. Top each with stew. Sprinkle with parsley.
title: Hungarian Stew

steps: 1. In large skillet, brown onions in 1 stick butter.
2. Add chicken, paprika and salt.
3. Brown on medium-low heat.
4. Add 1/2 cup chicken stock.
5. Simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
6. Cook noodles as directed on package and add frozen peas to cooking noodles.
7. Remove from heat.
8. Stir sour cream into chicken mixture, then add noodles and peas mixture and serve.
9. Garnish with parsley.
10. Enjoy!
title: Chicken Paprikash(Yields 4 Servings)

steps: 1. cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
2. add flour; mix well.
3. spread dough onto bottom and1 1/2 half inches high up sides of 9-inch springform pan.
4. Combine softened cream cheese and sugar, mixing until well blended.
5. Blend in egg and vanilla.
6. pour into pastry lined pan.
7. Toss apples with combined sugar and cinnamon.
8. spoon apple mixture over cream cheese layer.
9. sprinkle with nuts.
10. Bake at 450 degrees for 10 minutes.
11. Reduce oven temperature to 400 degrees; continue baking 25 minutes.
12. Loosen cake from rim of pan.
13. Cool; remove rim. Chill.
title: Bavarian Apple Torte

steps: 1. Add salt to eggs and beat 10 minutes.
2. Add sugar and flavoring; beat until well blended.
3. Fold in flour.
4. Transfer to a well-floured board and knead until dough blisters.
5. Cut in halves. Roll very thin and cut into 4-inch strips (long).
6. Slit each piece in center and pull one end through the slit.
7. Fry in hot fat until lightly browned.
8. Drain on absorbent paper.
9. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
title: Chrust(Polish)

steps: 1. Add crumbs to 1 cup water and let stand a few minutes.
2. Add meat and next 4 ingredients and mix well.
3. Shape into two loaves and brown on both sides in margarine in a skillet.
4. Combine 1 cup water and remaining ingredients, except flour, and add to loaves in the skillet.
5. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer, basting several times and turning once, about 1 hour.
6. Remove the loaves, skim fat from liquid and thicken with flour mixed with a little cold water. Simmer a few minutes, add a little more water, if necessary, strain and serve over sliced meat.
7. Serve with potato pancakes.
title: Twin Sauerbraten Loaves

steps: 1. Put salt and pepper on meat.
2. Place in deep ovenproof dish. Add spices and vegetables.
3. Heat vinegar and water to boiling. Pour over meat.
4. Cool, cover and refrigerate.
5. Let marinate 48 hours, turning meat twice a day.
title: Sauerbraten

steps: 1. In a medium pot, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the onions and cook, stirring occasionally until the onions start to caramelize. Add the carrots and cook until the carrots start to soften, about 4 more minutes.

2. Add the stock, water, potatoes, bay leaves, and black peppercorns. Season with salt and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and cook for 10 minutes. Add the millet and cook for 15 more minutes until millet and potatoes are cooked.
3. Gently add the fish cubes. Stir and bring the soup to a simmer. The fish will cook through very fast, so make sure to not overcook them. They are done when the flesh is opaque and flakes easily.
4. Garnish the soup with chopped fresh dill or parsley before serving.
title: Fish Soup (Ukha)

steps: 1. Cook potatoes.
2. Cool and slice.
3. In separate pan cube and fry. Add other ingredients in order given.
4. Bring to a boil.
5. Cook until clear, then add sliced potatoes.
6. Simmer at least one hour. Serve hot.
7. Serves 4 people.
title: German Potato Salad

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. small red potatoes, cooked and sliced

steps: 1. Cut bacon into 1-inch pieces.
2. Cook in skillet until crisp. Remove pieces from skillet and drain.
3. Pour off drippings, reserving 2 tablespoons to return to skillet.
4. Blend in sugar, onion, flour and seasonings.
5. Gradually add water and vinegar. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
6. Boil 1 minute.
7. Add potatoes and bacon pieces.
8. Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally 5 minutes, or until heated through.
9. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Brown beef with onion in 10-inch skillet; drain off fat.
2. Stir in water, rice, crushed bouillon cubes and dry mustard.
3. Bring to boil.
4. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until liquid is absorbed, about 25 minutes.
5. Stir in green pepper and tomato.
6. Sprinkle cheese over top.
7. Cover and remove from heat.
8. Let stand 2 to 3 minutes to melt cheese.
9. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Rice Goulash

steps: 1. Cook and cube potatoes.
2. Cook bacon and crumble.
3. Melt butter in saucepan.
4. Saute onion in butter until golden.
5. Combine flour, salt, sugar and celery seed.
6. Add to onion and cook until bubbly. Combine water and vinegar.
7. Stir into onion mixture.
8. Bring to a boil.
9. Add cooked potatoes and bacon and stir until well mixed. Heat through.
10. Serves 4.
title: Hot German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in boiling water to cover 30 minutes or until tender.
2. Drain and cool slightly.
3. Peel potatoes; cut into 1/2-inch cubes.
4. Cook bacon in a skillet until crisp.
5. Remove bacon, reserving 1/4 cup drippings in skillet.
6. Crumble bacon and set aside.
7. Add sugar, flour, water and vinegar to pan drippings, stirring well.
8. Cook mixture over medium heat until slightly thickened.
9. Combine potatoes, bacon, green pepper, onion, celery and pimiento in a large bowl.
10. Top with vinegar mixture and toss gently.
11. Serve hot.
12. Makes 6 servings.
13. (You may serve the peppers, onion and celery raw or cooked with salad.)
title: Hot German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Snap and cut beans.
2. Combine beans, water, salt and pepper in large kettle.
3. Boil until beans are about tender.
4. Add potatoes. When vegetables are done, add milk, cream and butter.
5. Return to boiling point and serve.
6. Makes approximately 8 to 10 servings.
title: German Green Bean Soup

steps: 1. Cook carrots in water to cover in saucepan until tender; drain.
2. Slice carrots.
3. Combine with mayonnaise, parsley, salt and pepper in a serving bowl.
4. Mix well.
5. Fry bacon in skillet until crisp; drain on paper towel.
6. Saute onion in bacon drippings; stir in sugar and vinegar.
7. Add to carrot mixture; mix well. Sprinkle with bacon.
8. Serve warm.
9. Serves 4 to 6.
title: German Winter Carrot Salad

steps: 1. Cook potatoes until tender.
2. Combine onions, vinegar, water, sugar, salt, pepper and mustard in large pan.
3. Bring to a boil. Add rest of ingredients and cook on low heat until heated through. Yields 6 servings.
title: Hot German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Peel potatoes and cut in half.
2. Place in saucepan.
3. Cover with boiling water.
4. Cover pan and cook until tender when pierced with fork, about 20 minutes.
5. Drain.
6. Shake pan over low heat a few minutes to dry potatoes.
7. Cut into 1/4-inch slices.
8. Dice and cook bacon until crisp.
9. Drain bacon on paper towels.
10. Return 6 tablespoons of drippings to skillet.
11. Add onions; cook, stirring frequently, until transparent.
12. Stir in vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper.
13. Heat to boiling.
14. Add bacon and stir.
15. Pour over potatoes. Toss lightly to distribute bacon.
16. Serve immediately.
17. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Saute bacon and onion until transparent.
2. Add vinegar, sugar, water, salt and pepper.
3. (Bacon should be cut into small crosswise strips before it is cooked.)
4. Mix cornstarch with water to thin paste and stir into other ingredients.
5. Stir until slightly thickened.
6. Add diced, cooked potatoes and serve warm.
7. Serves 6.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Fry bacon in a large skillet until crisp.

2. Remove and set aside. Drain, leaving only about 2 to 3 tablespoons of drippings. Cook onion until tender. Stir in flour and blend well. Add vinegar and water. Cook and stir until bubbly and slightly thickened.
3. Add sugar and stir until dissolved.
4. Crumble bacon gently. Stir in bacon and potato slices to lightly coat. Serve warm. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Cut cucumbers in half lengthwise and scoop out seeds.
2. Cut cucumber halves crosswise into 1/4-inch-wide half rounds.
3. Put cucumbers in a colander and sprinkle with salt.
4. Toss with your hands to mix well.
5. Let stand about 1 hour.
6. Rinse cucumbers if desired.
7. Gently squeeze water out of cucumbers and drain on paper towels.
8. When well drained, return to colander.
9. In a large bowl, whisk sugar, vinegar, mustard and oil.
10. Add cucumbers and mix with hands.
11. Mix in onion and garlic, if using.
12. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours.
13. Add fresh dill and paprika.
14. Mix well.
15. Serves 6.
16. Can be stored in refrigerator up to 1 week.
title: Hungarian Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. Sprinkle sugar over sauerkraut and allow to stand 1/2 hour. Stir in remaining ingredients.
2. Cover well and allow to set 24 hours in refrigerator before serving.
3. Makes 6 servings.
4. Keeps well for up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.
title: Sauerkraut Salad

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients; let stand in refrigerator overnight. Serves 6 to 8.
2. Keeps well for a long time.
title: Sauerkraut Salad

ingredients.text: 3 1/2 lb. potatoes, cooked and diced (7 c.)

steps: 1. In large skillet, cook bacon until crisp.
2. Drain, reserving 3 tablespoons drippings.
3. Crumble bacon.
4. In large bowl, toss bacon with the potatoes and onions; set aside.
5. In drippings, combine flour and sugar.
6. Combine water, vinegar, salt and pepper.
7. Stir into skillet.
8. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
9. Stir in cream.
10. Pour over potato mixture.
11. Toss gently to coat.
12. Makes 12 servings.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Bring the first 4 ingredients to a boil.
2. Remove from heat and add oil.
3. Pour over cabbage.
4. Refrigerate until well chilled. Serves 8.
title: Lou'S German Slaw

ingredients.text: 6 to 8 slices bacon, cooked and diced, reserve drippings

steps: 1. Combine bacon, potatoes and onion.
2. Add salt, pepper, dry mustard, sugar, water, vinegar and egg to bacon drippings.
3. Cook mixture until egg thickens.
4. Pour over bacon-onion-potato mixture and heat until liquid is absorbed.
5. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. In large skillet, cook bacon until crisp.
2. Remove and crumble. Into 1 tablespoon drippings add onion and cook until tender.
3. Add potatoes, bacon and Italian dressing.
4. Toss lightly until coated and heated through.
5. Serves 8.
title: German Style Potato Salad Toss

steps: 1. Melt margarine in Dutch oven.
2. Add apples and onion; saute. Add cabbage, wine, cloves and sugar.
3. Pour vinegar over cabbage first to prevent it from losing red color.
4. Simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: German Red Cabbage

steps: 1. Chop warm potatoes into bowl.
2. Add eggs and onions.
3. Fry bacon until crisp and crumble over potatoes.
4. Retain grease and add rest of ingredients to bacon drippings.
5. Bring to boil, stirring to combine ingredients.
6. Pour over potatoes.
7. Serve warm or cold. Serves 8.
title: German Sour Cream Potatoes

steps: 1. In a large skillet, fry bacon until crisp; remove; set aside. Cook onion in 3 tablespoons of bacon drippings until done.
