7. Place chicken in pan, skin side down.
8. Bake for 45 minutes; turn and bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until top crust begins to bubble.
9. Serve hot or cold, but crust texture is better if chicken is not refrigerated before eating.
10. Pan drippings make good gravy for mashed potatoes. Serves 4 or 5.
title: Oven Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Cream together the margarine and sugar. Add the eggs and beat well. Add the pineapple.
2. Stir in bread cubes.
3. Bake in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, uncovered, for 1 hour at 350° until lightly browned. Serves 6.
4. Can be served as a meat accompaniment, hot or cold.
title: Baked Pineapple Casserole

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except the eggs and milk in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
2. Whisk together the eggs and milk and pour over the top.
3. Refrigerate overnight.
4. In morning, bake, uncovered, at 375° for 45 minutes.
5. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Baked Eggs

steps: 1. Brown beef, bacon and onion; drain.
2. Add all other ingredients, except beans; stir well.
3. Add beans and mix well. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
4. Makes 20 to 24 servings.
title: Barbecue Bean Bake

ingredients.text: 1 c. cooked, ground or finely chopped, ham

steps: 1. Place the milk and butter in a saucepan; bring to boiling point. Stir in cornmeal slowly and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in beaten egg yolks, salt and paprika. Add the cheese and stir until melted. Add the ham and fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
2. Pour into a buttered 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 325° for about 1 hour or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Ham Puff Casserole

ingredients.text: 5 c. sliced apples, soaked in saltwater

steps: 1. Place apples in a buttered baking dish. Combine flour and cinnamon. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Sprinkle over apples and bake about 15 minutes in a 450° oven.
2. Makes 6 servings.
title: Apple Betty

ingredients.text: 1 lb. Italian sausage, cut in 3/4-inch pieces
1 medium onion, cut in thin wedges
8 oz. egg noodles, cooked and drained

steps: 1. Brown sausage for about 10 minutes; remove.
2. Drain all but 2 tablespoons of drippings.
3. Add peppers, onion, garlic and oregano. Saute until tender-crisp.
4. Add broth and sausage.
5. Cook until heated.
6. Add noodles.
7. Toss to coat.
8. Makes 4 servings.
title: Sausage And Peppers

steps: 1. Place all ingredients in a blender or a jar.
2. Cover and blend or shake until frothy and smooth.
3. Makes 4 servings.
title: Orange Smoothee

ingredients.text: 2 medium zucchini, cut in 2 x 1/2-inch sticks

steps: 1. About 15 minutes before serving, bring to boil water and 1/2 teaspoon of table salt in large saucepan.
2. Add vegetables; cover and simmer 5 to 8 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp. Drain well.
3. Spoon into serving dish.
4. Stir in remaining table salt and butter.
5. Makes 8 servings.
title: Fresh Vegetable Medley

ingredients.text: 1 chicken, skinned and cut in eighths
2 Tbsp. no sugar added orange marmalade

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325° (165°C).
2. Put chicken pieces in a baking dish.
3. Combine the other ingredients in a small bowl and pour over chicken.
4. Cover and bake until chicken is tender.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Quickie Chicken L'Orange

ingredients.text: 7 slices bread, remove crust and cube

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together.
2. Turn mixture into greased 2-quart casserole.
3. Bake 35 minutes at 350°.
4. Yield: 6 servings. Carbohydrate 18 g, protein 19 g, fat 18 g, calories 310.
5. One serving = 1 bread starch exchange, 2 meat medium fat exchange, 2 fat exchange, 1/4 milk exchange.
title: Egg And Cheese Casserole

steps: 1. Combine the raisins and nuts; set aside.
2. In a saucepan, bring brown sugar, water, margarine, cinnamon and nutmeg to a boil.
3. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
4. Core apples and place in an ungreased 2-quart baking dish; fill with raisin mixture.
5. Pour sugar mixture over and around apples.
6. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until apples are tender.
7. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Yield: 4 servings.
title: Spiced Baked Apples

steps: 1. Score steak on both sides in a diamond pattern.
2. Brush each side with 1 tablespoon mustard; place in a large shallow dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over steak.
3. Cover and marinate 8 hours.
4. Broil steak 5 minutes on each side or to desired degree of doneness, basting with remaining marinade.
5. Slice steak thinly to serve.
6. Serves 5.
title: Marinated London Broil

steps: 1. Put beef in casserole, salt lightly.
2. Sprinkle with flour and bread crumbs.
3. Pour red wine and consomme together and then pour over meat.
4. Slice onion on top.
5. Cover and bake at 300° for 3 1/2 hours or until meat is done.
6. Serves 6.
title: Busy Day Stew

ingredients.text: 2 chicken breasts, halved, skinned and boned

steps: 1. Combine crumbs, Parmesan cheese, parsley flakes and garlic salt.
2. Mix eggs and water together.
3. Dip each chicken cutlet into egg mixture, then into crumb mixture.
4. Heat oil in large skillet and brown cutlets on each side until golden brown.
5. Remove to flat baking dish.
6. Saute mushrooms briefly in same skillet; spoon over cutlets.
7. Combine melted butter and lemon juice; pour over chicken and mushrooms.
8. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
9. Serves 4.
title: Mushroom-Chicken Cutlets

steps: 1. Cut steak in long, narrow strips.
2. Salt, pepper and flour steak.
3. Brown in small amount of oil.
4. Drain oil and add tomatoes, onions and peppers.
5. Cook until tender, about 40 minutes.
6. Serve over rice.
7. Serves 6.
title: Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together except butter.
2. Heat butter in a skillet over moderate heat and drop in mixture by spoonfuls.
3. Fry to a delicate brown.
4. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Tomato Fritters

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Grease baking dish good.
3. Cook beef and onion in skillet until beef is brown.
4. Drain grease off.
5. Stir in soup, vegetables and milk.
6. Mix together the Bisquick and water in baking dish until moistened.
7. Spread evenly.
8. Add beef mixture over Bisquick batter.
9. Sprinkle with cheese.
10. Bake 30 minutes.
11. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Beef Bisquick Bake

steps: 1. In an 8 x 11-inch pan, mix melted oleo and brown sugar.
2. Add flour and nuts.
3. Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.
4. Stir once. Let cool.
5. Beat egg whites until they form soft peaks.
6. Add sugar, peaches and lemon juice.
7. Beat until it triples in volume and forms soft peaks.
8. Fold in whipped cream.
9. Arrange in layers with cooled crumbles and peach mixture.
10. Freeze.
11. Serves 12.
title: Peach Spectacular

steps: 1. Combine olive oil, garlic, thyme and lemon juice.
2. Marinate pork chops in mixture for at least 1 hour.
3. Grill pork chops over medium coals for 25 to 30 minutes or until no pink remains.
4. Turn chops several times and baste during the last 5 minutes of cooking time with marinade.
5. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Grilled Pork Chops

steps: 1. Soak beef in cold water 15 minutes (drain).
2. Pick into thin pieces.
3. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in pan.
4. Put in beef and brown. Add milk and cream.
5. Bring to
6. boil; thicken with flour, mixed to a smooth paste with balance of butter (1 tablespoon).
7. Stir constantly until it boils.
8. Serve over toast.
9. Serves 6.
title: Creamed Chipped Beef

steps: 1. Cook dried beef in butter until done.
2. Push meat to one side. Blend flour into butter.
3. Add milk all at once.
4. Cook, stirring, until thick.
5. Gradually add beef.
6. Add Worcestershire and dash of pepper.
7. Spoon over buttered toast.
8. Serves 3.
title: Creamed Beef

steps: 1. In a medium size mixing bowl, mix first 6 ingredients. Marinate for 1 day, then place pork chops on grill over hot charcoals.
2. Cook until done.
3. Makes 4 servings.
title: Marinated Pork Chops

steps: 1. Bring water and vinegar and seasonings to a boil. Rinse shrimp before adding to boiling water.
2. Cook 3 to 5 minutes after water comes to boil. Place in colander to drain-quickly refrigerate.
3. Serves 2.
title: Boiled Shrimp

steps: 1. Mix gently and put in greased casserole.
2. Put in oven at 350° until browned.
3. May be mixed ahead of time.
4. If you wish to make larger amount, add 1 can drained green peas.
5. Serves 6.
title: Quick Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°. Spray 2-quart oval baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Crumble sausage into large skillet. Brown over medium-high heat until no longer pink, stirring to separate meat. Drain sausage on paper towels. Discard fat and wipe skillet with paper towel. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in same skillet over medium heat. Stir in flour, salt and pepper until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Cook and stir until thickened. Add sausage, potatoes and eggs. Stir to combine. Pour into prepared dish. Melt remaining 1 tablespoon butter. Combine corn flakes crumbs and melted butter in small bowl. Sprinkle evenly over casserole. Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Sprinkle with green onions. Makes 6 servings.
title: Egg And Sausage Casserole

steps: 1. Brown hamburger and onion.
2. Add all remaining ingredients. Simmer for 20 minutes.
3. Serve on hamburger rolls.
4. Serves 8.
title: Barbecued Hamburger

ingredients.text: 1 frying chicken (about 2 1/2 lb.), cut into serving pieces

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Beat egg and milk.
3. In a plastic bag, combine flour, baking powder, salt, paprika and sesame seed.
4. Dip chicken pieces into egg mixture, then shake one piece at a time in plastic bag.
5. Place skin side up in baking dish.
6. Pour melted margarine over and bake about one hour or until done.
7. Serves 5.
title: Sesame Chicken

ingredients.text: 6 Chicken Breasts, skinless, boneless, cut into strips

steps: 1. Combine flour, paprika and pepper in a plastic bag.
2. Place chicken strips in the bag a few at a time and shake to coat.
3. Melt margarine in a large frypan.
4. Brown chicken lightly in margarine, then add water, cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
5. Remove chicken to a casserole dish, leaving dripping in the frypan.
6. Mix cornstarch and cream and stir into dripping over medium heat. Stir until thickened.
7. Add sherry and pour over breasts in the casserole dish.
8. Cover and bake 30 minutes at 350°.
9. Remove cover. Sprinkle with cheese.
10. Bake uncovered an additional 5 minutes. Serve over a bed of rice pilaf. Serves 6.
title: Judy'S Chicken Breasts

steps: 1. Mix together with salt and pepper to taste.
2. Roll tomatoes in mixture and fry until golden brown.
3. Serves 4 people.
4. May substitute yellow squash for green tomatoes.
title: Skillet Fried Green Tomatoes

steps: 1. Beat eggs; add margarine, milk and mustard.
2. Beat by hand. Fold in grated cheese, cubed bread and ham.
3. Pour into 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan.
4. Refrigerate overnight.
5. Bake 45 minutes in 350° oven.
6. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes.
7. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Ham And Cheese Casserole

steps: 1. Cut eggplant crosswise into 8 (1/2-inch) slices and peel. Brush each slice with melted butter.
2. Add remaining butter, salt and pepper to bread crumbs.
3. Dip slices into buttered crumbs. Bake, uncovered, on a baking sheet in a 450° oven for 18 minutes. Serves 4.
title: Baked Sliced Eggplant

steps: 1. Mix together flour, oats, brown sugar and butter.
2. Press half mixture into a 9 x 9-inch pan.
3. Cover with berries and rhubarb. Combine water, sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan and stir until blended.
4. Cook over medium heat until mixture thickens.
5. Add vanilla and pour over strawberry rhubarb mixture.
6. Top with remaining crumb mixture.
7. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
8. Serves 8.
title: Strawberry Rhubarb Crunch

steps: 1. Partly peel cucumbers, leaving narrow strips of peel.
2. Thinly slice cucumbers.
3. In a measuring cup or mixing bowl, combine vinegar, sugar, salt and ginger root; stir until sugar is dissolved.
4. Pour over cucumber slices.
5. Cover and chill thoroughly before serving.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Cucumber Namasu

steps: 1. Melt margarine.
2. Mix bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, parsley, marjoram and garlic.
3. Place chicken, one piece at a time, first in margarine, then in bread crumbs, turning to coat.
4. Place chicken, skin side up, in single layer in shallow roasting pan.
5. Dot with remaining 2 tablespoons margarine.
6. Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven for 1 hour or until fork can be inserted in chicken.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Imperial Chicken

steps: 1. In a baking dish, combine the oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper, flaxseed, and garlic.
2. Add the fish, coat it well, cover it, and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
3. Preheat your oven to 450 degrees F.
4. Line a baking sheet with foil and coat it with cooking spray. Remove the fish from the marinade and place the fish skin-side down on the baking sheet.
5. Bake for 9 to 12 minutes. Serve with rice and a green vegetable.
6. Makes 4 servings Per serving: 433 calories, 42 g protein, 19 g carbohydrates, 20 g fat (3 g saturated), 3 g fiber, 252 mg sodium.
title: Salmon Rushdie Dinner

steps: 1. Saute onions until tender.
2. Mix all ingredients together and mix well.
3. Shape
4. into 2 ounce round meat balls.
5. Makes 8 to 10 meat balls
6. per
7. pound.
8. Place in a greased baking pan and bake in a hot
9. oven at 400° until brown all over, about 30 to 40 minutes. Remove
10. the
11. meat balls from the pan and empty the grease. Replace the meat in the baking pan and cover with the tomato sauce.
12. Cook in
13. oven
14. at 325° for another 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Meat Balls

steps: 1. Saute onion and pepper in shortening in large skillet. Add ground beef; brown well. Add tomato juice, rice, chili powder and seasonings; stir well. Pour into casserole; cover. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes. Yields 4 servings.
title: Texas Hash

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°. Wash tomatoes, but do not peel. Cut slice from top of each; scoop out centers and slightly salt insides. Mix tomato pulp, celery, onion, bread crumbs, salt and 1/2 of cheese. Fill tomato cavities with mixture. Cover with remaining cheese. Dot with butter. Place in greased muffin cups or greased baking dish. Bake about 30 minutes. Serves 6.
title: Baked Stuffed Tomatoes

steps: 1. In large skillet heat 3 Tbsp. margarine over medium heat. Add mushrooms and celery; cook about 5 minutes or until tender. Strain mushrooms and celery; reserving vegetables and juices.
2. In medium saucepan stir together cornstarch, salt thyme and pepper. Gradually stir in reserved vegetable juices and milk.
3. Stirring constantly, bring to a boil over medium heat and boil 1 minute. Remove from heat.
4. Add turkey, noodles, wine, mushrooms and celery.
5. Stir until well mixed.
6. Spoon into 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.
7. In small skillet melt remaining margarine.
8. Add bread crumbs and stir until well mixed.
9. Sprinkle over casserole.
10. Bake at 400 degree oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until bubbly.
11. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Herb Flavored Turkey Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 fryer, cut up or pieces of your choice

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients except chicken in small saucepan.
2. Heat on low until butter is melted and ingredients are blended.
3. Dip each piece of chicken in sauce and place skin side down in a shallow baking pan.
4. Pour remaining sauce over chicken.
5. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 25 minutes.
6. Then turn pieces skin side up.
7. Bake 35 minutes.
8. Makes about 6 servings.
title: Chicken Tasty And Tangy

steps: 1. Melt cheese in milk in saucepan. Add 1 slice of bread, crumbled, and thicken. Add tuna.
2. Place in small uncovered casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or microwave for 7 minutes.
3. Serves 1.
title: Dieter'S Tuna Casserole(For 1)

ingredients.text: 1 large (28 oz.) can whole tomatoes, coarsely chopped
1 small (8 oz.) can kidney beans, drained

steps: 1. Crumble ground beef into 2 1/2-quart bowl; add onion and garlic powder.
2. Microwave at High power for 3 to 4 minutes or until all pinkness is gone; drain well.
3. Sprinkle seasoning over beef; stir to combine.
4. Add tomatoes and beans.
5. Cover loosely and microwave at High power for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring 3 or 4 times during cooking.
6. Garnish each serving as desired with shredded cheese, sliced ripe olives and sour cream.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Quick Chili

steps: 1. Pour beaten eggs over chicken.
2. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours.
3. Drain, then dredge in bread crumbs.
4. Place 8 tablespoons butter in pan and brown chicken pieces.
5. Place chicken in baking dish.
6. In same pan, add remaining 2 tablespoons butter and cook mushrooms 5 minutes.
7. Spoon mixture over chicken.
8. Top with cheese. Add broth.
9. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
10. Serves 4.
title: Company Chicken

steps: 1. Heat 4 tablespoons butter in large skillet; add onion and mushrooms and cook until tender.
2. Add salt and Tabasco; remove to small bowl.
3. Cut bread into 6 rounds; spread with remaining 2 tablespoons butter and toast in same skillet.
4. Grease six ramekins.
5. Place one toast circle in each ramekin; top with a layer of onion and mushrooms.
6. Carefully break two eggs into each ramekin.
7. Top each with 2 tablespoons cream.
8. Bake in 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes until eggs are set.
9. Serve immediately. Makes 6 servings.
title: Baked Eggs With Mushrooms

steps: 1. Melt butter in saucepan and add oysters.
2. Cook 3 minutes over moderate heat, until edges of oysters curl.
3. Add remaining ingredients.
4. Let heat almost to boiling point.
5. Serve at once. Sprinkle paprika on each serving.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Oyster Stew

steps: 1. Put milk, berries, sugar and 1 pint of vanilla ice cream in blender.
2. Cover and blend on high speed until smooth.
3. Pour into glasses and top with a scoop of ice cream.
4. Garnish with fresh blueberries.
5. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.
title: Purple Monster

ingredients.text: 1 large can sliced mushrooms, sliced (save liquid)

steps: 1. Prepare white sauce: melt butter, add flour and make a roux. Add milk, whisking as it thickens.
2. Add curry powder, salt, pepper and Tabasco.
3. Blend in eggs and mushrooms and gently heat through. Serve on toasted English muffins or toast points.
4. Serves 8.
title: Curried Eggs

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. drained, cooked cut green beans

steps: 1. In skillet, brown beef and onion, stirring to separate meat particles.
2. Stir in soup, water, beans and noodles.
3. Spoon into 1-quart casserole; top with cheese.
4. Bake in 375° oven about 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
5. Yield: 4 servings.
title: Family Casserole

ingredients.text: 4 large red onions, cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices

steps: 1. Place onions in a 1-gallon resealable plastic bag.
2. In a medium bowl whisk next 5 ingredients.
3. Pour vinegar mixture into bag and seal.
4. Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.
5. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
6. Using a slotted spoon, place onions in skillet and cook until brown on both sides.
7. Drain on paper towels.
8. Serve warm.
9. Serves 8.
title: Grilled Red Onions

steps: 1. Wash and clean peppers.
2. Combine remaining ingredients except tomato soup and mix thoroughly.
3. Fill pepper shells lightly with meat mixture.
4. Place on rack in cooker; add soup.
5. Pressure cook at 15 pounds pressure for 10 minutes.
6. Reduce pressure.
7. Serves 4.
title: Stuffed Green Peppers

steps: 1. Cream butter, brown sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy; beat in egg.
2. Sift together dry ingredients and 1/4 teaspoon of salt; mix into creamed mixture.
3. Divide dough into 4 parts; make 12 balls about 1/2-inch in diameter out of each part.
4. Place balls on ungreased cookie sheet.
5. Flatten by crisscrossing with fork tines. Bake at 375° for about 8 minutes.
6. Serves 8.
title: Butterscotch Thins

steps: 1. In skillet, brown ground beef.
2. Stir in tomato sauce and heat. Cook noodles as in directions; drain and mix with 1 teaspoon butter.
3. Combine cheeses, onion and pepper.
4. Butter 9 x 12-inch baking dish.
5. Line with half of the noodles.
6. Cover with cheese mixture.
7. Add rest of noodles.
8. Pour melted butter over top, then pour meat mixture over all.
9. Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven.
10. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Beef Casserole

steps: 1. In a large skillet, simmer the first 3 ingredients, covered, until the zucchini is tender. Add the remaining ingredients and heat through.
2. Serves 4.
title: Poppy Seed Zucchini

steps: 1. Clean berries; remove stems.
2. Place berries in a large bowl. Peel and slice bananas into bowl.
3. Toss lightly.
4. Serve this in red, white and blue snack cups or small bowls.
5. Serves 24.
title: Fourth Of July Fruit Cup

steps: 1. Rinse fillets; pat dry and set aside.
2. In small bowl, combine crumbs, cheese and garlic powder.
3. Dip fillets in egg whites, then into crumb mix.
4. Coat well.
5. Arrange fillets in a shallow microproof baking dish with the thickest parts facing outside of dish.
6. Cover with paper towel.
7. Cook cycle for 8 to 10 minutes. Let stand 2 minutes.
8. Serve with lemon wedges.
9. Makes 2 servings.
title: Fabulous Baked Fish

steps: 1. Brown steak on both sides.
2. Combine vegetables and water and pour over steak.
3. Simmer at 200° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
4. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Swiss Steak

steps: 1. Beat eggs until fluffy; add milk, flour, sugar and salt.
2. Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan in oven.
3. Tip pan to coat sides and bottom.
4. Pour in batter and bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
5. Serve with syrup or warmed pie filling.
6. Chop bacon and oven fry it first; pour off excess grease.
7. Spread bacon evenly before pouring the batter over it.
8. This gets very high and fluffy, but falls within a minute.
9. Serves 3.
title: Pannekoeken

ingredients.text: 1 lb. fish fillets (such as cod, flounder or trout)

steps: 1. Place fish in a greased baking pan. Combine remaining ingredients and spoon evenly over fish. Bake in preheated 350° oven 10 to 15 minutes until fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork; do not overcook. Makes 4 servings.
title: Baked Herbed Fish

steps: 1. Mix bread crumbs, cheese, beaten egg yolks, milk, 1 tablespoon butter and seasonings.
2. Saute onion in remaining butter.
3. Add to first mixture with ham and parsley and mix well.
4. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
5. Turn into buttered shallow baking dish. Bake at 325° for about 1 hour or until set.
6. Serves 6.
title: Ham Brunch Puffit

ingredients.text: 1 large zucchini, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices

steps: 1. In large skillet, saute bacon until crisp; remove bacon bits and set aside.
2. In hot drippings, saute onion until tender, about 5 minutes.
3. Add pepper strips and zucchini; sprinkle with salt and thyme.
4. Cook, covered, over medium heat for 15 minutes, or just until vegetables are tender.
5. Turn into serving dish; sprinkle with bacon bits.
6. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Zucchini And Green Peppers

ingredients.text: 4 (1 1/2 oz.) milk chocolate bars, broken into thirds (no nuts)

steps: 1. For each S'More, place piece of chocolate on a cracker.
2. Toast marshmallow and place on chocolate.
3. Top with second cracker. Squeeze gently and eat.
4. Serves 6.
title: S'Mores(Tastes Like Some More)

steps: 1. In a mixing bowl, combine clams, egg, salt and pepper.
2. Add just enough flour to hold together.
3. Drop by large spoonfuls into hot oil in a skillet.
4. Panfry until golden on both sides.
5. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Clam Fritters

steps: 1. Cook sausage in skillet until browned, stirring to crumble; drain.
2. Place hash browns in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; sprinkle with salt.
3. Layer sausage, cheese and green pepper.
4. Combine eggs and milk, stirring well.
5. Pour over top of green pepper layer.
6. Bake at 350° for about 50 minutes.
7. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Brunch For A Bunch

steps: 1. Beat egg whites until stiff.
2. Mash peaches in food processor or by hand.
3. Beat peaches into the egg whites; put into sherbet glasses.
4. Chill.
5. Yield: 6 servings.
6. Carbohydrate 8 g, protein 3 g, fat .1 g, calories 40.
7. One serving = 1 fruit exchange.
title: Floothy Peach

ingredients.text: 3 tablespoons hot pepper sauce (such as Frank's)

steps: 1. Add water to a Dutch oven to a depth of 1 inch; bring to a simmer. Place chicken in a vegetable steamer. Place steamer in pan over water; cover. Reduce heat to medium-low. Steam, covered, 10 minutes. Remove chicken from steamer; cool. Pat dry.

2. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add oil; swirl to coat. Add chicken to pan; saute 5 minutes, turning to brown on all sides. Add garlic and chives to pan; saute 30 seconds, stirring constantly. Remove pan from heat; transfer chicken mixture to a large bowl using a slotted spoon.
3. Combine pepper sauce and ground red pepper. Drizzle pepper mixture over chicken; toss to coat. Sprinkle with cheese.

4. Variation 1: Sticky Chile Drumettes Prepare Garlic-Buffalo Drumettes through step 2, omitting garlic and chives and adding 1/3 cup chopped green onions and 1 tablespoon minced peeled fresh ginger instead. Combine 3 tablespoons Thai sweet chili sauce (such as Mae Ploy), 1 1/2 tablespoons Sriracha (hot chile sauce, such as Huy Fong), 2 teaspoons rice vinegar, and 2 teaspoons fish sauce, stirring well. Drizzle chili mixture over chicken; toss. SERVES 4 (serving size: 5 drumettes) CALORIES 272; FAT 2g (sat 4g); SODIUM 520mg

5. Variation 2: Mango-Serrano Drumettes Prepare Garlic-Buffalo Drumettes through step 2, omitting garlic and chives and adding 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro and 2 thinly sliced serrano chiles instead. Bring 1 (6-ounce) can mango nectar to a boil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Simmer 15 minutes or until reduced to 1/4 cup, stirring occasionally. Stir in 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice and 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt. Drizzle mango mixture over chicken mixture; toss. SERVES 4 (serving size: 5 drumettes) CALORIES 297; FAT 2g (sat 4g); SODIUM 415mg
title: Garlic-Buffalo Drumettes

steps: 1. Notes: Make sure your turkey isn't any bigger than 12 pounds or it won't cook in time. Salting and putting baking powder on the skin and letting it chill overnight makes for moist meat and a very crisp-skinned turkey, but you can skip this step if you don't have time. The turkey might look a little blotchy and red after the overnight salting. That's OK. Serves 8-9 people.

2. 1. Put the turkey breast-side down on a cutting board. Using kitchen shears, cut down one side of the backbone and then cut down the other side. Chop off the wing tips. Reserve wing tips and backbone for stock. Open turkey like a book. Flip turkey over and press down as hard as you can on the breastbone to flatten the bird. Put it cut side down on a rack set in a roasting pan and sprinkle the baking powder and salt over the skin. Refrigerate overnight, or at least 6 hours, uncovered.
3. 2. Take turkey out of the fridge about an hour before cooking and let it come to room temperature. Preheat oven to 450F.
4. 3. Roast turkey for 70 minutes, rotating the pan halfway through, until the juice runs clear when turkey is pierced with a knife. Let rest for 30 minutes before carving.
title: 70 Minute Butterflied Roast Turkey

steps: 1. Cook and stir celery in butter until tender.
2. Stir in croutons, cheese and salt.
3. Cut thin slice from stem end of the green peppers.
4. Remove seeds and membranes.
5. Wash inside and outside.
6. Place each pepper on piece of double thickness heavy-duty aluminum foil.
7. Fill peppers with cheese stuffing (above).
8. Wrap securely in foil.
9. Cook directly on medium coals for 15 to 20 minutes, turning once, or on grill 3 to 4 inches from hot coals for 30 to 40 minutes, turning once.
10. Makes 4 servings.
title: Stuffed Peppers

steps: 1. In a mixing bowl, combine vinegar, water, sugar and salt. Pare cucumbers.
2. Cut into slices.
3. Put cukes in a glass or plastic bowl.
4. Pour dressing over cucumbers.
5. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, but no longer than 24 hours.
6. Drain.
7. Mix in sour cream and pepper.
8. Sprinkle with parsley.
9. Serves 4.
title: Sour Cream Cucumbers

steps: 1. Flake
2. the
3. salmon.
4. Mix
5. the dry ingredients together. Add the buttermilk slowly to the dry ingredients. Add eggs and beat well.
6. Mix	with
7. salmon.
8. Drop mixture by spoonfuls into deep hot fat.
9. Fry until golden brown.
10. Serves 6.
title: Deep Fried Salmon Puffs

steps: 1. Peel, core and slice apples.
2. Place slices into micro-safe dish.
3. Mix honey and orange juice and pour over apple slices. Sprinkle with cinnamon.
4. Toss to coat well.
5. Cover with plastic wrap.
6. Microwave on High for 2 minutes.
7. Stir.
8. Recover and micro 2 more minutes.
9. Serve hot.
10. Yields 4 servings.
11. Has 55 calories, fat free.
title: Baked Apple Slices

steps: 1. Mix eggs in a bowl with shredded zucchini.
2. Chop ham into bite size cubes, then add to egg mix.
3. Pour into hot, lightly greased frying pan and cook like scrambled eggs (serves 4 to 6.).
title: Green Eggs And Ham

ingredients.text: 1/2 tsp. garlic powder (garlic salt will work)

steps: 1. Melt butter in large skillet.
2. Add zucchini, onion and all spices.
3. Cover; simmer over low heat until zucchini and onion are soft.
4. Add Swiss cheese; re-cover until cheese is thoroughly melted.
5. Serves 4.
title: Zucchini L' Italienne

ingredients.text: 4 to 5 apples (cooking apples, hard, juicy and tart)

steps: 1. Core and slice apples.
2. Put oleo in skillet; add apples and cook on medium heat.
3. Add brown sugar and let cook down.
4. Add water to start cooking.
5. Serves 4 or 5.
6. Serve for breakfast or with pork dishes.
title: Fried Apples

steps: 1. Peel and slice cucumber.
2. In medium bowl, with fork, beat water, vinegar, oil, sugar, salt and pepper until well blended. Add cucumber slices and toss gently.
3. Cover and refrigerate. Serve as a relish or salad.
4. Serves 4.
title: Marinated Cucumbers

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat; add steak. Saute until brown.
2. Add tomatoes, green peppers, mushrooms and onion. Stir in soy sauce, salt, ginger, sugar and pepper.
3. Cover. Simmer for 30 minutes.
4. In a small bowl, blend a small amount of pan juices with flour.
5. Stir into skillet.
6. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
7. Serve over rice.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Pepper Steak

steps: 1. In a mortar, pound the garlic to a paste with the basil and parsley; add the tomato paste and cheese.
2. Beat in the oil by droplets, then beat in 1 cup of hot soup.
3. Pour the sauce into a small bowl and pass it around with Garden Soup.
4. Yield:
5. 10 to 12 servings.
title: Pistou

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450°.
2. Butter a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass baking dish.
3. Mix butter, mustard, lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce. Spread over fish.
4. Sprinkle bread crumbs over top.
5. Bake about 10 minutes.
6. Serves 2 to 3.
title: Fish Dijon

ingredients.text: 2 lb. cooking apples (Yellow Delicious are best)

steps: 1. Peel, core and thinly slice apples.
2. In large skillet, melt butter or margarine.
3. Add apples.
4. Saute 10 minutes.
5. Combine sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over apples.
6. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 5 minutes more.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Country Fried Apples

ingredients.text: 4 (5 oz.) fresh or frozen salmon steaks

steps: 1. Thaw salmon if frozen.
2. In large skillet, combine water, lemon juice and pepper.
3. Bring to a boil.
4. Add salmon.
5. Simmer, covered, for 7 to 10 minutes, until fish flakes easily.
6. Remove salmon from liquid and serve.
7. Serves 4.
title: Poached Salmon

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°. Trim boneless pork loin roast. Rinse and pat dry. Rub roast with olive oil. Sprinkle with salt and pepper; place in an aluminum foil-lined 13- x 9-inch pan.
2. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until a meat thermometer inserted into thickest portion registers 150°. Let stand 15 minutes before slicing.

3. Baked Pork Butt Roast: Substitute 1 (4- to 5-lb.) boneless pork shoulder roast (Boston butt) for boneless pork loin roast. Prepare recipe as directed in Step Bake at 350° for 4 to 4 1/2 hours or until a meat thermometer inserted into thickest portion registers 180°. Let stand 15 minutes before slicing. Makes 8 to 10 servings. Prep: 10 min., Bake: 4 hr.
title: Baked Pork Loin Roast

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients.
2. Bake in loaf pan, sprayed with nonstick cooking spray, for 1 hour.
3. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Lentil Roast(Low-Fat)

steps: 1. Tear beef in pieces.
2. Melt butter in frying pan.
3. Add beef and saute until light brown.
4. Sprinkle flour and pepper over beef and blend well.
5. Add milk slowly, stirring constantly, and cook over low heat until mixture thickens and boils.
6. Serve in hot dish or on toast or hot biscuits.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Creamed Dried Beef

ingredients.text: 8 to 9 lb. chicken (can use cut up fryers, leg quarters, I find chicken breasts are best)

steps: 1. Twenty-four hours ahead of cooking time, rinse and dry chicken pieces; set aside.
2. Combine all ingredients in food processor until smooth.
3. Place chicken pieces in large Ziploc bags and pour marinade in each.
4. Refrigerate 24 hours.
5. Soak mesquite wood with lighter fluid 30 minutes before lighting.
6. Light and allow coals to become red-hot.
7. Remove chicken from marinade and place over open grill.
8. Baste with remaining marinade and cook until no longer pink.
9. Can serve 10 to 12 healthy appetites.
title: Mesquite Grilled Chicken(For A Crowd)

ingredients.text: 1 Tablespoon Jalapeno, Seeded And Chopped Fine

steps: 1. Prepare quinoa according to package directions. Then let it stand and cool slightly before proceeding. Measure out 3/4 cup of the cooked quinoa and put it into a bowl. Add all of the remaining ingredients. Mix by hand. The mixture will be moist and stick together slightly.

2. Preheat oven to 350 F. Spray cooking spray into four cups of a muffin tin. Divide the mixture evenly between the four cups. Press the mixture down so that it is compacted a little into the muffin tin. Bake at 350 F for about 20 minutes. It will become golden brown on top. When done, remove the pan from the oven and let them sit for a minute or two before removing them from the muffin tin. Makes 4 servings.
title: Mushroom Jalapeno Quinoa Cups

steps: 1. Cook bacon until crisp.
2. Combine remaining ingredients except the lettuce; add to bacon.
3. Heat just to boiling, stirring constantly.
4. Tear lettuce into bowl.
5. Pour hot dressing over lettuce and toss lightly.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Pennsylvania-Dutch Lettuce

ingredients.text: 1 medium tomato, peeled and cut up small

steps: 1. Brown the rice in 2 tablespoons oil over moderate heat, stirring frequently.
2. Add tomato pieces, onion and garlic to rice. Cook 5 minutes longer, stirring constantly.
3. Brown chicken in remaining oil in large pot.
4. Add rice mixture, bouillon and seasonings.
5. Bring to boil.
6. Lower heat, cover and simmer 40 minutes or until rice and chicken is tender.
7. Serves 4.
title: Rio Grande Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 c. fresh corn, cut from the cob

steps: 1. Saute onion in butter in a Dutch oven.
2. Add remaining ingredients.
3. Cover and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
4. Serves 8.
title: Summer Garden Medley

steps: 1. Peel and slice potatoes. Mix brown sugar and seasonings; sprinkle over potatoes. Dot with butter; cover. Place over low heat. Cook 30 minutes. Remove cover the last 5 minutes to thicken syrup. Turn potatoes to glaze. Yield: 8 servings.
title: Candied Yams

ingredients.text: 3 c. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed

steps: 1. Brown sausage in skillet, stirring until crumbly.
2. Drain. Place potatoes in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
3. Sprinkle with salt. Layer sausage, cheese and green pepper over top.
4. Combine eggs and milk in bowl; mix well.
5. Pour over layers.
6. Bake at 350° for about 50 minutes or until set.
7. Yields 8 servings.
title: Rose'S Brunch For A Bunch

ingredients.text: 4 c. ripe strawberries, pureed and chilled

steps: 1. Combine sugar and water in small pan.
2. Cook and stir over medium heat until sugar is dissolved.
3. Before sugar comes to a boil, remove and chill until syrupy.
4. In blender, add syrup to remaining ingredients and blend well.
5. Turn mixture into freezing tray and freeze until firm.
6. Makes 8 servings.
7. One serving equals 90 calories or 2 1/2 fruit exchanges.
title: Fresh Strawberry Sherbet(Low Calorie)

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. sliced onions, pushed into rings

steps: 1. Brown first 4 ingredients.
2. After browning add in layers, sliced potatoes, sliced onions, sliced carrots, 2 teaspoons salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper.
3. Steam in electric frypan with the vent closed until fork-tender, then if desired, leave vent open for last 10 minutes.
4. This serves 4 to 6 people and is very tasty; your whole meal is in one pan.
title: A Meal In A Pan

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine first 8 ingredients.
2. Place chicken in mixture and turn to coat.
3. Cover and marinate overnight.
4. Coat with bread crumbs.
5. Bake, uncovered, in shallow baking pan at 350° for 45 minutes.
6. Makes 8 servings, each 271 calories and 5 grams of fat.
title: Low-Fat Baked Chicken Breasts

ingredients.text: 1 fresh lemon, 1/2 for juice and 1/2 for slices

steps: 1. Combine oregano, sage and basil thoroughly.
2. Wash and pat dry the chicken breasts.
3. Pat chicken breasts with combined spices on both sides.
4. Place in a glass casserole dish 2 to 3 inches deep. Squeeze 1/2 of fresh lemon on chicken.
5. Scatter over the chicken the carrots, celery, mushrooms, tomatoes and lemon slices.
6. Pour 1/3 cup of water over the vegetables and chicken.
7. Distribute butter over top of vegetables and cover tightly with casserole lid or aluminum foil.
8. Bake at 300° until vegetables are tender, about 1 hour.
9. Serve chicken with vegetables over buttered rice with spinach salad.
10. Serves 4.
title: Natalya'S Chicken

steps: 1. Brown ground beef.
2. Drain.
3. Add onion and celery.
4. Cook until tender.
5. Stir in rice, broth, water and soy sauce.
6. Cover.
7. Simmer until rice is done, about 20 minutes.
8. Yield:
9. 4 servings.
title: Oriental Skillet

steps: 1. Beat eggs and milk until well mixed.
2. Add remaining ingredients.
3. Put in well-greased 2-quart casserole and set in pan of hot water.
4. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until set.
5. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. Brown ground beef and onion; drain.
2. Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
3. Turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
4. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Beef And Bean Casserole

steps: 1. Pour into greased souffle dish or baking pan and put in a pan of hot water.
2. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until firm.
3. Serves 2.
title: Cochise Casserole

steps: 1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a glass dish.
2. Add chicken breasts.
3. Turn to coat with marinade.
4. Marinate about 2 hours. Broil or grill 4 to 5 inches from heat for 5 minutes per side or until thoroughly cooked.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Lemon Marinated Chicken

steps: 1. Cover rabbits with water in large pan; cook for 2 hours or until meat is easily removed from bones.
2. Reserve liquid from pan. Debone rabbits; put meat back in pan.
3. Add liquid and vegetables; bring to boil.
4. Reduce to simmer until vegetables are done.
5. Add salt and pepper.
6. Make paste with flour and water; stir into the mixture to thicken it.
7. Remove from heat and eat.
8. Serves 4 to 6 people.
title: Rabbit Stew

steps: 1. In a saucepan, melt margarine, then stir in flour and salt until blended.
2. Slowly add Sprite and milk, stirring until mixture is smooth.
3. Add cheese and stir until it is melted into the mixture.
4. Pour mixture into a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.
5. Break eggs into the sauce.
6. Bake at 350 degrees until eggs become firm. Serves 6.
title: Oven Baked Eggs

ingredients.text: 3 medium (1 lb.) cooking apples, peeled, quartered, cored and cut into 1/2-inch slices
2 Tbsp. frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed

steps: 1. Arrange apples in circles in greased 9-inch pie plate.
2. Stir together honey, orange concentrate and cardamom.
3. Pour over apples and dot with butter.
4. Bake in preheated 375° oven, basting once with pan juices, 25 to 30 minutes or until tender.
5. Serve warm as side dish with lamb or pork or as dessert.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Baked Orange-Cardamom Apples

steps: 1. Brown meat and drain.
2. Pour other ingredients over meat and mix well.
3. Simmer over low heat for about 15 minutes.
4. Serve on buns.
5. Makes approximately 4 servings.
title: Sloppy Joes

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. dry sherry (I use cooking sherry)

steps: 1. In large skillet, heat oil and add beef which you have cut into bite-sized pieces.
2. Brown meat over high heat.
3. Pour off most of the accumulated fat.
4. Sprinkle meat with flour and place meat in heavy saucepan.
5. Pour next 8 ingredients over it.
6. Simmer, covered, for 2 to 3 hours, or until meat is easily pierced with a fork.
7. During the last hour of cooking, add sherry.
8. Separately cook the last three ingredients until nearly tender.
9. Add to rest of stew for last 15 minutes of cooking.
10. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Gaston Beef Stew

steps: 1. Cook sausage until brown; drain.
2. In same pan, melt butter; brown hash browns.
3. In 2-quart dish, layer sausage, potatoes and cheese.
4. Beat eggs, milk and salt; pour over casserole.
5. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until firm.
6. Serves 8.
title: Eggs Strata

steps: 1. Sprinkle chicken with paprika. In a large skillet, brown chicken in 2 teaspoons butter. Place the vegetables in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with chicken. Melt the remaining butter. Stir in the tarragon, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Pour over chicken and vegetables. Cover and bake at 350° for 35 minutes, until vegetables are tender. Makes 4 servings.
title: Chicken Tarragon

ingredients.text: 1 lb. plain sausage, cooked, drained and cooled

steps: 1. Cover bottom of a greased 10 x 6-inch or 7 x 11-inch baking dish with half of grated cheese.
2. Mix all seasonings with sour cream and pour half over the cheese.
3. Add crumbled, cooked sausage.
4. Beat eggs and pour over mixture.
5. Spoon rest of sour cream mixture over eggs and rest of cheese on top.
6. Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes, uncovered.
7. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: Sausage 'N Egg Casserole

steps: 1. Combine rice, carrots, 1 1/2 cups cheese, milk, eggs, onion and seasonings. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.
title: Golden Cheese Bake

steps: 1. Cut fish into 6 portions.
2. Dip in milk; roll in mixture of bread crumbs and salt.
3. Place in single layer, skin side down, in greased baking pan.
4. Drizzle with mixture of melted butter and lemon juice.
5. Bake at 500° until fish browns and flakes easily when tested with a fork, 10 to 15 minutes.
6. Serves 6.
7. (I use fresh or frozen fish fillets or steaks.)
title: Oven-Fried Fish

steps: 1. Pare oranges; cut into thin slices. Peel banana; cut into thin slices. In serving bowl, mix fruits carefully. Stir together orange juice, honey and lemon juice in a separate bowl. Pour over fruit in bowl. Sprinkle coconut on fruit. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Honeybee Ambrosia

steps: 1. Quarter hot potatoes lengthwise and place in a bake and serve dish.
2. Sprinkle grated cheese over potatoes.
3. Melt butter in a skillet and add remaining ingredients; stir until mixture is moist.
4. Crumble mixture over potatoes and broil until cheese melts.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Freckle Face Taters

steps: 1. Cover baking sheet with foil and lightly coat with nonstick cooking spray.
2. Combine all ingredients except chicken and buttermilk.
3. Skin, bone and pat dry the chicken.
4. Dip chicken in buttermilk.
5. Then roll in dry mixture and place on baking sheet. Bake at 400° for 35 minutes until golden brown.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: No-Fat "Fried" Chicken

steps: 1. Pat pork dry with paper towel.
2. Combine all seasonings for rub. Place in a jar with tight fitting lid; shake well to blend seasoning thoroughly. Store covered at room temperature.

3. Apply 2-3 tablespoons rub seasonings to all surfaces of the pork roast. Place roast in a shallow pan and roast in a 350 degrees F. Roast for about 20 minutes per pound, or until internal temperature on a thermometer reads 145 degrees F. Remove roast from oven; let rest about 10 minutes.
4. Serves 8.
title: Latin-Rubbed Pork Loin Roast

ingredients.text: 1 lb. boneless chicken breast, cut in 1-inch cubes

steps: 1. In large resealable bag, combine bread crumbs and cheese.
2. In shallow bowl, beat the egg white.
3. Dip the chicken pieces in egg white, then place in bag and shake to coat.
4. Place in a 15 x 10-inch baking pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
5. Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes or until chicken is done. Yield: 4 servings.
title: Tender Chicken Nuggets

steps: 1. Wash tomatoes and scoop out pulp.
2. Save caps.
3. Sprinkle inside of tomatoes with salt substitute.
4. Pan broil onions in a little oil until soft.
5. Now mix onions, parsley, dill, raisins or currants, nuts, rice and more of olive oil.
6. Fill tomatoes with remaining oil and the water.
7. Weigh down the tomatoes with a heavy plate.
8. Cover casserole.
9. Let simmer for 30 minutes or until rice is done.
10. Let cool.
11. May be refrigerated.
12. Serve cold.
13. Serves 6.
title: Stuffed Tomatoes

ingredients.text: 2 medium apples, peeled, cored and sliced

steps: 1. In medium skillet, combine the first 6 spiced apple ingredients.
2. Bring to a boil.
3. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until slightly thickened.
4. Add apples.
5. Simmer, uncovered, until apples are just tender, stirring gently.
6. Serve with sliced pork roast.
7. Yields 8 to 10 servings.
title: Spiced Apples

ingredients.text: 1 green pepper, cut into thin strips

steps: 1. In iron pot (or flameproof casserole), saute onion in 1 tablespoon of oil until golden.
2. Mix all seasonings together. Layer vegetables sprinkled with seasonings; drizzle with remaining oil.
3. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
4. Add sliced tomatoes; top with cheese and bake, uncovered, for 20 to 30 minutes, until cheese is thoroughly melted and bubbly.
5. Serves 4.
title: Harvest Bake

steps: 1. Brown hamburger and onion; drain grease.
2. Add salt, pepper, butter, chili powder, catsup and dry mustard.
3. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes.
4. Serve on buns (like Sloppy Joes).
5. Serve 4 to 6 people.
title: Tavern Sandwiches

steps: 1. Toast 12 slices of bread and spread each slice with meat mixture to the very edge.
2. Broil about 3-inches from heat for about 5 minutes or until done.
3. Serves 6.
title: Open Devil Burgers

steps: 1. Mix ingredients well.
2. Top with nuts and serve.
3. Serves 6.
title: Fruity Fruit

steps: 1. Cream together cream cheese and sugar.
2. Add fruit and just a little of the juice. Fold in Cool Whip and freeze in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
3. Serves 12.
title: Strawberry Freeze

steps: 1. Simmer beef and onions in dry skillet.
2. Add remaining ingredients; cover and cook slowly until vegetables are done. Serves 6.
title: Ground Beef Stew

ingredients.text: 4 large green tomatoes (firm), cut in 1/2-inch slices

steps: 1. Wash and slice tomatoes.
2. Combine meal, salt, pepper and paprika.
3. Dredge tomatoes in this and fry in skillet, with a 1/4-inch of oil, until brown, turning once.
4. Serves 6.
title: Fried Green Tomatoes

ingredients.text: 2 lb. sausage, brown and drain well

steps: 1. Put sausage in crock-pot; add Velveeta.
2. Scramble eggs, and add to sausage mixture; mix well.
3. Heat until warm and serve. Note:
4. Sausage and cheese may be prepared the night before and refrigerated.
5. Heat 30 to 45 minutes in crock-pot then add scrambled eggs.
6. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: Sausage And Eggs

steps: 1. Boil together for 5 minutes the first 3 ingredients; place in casserole.
2. Cream the shortening.
3. Add sugar gradually and cream well.
4. Add vanilla.
5. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk.
6. Add nuts.
7. Drop by spoonfuls on the liquid in the casserole.
8. Cover the surface of the liquid.
9. Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350°.
10. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Baked Devil'S Float

steps: 1. Combine water, mustard and soy sauce.
2. Brush tenderloins with the mustard mixture and oil.
3. Place tenderloins, fat side up, on a rack, in a shallow roasting pan.
4. Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until meat is done.
5. Baste meat while baking.
6. Serves 6.
title: Pork Tenderloin Dijon

steps: 1. Combine peaches, egg white, sugar and vanilla in large mixing bowl. Beat at high speed until light and almost doubled in volume (about 5 minutes). Fold in yogurt. Turn into a container, cover and freeze. Let soften 1/2 hour at room temperature before serving. Makes 4 servings.
title: Frozen Peach Yogurt

steps: 1. Beat all the ingredients together for 5 minutes until light and fluffy.
2. Refrigerate or freeze until ready to serve.
3. Makes 30 to 40 servings.
title: Hot Buttered Rum

steps: 1. Peel, slice and coat apples with flour and 1/3 cup sugar. Stir in the raisins, cinnamon and oatmeal.
2. Pour 1 cup water into crock-pot.
3. Add apple mix.
4. Pour melted butter over apples and then brown sugar.
5. Cook on low 4 to 6 hours.
6. Serves 6.
title: Country Apples - Crock-Pot Style

steps: 1. Cook rice in 5 cups boiling water for 5 minutes.
2. Drain.
3. Set aside.
4. Cook onions in butter until limp but not browned.
5. Combine all ingredients.
6. Mix well.
7. Pour in a 2-quart casserole.
8. Bake 1 hour at 350°.
9. Serves 8.
title: Onion Casserole

ingredients.text: 2 medium tomatoes, sliced in half lengthwise

steps: 1. Heat broiler.
2. Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange tomato halves on baking sheet.
3. Sprinkle parsley and pepper over tomatoes.
4. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top.
5. Broil 5 inches from heat for approximately 3 minutes or until golden brown.
6. Serves 4 (1/2 tomato per serving).
7. Each serving contains 39 calories, 3 g protein, 1.8 g fat, 5 mg chol. and 11 mg sodium.
title: Grilled Parmesan Tomatoes

steps: 1. Cream 1/4 cup butter and 3/4 cup sugar in a large mixing bowl. Add beaten egg and stir in mixture of 2 cups of flour, baking powder and salt alternately with milk, beating until smooth.
2. Fold in blueberries.
3. Spread evenly into a 9-inch square baking pan. Combine remaining 1/4 cup butter, 1/2 cup sugar, 1/3 cup flour and cinnamon in a small mixing bowl.
4. Mix until crumbly.
5. Sprinkle over blueberry layer.
6. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.
7. Yields 9 servings.
8. Serve with milk.
title: Blueberry Buckle

steps: 1. Combine flour and seasoning.
2. Dredge mixture thoroughly into both sides of steak.
3. Cut into serving pieces.
4. Place fryer over medium heat and add shortening.
5. Brown meat well on both sides. Mix vegetables and place over meat.
6. Cover and reduce heat to low and simmer until tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
7. Thicken remaining sauce for gravy.
8. Serves 6.
title: Swiss Steak

ingredients.text: 40 graham crackers, finely crushed and divided

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine 2 cups of the graham cracker crumbs, marshmallows, dates and walnuts.
2. Stir in cream; mix thoroughly. Shape into a 14 x 3-inch log.
3. Roll in remaining graham crumbs. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap.
4. Refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight.
5. Slice.
6. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: Date Nut Log

steps: 1. Saute celery and onions in butter 5 minutes, add mushrooms and saute 5 minutes.
2. Layer half each of bread cubes, cheeses and vegetables in a buttered 2 1/2-quart casserole.
3. Repeat layers; set aside.
4. Combine eggs, milk and seasonings; stir well.
5. Pour over casserole.
6. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
7. Remove from oven, let stand five minutes before serving.
8. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Mushroom Bake

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon hot pepper sauce (or crushed red pepper)

steps: 1. Combine first 9 ingredients(parsley through garlic) in a food processor; pulse until minced, scraping the sides occasionally.
2. Place herb mixture in a bowl, cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Stir in the oil before serving.
3. Yield: 8 servings.
title: Pebre

steps: 1. Cook eggplant until mushy and drain.
2. Add all ingredients except 1/2 cup of cheese and 1/2 cup of cracker crumbs and small amount of melted margarine.
3. Mix well, pour into baking dish. Sprinkle with reserved cheese, crumbs and margarine.
4. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
5. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Eggplant Casserole

steps: 1. Brown ground beef, onions and celery.
2. Drain well.
3. Pour into a large casserole dish and stir in remaining ingredients.
4. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
5. Serves 6.
title: Baked Bean Casserole

steps: 1. Whip whipping cream, gradually adding sugar, lemon juice and vanilla.
2. Fold
3. in	prunes,
4. pineapple,
5. coconut and nuts. Chill several hours before serving.
6. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Prune Sunburst

steps: 1. Cook peas in small amount of water; drain and set aside. Saute mushrooms and onions in butter until tender.
2. Stir in remaining ingredients, stirring constantly.
3. Cook until thickened. Add peas and serve warm.
4. Serves 6.
title: Saucy Peas

steps: 1. Mix well and place in buttered 1 quart casserole dish.
2. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
3. Yield: 4 servings.
title: Zucchini Casserole

steps: 1. Blend cream cheese, mayonnaise and sugar.
2. Add drained fruit and nuts, mixing carefully.
3. Add whipped cream.
4. Put in ice tray and freeze approximately 4 hours.
5. Serves 6.
title: Fruit Freeze

ingredients.text: 4 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned

steps: 1. Mix together soy sauce, lime juice, Worcestershire sauce, garlic and mustard.
2. Place chicken in bowl and pour sauce over it. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 30 minutes.
3. Spray a nonstick pan with Pam and place on a burner set at medium heat. Add chicken and cook about 6 minutes on each side or until meat is fork-tender.
4. Makes 4 servings, 130 calories each.
title: Garlic Lime Chicken

steps: 1. In a small saucepan, heat sauerkraut and caraway seeds; keep warm.
2. Shape pork into two patties.
3. Grill, uncovered, over medium heat or broil 4-6 in. from heat for 4-5 minutes on each side or until a thermometer reads 160°.
4. Top each patty with cheese; continue cooking until cheese is melted. Drain sauerkraut. Place patties on buns; top with sauerkraut. Replace bun tops. Yield: 2 servings.
title: Reuben Burger

steps: 1. Use 2-quart baking dish.
2. Layer zucchini, alternated with sugar and salt.
3. Layer onions, alternated with sugar and salt. Repeat layers.
4. Pour tomato sauce over zucchini and onions.
5. Top with cheese.
6. Bake 1 hour at 400°.
7. Serves 4.
title: Zucchini Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. carrots, peeled and sliced, or 20 oz. frozen sliced and thawed

steps: 1. In saucepan, cook carrots just until crisp-tender.
2. Drain, reserving 1/4 cup liquid.
3. Place carrots in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
4. Combine mayonnaise, onion, horseradish and reserved cooking liquid.
5. Spread evenly over carrots.
6. Sprinkle with cheese.
7. Top with bread crumbs.
8. Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.
9. Yields 8 to 10 servings.
title: Creamy Carrot Casserole

steps: 1. Grate cheese.
2. Add butter to cheese and mix.
3. Add flour and Rice Krispies; mix well.
4. Form into little balls.
5. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Yummy!
6. Serves 6 to 8.
7. We triple this recipe!
title: Yummers

steps: 1. Brown sausage in heavy skillet; crumble and drain. Beat eggs; mix in milk, salt and mustard. Break bread into small pieces. Stir into egg mixture. Fold in cheese and sausage. Pour mixture into 9 x 13 Pyrex that has been buttered. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Sausage Casserole

steps: 1. Place liquid smoke, soy sauce, pepper, celery salt, Worcestershire sauce, salt and garlic and onion salts in covered jar; shake until well mixed.
2. Line a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with large piece of heavy foil.
3. Place brisket, fat side up, in foil-lined pan.
4. Pour soy sauce mixture over brisket.
5. Fold foil over brisket; seal.
6. Refrigerate overnight.
7. Bake at 300° for 5 hours.
8. Yields 12 servings.
title: Beef Brisket

steps: 1. Melt shortening in skillet; add beef and next 4 ingredients. Cook only until meat turns very light brown, stirring occasionally.
2. Drain off any excess fat.
3. Stir in water, Worcestershire sauce and catsup; simmer, stirring occasionally, for 15 to 20 minutes or until desired consistency is obtained. Serve in heated sandwich buns.
4. This recipe makes 10 servings.
title: Sloppy Joes

steps: 1. Combine the first 3 ingredients in a medium bowl. Cover with cold water and refrigerate overnight. Drain. Rinse with cold water and drain again.
2. Mix together the vinegar, sugar and sour cream. Pour over vegetables and stir. Add pepper to taste.
3. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
4. Makes 6 servings.
title: Grandma Miller'S Cucumbers And Onions

ingredients.text: 1 c. orange juice (water may be used instead)

steps: 1. In covered pan, cook cranberries in orange juice until berries burst.

2. Strain fruit while still hot, using strainer attachment on mixer or push through sieve with wooden spoon like Aunt Mary did. Stir sugar into hot fruit until dissolved, but do not cook after adding the sugar.
3. This must not be cooked after adding the sugar. Pour into 1 large or several small molds and chill until set. Serves 8.
title: Aunt Mary'S Cranberry Mold

ingredients.text: 2 c. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained

steps: 1. Melt margarine in saucepan.
2. Saute onion until transparent. Blend in flour and seasonings.
3. Stir in milk gradually; cook until thickened.
4. Add cheese; stir until melted.
5. Add macaroni.
6. Pour into a greased 2-quart baking dish.
7. Slice tomato and arrange on top.
8. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over surface.
9. Bake in a moderate 375° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.
10. Makes 6 servings.
title: Macaroni And Cheese Casserole

steps: 1. Combine the first 8 ingredients in a skillet.
2. Cover and cook over medium heat 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
3. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover and cook 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated, stirring occasionally.
4. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Oriental Turkey-Orange Skillet

steps: 1. Toast bread in toaster.
2. Place cheese on bread; top with second piece of bread.
3. Place on paper plate.
4. Microwave on High for 15 to 20 seconds, or until cheese melts.
5. Makes 1 serving.
title: Quick Cheese Sandwich

steps: 1. Put croutons and ham into a greased casserole dish. Mix all other ingredients in a blender or with a mixer and pour over the croutons and ham.
2. Refrigerate for 12 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 350°. Bake uncovered 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 6.
title: Eggs Rebel Recipe

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Combine milk, eggs, dry mustard and salt. Beat for 1 minute.
3. Stir in cheese, bread and ham.
4. Pour into ungreased 11 x 17-inch loaf pan or baking dish.
5. Bake at 350°
6. for 30 to 40 minutes, or until knife comes out clean.
7. Serves 12. This can be mixed and refrigerated ahead of time.
8. Add 5 to 10 minutes for baking if refrigerated.
title: Egg Casserole

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. jelly (red currant or your favorite)
1 lb. frankfurters, diagonally cut in thirds

steps: 1. In a 1-quart micro-safe casserole dish, combine jelly and mustard.
2. Add franks; stir lightly.
3. Cover.
4. Microwave on High 2 1/2 to 4 minutes or until bubbly and hot, stirring every 1 1/2 minutes.
5. Serves 8 to 10 people.
6. Delicious!
title: Saucy Hot Dogs

steps: 1. Place water, spices and sugar in a saucepan.
2. Bring to a boil over high flame; reduce flame.
3. Simmer 10 minutes.
4. Add juices. Heat through.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Hot Spiced Lemon-Appleade

steps: 1. Mix crumbs, cheese, parsley, garlic, salt and pepper.
2. Dip chicken in melted butter and then in crumb mixture.
3. Arrange pieces in single layer in large shallow dish.
4. Pour remaining margarine over chicken.
5. Bake for 1 1/4 hours at 350°.
6. Serves 8.
title: Crunchy Baked Chicken

steps: 1. Combine flour, paprika and pepper on a plate.
2. Press chicken into mixture, coating evenly and then shake off excess.
3. In a heavy 10-inch skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat for 1 minute.
4. Add chicken and cook for 3 minutes on each side.
5. Do not overcook.
6. Place on heated platter.
7. Add chicken broth to skillet, scraping up any browned bits on the bottom. Stir in the lemon juice and capers and heat through.
8. Pour sauce over chicken breasts and serve.
9. Serves 4.
title: Lemon Caper Chicken

steps: 1. In small bowl combine nuts, cinnamon and 1/2 cup sugar; set aside.
2. Thinly
3. slice apples; set aside.

title: Apple Sour Cream Ring

steps: 1. Whisk together olive oil, turmeric, pepper, garlic, basil, mint, red pepper and vinegar.
2. Rinse shrimp; pat dry with paper towels.
3. Toss shrimp in marinade to coat.
4. Cover and refrigerate 6 to 8 hours or overnight, tossing occasionally.
5. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before barbecuing.
6. Preheat grill.
7. Remove shrimp from marinade (reserve marinade).
8. Grill shrimp in a seafood basket until pink (3 to 5 minutes) turning 3 or 4 times with marinade.
9. Serve hot.
10. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Spicy Skewered Shrimp

ingredients.text: 2 large chicken breasts, boned, skinned and split

steps: 1. Coat chicken breasts with a mixture of flour, salt and pepper. Shake off and reserve excess flour.
2. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in skillet.
3. Brown chicken on both sides; remove.
4. Add remaining oil, mushrooms and onion.
5. Saute until onion is tender.
6. Stir in reserved flour; mix in wine.
7. Return to skillet with parsley. Simmer 25 minutes.
8. Serves 4.
title: Chicken With White Wine

steps: 1. Brown beef; add all ingredients and warm.
2. Serve on hamburger buns.
3. Makes 6 servings.
title: Sloppy Joes

steps: 1. Peel the oranges; cut into bite-sized pieces.
2. Mix sugar and cinnamon in small bowl.
3. Sprinkle over oranges.
4. Put into individual paper
5. cups.
6. Makes 24 servings.
title: Chilled Oranges

steps: 1. Cut zucchini into 1/4-inch slices. Dip zucchini slices in egg. Coat with crumbs. In a frying pan, cook garlic in oil until brown. Cook zucchini slices until brown, turning once. Drain on absorbent paper. Serve immediately. Serves 6.
title: Sauteed Zucchini

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F Score the fat of the pork with a knife and rub with salt, majoram and caraway seeds over the meat.
2. In a large pan, melt the butter over high heat and seal the meat rapidly.
3. When the pork is brown all over, place into a roasting dish and roast for 2 1/2 hours, basting frequently.
4. Serves 6.
title: Roast Pork With Caraway (Schab Wieprzowy Po Polsku)

ingredients.text: 2 large apples, pared and sliced in eighths

steps: 1. Sift first 4 ingredients into mixing bowl.
2. Add egg, milk and shortening.
3. Beat until smooth.
4. Dip apples in batter and fry in deep hot shortening about 4 minutes or until brown.
5. Drain on paper towel.
6. Serve with maple syrup or a sprinkle of confectioners sugar.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Apple Fritters

steps: 1. Combine the first five ingredients in a Dutch oven.
2. Bring to a boil.
3. Add carrots.
4. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Add pepper, onion, yellow squash and zucchini.
5. Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
6. Stir in mushrooms; cover and simmer 5 more minutes. Drain.
7. Place vegetables in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
8. Sprinkle with cheese.
9. Broil just until cheese melts. Yields 8 servings.
title: Vegetable Medley

ingredients.text: 4-5 medium apples, peeled and sliced thinly

steps: 1. Make syrup of 1 c. sugar and water. Add red food coloring if desired. Place apples in 8 x 12 inch baking dish; pour syrup over apples. Make a soft dough of flour, baking powder, salt, shortening, and milk. Drop by spoonsful on top of apples, make a dent in top of each one, and place in the dented dough a teaspoonful of the butter-cinnamon sugar mixture. Bake at 450° for 25-30 minutes. Serve warm with cream or milk if desired. Makes 8-10 servings.
title: Aunt Betty'S Apple Cinnamon Puffs

steps: 1. Place salmon in a greased 13-in. x 9-in. baking dish. Combine the remaining ingredients; spoon over salmon.
2. Bake, uncovered, at 425° for 12-15 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Pistachio Baked Salmon

steps: 1. Toast bread in toaster. Then put toasted bread on plate and place cheese on one slice of the bread.
2. Cover with other slice of toasted bread.
3. Place in microwave for 15 to 20 seconds or until cheese is melted.
4. Yields 1 serving.
title: Dad'S Microwave Grilled Cheese

steps: 1. Brown sausage in skillet, stirring until crumbly.
2. Drain. Layer bread cubes, sausage and cheese in greased 9 x 9-inch baking dish.
3. Beat eggs with milk, mustard and salt in bowl.
4. Pour over layers.
5. Bake for 45 minutes in a preheated 350° oven.
6. Yields 4 servings.
title: Egg And Sausage Casserole

steps: 1. Cook macaroni in boiling water with 1 tablespoon cooking oil. Drain off liquid.
2. Meanwhile, brown beef and onion.
3. Add tomato juice, brown sugar, salt, pepper, chili powder and cooked macaroni.
4. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes.
5. Pour into dish and serve. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Chili Mac

steps: 1. Heat oil and add all other ingredients.
2. Fry for 6 minutes over medium heat.
3. Reduce heat and simmer 15 more minutes.
4. May serve with white rice.
5. Serves 6.
title: Smothered Shrimp

steps: 1. Sift together dry ingredients.
2. Cut in butter until crumbs form.
3. Combine milk, vanilla and egg; stir into flour until moistened.
4. Spread dough into 8-inch square baking pan.
5. Arrange peaches in rows, pressing lightly into dough.
6. Bake at 425° for 25 minutes.
7. Serves 8.
title: Peach Delight

steps: 1. For sauce: In a small saucepan, cook onion in hot oil until tender. Stir in all ingredients, except chicken. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Preheat grill to medium. Grill chicken, uncovered, for 12 to 15 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink (160°), turning once and brushing with sauce during last 5 minutes of grilling. Reheat remaining sauce and pass with chicken. Serves 4.
title: Apricot Ginger Chicken Breasts

ingredients.text: 3 chicken breasts, boned, skinned and halved

steps: 1. In a blender, place 2 cups of raspberries, the corn syrup and the lemon juice; cover and blend on high until smooth.
2. In a small saucepan, stir together the cornstarch, salt and pepper. Gradually stir in the raspberry mixture until smooth.
3. Stirring constantly, bring to a boil over medium heat and boil for 1 minute.
4. Arrange chicken and remaining raspberries in a greased 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish.
5. Spoon sauce over chicken.
6. Bake at 400° for 25 to 35 minutes or until chicken is tender.
7. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Governor Whitman'S Favorite Recipe (Raspberry Chicken)

steps: 1. Peel large onions.
2. Place in individual ramekins.
3. Salt and pepper to taste.
4. Top each with a small pat of margarine. Microwave on High 3 to 4 minutes per onion or until tender. Serves 4.
title: Vidalia Onions

steps: 1. Beat eggs well.
2. Add sour cream, flour, salt, sugar and baking soda.
3. Blend until smooth.
4. Cook on hot, lightly greased griddle until bubbly on top.
5. Turn and cook until brown.
6. Serve at once. Makes 4 servings.
title: Favorite Flapjacks

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Combine first 6 ingredients in a bowl; beat until smooth, using a wire whisk.
3. Layer half of cooked macaroni in bottom of a greased 9-inch square baking dish, sprinkle with 1 2/3 cups cheese and layer remaining macaroni on top.
4. Pour milk mixture over macaroni; sprinkle with breadcrumbs. Bake uncovered for 50 minutes.
5. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and continue baking 5 minutes longer or until set.
6. Serves 6 to 10.
title: Old Fashioned Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. Brown ground beef in 1 teaspoon oil.
2. In a separate pan, brown onion in 1 teaspoon oil.
3. When onion is browned, add vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper, chili powder and garlic powder.
4. Stir well. Drain and mash 1 quart of tomatoes and add to mixture along with beef and beans.
5. Simmer on low heat for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Chili

steps: 1. Brown, drain and cool sausage.
2. Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish with bread.
3. Mix sausage and cheese and spread over bread. Beat eggs, milk, salt and mustard.
4. Pour over casserole. Refrigerate at least 8 hours.
5. Cook at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Sausage Casserole

steps: 1. Saute onion in butter.
2. Add meat and cook until all the pink has disappeared.
3. Add celery, carrots, green pepper, beef bouillon cube, hot water and seasonings.
4. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
5. Mix flour and cold water until smooth and add to mixture.
6. Turn into a 1-quart casserole.
7. Spoon fluffy mashed potatoes around edge of the casserole.
8. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until the top has become a golden brown.
9. Serves 4.
title: Hamburger-Vegetable Casserole

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in a large skillet until hot and bubbly. Reduce heat.
2. Separate 1 can biscuits and place 1-inch cube of Cheddar cheese in each.
3. Fold in half; press firmly.
4. Drop biscuits in one tablespoon of milk, then roll in crushed corn chips.
5. Pour hot mixture ina 2 or 3-quart casserole dish.
6. Place biscuits on top.
7. Bake in 400° oven for 12 to 18 minutes.
8. Yields 5 to 6 servings.
title: Chuckwagon Beef Bake

steps: 1. Clean and hull 2 quarts of strawberries.
2. Sweeten with sugar. Whip vanilla ice cream and fold in cream (whipped).
3. Add the juice of 1 lemon, rum and Cointreau.
4. Pour cream over strawberries.
5. Serves 8.
title: Strawberries Romanoff

steps: 1. Mix together first 7 ingredients and cook, stirring, until thick.
2. Place chicken in baking dish or pan and sprinkle with salt.
3. Pour half of sauce over chicken.
4. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, uncovered.
5. Pour remaining sauce over chicken and cook, covered, for 1/2 hour.
6. Remove cover and cook 1/2 hour.
7. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Hawaiian Chicken

steps: 1. Beat pineapple, eggs, sugar and flour with a fork.
2. Pour into greased casserole dish.
3. Cut bread into cubes and brown in butter. Place cubes on top of pineapple mixture.
4. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
5. Cool for 15 minutes before serving.
6. Serve with main course in place of potatoes.
7. Serves 6.
title: Pineapple Filling

ingredients.text: 6 c. frozen cubed hash brown potatoes

steps: 1. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon; crumble and set aside. Drain, reserving 2 tablespoons of drippings. Add potatoes, green pepper, onion, salt and pepper to drippings. Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are browned and tender, about 15 minutes. Make six wells in the potato mixture. Break one egg into each well. Cover and cook on low heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until eggs are completely set. Sprinkle with cheese and bacon. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Country Brunch Skillet

ingredients.text: 8 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned

steps: 1. Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
2. Set aside. Combine flour and next 5 ingredients.
3. Combine egg and buttermilk.
4. Dip chicken in egg mixture and dredge in flour mixture, coating well.
5. Place in baking dish, turning once to coat with butter.
6. Sprinkle with pecans.
7. Bake chicken at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.
8. Yields 8 servings.
9. Invite the neighbors over!
title: Buttermilk-Pecan Chicken

steps: 1. Boil yams until tender, but firm; peel and halve lengthwise. In heavy frying pan, melt butter and sugar.
2. Add Kahlua; stir and cook 1 minute.
3. Add yams; turn until brown on all sides.
4. Cover; reduce heat and cook 15 minutes.
5. Turn once before serving. Serves
6. 4 to 6 people.
title: Kahlua Candied Yams

ingredients.text: 1 lb. large shrimp (about 24), shelled, deveined, washed and dried thoroughly with paper towels
1 1/4 c. fresh tomatoes, cut into 1/2-inch dice
3/4 c. Feta cheese (about 2 generous slices), crumbled

steps: 1. In a skillet, heat oil; add shrimp and cook for about 1 minute until shrimp curl and turn pink.
2. Add scallions, tomatoes and mushrooms and stir until well mixed with shrimp.
3. Add crumbled cheese and mix well; cook for about 1 1/2 minutes.
4. Add wine and simmer for 1 more minute.
5. Remove from heat.
6. Place in a heated dish and serve immediately over boiled rice.
7. Serves 4.
title: "Garides" - Shrimp Tourkolimano

steps: 1. Brown roast in hot oil in skillet.
2. Sprinkle with salt. Combine other ingredients and pour over meat.
3. Cover tightly and simmer 2 hours or until fork-tender.
4. Remove to platter, skim off excess fat then spoon sauce over meat.
5. Serves 8.
title: Spicy Pot Roast

steps: 1. Melt butter in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
2. Add cooked carrots and coat with butter.
3. Stir in croutons and cheese.
4. In a small bowl, mix half and half, Worcestershire sauce, eggs and salt.
5. Add mixture to casserole and mix with other ingredients. Bake, uncovered, at
6. 400° for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.
7. Serves 6.
title: Carrot Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 lb. round steak, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1 c. sliced green onions and tops

steps: 1. Brown meat in oleo for 5 minutes.
2. Add cauliflower, green pepper, soy sauce and garlic.
3. Stir lightly to coat with soy sauce.
4. Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
5. Blend cornstarch, sugar and broth.
6. Add to meat mixture with green onions.
7. Cook, stirring constantly, until heated and thickened.
8. Serve over rice.
9. Makes 6 servings.
title: Beef Choufleur

steps: 1. Put rhubarb in a deep baking dish. Combine oats, flour and brown sugar. Cut into margarine until crumbly. Sprinkle over rhubarb. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Rhubarb Crunch

steps: 1. Preheat6 the oven to 375°. In a medium size bowl, combine the blueberries with 2 tbsp of the granulated sugar and let stand while preparing the batter.

2. In a food processor or blender, whirl the remaining granulated sugar, milk, flour, eggs, orange rind, vanilla and cinnamon for 30 seconds or until smooth. Or put all the ingredients in a medium-size bowl and stir until just blended.

3. Lightly grease a 9-in pie plate and arrange the blueberries on the bottom. Spread the batter evenly over the blueberries and bake for 35-40 or until puffed and lightly golden. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
4. Serves 4-6.
title: Blueberry Clafouti

steps: 1. Combine all marinade ingredients and pour over mushrooms. Marinate for 24 hours in refrigerator.
2. Makes 5 to 6 servings.
title: Marinated Mushrooms

steps: 1. Core the tomatoes and thinly slice; overlap the slices on a serving plate.
2. Drain and chop the olives.
3. Combine olives and the green onions, then add the oil, vinegar, salt and pepper.
4. Makes 4 servings.
title: Tomatoes With Green Onions And Olives

steps: 1. Wash zucchini.
2. Cut lengthways into quarters.
3. Cook in microwave about 5 minutes.
4. (Cover with plastic wrap.)
5. Cut zucchini into bite size cubes and add to onion.
6. Stir together cheese, Accent, salt and pepper.
7. Add to vegetables and stir in beaten eggs.
8. Melt butter and add to bread crumbs; put on top of mixture.
9. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until a knife, when inserted in the center, comes out clean.
10. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Zucchini Casserole

steps: 1. Cut stems from caps of mushrooms.
2. Saute stems and onions in butter; add to dry ingredients and mix.
3. Stuff caps with bread-cheese mixture.
4. Bake in hot oven at 450° for 8 minutes.
5. May also be broiled.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Blue Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms

steps: 1. Cut eggplant into 1 1/2-inch cubes.
2. Boil eggplant in salted boiling water just until tender.
3. Drain well.
4. Mix together tomato sauce with seasoning.
5. Alternate sauce with eggplant.
6. Top with remaining sauce, Monterey Jack cheese and Parmesan cheese.
7. Mix together bread crumbs and butter.
8. Sprinkle on top of casserole. Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 45 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Eggplant Casserole

steps: 1. Brown pork chops; arrange in a baking dish with lid.
2. Put onion over pork chops; pour sauce over the top.
3. Bake, covered, in a moderately slow oven (300° to 325°) for 1 hour.
4. Serves 6.
title: Barbecued Pork Chops

steps: 1. Pare, quarter
2. and
3. core apples and pears.
4. Brush fruit with lemon
5. juice.
6. Combine
7. orange juice rind, sugar and salt in a large
8. skillet.
9. Heat to boiling point.
10. Add fruit; cover and simmer until just tender, about 15 minutes.
11. Serve warm or chilled.
12. Makes 6 servings.
title: Poached Pears

steps: 1. Pare turnips and cut into cubes.
2. Place in baking dish with remaining ingredients.
3. Cover closely and bake in moderate oven at 350° for about 1 hour or until tender.
4. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Theresa Shea'S Baked Turnips

steps: 1. Cook and drain sausage.
2. Mix in other ingredients and place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
3. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Uncover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
4. Serves 12.
title: Egg And Sausage Casserole

ingredients.text: 4 medium carrots, sliced or 1 can carrots, drained

steps: 1. In large skillet, combine sausage, potatoes, carrots, water and pepper.
2. Bring to boil.
3. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
4. Stir in lemon juice; sprinkle with parsley.
5. Serves 4.
title: Sausage Supper(Teacher Favorite)

steps: 1. In a bowl, beat the egg and milk.
2. Stir in cheese, oats, onion and salt.
3. Add beef and mix well.
4. Shape into eight loaves; place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish.
5. Combine ketchup, brown sugar and mustard; spoon over loaves.
6. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes or until the meat is no longer pink.
7. Yield: 8 servings.
title: Li'L Cheddar Meat Loaves

ingredients.text: 1 medium eggplant, peeled and diced (about 1 1/4 lb.)

steps: 1. Place bacon in a 2 1/2-quart shallow baking dish.
2. Cover with wax paper; microwave at High for 5 to 7 minutes, or until crisp. Remove bacon, reserving drippings.
3. Crumble bacon; set aside.
4. Add eggplant, green pepper, celery, onion and water; stir well.
5. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap (do not vent).
6. Microwave vegetables at High for 6 minutes, giving dish a quarter turn at 2-minute intervals.
7. Let stand 5 minutes; drain.
8. Add tomatoes, brown sugar, salt and pepper to eggplant mixture; stir well.
9. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap; microwave at High for 4 minutes, stirring after 2 minutes.
10. Let stand 5 minutes.
11. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bacon.
12. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Easy Eggplant

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except lettuce; add to bacon and heat just to boiling, stirring constantly.
2. Tear lettuce into pieces; pour hot dressing over and toss lightly.
3. Serves 4.
title: Duch Lettuce

steps: 1. Combine bouillon broth, cornstarch and soy sauce; blend well. Stir in scallions and set aside.
2. Heat oil in wok and stir-fry chicken and garlic, 3 to 4 minutes.
3. Remove and keep warm.
4. Add broccoli and broth mixture to the wok.
5. Cover and simmer 8 minutes. Add the chicken and pimentos and heat just until mixture is good and hot.
6. Top with sesame seed.
7. Serve over pasta or rice.
8. (May substitute pork for chicken.
9. Makes 6 servings.
10. Calories 153, fat 4.l g.
title: Sesame Chicken
