10. Bake, uncovered, in a 375° oven for 25 minutes or until lightly browned.
11. Makes 6 servings.
title: Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. Place all ingredients in blender and blend well. Makes 2 servings.
title: Orange Julius

steps: 1. Combine croutons and cheese; put on bottom of a casserole. Mix other ingredients until well blended.
2. Pour over croutons. Crumble cooked bacon on top.
3. Bake 55 to 60 minutes at 325°. Serves 6.
title: Brunch Egg Casserole

steps: 1. Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp.
2. Remove bacon, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon. Set aside.

3. Saute green pepper and onion in drippings until tender. Add eggplant and tomatoes. Cover and cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in salt and pepper. Spoon eggplant mixture into a slightly greased 2-quart casserole dish and top with bacon. Sprinkle cheese over casserole. Top with bread crumbs. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25 minutes.
4. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Eggplant Tomato Casserole

ingredients.text: 6 to 7 medium cooked sweet potatoes, or 2 cans yams (no juice)

steps: 1. In 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole dish, combine butter, syrup and spices.
2. Add sweet potatoes and roll until coated with liquid. Bake uncovered at 325° for 35 minutes.
3. If sweet potatoes start to brown, turn them over in the liquid.
4. If necessary, cover to keep from burning.
5. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Candied Yams

steps: 1. Spread berries evenly in 2 quart baking dish.
2. Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle over berries.
3. Bake for 45 minutes in 350° oven.
4. Yields approximately 6 servings.
title: "Berry" Crunch

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp; remove.
2. Slice and saute the remaining ingredients in the bacon drippings until tender.
3. Top with Polska kielbasa or smoked sausage.
4. Heat for 12 minutes, covered. Garnish with crumbled bacon.
5. Yield:
6. 4 to 6 servings.
title: Old World Supper

steps: 1. Sear chops on both sides in shortening.
2. Combine remaining ingredients and heat; add chops.
3. Cook slowly for 1 hour or 1 1/2 hours.
4. Place pork chops in baking dish.
5. Heat in 375° oven for about 15 minutes.
6. Serve sauce on rice.
7. Yields 6 servings.
title: Sunday Barbecued Pork Chops

steps: 1. Cream butter and sugar.
2. Add eggs.
3. Sift dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture.
4. Stir in nuts and apples.
5. Spread into 9 x 13-inch pan.
6. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.
7. Top with 1 tablespoon whipped topping.
8. Yield:
9. 15 servings.
10. Carbohydrate 64 g, protein 5 g, fat 13 g, calories 393.
11. One serving = 2 bread exchange, 3 fruit exchange, 2 1/2 fat exchange.
title: Torte

steps: 1. Place figs and water in saucepan.
2. Bring to hard boil, then lower heat and simmer.
3. Cover figs and cook for 20 minutes.
4. Add molasses, ginger and sugar.
5. Stir gently in order to avoid breaking figs.
6. Simmer for 15 minutes more or until figs are plumped and tender.
7. Wonderful with meat or on their own!
8. Makes 5 to 6 servings.
title: Gingered Figs

steps: 1. Cut tomatoes in half crosswise and brush with melted butter or margarine.
2. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and Parmesan cheese.
3. Broil 6 inches from heat 5 to 7 minutes or until golden brown.
4. Serves 6.
title: Parmesan Broiled Tomatoes

steps: 1. Bone the turkey breast and remove skin.
2. Add all ingredients to a large zipper bag.
3. Let turkey marinate 8 to 12 hours.
4. Remove turkey from bag, reserving marinade.
5. Grill turkey over very hot coals 8 to 10 minutes on each side, brushing with marinade.
6. Serve with rice pilaf and a fresh steamed vegetable.
7. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Tandori Turkey

steps: 1. Heat butter in large skillet.
2. Saute chicken and onions for 10 minutes. Add spices and tomatoes.
3. Place in baking dish.
4. Bake, covered, in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
5. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Audrey'S Chicken

steps: 1. Mix and fry as patties; may cover with mushroom soup and Cheddar cheese. Serves 6.
title: Cottage Cheese Patties

steps: 1. Cut all zucchini in 1/4-inch thick slices.
2. Set aside.
3. Melt butter or margarine for 20 seconds.
4. On Medium heat, cook zucchini and butter until vegetables are transparent and tender. Makes 2 to 4 servings.
title: Saute Zucchini

steps: 1. Brown onion and hamburger.
2. Cook until brown.
3. Drain meat. Add remaining ingredients.
4. Simmer over low heat 1 hour.
5. Serve on buns with pickles and cheese.
6. Serves 4.
title: Maidrites

steps: 1. Cook macaroni in water and 1 teaspoon salt.
2. Drain.
3. Melt margarine, blend in flour and add oil and water.
4. Stir over heat until sauce boils and thickens.
5. Then stir in beaten egg, 1 teaspoon salt and grated cheese.
6. Stir until cheese melts. Arrange macaroni and cheese sauce in layers in a buttered casserole and bake in oven at 400° until toasted on top (10 to 15 minutes).
7. Makes 5 servings.
title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. This dish can be served warm or cold. To serve warm add all ingredients while pasta is still hot and serve.
2. To serve cold, rinse pasta in cool water, drain add other ingredients and chill. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Summer Pasta

steps: 1. Remove stems and seeds from green peppers.
2. Rinse and drain on paper towel.
3. Mix ground beef, bread crumbs, salt, pepper, onion, rice and 1/2 cup tomato juice.
4. Stuff green peppers with mixture. Place in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
5. Pour remaining tomato juice over stuffed peppers.
6. Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes.
7. Uncover; bake for 15 minutes longer.
8. Yields 6 servings.
title: Stuffed Green Peppers

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 500°. Combine first 5 ingredients in a shallow dish. Stir well. Dip fish in eggs and dredge in crumb mixture. Place fish on a baking sheet coated with vegetable cooking spray. Bake at 500° for 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Makes 4 servings.
title: Oven-Fried Fish

ingredients.text: 1/3 c. instant nonfat dry milk powder

steps: 1. Place milk, milk powder, cocoa, vanilla and sugar in blender. Cover and blend at high speed until smooth.
2. Remove center of cover and add ice, one at a time, blending until each is thoroughly crushed.
3. Serve immediately.
4. Makes 2 servings.
title: Chocolate Milk Cooler

steps: 1. Combine cornstarch, salt and water in a saucepan, stirring until blended.
2. Add vinegar, honey and margarine.
3. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
4. Add beets and cook until heated through, stirring constantly.
5. Yield: 4 servings.
title: Honey Beets

steps: 1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a shallow bowl.
2. Dredge pork chops in mixture.
3. Reserve remaining flour mixture.
4. Brown chops in oil in large skillet.
5. Arrange chops in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
6. Core unpeeled apples and cut into rings.
7. Place on chops. Pour 1 1/2 cups apple juice over apples.
8. Combine sugar and allspice; sprinkle over apples.
9. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for one hour or until chops are tender.
10. Remove pork chops and apple slices to a serving platter.
11. Reserve pan drippings.
12. Dissolve 1 1/2 tablespoons remaining flour mixture in remaining 1/2 cup apple juice.
13. Combine flour mixture and pan drippings in a saucepan; cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring constantly.
14. Serve sauce over chops.
15. Yields 6 servings.
title: Apple Pork Chops

steps: 1. Brown turkey, onions and pepper until tender.
2. Mix with the remaining ingredients and put into covered casserole.
3. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
4. Makes 4 servings.
title: Texas Hash(Weight Watchers)

steps: 1. Saute in skillet butter, onion and celery until tender.
2. Stir in flour, salt and pepper.
3. Gradually add 4 cups milk; cook until it is thick.
4. Add 4 cups diced turkey.
5. Serve over toast or toasted buns.
6. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Creamed Turkey

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. finely shredded, reduced-fat, sharp Cheddar cheese

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine the first 5 ingredients; mix well. Shape into 3/4-inch balls. Roll in parsley. Cover and chill. Yield: 8 servings (2 dozen).
title: Crunchy Chicken Balls

steps: 1. Melt butter in pan.
2. Combine salt, milk, pepper and flour. Put eggs into pan.
3. Cook until creamy in a 250° oven, stirring often.
4. Lower temperature.
5. May hold eggs up to 2 hours.
6. Serves 6 to 8 people.
title: Oven Eggs

ingredients.text: 4 medium cooking apples, peeled, quartered and cored

steps: 1. Place apples in an 8 x 5-inch microwaveproof loaf dish. Combine brown sugar and cinnamon in small bowl.
2. Crumble over apples.
3. Dot with margarine.
4. Cook, covered, on High (maximum power) for 7 to 8 minutes, stirring once.
5. Serves 4.
title: Baked Apple Chunks

ingredients.text: 2 lb. lean beef chuck, cut into cubes

steps: 1. Coat beef with flour and brown in oil in a large Dutch oven. Add onion and garlic and cook until vegetables are soft.
2. Pour off fat.
3. Add remaining ingredients (except potatoes, tomatoes and carrots); bring to a boil.
4. Cover and simmer for 1 hour.
5. Add tomatoes, potatoes and carrots.
6. Simmer 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
7. Makes 8 servings.
title: Beef Stew

steps: 1. Boil peeled potatoes; let set until almost cool, then slice or dice. Melt butter. Mix with cream of chicken soup, cheese and green onions. Blend in sour cream. Add potatoes and toss lightly. Place in 9 x 12-inch casserole; top with corn flakes. Bake for 1 hour at 350°. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: "Scrumptious Taters"(Club Member: Ben Steadman)

steps: 1. Cut tops off peppers and remove seeds.
2. Precook 5 minutes in boiling water.
3. Drain and sprinkle inside of peppers with salt. Cook ground beef and onions until brown.
4. Drain off fat.
5. Add salt, pepper, tomato juice, rice and Worcestershire sauce.
6. Simmer until rice is tender.
7. Cover peppers with tomato sauce and sugar; bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.
8. Add cheese as topping during last 15 minutes of baking time.
9. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Stuffed Green Peppers

steps: 1. Cut into 1/2 inch cubes, place meat in crock-pot and stir in tomato paste to completely coat meat.
2. Add the remaining ingredients and stir to blend.
3. Do not add any additional liquid. Cover and cook for 12 hours on low heat.
4. Yield:
5. 4 servings. Carbohydrate 15 g, protein 34 g, fat 24 g, calories 414.
title: Chili In Crock-Pot

steps: 1. Cut zucchini into 1/4-inch thick julienne strips.
2. Heat a wok or skillet and add cooking oil.
3. Add zucchini and toss gently for 1 minute.
4. Add all remaining ingredients and stir-fry for another few seconds, or until the sauce is hot.
5. Serve hot.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Gingered Zucchini

steps: 1. Cook yams in boiling salted water; peel and cut in halves lengthwise.
2. Place pieces in greased baking dish.
3. Cook honey, sugar, butter or margarine and hot water together for 5 minutes. Pour syrup over yams and bake in a moderately hot oven (375°) about 20 minutes or until browned.
4. Makes 6 servings.
title: Candied Yams

ingredients.text: 5 -6 lbs fresh beef brisket, well trimmed
1/4 cup liquid smoke (colgins is the best)

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 275F DEGREES.

2. in a large pyrex baking dish, thoroughly mix all ingredients for sauce. put the brisket in the baking dish, and turn it over once to coat it with the sauce. sela the dish tightly with havy-duty aluminum foil.

3. bake at 275F DEGREES; for 5 to 7 hours (about 1 hour and 15 minutes per pound). remove from oven and allow to stand for 1 hour before slicing. slice across the grain, and serve with sauce. makes 8 to 10 servings.

4. note: this recipe works well with 5- to 6- pound brisket. be sure to use a pyrex baking dish or a very heavy metal pan. also, before you prepare the brisket, remove it from the refrigerator far enough ahead of time to allow it to come to room temperature.
title: Texas Oven Brisket

steps: 1. Heat 1 1/2-inches of water, onion, lemon, parsley, bay leaf, salt and peppercorns to boiling in a 10-inch skillet.
2. Reduce heat.
3. Arrange fish in single layer in skillet.
4. Simmer, uncovered, until fish fillets flake easily with fork, 4 to 6 minutes.
5. Makes 5 to 6 servings.
title: Poached Fish

steps: 1. Melt butter in a saucepan.
2. Add sprouts, onion and seasonings. Squeeze the juice of 1 lemon over the sprouts in pan.
3. Dice the lemon peel and add 1 to 2 teaspoons to pan.
4. Cover and cook over low heat until tender, about 30 minutes.
5. Serves 4.
title: Brussels Sprouts

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. medium shrimp, shelled and deveined

steps: 1. In a 1 1/2-quart glass casserole, cook butter until melted. Add garlic; cook on High for 1 1/2 minutes, or until butter is bubbly.
2. Mix in Parmesan cheese, parsley, lemon juice and shrimp. Cook on High for 2 minutes, or until shrimp are cooked.
3. Partially cover dish with Saran Wrap while cooking.
4. Serve over rice. Serves 2.
title: Microwave Shrimp Scampi

steps: 1. Slice tomatoes 1/4-inch thick. Lightly sprinkle green tomatoes with salt; drain on paper towels at least 30 minutes. Combine cornmeal, cheese, flour, garlic salt, oregano and pepper in pie plate. Dip each tomato slice into egg, then in cornmeal mixture. Heat oil in skillet on medium-high. Fry a few at a time about 2 minutes on each side, until golden brown. Drain on paper towel-lined wire rack. Serve immediately. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Fried Green Tomatoes

steps: 1. Arrange apple slices in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine honey, vinegar, salt and cinnamon in a small bowl. Drizzle over apples. Bake at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes or until tender.
2. Yields 8 servings.
title: Honeyed Apple Rings

steps: 1. Saute onion until tender, about 5 minutes.
2. Stir in turkey, catsup, chili sauce, water and mustard. Simmer 10 minutes. Stir occasionally. Spoon into buns.
3. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
4. Enjoy.
title: Sloppy Tom

ingredients.text: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Spray a large cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray.
3. In paper or plastic bag, combine first 5 ingredients. Shake to mix.
4. Dip chicken in egg white.
5. Shake dipped chicken in cereal mixture to coat.
6. Place on prepared pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes until chicken is no longer pink and coating is crisp.
7. Serve with sweet and sour sauce or barbecue sauce. Serves 4.
title: Crispy Chicken Nuggets

ingredients.text: 1 medium head cabbage, cored and quartered

steps: 1. Cut sausage into 1/2-inch slices.
2. Wash potatoes and peel, then cut into slices or quarters.
3. Layer sausage, potatoes and next 3 ingredients in a large Dutch oven, sprinkling each vegetable layer with salt and pepper.
4. Add 1 cup water and bring to boil.
5. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 35 to 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
6. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Smoked Sausage Vegetable Dinner

ingredients.text: 1 c. tomato sauce, divided in half
4 large red peppers, tops and seeds removed

steps: 1. Place beef, onion, celery and garlic in a bowl.
2. Stir in rice, egg, half of tomato sauce, parsley, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.
3. Fill red peppers with beef mixture, mounding the tops. Arrange peppers in a line, standing upright.
4. Cover with remaining tomato sauce.
5. Cook for 45 minutes at 350°.
6. Serves 4.
title: Stuffed Red Peppers(Our Favorite)

steps: 1. Boil chicken breasts and bouillon cubes in water in a 5-quart kettle until tender.
2. Take out the chicken and shred with fork. Return to kettle.
3. Mix 2 cups of chicken broth with 4 cups of flour, salt and pepper until dough forms.
4. Roll out on a floured surface until 1/8-inch thick.
5. Cut dough into 1 x 2-inch strips. Put dough strips back into kettle individually all across kettle. Cook until dumplins are done (approximately one hour on medium). Stir occasionally.
6. Yields 8 to 10 servings.
title: Robert'S Chicken N' Dumplins

ingredients.text: 3 c. raw apples, peeled and sliced

steps: 1. Mix apple slices and cranberries; sprinkle with sugar.
2. Spread in a 7 x 11-inch or 9-inch square pan.
3. Melt margarine; add oatmeal, flour, brown sugar and pecans.
4. Mix together and spread on the fruit mixture.
5. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
6. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Apple Cranberry Casserole

steps: 1. Parboil yams, peel and cut into pieces.
2. Peel apples and dice. Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt in saucepan.
3. Add boiling water and butter.
4. Stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil. Butter casserole dish and place yams and apples in casserole in layers.
5. Pour sauce over.
6. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
7. Serves 12.
title: Yam 'N Apple Creation

steps: 1. Peel cucumbers if desired and thinly slice.
2. Combine sour cream and remaining ingredients, stirring well.
3. Stir cucumber into sour cream mixture.
4. Cover and chill.
5. Yields 6 servings.
title: Cucumbers In Sour Cream

steps: 1. Boil macaroni and strain when cooked.
2. While macaroni is draining, place slices of cheese in bottom of pan and return to low heat until melted.
3. Stir in macaroni.
4. Serves 4.
title: Cheese And Macaroni

steps: 1. Rinse the clams in several changes of cold water and drain well. Tip the clams into a large pan with 500ml of water. Cover, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 mins until the clams have just opened. Tip the contents of the pan into a colander over a bowl to catch the clam stock. When cool enough to handle, remove the clams from their shells – reserving a handful of empty shells for presentation if you want. Strain the clam stock into a jug, leaving any grit in the bottom of the bowl. You should have around 800ml stock.

2. Heat the butter in the same pan and sizzle the bacon for 3-4 mins until it starts to brown. Stir in the onion, thyme and bay and cook everything gently for 10 mins until the onion is soft and golden. Scatter over the flour and stir in to make a sandy paste, cook for 2 mins more, then gradually stir in the clam stock then the milk and the cream.

3. Throw in the potatoes, bring everything to a simmer and leave to bubble away gently for 10 mins or until the potatoes are cooked. Use a fork to crush a few of the potato chunks against the side of the pan to help thicken – you still want lots of defined chunks though. Stir through the clam meat and the few clam shells, if you've gone down that route, and simmer for a minute to reheat. Season with plenty of black pepper and a little salt, if needed, then stir through the parsley just before ladling into bowls or hollowed-out crusty rolls.
title: Clam chowder

steps: 1. 2 Servings

2. 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry all produce. Cut potatoes into 1/2-inch-thick wedges. Toss on one side of a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. (For 4 servings, spread potatoes out across entire sheet.) Roast on top rack for 5 minutes (we'll add the broccoli then).

3. 2. Meanwhile, cut broccoli florets into bite-size pieces, if necessary. Peel and finely chop garlic. In a small microwave-safe bowl, combine 1 TBSP olive oil (2 TBSP for 4 servings) and half the garlic. Microwave until garlic sizzles, 30 seconds.

4. 3. Once potatoes have roasted 5 minutes, remove sheet from oven and add broccoli to empty side; carefully toss with garlic oil, salt, and pepper. (For 4 servings, add broccoli to a second sheet.) Continue roasting until potatoes and broccoli are browned and crispy, 15-20 minutes more.

5. 4. While veggies roast, pat chicken dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes per side. (If chicken browns too quickly, reduce heat to medium.) Turn off heat; set chicken aside to rest. Wash out pan.

6. 5. Heat pan used for chicken over medium-high heat. Add a drizzle of oil and remaining garlic; cook until fragrant, 30 seconds. Stir in vinegar, honey, stock concentrate, and 1/4 cup water (1/3 cup for 4 servings). Simmer until thick and glossy, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4). Season with salt and pepper.
7. 6. Return chicken to pan and turn to coat in glaze. Divide chicken, broccoli, and potatoes between plates. Spoon any remaining glaze over chicken and serve.
title: Honey Balsamic Chicken with Crispy Broccoli & Potatoes

steps: 1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add ground beef and all vegetables, except parsley and scallions.
3. Brown beef and then turn the heat to low.
4. Cook for about 45 minutes, stirring often.
5. Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
6. Add rice and reduce the heat.
7. Cover and cook for 20 minutes.
8. Add green onion and parsley.
9. Cover and cook another 5 minutes.
10. Serves 4.
title: Dirty Rice

ingredients.text: 3 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes

steps: 1. Saut onion in Crisco oil in heavy 10-inch cast-iron skillet until transparent.	Add potatoes.
2. Fry potatoes until they are tender and golden, turning as necessary.
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
4. Makes 4 servings.
title: Southern Fried Potatoes

steps: 1. Wash the zucchini thoroughly.
2. Do not peel, but slice it wafer-thin.
3. Prepare the other vegetables and one hour or so before serving, toss them all together.
4. When ready to serve, toss again with olive oil and wine vinegar to taste.
5. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Creole Salad

steps: 1. Cook bacon, drain, save some fat and saute onion.
2. Combine beans with 1/2 bacon, onion, water, salt and pepper.
3. Cover and cook in crock-pot on low for 5 hours.
4. Add vinegar, sugar and bacon the last hour.
5. Makes 8 to 12 servings.
title: Southern Smothered Green Beans

ingredients.text: 1 small can whole tomatoes, drain off about 1/2 the liquid

steps: 1. Brown chops in skillet on medium high heat.
2. Put rice, green pepper, onions, salt, pepper and paprika in the bottom of a 1-quart casserole dish.
3. Place browned pork chops on top of rice mixture.
4. Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water.
5. Pour tomatoes and bouillon water over pork chops.
6. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Southern Pork Chops With Rice

ingredients.text: 1 lb. carrots, cooked, drained and mashed

steps: 1. Mix ingredients.
2. Bake in a greased dish at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 4.
title: Southern Baked Carrots

steps: 1. Heat the margarine in a skillet and lightly saute peppers, onions and mushrooms.
2. Grease a 2-quart casserole.
3. Put a layer of half the bread cubes in the bottom, then a layer of tomatoes and a layer of sauteed mixture.
4. Sprinkle tomatoes with sugar, salt, paprika and dot with margarine.
5. Repeat layer.
6. Top with bread cubes and sprinkle with cheese.
7. Bake in a 400° oven for 30 minutes or until well browned.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Creole Scalloped Tomatoes

ingredients.text: 9 slices bread (to fill 9 x 13-inch cake pan bottom)
4 c. cooked chicken, chopped over bread

steps: 1. Lay bread in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
2. Top with chopped chicken pieces.
3. Mix together other ingredients and pour over top of chicken.
4. Put slices of cheese over mixture and pour 2 cans of undiluted cream of chicken soup.
5. Top with bread crumbs.
6. Cover and refrigerate overnight for a better flavor.
7. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.
8. Serves 10.
title: Chicken Gumbo

steps: 1. Saute onion and peppers in butter.
2. Combine beans and tomatoes.
3. Season and place in buttered baking dish.
4. Top with cracker crumbs and sprinkle with cheese.
5. Bake, covered, in a 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly browned.
6. Serves 6.
title: Creole String Beans

steps: 1. Combine the mayonnaise, Creole seasoning, dill weed and paprika.
2. Mix well and set aside.
3. Combine chicken, bell pepper, celery, onion, and relish.
4. Toss to mix.
5. Add flavored mayonnaise and mix well.
6. Makes about 6 servings.
title: Creole Chicken Salad

steps: 1. Combine corn, eggs and salt.
2. Alternate layers of corn mixture and crumbs in greased baking dish.
3. Dot with butter on each layer. Pour in milk.
4. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
5. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Corn Casserole

steps: 1. Dice bananas and apples and mix with grapes.
2. No dressing needed.
3. Serves 2.
title: Easy Salad

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in large skillet; cover and simmer for 30 minutes until tender.
2. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Skillet Cabbage

steps: 1. Brown meat; drain.
2. Stir in spaghetti sauce, macaroni, squashes and mayonnaise.
3. Heat through.
4. Let it cook for 1/2 hour or more. Sprinkle with cheese and serve.
5. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Creamy Beef, Macaroni And Vegetables

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. fresh parsley, diced (use less if dried)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Place chicken breasts on bottom of deep, stainless steel, nonstick pan.
3. Sprinkle the parsley, rosemary, garlic and pepper over chicken.
4. Place a layer of cut potatoes across chicken.
5. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of peas over potatoes. Pour wine over mixture.
6. Add another layer of potatoes and peas. Add more wine, if desired.
7. Place onion slices over mixture. Sprinkle with more pepper, garlic and rosemary.
8. Cover with foil. Cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
9. Serves 4.
title: Chicken And Vegetables

steps: 1. Cook
2. potatoes, covered, in boiling salted water for 15 minutes
3. or
4. until tender; drain.
5. Saute garlic in butter in a small skillet
6. until
7. tender.
8. Add parsley and pepper to skillet. Pour
9. mixture
10. over
11. potatoes,
12. tossing gently to cover. Yields 6 servings.
title: Garlic New Potatoes

ingredients.text: 2 lb. very small new potatoes (unpeeled; if you can't find very small ones, use larger ones cut into small chunks with the skin on)

steps: 1. Cook the potatoes in boiling salted water until tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Drain and set aside. In a large saucepan or skillet, heat the butter and oil. Add the potatoes and saut for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Add the garlic, salt, pepper, lemon juice and Tabasco sauce; lower the heat and cook for 3 to 4 minutes or until the garlic turns a golden color. Be careful not to burn the garlic. Serves 6. Probably can't be frozen. Can make ahead.
title: New Potatoes With Garlic

ingredients.text: 1/2 heads Large Cabbage, Sliced Thin (or 1 Head Napa Cabbage, Thinly Sliced)
2 whole Granny Smith Apples, Peeled, Cored And Cut Into Matchstick Pieces
2 whole Jalapeno Peppers, Seeded And Diced

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, vinegar, lime zest, lime juice, sugar, salt and pepper.
2. In a separate bowl, combine cabbage, apple and jalapeno.
3. Pour the dressing over the cabbage mixture; toss to coat.
4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
5. Toss in the chopped cilantro just before serving. Makes 6 servings.
6. (Recipe adapted from Taste of the South.)
title: Cilantro Lime Slaw

ingredients.text: 1/4 teaspoons Freshly Ground Black Pepper, Or To Taste

steps: 1. Steam green beans OR cook in boiling, salted water just until tender; drain and set aside.
2. Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon, reserving 1 tablespoon drippings in the skillet. Drain, then crumble bacon; set aside.

3. Saute onion in bacon drippings until tender. Add garlic; cook and stir for 1 minute more. Stir in bacon, green beans, barbecue sauce, ketchup and black pepper to taste; cook and stir over medium-low heat until thoroughly heated. Makes 6 servings.
4. (Inspired by a recipe from Southern Living Annual Recipes 1986 cookbook.)
title: Barbecued Green Beans

steps: 1. Heat butter in a large saucepan.
2. Add onions and fry 10 minutes.

title: Oven Roast Potatoes

ingredients.text: 6 whole Large Russet Potatoes (use Up To 8 Potatoes), Peeled And Cut Into 1 1/2 To 2 Inch Chunks
1 teaspoon (up To 1 1/2 Teaspoons) Dried Oregano, Or Use A Dried Herb Of Your Choice

steps: 1. Place potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring them to a boil over medium-high heat. Add some kosher salt to the water, reduce the heat to medium and cook for 3-4 minutes, no longer than that. You want them to just start getting tender.

2. Place a baking pan with sides large enough to hold all the potatoes in a single layer without crowding them in the oven. Turn the oven temperature to 375°F. I use a large rimmed baking sheet. You want that pan to be preheated before adding the potatoes. This will help to prevent them from sticking to the pan.
3. Drain potatoes and let them sit in the colander for 5 minutes. Place the potatoes in a large bowl and add lemon juice. Gently stir to make sure that all of the potatoes are coated with the juice.
4. Add salt, pepper, oregano (or whatever herb you choose), olive oil and melted butter. Mix to coat the potatoes with the oil, butter and spices.

5. Transfer the coated potatoes to the hot baking pan. They should sizzle when they hit the pan-that will tell you the pan is hot and ready to go. Bake at 375°F for 45-75 minutes, depending on how big you cut the potatoes. Give the pan a good shake after the first 10 minutes of baking to be sure that the potatoes aren't sticking to the pan. If they are, use a spatula to gently release them from the pan. Continue baking the potatoes, turning them every 20 minutes or so, until they're golden brown and tender.
6. Serve immediately. Makes 4-6 servings.
7. Recipe slightly adapted from Rock Recipes.

title: Sour Cream Potato Salad

ingredients.text: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breasts, about 1 1/4 pounds
4 large firm-ripe peaches, cut into 1/4-inch slices, or 2 (10-ounce) packages frozen peaches, (about 4 1/2 cups)

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over a medium-high heat. Season the chicken on both sides with salt and pepper, add to the skillet and cook until browned, about 2 minutes per side. Meanwhile combine the brown sugar, soy sauce, rice vinegar and orange juice in a small bowl and set aside. When the chicken is browned, transfer to a plate and set aside.

3. Add the ginger and garlic to the pan and cook, stirring, for 30 seconds. Add the chicken broth, the soy sauce mixture, and the peaches to the pan. Turn the heat up to high and cook, uncovered, for about 6 minutes, stirring occasionally until the sauce is nicely thickened and the peaches soften. Add the chicken back to the pan with the sauce, turn the heat down to moderate-low, cover and cook for about 5 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
5. In the meantime, toast the almonds in a dry skillet over a medium-high heat stirring frequently, until golden brown and fragrant, about 2 minutes.
6. Serve the chicken topped with the sauce and sprinkled with the toasted almonds.
8. Yield: 4 serving, 1 piece chicken, 2/3 cup sauce and 1/2 tablespoon almonds per serving
title: Creamy Corn And Vegetable Soup

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients with macaroni in large mixing bowl.
2. Chill or serve immediately.
3. Serves 8 to 10.

steps: 1. Make medium white sauce using Watkins cream soup; set aside. Simmer potatoes, onion and celery in 1 1/2 cups water in a covered 2-quart saucepan.
2. Do not drain.
3. Add 1/4 teaspoon Watkins dry mustard and a dash of Watkins black pepper to the medium white sauce; add to vegetables.
4. Bring to a full boil, stirring constantly.
5. Makes 6 servings.

steps: 1. Toss lettuce and avocado in bowl.
2. Toss with dressing.
3. Serves 5.

2. Add onion and tomato juice. Bring to a boil, then add baked beans, chili powder, salt and pepper.

steps: 1. Combine the oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, black pepper and parsley in a jar and shake until thoroughly mixed.
2. Pour over tomatoes, cucumbers and onions.
3. Marinate 2 hours before serving. Makes 6 servings.
title: Tomato And Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. In a saucepan, bring beans and water to boil.
2. Reduce heat to medium.
3. Cover and cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until beans are crisp-tender; drain.
4. Add butter, soy sauce and sesame seeds. Toss to coat.
5. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Sesame Green Beans

steps: 1. Cook macaroni as directed, drain.
2. Rinse with cold water, drain. Mix mayonnaise with lemon juice, salt and sugar.
3. Combine with macaroni, celery seed, tomato, celery, pimiento and green pepper.
4. Serve on salad greens, garnish with radish roses. Serves 6.
title: Macaroni Salad

steps: 1. Melt margarine and place in oiled baking dish or directly in Dutch oven.
2. Place sliced squash and salt in margarine.
3. Place cheese and then cracker crumbs on top.
4. Bake for about 10 minutes, until tender to fork.
5. Do not overcook.
6. Serves 8.

ingredients.text: 1 qt. fresh spinach, torn into pieces

steps: 1. In medium bowl, toss spinach, mushrooms and carrots.
2. Set aside.
3. In a 9 to 10-inch microwave pie plate, arrange bacon. Cover with paper towel. Microwave on High 3 1/2 minutes or until crisp.
4. Drain and crumble.
5. Into pie plate, add dressing, blended with mustard.
6. Microwave on High 1 minute, or until heated through.
7. Pour over spinach mixture. Add bacon and toss.
8. Yields 2 servings.
title: Warm Spinach Salad

steps: 1. In covered saucepan, cook carrots, onion and celery in butter over low heat until tender.
2. Stir in flour and add broth and salt. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
3. Stir in cream or milk and cheese until cheese melts and soup is heated through.
4. Do not boil.
5. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Cheese Soup

steps: 1. Shred cabbage, grate carrot and chop green pepper finely.
2. Add salt to cabbage and allow to stand 1 hour. Drain well.
3. Add carrot and pepper and mix.
4. Heat remaining ingredients until sugar dissolves. Cool.
5. Pour over slaw and freeze in containers.
6. Makes 12 servings.

steps: 1. Brown ground beef and sausage in a large skillet (cut sausage in small pieces). Add chopped onion.
2. When onion is tender, add rice, salt and pepper.
3. Stir well and serve while hot. Serves 12.

2. Drain some juice from the pork and beans.

steps: 1. Combine Miracle Whip, mustard, celery seed, salt, pepper, onions and pickle.
2. Mix well.
3. Add potatoes and eggs; mix lightly. Chill.
4. Makes 6 servings.

2. Mix salad dressing, sugar and vinegar; stir into potato mixture.
3. Chill thoroughly, garnish with green onions.
4. Makes 12 servings.

steps: 1. Rinse and chop the broccoli.
2. Use only the tips of the broccoli (not the stems).
3. Chop the onion and nuts; add raisins. In a bowl, mix the mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar.
4. This sauce should then be stirred into the larger bowl of other ingredients. Sprinkle cooked and crumbled bacon on the top of the salad before serving.
5. Salad can be made ahead of time and is better after chilling for a few hours.
6. Keeps well overnight.
7. Stir before serving.
8. Yields 8 servings.
title: Broccoli And Raisin Salad

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. small new potatoes, red or white

steps: 1. Scrub potatoes.
2. Place potatoes and water in covered microwave-safe dish.
3. Cook on full power in the microwave, 8-10 minutes or until fork tender, stirring once.
4. Drain water.
5. Add remaining ingredients, stirring to combine.
6. Microwave for 45 seconds on full power.
7. Place potatoes in serving bowl and pour sauce over them.
8. Yield:
9. 6 servings.
title: Parsley Buttered New Potatoes

steps: 1. Fry 1 egg over easy.
2. Mix on top of rice and add soy sauce. Serves 1.
title: Grandma'S Egg-Topped Rice

steps: 1. Simmer vegetables until tender in chicken broth.
2. In medium bowl, combine milk, cornstarch, salt, pepper and thyme.
3. Add milk mixture to vegetables; cook until soup is slightly thick, stirring constantly.
4. Makes 4 servings.
title: "Lite" Broccoli Soup

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and chill before serving.
2. If on diet, leave out mayonnaise and sugar.
3. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Shredded Carrot Salad

steps: 1. Brown beef.
2. Add celery, onion and green pepper and cook until tender.
3. Blend flour and salt.
4. Add crushed bouillon cube and milk.
5. Cook and stir over low heat until thick (approximately 1 hour).
6. Add cheese.
7. Cook and stir only until cheese melts. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Cheeseburger Chowder

ingredients.text: 3 eggs, lightly beaten or Egg Beaters (1/4 c. Egg Beaters equals 1 egg)

steps: 1. In a mixing bowl, combine bread crumbs and 1 cup cracker crumbs.
2. Stir in broth, eggs, salt, celery, onion, chicken and mushrooms.
3. In a saucepan, melt butter; brown remaining cracker crumbs.
4. Sprinkle over casserole.
5. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Scalloped Chicken(Healthy Heart)

ingredients.text: 8 oz. orzo, cooked al dente and drained

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in large bowl and toss.
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least 3 hours for flavors to blend.
3. Serve chilled or room temperature.
4. Serves 4.
title: Spicy Broccoli-Orzo Salad

steps: 1. Cook and stir ground beef, celery, onion and green pepper in Dutch oven until vegetables are tender; drain.
2. Stir in cabbage and water.
3. Cover and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally until cabbage is done (about 10 minutes).
4. Stir in milk, cheese, flour, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
5. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
6. Boil and stir 1 minute.
7. Garnish with pimentos. Makes 8 servings.
title: Cabbage Cheddar Chowder

steps: 1. Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. Add beans; cook 5 minutes. Plunge beans into ice water; drain.

2. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add butter and oil; swirl until butter melts. Add garlic; saute 30 seconds. Remove garlic; set aside. Add beans; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cook 2 minutes, tossing frequently. Top with garlic.

3. SESAME-SOY variation: Prepare beans through step Heat 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper; saute 30 seconds. Add beans, 1 tablespoon lower-sodium soy sauce, and 1/8 teaspoon salt; cook 2 minutes, tossing frequently. Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon toasted sesame seeds. Yield: 4 servings.
4. CALORIES 72; FAT 8g (sat 5g); SODIUM 214mg

5. CITRUS-NUT variation: Prepare green beans through step Combine beans, 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper; toss. Combine 2 tablespoons finely chopped blanched hazelnuts, 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley, 1/2 teaspoon grated orange rind, and 1 minced garlic clove; sprinkle over beans. Yield: 4 servings. CALORIES 90; FAT 7g (sat 7g); SODIUM 156mg

6. PEPPERY BACON variation: Prepare green beans through step Cook 2 chopped bacon slices in a skillet over medium-high heat until crisp. Remove bacon, reserving 2 teaspoons drippings in pan. Add 2 tablespoons chopped shallots; saute 2 minutes. Add beans; sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon pepper and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Cook 2 minutes. Top with bacon. Yield: 4 servings.
7. CALORIES 76; FAT 6g (sat 3g); SODIUM 231mg

title: Green Beans With Toasted Garlic

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. cottage cheese at room temperature

steps: 1. In a 2-quart saucepan, melt butter; saute vegetables.
2. Add catsup, chili sauce, lemon juice and soy sauce, cover and simmer 10 minutes.
3. Add frankfurters and simmer 5 additional minutes. Meanwhile, cook noodles according to package directions; drain. Return noodles to saucepan; stir in cottage cheese.
4. Alternate 2 layers each of noodles and sauce in a buttered 2 1/2-quart casserole.
5. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.
6. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Franks 'N Noodles

steps: 1. Put flour in bowl.
2. Add egg in center of flour.
3. Also add water equal to 1/2 of 1/2 an eggshell.
4. Mix well (using plenty of flour).
5. Roll on floured board until very thin.
6. Roll dough into cylinder and cut thin.
7. Drop into boiling broth.
8. Cook 15 to 20 minutes until tender.
9. Serves 4.
title: Gran'S Noodles

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. hamburger (I use a little more)
1 c. brown sugar (I use 1/2 to 3/4 c.)

steps: 1. Brown hamburger in skillet; add to beans.
2. Mix in remaining ingredients.
3. Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until brown.
4. Serves 6.
title: Baked Beans Supreme

steps: 1. In a buttered casserole dish, place thinly sliced potatoes and chopped onion.
2. Add half the cheese, then the hamburger and top with remaining cheese.
3. Mix seasonings with tomato sauce and pour over top.
4. Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender. Serves 6.
title: Hamburger And Potato Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 c. grapes (white, purple or mixed), halved and seeded

steps: 1. Prepare the first 3 ingredients. Combine the the remaining ingredients.
2. Yields 6 servings.
title: Waldorf Salad

steps: 1. Cut cabbage into 6 to 8 squares or wedges.
2. Cover with water and add 1 teaspoon salt and 1 tablespoon butter.
3. Bring to boil for 5 to 7 minutes.
4. Drain cabbage.
5. Beat eggs and 4 tablespoons milk. In another container mix flour, pepper and remaining salt.
6. Dip cabbage into egg mixture and coat with flour.
7. Deep fry in hot bacon dripping.
8. May also be pan-fried.
9. Serves 6 to 8.

2. add	raisins, celery and mayonnaise. Blend together.

5. pound
6. raisins
7. in 1 ounce sugar to make sugar coated raisins.) Serves 24.

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp.
2. Crumble.
3. Cut the broccoli flowers into bite size pieces.
4. Slice the stalk part into thin slices. The lower part may need to be peeled before slicing.
5. Combine the bacon, chopped onion, raisins, sunflower seeds and prepared broccoli.
6. Combine the mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar and mix well with other ingredients.
7. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Broccoli Salad

ingredients.text: 1 large broccoli, cut into bite size pieces

steps: 1. Add broccoli to boiling water.
2. Cook 3 minutes.
3. Drain and rinse with cold water.
4. Drain well.
5. Pour into large bowl. Combine vinegar, oil, sugar and salt in small bowl.
6. Beat with wire whisk.
7. Pour dressing over broccoli; toss well and refrigerate until ready to serve.
8. Yields 6 servings.
title: Broccoli Salad *

ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp. corn, olive or safflower oil

steps: 1. Peel potatoes and cut into long strips.
2. Toss in a bowl with oil until coated.
3. Spray cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray; place potatoes on sheet.
4. Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until tender.
5. Turn occasionally to brown all sides.
6. Serves 4. Each serving contains 120 calories, 3 g protein, 3.5 g fat, 0 chol. and 8 mg sodium.
title: Oven Fries

steps: 1. Cut carrots diagonally into 1/4-inch slices.
2. Cook carrots in boiling water to cover 7 minutes or until tender; drain.
3. Keep warm in a serving dish.
4. Combine next 4 ingredients in saucepan; gradually add orange juice, stirring well.
5. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
6. Boil 1 minute, stirring constantly; stir in butter.
7. Pour over carrots; toss well.
8. Makes 8 servings.
title: Gingered Carrots

steps: 1. Core and shred cabbage and wash well.
2. Cut sausage in 4 to 6 pieces, then slice down the center.
3. Place cabbage in large skillet.
4. Cover with just enough water to steam it, about 1 cup water.
5. Place sausage on top of cabbage.
6. Cover; cook over low heat until sausage is done and cabbage is tender.
7. Serves 4.
title: Steamed Cabbage And Smoked Sausage

steps: 1. Saute onion in butter until soft, but not brown.
2. Add 5 cups thinly chopped potatoes.
3. Salt and pepper to taste.
4. Barely cover with water.
5. Cook until potatoes fall apart and become thickened. Remove from heat.
6. Mash with potato masher or fork.
7. Add vinegar and condensed milk.
8. Reheat to serving temperature, but do not allow to boil.
9. Serve with crackers, cornbread or cornsticks. Serves 4 or 5.
title: Potato Soup

steps: 1. Shred cabbage, onion and pepper.
2. Add celery and pimentos. Sprinkle sugar on top; do not stir.
3. Bring other ingredients to a boil.
4. Pour while hot over the veggies.
5. Cover, without stirring; refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
6. The older it gets, the better. Serves 12 to 14.
title: Two-Week Slaw

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
2. Mix well.
3. Place in a casserole dish.
4. Bake at 325° for 2 hours.
5. Yield: 8 servings.
title: Chicken Rice Casserole

steps: 1. Cook all ingredients except cheese in 2-quart casserole, covered on High in microwave for 4 minutes.
2. Stir and cook 4 minutes.
3. Stir in cheese and salt.
4. Serves 4.
title: Microwave Cabbage

steps: 1. Combine egg, oil and milk.
2. Add to flour gradually.
3. Add salt. Beat with rotary beater until smooth.
4. Divide cauliflower into flowerets.
5. Cook in salted water until tender.
6. Drain well.
7. Dip flowerets in batter.
8. Fry in 375° deep fat until lightly browned. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Deep Fried Cauliflower

steps: 1. In a food processor or by hand, coarsely chop the cabbage and carrot.
2. In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, milk, vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper and celery seed.
3. Stir into the cabbage mixture.
4. Chill until serving.
5. Yields 6 servings.
title: Cabbage Slaw

steps: 1. Place everything except sugar in saucepan.
2. Bring to boil. Stir in sugar, cover and simmer 30 minutes until tender.
3. Serves 6.
title: Gingered Carrots

ingredients.text: 6 c. beef broth (canned is best or 6 cubes and 6 c. water)

steps: 1. Saute onions in butter; add pepper.
2. Cook until lightly browned.
3. Sprinkle onions with flour; cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
4. Add beef broth and simmer 30 minutes.
5. Taste and add salt to taste.
6. Place soup in individual ovenproof dishes.
7. Place toast on top and sprinkle with cheese.
8. Place under broiler or in 400° oven until cheese is melted.
9. Serves 6.
title: Vidalia Onion Soup

steps: 1. Combine ingredients; mix well.
2. Pour out on floured foil. Make patties; fry in corn oil until browned on both sides. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Mashed Potato Patties

steps: 1. Brown beef and drain.
2. Add onion and cook until done (about 5 minutes).
3. Add all other ingredients except tomatoes.
4. Bring to a boil.
5. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes.
6. Add tomatoes; simmer another 10 minutes.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Autumn Soup

steps: 1. Cook together broccoli, onion, bouillon cubes, salt and water 25 minutes.
2. Add cornstarch to milk (mix well).
3. Add to ingredients; bring to boil, stirring constantly.
4. Boil 1 minute. Serves 4.
title: Broccoli Soup

steps: 1. Melt 4 tablespoons butter, add flour and salt.
2. Add milk slowly.
3. Cook until sauce thickens.
4. Add sliced potatoes and bring to a boil.
5. Arrange in a 9 x 13 baking dish and dot with remaining butter.
6. Bake a 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
7. Yields 12 servings.
title: Scalloped Potatoes

steps: 1. Bring water, sugar and salt to boil.
2. Add raisins and carrots. Cover and cook until tender.
3. Stir in butter.
4. Makes 4 servings.
title: Buttered Carrots

steps: 1. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.
2. Cool.
3. When slightly set; add other ingredients.
4. Add radishes for color (optional).
5. Serve 10 to 12.
title: Spring Tonic Salad

steps: 1. Cut carrots 5 inches from top, reserving smaller end for another use.
2. Cook carrots, covered, in a small amount of water until tender-crisp; let cool.
3. Cut carrots in half lengthwise. Scoop out center of each.
4. Combine cracker crumbs and remaining ingredients; toss to mix.
5. Stuff carrots with mixture.
6. Place in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
7. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes or until carrots are hot.
8. Yield:
9. 6 servings.
title: Stuffed Carrots

ingredients.text: 1 head cauliflower, cut, broken or sliced
8 to 10 slices bacon, diced and cooked

steps: 1. Layer lettuce, cauliflower, onion and bacon in 11 x 16-inch pan.
2. Mix mayonnaise, sugar and Parmesan cheese and spread over the top.
3. Refrigerate for 24 hours.
4. Toss lightly before serving. Yield:
5. 8 to 10 servings.

4. Repeat
5. layers.

12. Bake
13. in

15. knife inserted near center comes out clean.
16. Let cool 10 minutes before serving.
17. Serves 8.
title: Cheese Potato Casserole

steps: 1. Combine vinegar, water, sugar, celery seed and salt in 2-quart casserole dish.
2. Toss with cabbage and apple slices.
3. Dot with melted butter.
4. Cover with lid. Microwave for 4 to 5 minutes on High, or until heated through.
5. Serves 3 to 4.
title: Hot Apple Slaw

steps: 1. Melt margarine in a saucepan.
2. Add onion and celery.
3. Cook until tender.
4. Add carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
5. Add broth. Bring to a boil.
6. Cover and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes or until carrots are tender.
7. Puree in electric blender or food mill.
8. Pour into saucepan; add milk, salt, nutmeg and pepper. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes; do not boil.
9. Serves 6.
title: Low-Fat Creamy Carrot Soup

ingredients.text: 4 medium size potatoes, pared and cubed

steps: 1. Melt butter in 3-quart saucepan.
2. Add minced onion and cook at 250° for 3 to 5 minutes.
3. Add cubed potatoes, 1/2 cup water and salt.
4. Cover and cook 30 minutes at 212°.
5. Add milk and celery salt, allowing to heat through 10 minutes.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Cream Of Potato Soup

steps: 1. Mash cooked squash.
2. Add other ingredients and mix well.
3. Pour into greased dish.
4. Bake at 375° for about 40 minutes.
5. This is excellent.
6. Yields 6 servings.
title: Squash Casserole

steps: 1. Cut chicken into large chunks.
2. Toss together the first 5 ingredients.
3. Add mayonnaise; blend well.
4. Mound in individual lettuce cups; sprinkle with almonds.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Chicken Fruit Salad

steps: 1. On a sheet of aluminum foil, place 1/2 acorn squash.
2. Fill with 1 tablespoon each of butter and brown sugar.
3. Seal foil.
4. Bake in 425° oven for 1 hour.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Baked Acorn Squash

steps: 1. Cut stems off spinach; wash leaves well.
2. Drain in colander. Chop spinach.
3. Cook bacon until browned and crisp; remove.
4. Drain on paper towels and crumble.
5. Add bacon, minced onion, salt and pepper to spinach.
6. Add vinegar to bacon fat; bring to a boil. Stir and pour over the spinach.
7. Serve immediately while spinach is still crisp. Yield: 4 servings.
title: Wilted Spinach Salad

ingredients.text: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
2 onions, thinly sliced and separated into rings

steps: 1. Melt butter in saucepan over low heat.
2. Add flour and stir until smooth, stirring constantly.
3. Gradually add milk until mixture is thickened and bubbly.
4. Add salt and pepper.
5. Spoon 1/4 cup sauce mixture into a greased 10-inch casserole dish.
6. Combine potatoes and remaining ingredients in big bowl.
7. Layer half the potato mixture over sauce.
8. Top with remaining sauce.
9. Repeat layers.
10. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender.
11. Serves 8.
title: Scalloped Ham And Potatoes

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. bacon, fried crisp and broken

steps: 1. Arrange in layers in a large bowl, except mayonnaise/sugar mixture.
2. Pour mayonnaise/sugar mixture over and mix well.
3. Stays fresh in refrigerator for several days.
4. Serves 6 to 8. Delicious!
title: Lettuce-Cauliflower Salad

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium-high heat. Saute celery and onion until tender. Add potatoes and broth. Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 12 minutes. Stir in milk and seasonings. Add the cheese and heat only until melted. Garnish with parsley and cheese. Yield: 8 servings.
title: Wisconsin Potato Cheese Soup

steps: 1. Cook the potatoes, celery and onion in the water in a covered pan until very tender (do not drain).
2. Press vegetables through a sieve.
3. Add milk, bouillon cubes and butter.
4. Mix sour cream and flour until smooth.
5. Add to soup and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened and bouillon cubes are dissolved.
6. Stir in salt and pepper.
7. Serves 6.
title: Potato Soup

steps: 1. In a large bowl, make a white sauce with the first 5 ingredients.
2. In a greased 2-quart casserole, place half of the sliced potatoes, half of the onion and half of the white sauce. Repeat the layers.
3. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
4. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer with American cheese, if desired. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Scalloped Potatoes

steps: 1. Place mayonnaise in a large heavy-duty Zip-top plastic bag. Add cauliflower, seal and shake to coat. Place breadcrumbs in a large heavy-duty Zip-top plastic bag. Add half of cauliflower mixture. Seal and shake to coat. Spread in a single layer onto a lightly greased baking sheet. Repeat with remaining cauliflower mixture and breadcrumbs. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Yield: 8 servings.
title: Oven-Fried Cauliflower

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. chopped, cooked broccoli (one 10 oz. pkg.)

steps: 1. In large saucepan, saute onions and margarine. In bowl, dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water.
2. Add bouillon, carrots and celery to onions.
3. Cook over moderate heat about 10 minutes. In another bowl, gradually add a small amount of the milk to the flour and stir until smooth.
4. Add remaining milk.
5. Pour milk mixture, salt, pepper and broccoli into saucepan.
6. Cook over moderate heat, stirring until bubbles appear.
7. Serves 8.
title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup

ingredients.text: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (approximately 3 oz. each)

steps: 1. Place mushrooms, celery, carrot and margarine in 1 quart casserole.
2. Cover tightly and microwave on High (100%) until vegetables are tender, 2 1/2 to 3 minutes.
3. Cut chicken breast half into 1/4-inch strips.
4. Stir chicken and remaining ingredients into vegetable mixture.
5. Cover tightly and microwave until boiling, 5 to 6 minutes.
6. Makes 2 servings.
title: Microwave Chicken Soup

ingredients.text: 12 oz. frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed

steps: 1. Drain and combine pineapple, pears and apricots.
2. Slice bananas into thawed orange juice.
3. Combine all of the fruits except the strawberries.
4. Add sugar and lemon juice to the chopped fruits.
5. Carefully stir in the thawed strawberries. Yields 25 servings.
title: Fruit Salad

ingredients.text: 5 to 6 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled

steps: 1. Spread potatoes evenly in a lightly greased baking dish. Spread evenly with sour cream.
2. Sprinkle with bacon and green onions.
3. Sprinkle on cheese.
4. Bake at 300° for 30 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly.
5. Serve at once.
6. Serves 6.
title: Easy Potato Bake

ingredients.text: 4 c. cooked, drained small white beans

steps: 1. Saute in skillet the bacon and onion until onion is almost tender.
2. Remove from heat.
3. Stir in honey, mustard, salt and cayenne.
4. Layer half of beans in a 2-quart covered baking dish. Spoon half of honey mixture over beans.
5. Repeat layers.
6. Cover and bake at 325° for 1 hour or until honey mixture is absorbed.
7. Makes 8 servings.
title: Quick New England Baked Beans

ingredients.text: 1 medium head cabbage, finely shredded (about 6 c.)

steps: 1. In serving dish, combine shredded cabbage and sliced onion. In small bowl, combine mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, celery seed and salt; stir until sugar is dissolved and ingredients are well blended.
2. Drizzle mayonnaise mixture over cabbage mixture in bowl. Toss lightly to mix well.
3. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Creamy Cabbage Slaw

steps: 1. Take off outer leaves of cabbage. Core cabbage and cut cabbage into narrow wedges, then slice wedges into thin strips. Place strips into a large bowl.
2. Add sugar and salt, mix well. Let stand at room temperature for 10 - 15 minutes.
3. Add vinegar, and mayonnaise, mix. Cover and refrigerate for a minimum of four hours. Makes 6 - 8 servings.
4. Note: Can add any of the following to the cole slaw: celery seeds, shredded carrots, green pepper, raisins, chopped apples, red cabbage, nuts, pineapple, etc.
title: Clifton'S Cafeteria Cole Slaw

steps: 1. Wash and peel carrots.
2. Cook in a small amount of boiling salted water until tender.
3. Melt butter in a saucepan.
4. Combine sugar, cornstarch and salt.
5. Gradually add orange juice and lemon juice.
6. Add to melted butter and cook over moderate heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
7. Pour sauce over carrots.
8. Serves 4.
title: Orange Carrots

steps: 1. Cut and scrape corn from cob (makes 3 cups).
2. Cook bacon slowly until crisp; remove and reserve.
3. Stir corn into hot bacon fat.
4. Add water, salt and sugar; stir and cook for 5 minutes, uncovered.
5. Stir flour into milk; mix until smooth.
6. Add to corn and stir constantly until thickened.
7. Add pepper and butter. Serve hot; garnish with reserved bacon.
8. Yields 6 servings.
title: Creamy Fresh Corn

steps: 1. Combine vegetables in bowl.
2. Mix together remaining ingredients.
3. Toss lightly with vegetables.
4. Chill 2 hours, mixing gently several times.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Calico Cauliflower Salad
