title: Ham And Cheese Omelet

steps: 1. Cut bread in small squares.
2. Mix everything except sugar and nuts.
3. Pour over the bread and refrigerate overnight or until bread it totally soaked.
4. Sprinkle nuts and brown sugar over bread mixture.
5. Bake in a 12# Dutch Oven at 350° for 40 minutes.
6. Serve with syrup, a breakfast meat and coffee.
7. Yield 10-12 servings.
title: French Toast Casserole

steps: 1. Preheat oven at 350°.
2. Combine eggs, sugar, milk, cream, butter, vanilla and nutmeg; blend well.
3. Pour mixture over bread slices, turning until saturated.
4. Arrange into lightly greased 4-quart dish.
5. Pour excess over bread.
6. Bake, uncovered, 30 to 45 minutes.
7. Serve with warm syrup or fruit preserves.
8. Serves 10.
title: Baked French Toast

steps: 1. Sift dry ingredients together.
2. Blend shortening into flour as you would when making biscuits, working until they resemble corn meal.
3. Beat egg yolks and add milk.
4. Beat together thoroughly. Add dry ingredients and beat only until the two are blended.
5. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
6. Bake until light goes out on waffle iron.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Waffles

ingredients.text: 2 medium potatoes, peeled and finely chopped (2 c.)

steps: 1. In a 10-inch skillet cook onion in butter or margarine until tender.
2. Add potatoes, water and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
3. Cover and cook over medium heat about 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally.
4. Beat together eggs, milk, 1/4 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper; stir in ham.
5. Pour over potato mixture.
6. Cook, without stirring, until mixture begins to set on the bottom and around edges.
7. Using a large spoon or spatula, lift and fold partially cooked egg mixture so uncooked portion flows underneath.
8. Continue cooking over medium heat about 4 minutes or until eggs are cooked throughout but still glossy and moist.
9. Serve immediately.
10. Makes 4 servings.
title: Farmer'S Breakfast

steps: 1. Fry sausage; drain well.
2. Place bread in bottom of large casserole dish.
3. Spread cooked sausage and cheese over bread. Beat eggs and milk together; pour over bread, sausage and cheese. Refrigerate overnight.
4. Bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes or until set.
5. Serves 6.
6. Good!
title: Breakfast Dish

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a blender until smooth; serves 1.
title: Orange Breakfast Flip

steps: 1. Make this casserole the night before you serve it and place in refrigerator.
2. Put in 13 x 9-inch greased casserole pan with cheese on top.
3. In the morning, place in oven and bake 30 minutes at 350°.
4. This recipe will serve 5 people.
title: Jen'S Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. In large skillet, fry bacon crispy.
2. Dice and fry potatoes. Break bacon into small bits as potatoes fry.
3. Crack eggs into bowl (don't break).
4. When potatoes are nearly finished, put bacon bits into them and stir.
5. Pour eggs over all and simmer until done. Divide and eat.
6. Serves 6 or more.
title: Camp Breakfast

steps: 1. About 30 minutes before serving, preheat oven to 350°.
2. In large bowl, at high speed, beat egg whites until foamy.
3. Add cream of tartar beating until stiff but not dry.
4. In small bowl, at medium speed, beat yolks with 1/4 cup cold water and salt until very light and fluffy.
5. Fold into whites.
6. In a skillet, heat butter.
7. Add egg mixture.
8. Cook over low heat 3 minutes until puffy and golden on bottom when lifted with spatula.
9. Bake 10 minutes until light brown and center springs when lightly touched. Run spatula around sides to loosen omelet. Make cut through center.
10. Fold in half and slide out.
11. Serves 3 to 4.
12. Top with Shrimp Sauce.
title: Puffy Omelet

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together. Pour in hot waffle iron. Brown to preference. Serves 6 (2 waffles each); makes 12 (4 x 4-inch) waffles.
title: Heavenly Waffles

steps: 1. Mix thoroughly the eggs, milk, sugar and salt in a pie pan or baking dish.
2. Melt butter in skillet until bubbly, but not brown. Dip bread in egg mixture, turning to coat both sides.
3. Place in skillet; fry until golden brown.
4. Turn and brown other side. Yield 2 servings.
title: French Toast

steps: 1. Beat eggs in mixing bowl.
2. Break bread into small pieces.
3. Mix mustard in a little milk so it blends well.
4. Crumble the fried sausage.
5. Mix in all ingredients and put into 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
7. Serves 5 or 6.
title: Breakfast Egg Casserole

steps: 1. Brown sausage, drain well.
2. Put milk, eggs, salt and mustard into bowl.
3. Add bread cubes, cheese and sausage.
4. Pour into baking dish (7 x 11 inches or 8 x 12).
5. Refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
7. Let stand a few minutes before serving.
8. Serves 8.
title: Breakfast Sausage(Also Good As Lunch Sausage)

ingredients.text: 1 c. finely chopped fully cooked ham

steps: 1. In a bowl, beat the eggs and cream until light and fluffy. Stir in the cheese, ham, green pepper and onion. Pour into a greased 9-inch square baking dish. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Oven Denver Omelet

steps: 1. Brown and drain meat and onion.
2. Mix together with milk, mustard and drained mushrooms.
3. Add the rest of the ingredients and bake in a 7 x 11-inch pan for 35 to 45 minutes at 350°. Serves 9.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Melt margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
2. Toss in bread cubes in melted margarine until coated.
3. Sprinkle cooked sausage and grated Cheddar cheese over bread.
4. Combine milk, eggs and dry mustard.
5. Pour over bread, sausage and cheese mixture. Refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
7. Cut into squares.
8. Serves 8 hungry beachcombers along with fresh fruit and beverage.
title: Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 loaf French bread, cut in 3/4-inch slices

steps: 1. Cook the sugar, butter and syrup until syrupy.
2. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
3. Spread apple slices over the syrup.
4. Place bread on top of apples.
5. Whisk together the remaining ingredients and pour over bread.
6. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
7. Bake, uncovered, for 40 minutes at 350°.
8. Cut into squares and serve with spicy apple syrup.
9. Serves 9. Great for brunch.
title: Main Stay French Toast

steps: 1. Place bread in greased 2-quart baking dish. Press down gently. Sprinkle with raisins. In small bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in whipping cream and syrup. Whisk together eggs, vanilla, cinnamon and salt. Add to cream cheese mixture. Pour evenly over bread. Lightly press bread into mixture with spatula. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. Remove from fridge 30 minutes before baking. Bake, covered, for 25 minutes at 375°. Uncover. Bake 20 minutes longer until center is set and top is golden brown. Serve with maple syrup. Serves 6.
title: French Toast Casserole

steps: 1. In a large skillet, crumble the sausage and cook over medium heat until done. Drain on paper towels. Set aside.
2. Slice the crusts off the bread and cut into cubes.
3. Spread in the bottom of a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with sausage and cheese. Set aside.
4. In mixing bowl, combine the eggs, salt and milk.
5. Pour over cheese and sausage.
6. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake, uncovered, in preheated 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.
7. Serves 12 to 14.
title: Make-Ahead Breakfast Bake

steps: 1. Put egg, milk and cinnamon in a bowl and mix well. Dip bread in the mixture, be sure both sides are covered.
2. Fry on medium, lightly greased pan until golden brown.
3. Serve with butter and syrup.
4. Serves 1.
title: French Toast

steps: 1. Crumble sausage in medium skillet; cook over medium heat until brown, stirring occasionally.
2. Drain well.
3. Spread bread cubes in a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish; top with sausage and cheese. Combine eggs, milk and seasonings.
4. Beat well and pour over cheese.
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until set.
7. Makes 8 servings.
title: Make-Ahead Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 c. chopped ham, crisp bacon or sliced corned beef

steps: 1. Heat oven to 325°.
2. Beat eggs, milk and seasoned salt.
3. Add meat to egg mixture.
4. Stir in cheese and onion.
5. I use half and half for the milk for company.
6. Pour into greased 8 x 11-inch baking dish.
7. Bake, uncovered, 40 to 45 minutes or until set and top is golden brown.
8. Serves 6.
title: Breakfast Oven Omelet

steps: 1. Pam spray 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
2. Combine eggs and milk in a large bowl.
3. Mix well.
4. Mix sugar and cinnamon.
5. Butter both sides of all bread slices.
6. Dip each in egg mixture.
7. Place one layer of bread in bottom of baking dish.
8. Cover with 1 cup of cheese, all of the ham, 1/2 of the sugar/cinnamon, then the remaining bread, then the remaining cheese.
9. Pour remaining egg mixture over cheese.
10. Refrigerate 24 hours.
11. Remove from refrigerator 1 hour before baking.
12. Sprinkle remaining sugar and spice over.
13. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 1 hour.
14. Serves 12.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Pour into greased 9-inch square baking dish.
2. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
3. Serve with additional milk.
4. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.
title: Baked Oatmeal

steps: 1. Melt butter in top of double boiler over boiling water. Combine eggs with cream, salt and pepper.
2. Beat with rotary beater until well blended.
3. Pour into top of double boiler.
4. Cook eggs over boiling water, stirring occasionally 10 minutes.
5. Add diced ham to eggs and cook, stirring several minutes longer or until eggs are of desired doneness.
6. Stir in chives.
7. Add more salt and pepper, if necessary.
8. Makes 4 servings.
title: Scrambled Eggs With Ham

steps: 1. In a 10-inch skillet, cook sausage over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned.
2. Remove sausage from pan, leaving drippings.
3. Add potatoes and onion to drippings.
4. Cook over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally until potatoes begin to brown, about 5 to 7 minutes.
5. Reduce heat to medium.
6. Beat together eggs, milk, salt and parsley until blended.
7. Pour over potato mixture.
8. Add reserved sausage.
9. Scramble.
10. Top with Cheddar cheese, cover and heat until cheese melts.
11. Serves 4.
title: Farmer'S Country Breakfast

steps: 1. Fry sausage.
2. Whisk eggs. Add milk, mustard, cheese and cooked sausage. Put bread in casserole dish.
3. Put sausage-egg combination over bread cubes.
4. Bake 1 hour at 350°.
5. Serves 6.
6. Serve with fresh fruit and danish.
title: Scrambled Egg Casserole

steps: 1. Sift together dry ingredients.
2. Blend milk and egg.
3. Add to the dry ingredients and beat until smooth.
4. Dip bread into batter and fry in fat heated to 375° for 4 or 5 minutes.
5. Serve with butter and warm syrup.
6. Batter may be prepared ahead of time. Serves 4.
title: Bret'S Puffy French Toast(A Saturday Morning Favorite!)

ingredients.text: 7 to 8 slices bread, crusts removed and spread with margarine, cubed
1 lb. bulk cooked sausage, crumbled and drained

steps: 1. In a 3-quart casserole dish place the bread and top with sausage and cheese.
2. In a medium bowl, combine the eggs, milk, salt and dry mustard, beating well. Pour the mixture over the casserole and refrigerate for 8 to 12 hours.
3. Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.
4. Serves 12.
title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Crumble and cook sausage in a fry pan. Drain and set aside. In a mixing bowl, beat eggs, add milk, salt and mustard. In a greased baking dish, layer bread, sausage and cheese. Pour egg mixture over top of ingredients. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 6.
title: Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.text: 6 slices white bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes

steps: 1. Saute mushrooms with sausage and drain.
2. Place bread cubes in a greased casserole dish (12 x 8 x 2-inch) and top with sausage and Cheddar cheese.
3. Mix eggs, milk, celery seed and oregano. Pour over all.
4. Refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.
5. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Sausage Breakfast Dish

steps: 1. Heat oven to 325°.
2. Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan to coat bottom.
3. Beat eggs, sour cream, milk and salt together until smooth.
4. Pour into dish and sprinkle green onion on top.
5. Bake 30 minutes or until eggs set.
6. Test with knife blade.
7. Cut in squares. Serves 12.
title: Oven Omelet

steps: 1. Beat eggs lightly in bowl.
2. Add flour and salt; mix until smooth.
3. Stir in milk gradually.
4. Melt butter in 9 x 12-inch baking pan.
5. Pour into batter.
6. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
7. Let stand until slightly cooled and butter is absorbed.
8. Serve with legon. Yield:
9. 6 to 8 servings.
title: Omelet Popover(Sweden)

steps: 1. Cook sausage over medium heat until done, stirring to crumble well.
2. Drain sausage on paper towel, set aside.
3. Spread each side of bread with butter, cut into cubes in 9 x 13-inch pan.
4. Sprinkle with sausage and top with cheese.
5. Combine remaining ingredients. Beat well and pour over mixture in pan.
6. Chill at least 8 hours. Remove from refrigerator and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 12 or 13.
title: Breakfast Sausage Casserole

steps: 1. Cover 9 x 13-inch pan with bread.
2. Grate both cheeses on top. Layer with browned bacon slices.
3. Beat milk and eggs and pour into pan.
4. Cover overnight in refrigerator.
5. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes at 350°.
6. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Company For Breakfast

steps: 1. Butter bread and place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Top with bacon (can substitute sausage or a vegetable) and cheese. Mix eggs, milk, salt and mustard.
2. Pour into dish.
3. Cover and let set in refrigerator overnight.
4. In the morning, mix cornflakes and melted butter.
5. Pour on top of casserole.
6. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Makes 8 to 12 servings.
title: Breakfast Bake

ingredients.text: 2 Granny Smith apples, peeled, sliced and sauteed in butter

steps: 1. Line Dutch oven with foil.
2. Mix ingredients in a bowl, then put in an oven and cook about 1 hour.
3. Serves 8 Scouts.
title: Dutch Oven Breakfast

steps: 1. Saute meat and drain excess fat.
2. Beat eggs, milk and seasonings.
3. Layer bread cubes, meat and cheese in a 6 x 8-inch shallow pan.
4. Pour egg mixture over all.
5. Refrigerate overnight covered with foil.
6. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Breakfast Overnight

ingredients.text: 1 loaf Italian bread, cut into 1-inch thick slices

steps: 1. Put bread in a well-greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
2. Mix other ingredients, except butter, and pour over bread in pan.
3. Cover with foil; refrigerate for 4 to 36 hours.
4. Uncover, dot with butter and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes, until puffy and lightly browned.
5. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
6. Serves 8 to 10.
7. Serve with powdered sugar or syrup.
title: Night-Before French Toast

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325°.
2. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
3. Beat eggs, sour cream, milk and salt together.
4. Pour into pan. Sprinkle with green onions.
5. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.
6. Test with toothpick for doneness. Cut into squares (12 to 15).
7. Serves 6.
title: Oven Omelet(For Breakfast Or Dinner)

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients but egg whites. Stir only until blended. Fold in egg whites.
2. Pour in hot waffle iron.
3. Serves 4.
title: Mimi'S Waffles

ingredients.text: 2 c. bread cubes (to cover bottom of dish)

steps: 1. Saute sausage; drain.
2. Beat eggs with milk and salt.
3. Layer bread cubes, sausage and cheese in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
4. Pour egg mixture on top.
5. Refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
7. Will serve 6 to 8 people.
title: Night-Before Breakfast

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, firmly packed
10 ounces crushed pineapple with juice, drained

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400F.
2. In a saucepan, melt butter over moderate heat and stir in sugar until dissolved.
3. Add pineapple, stirring well to incorporate.
4. In a bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, half and half, reserved pineapple juice, salt, cinnamon and vanilla.
5. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 pan and spread pineapple mixture evenly over bottom.
6. Dip bread slices into milk mixture and arrange in one layer on top of pineapple mixture.
7. Bake french toast in middle of oven 20-25 minutes or until bread is golden.
8. French toast can be made a day ahead of time, covered with plastic wrap and stored in the refrigerator.
9. Serves 4.
title: Pineapple Upside Down French Toast

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except apples; bring to a boil.
2. Pare apples, core, cut in eights and add to syrup.
3. Cook slowly until done, 5 to 8 minutes.
4. Remove from heat and cool in syrup.
5. Remove spices and lemon.
6. Serves 4.
title: Breakfast Apples

steps: 1. Slice pepperoni.
2. Put in 10-inch skillet.
3. Cook over low flame until fat melts.
4. Add Ricotta.
5. Let melt.
6. Beat eggs; add to pan. Let settle.
7. Turn over to cook.
8. Have plate ready.
9. Turn omelet onto dish.
10. Serves 4 or 6 people.
title: Pepperoni Omelet

steps: 1. Mix together hash browns, sour cream, Velveeta, softened butter or margarine, soup and onion; mix well.
2. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
3. Mix corn flakes and melted margarine.
4. Put on top. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.
5. Serves 10.
title: Scalloped Hash Brown Potatoes

ingredients.text: 4 oz. cooked ham, cut into thin strips

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Lightly spray a 10-inch glass pie pan with nonstick cooking spray.
3. In medium bowl with wire whisk, beat eggs with 1/4 cup of water until well blended.
4. Stir in remaining ingredients with rubber spatula.
5. Scrape into prepared pie pan. Bake 20 to 30 minutes until omelet is set, slightly puffed and browned.
6. Cut into 4 servings and serve at once.
7. Yields 4 servings.
title: Baked Western Omelet

steps: 1. Beat eggs lightly with water.
2. Melt butter in large saucepan. Saute onions until golden brown.
3. Mix Ricotta cheese and Parmesan cheese.
4. Pour eggs into frypan.
5. Sprinkle cheese mixture and parsley over eggs and onions.
6. Salt and pepper.
7. Cover and cook in oven at 250°.
8. Serves 4.
title: Omelette With Ricotta Cheese

steps: 1. Combine eggs, oil and milk in electric mixer bowl; mix well. Combine dry ingredients; add to egg mixture, beating at medium speed.
2. Beat for about 2 minutes.
3. Pour batter into hot waffle iron.
4. Bake until done.
5. Serve with favorite topping.
6. Yields 6 servings.
title: Waffles

steps: 1. Spread sausage in 9 x 13-inch dish.
2. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over sausage.
3. Bake 30 minutes at 350°, until slightly golden brown.
4. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Beat eggs, milk, sugar, salt and cinnamon well.
2. Dip 8 slices of bread, one at a time, into mixture and cook in hot skillet with butter.
3. Brown lightly on both sides.
4. Serve with syrup.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: French Toast

steps: 1. Crumble and brown sausage and drain.
2. Beat eggs with milk and salt.
3. Layer bread cubes, sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13 x 2 inch casserole dish.
4. Pour egg mixture on top.
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
7. Serves 6 - 8.
title: "The Night Before" Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt.
2. In a small mixing bowl, beat egg yolks on low while adding cream; beat for 1 minute.
3. Add to flour mixture; blend on low speed, then beat on medium-high until smooth.
4. In another small mixing bowl, beat egg whites on high until stiff but not dry.
5. Gently fold into batter. Bake in a preheated waffle iron according to manufacturer's directions.
6. Serve with warm maple syrup or fresh fruit in season. Yields 2 to 3 servings.
title: Dutch Cream Waffles

ingredients.text: 3 (8-oz.) baking potatoes, peeled and shredded (about 3 cups firmly packed)*

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°. Place shredded potatoes in a large bowl; add cold water to cover. Let stand 5 minutes; drain and pat dry.

2. Melt butter with oil in a 10-inch cast-iron skillet over medium heat. Add bell pepper and onion, and saute 3 to 5 minutes or until tender. Add garlic; saute 1 minute. Stir in shredded potatoes and 1/2 tsp. salt; cook, stirring often, 10 minutes or until potatoes are golden and tender.
3. Remove from heat. Make 6 indentations in potato mixture, using back of a spoon. Break 1 egg into each indentation. Sprinkle eggs with pepper and remaining 1/4 tsp. salt.
4. Bake at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes or until eggs are set. Serve immediately.
5. *3 cups firmly packed frozen shredded potatoes may be substituted, omitting Step

6. Veggie Confetti Frittata: Prepare recipe as directed through Step 2, sauteing 1/2 (8-oz.) package sliced fresh mushrooms with bell peppers and onion. Remove from heat, and stir in 1/4 cup sliced ripe black olives, drained, and 1/4 cup thinly sliced sun-dried tomatoes in oil, drained. Whisk together eggs, pepper, and remaining 1/4 tsp. salt; whisk in 1/2 cup (2 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese. Pour egg mixture over potato mixture in skillet. Bake at 350° for 9 to 10 minutes or until set. Cut into wedges, and serve immediately. Makes 6 servings. Prep: 20 min., Stand: 5 min., Cook: 16 min., Bake: 10 min.

7. Soaking the shredded potatoes in cold water keeps them from turning gray before cooking. It also rinses off some of the starch. Drain and pat them dry, so they won't stick to the cast-iron skillet.
title: Sunny Skillet Breakfast

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients.
2. Shape mixture by tablespoonfuls into 2-inch patties.
3. Cook in skillet over medium-high heat, about 2 to 3 minutes on each side.
4. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Breakfast Burgers

steps: 1. Mix all the ingredients together and press into 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve with milk. Serves 4.
title: My Mother-In-Law'S Baked Oatmeal(Prep. Time: 35 Minutes)

steps: 1. Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan in 350° oven.
2. Beat eggs slightly.
3. Add salt and scalded milk; mix.
4. Pour into melted butter and bake 15 minutes.
5. Stir; bake approximately another 15 minutes.
6. Serves 6 people.
title: Oven-Scrambled Eggs

ingredients.text: 12 slices white bread, cut in quarters

steps: 1. Cook sausage until browned; drain all drippings except 2 tablespoons.
2. Saute the onion in the reserved drippings, until tender.
3. In a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish, layer the ingredients.
4. Begin with 1/2 of the bread, then 1/2 the sausage, 1/2 onion and 1/2 cheese.
5. Repeat layers.
6. Beat together the eggs, milk, salt, pepper and dry mustard, then pour over the layers. Cover; refrigerate for at least overnight before cooking.
7. When ready to bake, remove baking dish from refrigerator 1 hour before baking to bring to room temperature, then bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
8. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Breakfast Sausage Casserole

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9-inch pie dish.

2. Place the brown sugar and butter in a mixing bowl, and beat them together with an electric mixer until creamy and very well combined, without lumps. Beat in eggs, one at a time, incorporating the first egg before adding the next one. Add the vanilla extract and salt; beat the flour in, a little at a time, and then the milk, making a creamy batter. Pour the batter into the prepared pie dish.

3. Bake in the preheated oven for 35 minutes; remove pie, and cover the rim with aluminum foil to prevent burning. Return to oven, and bake until the middle sets and the top forms a crusty layer, about 15 more minutes. Let the pie cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.
title: Sugar Pie

steps: 1. Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Line a 20 x 30cm baking tray tin with baking parchment. Put the chocolate, butter and sugar in a pan and gently melt, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon. Remove from the heat.

2. Stir the eggs, one by one, into the melted chocolate mixture. Sieve over the flour and cocoa, and stir in. Stir in half the raspberries, scrape into the tray, then scatter over the remaining raspberries. Bake on the middle shelf for 30 mins or, if you prefer a firmer texture, for 5 mins more. Cool before slicing into squares. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
title: Chocolate Raspberry Brownies

steps: 1. First, make the pastry. Tip the ingredients into a food processor with 1 /4 tsp salt. Blend until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs. Drizzle 2-3 tsp cold water into the funnel while the blade is running – the mixture should start to clump together. Tip onto a work surface and bring together, kneading briefly into a ball. Pat into a disc, wrap in cling film, and chill for at least 20 mins. Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6.

2. Remove the pastry from the fridge and leave at room temperature for 5 mins to soften. Flour the work surface, then unwrap the pastry and roll to a circle the thickness of a £1 coin. Use the pastry to line a deep, 23cm round fluted tin – mine was about 3cm deep. Press the pastry into the corners and up the sides, making sure there are no gaps. Leave 1cm pastry overhanging (save some of the pastry scraps for later). Line with baking parchment (scrunch it up first to make it more pliable) and fill with baking beans. Blind-bake for 15-20 mins until the sides are set, then remove the parchment and beans and return to the oven for 5 mins until golden brown. Trim the pastry so it’s flush with the top of the tin – a small serrated knife is best for this. If there are any cracks, patch them up with the pastry scraps.

3. Meanwhile, weigh the butter, syrup and sugars into a pan, and add 1 /4 tsp salt. Heat until the butter has melted and the sugar dissolved, stirring until smooth. Remove from the heat and cool for 10 mins. Reduce oven to 160C/140C fan/gas 3.

4. Beat the eggs in a bowl. Add the syrup mixture, vanilla and pecans, and mix until well combined. Pour half the mixture into the tart case, scatter over half the chocolate chips, then cover with the remaining filling and chocolate chips. Bake on the middle shelf for 50-55 mins until set. Remove from the oven and leave to cool, then chill for at least 2 hrs before serving.
title: Choc Chip Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Heat the oven to 160C/fan 140C/gas 3. Whizz the biscuits to crumbs in a food processor (or put in a strong plastic bag and bash with a rolling pin). Mix with the melted butter and press into the base and up the sides of a 22cm loose-based tart tin. Bake in the oven for 10 minutes. Remove and cool.

2. Put the egg yolks in a large bowl and whisk for a minute with electric beaters. Add the condensed milk and whisk for 3 minutes then add the zest and juice and whisk again for 3 minutes. Pour the filling into the cooled base then put back in the oven for 15 minutes. Cool then chill for at least 3 hours or overnight if you like.

3. When you are ready to serve, carefully remove the pie from the tin and put on a serving plate. To decorate, softly whip together the cream and icing sugar. Dollop or pipe the cream onto the top of the pie and finish with extra lime zest.
title: Key Lime Pie

steps: 1. Mix corn meal in a 2-quart bowl.
2. (Omit salt and baking powder when using self-rising meal.)
3. Add milk gradually until mixture is firm.
4. Add egg and melted shortening.
5. Stir 1 minute, until smooth.
6. Pour into warm greased muffin pan.
7. Bake at 350° until done.
8. Serve warm.
9. Makes 12 servings.
title: Southern Corn Muffins

steps: 1. Mix in a 1 1/2-quart bowl the sugar, flour and salt.
2. Stir in corn syrup.
3. Beat in eggs, one at a time.
4. Mix in milk, pecans and vanilla.
5. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells.
6. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until firm.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: "Easy" Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients; add onions and buttermilk and finally the beaten egg.
2. Fry in moderately hot cooking oil until brown; turn only once.
3. Serves 4.
title: Kentucky Hush Puppies

steps: 1. In small mixing bowl, cream the butter.
2. Add eggs and vanilla. Combine sugar and flour.
3. Add to creamed mixture.
4. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts (and peanut butter chips, if you wish). Pour into pie shell and bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown in a 350° oven.
5. Makes 8 to 10 servings because this is a very rich pie.
title: Chocolate Chip Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Combine first 6 ingredients together in a large bowl; cut in shortening with a pastry blender or 2 forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 6 weeks or freeze for up to 6 months. Attach instructions.

2. Combine 2 cups cornbread mix with one teaspoon chili powder in a large mixing bowl; form a well in the center and set aside. Whisk one egg and 3/4 cup water together; pour into well. Mix just until combined; spread batter in a greased 8"x8" pan. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Makes 16 servings.
title: Gotta-Have-It Cornbread Mix

steps: 1. Preheat oven 450 degrees.
2. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; make a well in center of mixture. Combine buttermilk, oil, egg and egg whites; add to dry ingredients, stirring just until moist.
3. Place a 10-inch cast-iron skillet in a 450 degree oven. for 5 minutes or until hot. remove skillet from oven; coat with cooking spray, and immediately pour batter into hot skillet.
4. Bake at 450 degrees for 20 minutes or until lightly browned.
5. Remove cornbread from skillet immediately.
6. Yield 10 servings.
7. Serving Size 1 wedge @ 3 ww pts.
title: Weight Watchers Basic Skillet Cornbread

steps: 1. Cream margarine until soft.
2. Add sugar, gradually, continuing to beat until light and fluffy.
3. Beat eggs, using mix-stir.
4. Add syrup, honey and vanilla.
5. Blend thoroughly.
6. Slowly beat egg mixture into margarine-sugar mixture.
7. Add 1 cup pecans.
8. Pour into pie shell.
9. Arrange remaining 1 cup pecans on top.
10. Bake 50 to 55 minutes at 350°. Cool.
11. Top with whipped cream if desired. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Southern Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients.
2. Add onion, egg and milk; mix well.
3. Drop by spoonfuls into deep fat.
4. Fry until golden brown.
5. Drain on paper.
6. Yield:
7. 8 servings.
title: Hush Puppies

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Place oil in a 10-inch black iron frypan; heat in oven 10 minutes.
3. Combine cornmeal, baking powder and baking soda in medium size mixing bowl.
4. Beat together the egg and buttermilk carefully.
5. Stir into dry ingredients; do not overmix.
6. Stir in hot oil.
7. Pour batter into hot frypan.
8. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, or until golden brown.
9. Remove from frypan to serving plate.
10. Cut in pie shaped wedges.
11. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Cornbread

steps: 1. Combine first 6 ingredients.
2. Beat well; add peanuts.
3. Pour into pie shell.
4. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then lower heat to 350° for approximately 30 minutes.
5. Serve at room temperature. Serves 8 to 10.
6. Top with Cool Whip and chopped peanuts.
title: Southern Peanut Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. In a large bowl, beat eggs with fork just until blended.
3. Stir in corn syrup, sugar, butter and salt. Sprinkle cranberries in pastry shell.
4. Arrange pecan halves on top of cranberries.
5. Pour syrup mixture carefully over pecans.
6. Bake for 50 to 55 minutes, or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge of pie comes out clean.
7. Cool on rack before serving.
8. If edge of pie seems to be browning too quickly, cover it with a strip of foil.
9. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Cranberry Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Grease an 8-inch round cast-iron skillet or a 9 x 12-inch baking dish.
3. Sift together first 4 dry ingredients and set aside.
4. Beat together eggs, sugar, buttermilk, melted butter and cornmeal in large bowl (in order).
5. Stir dry ingredients into buttermilk mixture.
6. Turn into prepared pan.
7. Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean.
8. Serve warm with chile or beans!
9. Makes 12 servings.
title: Buttermilk Cornbread

ingredients.text: 1 c. mashed cooked fresh sweet potatoes

steps: 1. Cream butter with brown sugar.
2. Beat in eggs, one at a time; blend in corn syrup, vanilla and mashed sweet potatoes.
3. Stir in pecans and turn into unbaked pie shell.
4. Bake in 400° oven for 10 minutes.
5. Reduce heat to 350° and bake 30 minutes longer, until filling is set and pastry browned.
6. Cool.
7. Serve with whipped cream, more pecans or ice cream.
8. Serves 8.
title: Sweet Potato Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Combine first 5 ingredients until smooth and spread in pie shell.
2. Sprinkle with pecans.
3. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over pecans in shell.
4. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes or until center is firm to touch.
5. Serves 8.
title: Cream Cheese Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. In medium bowl, stir together flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder and salt.
3. Stir in remaining ingredients just until moistened.
4. Pour into greased 9-inch baking pan.
5. Bake 20 to 25 minutes, or until pick comes out clean. Serves 6.
title: Honey Moist Cornbread

steps: 1. Combine sugar and eggs in a bowl and mix well.
2. Add Karo, chopped pecans and vanilla; mix well.
3. Pour into raw or frozen pie shell.
4. Bake for 1 hour at 300°.
5. Serves 6.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Grease 12 (2 1/2-inch) muffin cups. (These muffins brown better on the sides and bottom when baked without paper liners.)
3. In large bowl, combine flour, sugar and baking powder.
4. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
5. Stir in milk just until flour mixture is moistened. Spoon into muffin cups.
6. Bake 20 minutes or until golden.
7. Remove from pan.
8. Cool on wire rack. Serve with jelly, jam or honey. Makes 12 servings.
title: Southern Biscuit Muffins

steps: 1. Line uncooked pie shell with pecans.
2. Beat eggs and add sugars and salt.
3. Add corn syrup and vanilla.
4. Add melted margarine and pour over pecans.
5. Bake 45 to 50 minutes in a 350° oven.
6. Yields 6 servings.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Mix corn, eggs, sugar, butter, salt and pepper.
2. Put in a baking dish.
3. Pour milk over corn.
4. Place dish in a pan with an inch of water.
5. Bake at 325° about 45 minutes or until firm. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Southern Corn Pudding

steps: 1. Combine buttermilk, sugar, biscuit mix, eggs, butter, vanilla and nutmeg in blender container.
2. Cover and blend 3 minutes.
3. Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan.
4. Sprinkle with pecans.
5. Bake at 350° or 45 minutes.
6. Serve warm or cool.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Texas Buttermilk-Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Beat the eggs slightly.
2. Add the other ingredients and mix well.
3. Pour this into an unbaked pie shell.
4. Bake until firm. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Cream the butter and sugar.
2. Add eggs; mix well.
3. Add milk, sweet potatoes, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt.
4. Mix well. Pour into pie shell and bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
5. Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 35 to 40 minutes longer or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
6. Cool.
7. Store in refrigerator. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Sweet Potato Pie

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients; add buttermilk, oil, eggs and corn.
2. Mix and beat well.
3. Stir in jalapenos, green pepper and onion.
4. Grease a 9 x 14-inch baking dish with bacon drippings or margarine.
5. Heat dish.
6. Pour in 1/2 of batter, sprinkle with 1/2 of cheese.
7. Pour in remaining batter and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
8. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.
9. Serves 6.
title: Jalapeno Cornbread

steps: 1. Peel and slice onion.
2. Cook in butter until tender.
3. In a bowl, combine muffin mix, egg, milk and corn.
4. Turn this into a greased 8-inch square pan.
5. When onion is tender, add sour cream, salt and 1/2 cup cheese to it.
6. Spread this mixture over batter. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
7. Bake at 425° for 25 to 30 minutes.
8. Cut into squares and serve warm.
9. Makes about 6 to 8 servings.
title: Onion Cheese Cornbread

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Unwrap caramels and place in pot with water and margarine on low heat.
3. Stir occasionally until melted and smooth.
4. In a separate bowl, combine sugar, salt, vanilla and beaten eggs.
5. Gradually add caramel mixture, mixing well.
6. Stir in pecans.
7. Pour into pie shell and bake for 30 minutes.
8. Makes 8 servings.
title: Caramel Pecan Pie

ingredients.text: 3 tablespoons peanut oil (I always use peanut oil, which is excellent, but another type of oil may be used.)
1 tablespoon sugar (this is how I make the bread, making it not sweet, for a bit sweeter bread add an extra 1-2 tbsp)

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients until just mixed.
2. Pour into a sprayed (greased) microwavable ring pan or microwavable dish with a glass in the centre.
3. Place pan or dish on a upsidedown saucer in microwave.
4. Let stand 5 minutes in microwave.
5. Then, for a 1200watt microwave, cook on HIGH for 3 minutes until dry on top (when touched finger comes off clean).
6. NOTE: cooking time depends on the wattage of the microwave -in our old microwave, which was 500watts I microwaved on HIGH 6 minutes.
7. Serve right away for a fresh, warm cornbread.
8. Excellent plain, with garlic butter, or even peanut butter!
9. Serves 8 with 8 good sized wedges.
title: Quick Microwave Cornbread

steps: 1. Mix all dry ingredients.
2. Mix in another bowl the milk, egg and oil.
3. Add milk mixture to cornmeal mixture.
4. Mix well.
5. Pour into greased baking pan until half full.
6. Bake at 425° for 25 minutes or until lightly browned.
7. Yields 6 servings.
title: Yellow Cornbread

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed into a fine paste

steps: 1. Combine sweet potato paste with sugar, cinnamon, allspice and salt.
2. Add eggs.
3. Mix milk and butter; stir into potato mixture. Mixture will be fairly liquid.
4. Pour into unbaked pastry shell. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
5. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Spicy Sweet Potato Pie

steps: 1. Cut shrimp into 1/2-inch pieces.
2. Cook shrimp and onion in margarine over medium heat for 5 minutes or until opaque.
3. Cut French bread loaf in half lengthwise.
4. Reserve one half for another use.
5. Hollow the center of bread with fork to form a 1/2-inch thick shell.
6. Break any big pieces of scooped out bread into crumbs.
7. Place crumbs and shell on baking sheet.
8. Bake at 350° for 5 to 10 minutes.
9. Combine crumbs, shrimp mixture, cajun seasoning, salt and pepper.
10. Spoon mixture into the hollowed loaf. Sprinkle cheese over the top.
11. Bake at 350° for 3 to 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings.
title: Country Cajun Shrimp Bread

ingredients.text: 12 to 14 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled

steps: 1. Combine cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt.
2. Mix well. Add buttermilk, eggs and vegetable oil. Stir well.
3. Stir in cheese, corn, onion, bacon and pimento.
4. Pour into greased 9-inch square pan or 8-inch black iron skillet.
5. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until lightly browned.
6. Makes 8 or 9 servings.
title: Cowboy Cornbread

steps: 1. Sift dry ingredients together until well mixed. Cut in fat until well blended. Place in a glass jar. Keep tightly closed in a cool place. Mixture will keep for 1 to 6 months on the shelf in dry weather. In hot and humid weather, store in the refrigerator.

2. Cornmeal Muffins-Grease 8 medium-size muffin cups. Combine 2-1/4 cups Cornmeal Mix, 2/3 cup water and 1 beaten egg. Stir just enough to moisten dry ingredients. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 425 degrees F for about 20 minutes. Makes 8.
3. Cornmeal Biscuits-Add about 1/2 cup water to 2 cups Cornmeal Mix to make a soft dough. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto a greased baking sheet. Bake at 425 degrees F for 12 minutes. Makes 12 biscuits.

4. Cornbread-Combine 4 1/2 cups Cornmeal Mix, 2 beaten eggs and 1 1/3 cups water. Stir just enough to moisten dry ingredients. Pour into a greased pan, about 8 inches square. Bake at 425 degrees F for about 25 minutes. Serves 12.
5. Blueberry Cornbread-Add 1 cup fresh or partially-thawed frozen blueberries to Cornbread batter and mix gently. Bake as directed.
6. Cheese Cornbread-After turning Cornbread batter into pan, sprinkle with shredded Cheddar cheese and sesame seed. Bake as directed.
title: Cornmeal (Cornbread)  Mix

steps: 1. Scald milk over low heat; gradually stir in corn meal.
2. Cook to consistency of mush, stirring often.
3. Add butter, baking powder, salt, sugar and egg yolks which have been beaten until light.
4. Cool slightly.
5. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Fold into batter.
6. Turn into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake in a slow oven (325°) for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
7. Serve at once with plenty of butter or gravy.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Southern Spoon Bread

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Sift the flour, cornmeal, baking soda and salt into a mixing bowl.
3. Beat the eggs until foamy and stir them into the dry mixture.
4. Stir in the buttermilk and 1 cup of the milk.
5. Heat the butter in a 9 x 2-inch black skillet and when it is very hot, but not brown, pour in the batter.
6. Carefully pour the remaining 1 cup of milk on top of the batter, without stirring.
7. Place the skillet in the oven and bake 50 minutes or until set and baked through.
8. Slice into wedges.
9. Serves 8.
title: Southern Cornbread

steps: 1. In a double boiler, mix together the flour, 1 cup of sugar, and salt. Add water and stir until mixture forms a paste. In a separate bowl, lightly beat eggs and 3 cups of heavy cream. Stir into the paste. Allow mixture to simmer for 15-20 minutes, stirring constantly, until thickened. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla, stirring until butter has melted. Let cool.

2. Arrange vanilla wafers in a single layer on the bottom of a 9 x 13 x 2 inch casserole dish. Slice bananas and layer over vanilla wafers. Pour vanilla pudding mixture over bananas and vanilla wafers. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 6-8 hours.
3. Before serving, beat remaining heavy cream on high with an electric mixer. Slowly add remaining sugar. Continue to beat until still peaks form. Spread whipped cream over pudding.
4. Serves 8-10.
5. (Recipe adapted from "Margaret's Banana Pudding" from the Cotton Country Collection.)
title: Real Banana Pudding

steps: 1. In a mixing bowl, combine flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder and salt.
2. Add eggs, milk and oil.
3. Beat just until moistened.
4. Spoon into a greased 8-inch square baking dish.
5. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until bread tests done.
6. Yields 9 servings.
title: Cornbread Squares

steps: 1. In a large glass or ceramic bowl, stir all the ingredients together.
2. Store in an airtight container decorated with a pretty ribbon.
3. Attach this to the Jar: California Corn Bread Serves 4 to 6 1 package California Corn Bread Mix 2 eggs 1 cup milk 1/2 cup butter, melted Preheat the oven to 350°F.
4. Place the corn bread mix in a large mixing bowl and add the eggs, milk and butter.
5. Blend until the mixture is smooth.
6. Poor into a greased 8 inch baking pan and bake for 30 minutes.
title: California Cornbread-Gift In A Jar

steps: 1. Mix unsifted dry ingredients.
2. Add eggs, chopped onions and enough milk to make a stiff batter.
3. Drop by spoonfuls into hot grease.
4. Brown on both sides. Drain. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Hush Puppies

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell.
2. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
3. Makes 8 servings.
title: Southern Pecan Pie

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. very finely chopped jalapeno peppers (fresh or canned)

steps: 1. Put cornbread mix in large bowl.
2. Add milk and stir.
3. Add other ingredients in order given.
4. Bake in 3 greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pans at 400° for about 35 minutes or until done.
5. Yield: 12 to 16 servings.
title: Jalapeno Cornbread

ingredients.text: 1 c. buttermilk, mixed with 1 tsp. soda

steps: 1. Sift the corn meal, baking powder, salt and flour together. Add onion and egg, then add buttermilk mixture.
2. Shape into small balls and fry in deep fat until brown.
3. Serves 6.
title: Hush Puppies

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450°.
2. Combine first five ingredients thoroughly.
3. Fold in pecans.
4. Pour into
5. pie shell and bake at 450° for 8 minutes.
6. Reduce heat to 350°; bake 25 minutes longer. Yields 6 servings.
title: Southern Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Beat
2. eggs
3. and
4. sugar	together.
5. Add	syrup, vanilla, pecans, salt and butter.
6. Mix thoroughly.
7. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells.
8. Bake
9. for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 325°.
10. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.
2. Drop with a large spoon into hot oil in a deep fat fryer.
3. Cook until brown, turning with a long wooden spoon.
4. Great with fried catfish.
5. Yields 4 servings.
title: Cajun Hush Puppies

steps: 1. Slightly beat eggs.
2. Add sugar and vanilla and mix well.
3. Add butter and stir.
4. Add syrup and beat until thickens.
5. Stir in nuts.
6. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell.
7. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
8. Reduce heat to 300° and cook 35 minutes.
9. Serves 8.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Combine cornmeal, flour, salt and baking powder.
2. Combine beaten eggs and milk.
3. Stir into cornmeal mixture.
4. Mix well.
5. Put shortening into a 10-inch skillet and heat.
6. As soon as shortening is very hot, coat side of skillet with oil.
7. Add remaining shortening to cornbread mixture.
8. Spoon mixture into hot skillet and bake for about 20 minutes or until golden brown.
9. Yield:
10. 12 servings.
title: Skillet Cornbread

steps: 1. Beat eggs. Add sugar, syrup, salt and melted butter. Combine well and add pecans and vanilla. Pour into uncooked pie shell. Bake in oven at 350° until firm, about 45 minutes. Makes 6 servings.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. In large mixing bowl, combine first seven ingredients; mix well.
2. Add the pecans.
3. Pour 2 1/4 cups filling into each pie shell.
4. Bake at 300° for 40 to 50 minutes.
5. This makes 64 servings.
title: Pecan Pie For A Crowd

steps: 1. Cream
2. butter,	salt
3. and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs;
4. beat
5. well.	Mix all dry ingredients and gradually add
6. to mixture,

15. Serves 20.
title: Cheese Cornbread

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Mix together the butter, sugar, eggs, syrup and vanilla.
3. Add oats and blend.
4. Pour into crust and bake about 50 to 55 minutes, until knife comes out clean.
5. Serves 6 to 8.
title: No Pecan Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Beat eggs, sugar, molasses and oleo together.
2. Sift dry ingredients together and add to sugar mixture with 1 cup boiling water.
3. Beat well.
4. Pour into well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake in preheated 350° oven for
5. 35 minutes.
6. Serves 20.
title: Spicy Southern Gingerbread

steps: 1. Mix ingredients and shape into hush puppies or walnut size balls.
2. Fry until golden brown.
3. Serves 24.
title: Hush Puppies

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Grease an 8 or 9-inch square pan. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup.
3. Level off.
4. In large bowl, combine flour, cornmeal, raisins, baking powder, cinnamon, salt, nutmeg and peel.
5. Mix well. Add milk, syrup, margarine and eggs.
6. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened.
7. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 400° for 17 to 22 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.
8. Serve warm.
9. Yields 9 servings.
title: Maple And Spice Cornbread

steps: 1. Cook sweet potatoes; cool.
2. Slice potatoes 1/4-inch thick. Peel and slice apples.
3. In 1 1/2-quart casserole, alternately layer potatoes, apples and pineapple, ending with potatoes. Sprinkle each layer with some of sugar, allspice, butter and lemon juice.
4. Cover and bake for 1 hour or until apples are done. Serves 6.
title: Sweet Potato Casserole

steps: 1. Combine graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, 2 tablespoons of sugar and cinnamon in a bowl.
2. Mix well.
3. Pat into lightly greased 9-inch spring-form pan.
4. Beat cream cheese in mixer bowl.
5. Add 2 cups sugar and eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
6. Stir in vanilla.
7. Fold in sour cream.
8. Pour into prepared pan.
9. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
10. Turn off oven.
11. Let stand in cold oven for 1 hour.
12. Cool to room temperature.
13. Remove side of pan.
14. Chill, covered, in refrigerator for 24 hours before serving.
15. Yields 16 servings.
title: New York Cheesecake

steps: 1. Combine milk and onion in small mixing bowl.
2. Mix well and let stand 10 minutes.
3. Combine flour, baking powder, salt and pepper in large mixing bowl.
4. Add egg, cheese, butter and milk mixture. Stir only to moisten.
5. Spread batter evenly in a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until lightly browned.
6. Yields 15 servings.
title: Onion Cheese Bread

steps: 1. In saucepan, combine peaches, water and 1/2 cup sugar.
2. Bring to boil and stir.
3. Keep hot.
4. With spoon, beat egg, 1/2 cup sugar and shortening until fluffy.
5. Add milk; stir in flour, baking powder and salt.
6. Spread batter in a greased 8-inch square pan, then pour hot peaches over the batter.
7. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender.
8. Serve warm with cream, if desired. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Fresh Peach Cobbler

steps: 1. Cook sweet potatoes until tender.
2. Peel and cut into halves lengthwise.
3. Brown bacon lightly.
4. Add hot water to bacon and drippings.
5. Add potato halves.
6. Cover skillet and heat slowly until potatoes are thoroughly hot.
7. Remove potatoes to a hot dish. Add marmalade to liquid in skillet, heat to boiling and pour over sweet potatoes.
8. Serves 6.
title: Orange Sweet Potatoes

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450°. Combine graham crackers, butter, 2 tablespoons of sugar; blend well. Press into 9-inch spring-form pan. Beat cream cheese, sugar, beaten eggs, vanilla and cornstarch, just until blended; stir in sour cream. Pour into prepared crust. Bake 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 200° and bake for 45 minutes. Turn the oven off and allow cheesecake to cool with the oven door slightly open for 3 hours. Remove from pan. Serve with fruit of your choice or plain. Serves 12. Enjoy.
title: My Sister'S Cheesecake(Prep Time: 15 Minutes)

steps: 1. Cream butter, shortening and sugars.
2. Add vanilla and egg. Sift together salt, soda and flour.
3. Add to creamed mixture.
4. Add nuts and chocolate.
5. Bake at 325 degrees on parchment paper until light brown. Makes 24 servings.
title: White Chocolate - Macadamian Nut Cookies

steps: 1. Stir together dry ingredients with a whisk.
2. Beat the eggs slightly and combine with the milk, then add to the dry ingredients.
3. Stir in oil.
4. Heat the pan (nonstick), but do not grease it.
5. Pour batter into the pan by large spoonful.
6. Cook over medium heat, turning once when bubbles come to the surface and pop and the edges are slightly dry.
7. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Whole Wheat Pancakes

steps: 1. Blend first five ingredients, then stir in dried beef and sour cream.
2. Pour into shallow baking dish and sprinkle with nuts.
3. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
4. Serve hot with crackers.
5. Serves 8.
title: Hot Appetizer Pie

ingredients.text: 1/2 tsp. baking powder (add if not served immediately)

steps: 1. Peel potatoes.
2. Place in cold water until ready to grate.
3. Dry potatoes and grate.
4. Grate onion and add to potatoes.
5. Stir in well beaten eggs, hot milk, melted butter and salt.
6. Pour into well buttered 6 x 10-inch baking dish.
7. Sprinkle parsley over top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes until golden brown. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Potato Pudding

steps: 1. Toast bread, then make into crumbs.
2. Combine all ingredients thoroughly.
3. Line 16 loaf pans with foil.
4. Pieces can be long enough to fold over loaves for freezing, if desired.
5. Divide equally and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
6. Three strips of bacon may be placed over each loaf before baking, if desired.
7. Yield: 100 to 120 servings.
title: Never-Fail Meat Loaf

ingredients.text: 1 c. corn meal (preferably white, water ground)

steps: 1. Boil the corn meal and water together until thick. Add the butter and sugar and mix well. Beat the eggs and add to the milk. Stir into corn meal mix.
2. Bake at 400° for 35 minutes in pan of water. Serve hot.
3. Serves 6.
title: Easy Spoon Bread

steps: 1. Spread apples in greased 9-inch dish.
2. Mix oats, sugar, flour and cinnamon.
3. Cut in margarine.
4. Sprinkle evenly over apples. Bake at 350° for 35-45 minutes.
5. Serves 4-6.
title: Apple Oatmeal Crisp(Quick And Easy)

steps: 1. Combine sugar, flour and salt. Blend in butter or oleo.
2. Add beaten eggs, reserving 1 teaspoon egg white. Blend until smooth. Add sliced lemon, rind and sugar mixture.
3. Stir in water. Blend well. Turn into a pastry-lined pan.

4. Top with second crust which has been slit to allow escape of steam. Seal and flute edges. Brush with reserved egg white and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon mixture. Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes. Yields 6 servings.
title: Slice O' Lemon Pie

steps: 1. Prepare potatoes, celery, onion and carrots; boil in juice of peas until done.
2. When nearly done, add 1/2 teaspoon salt.
3. Melt margarine in saucepan.
4. Remove from stove; stir in flour.
5. Add cold milk all at once.
6. Return to stove; stir constantly until sauce boils and thickens.
7. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt to sauce.
8. Remove fluid from tuna in can; rinse with cold water.
9. Add fish to drained vegetables, adding peas last.
10. Put in greased casserole; cover with cream sauce.
11. Bake in a 425° oven for about 25 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
12. Serve over patty shells or with rolls.
title: California Chicken Pie

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350 °F (180 °C) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a stand mixer with the paddle attachment, cream the butter, white sugar and egg until combined, then add the molasses and vanilla and mix until smooth.
3. Once combined, add the baking soda water mixture and mix for another minute to combine.

4. Combine dry ingredients; mix baking powder, cinnamon, flour and salt in a separate bowl then add to the wet ingredients a little at a time, mixing on low until fully combined and scraping down the sides to ensure everything is incorporated. The dough should be easily shaped.
5. Portion dough with a small spoon, roll them into balls and place them on the lined cookie sheet, press them into flat discs using a floured glass or your moistened palm.
6. Place cookies on parchment-lined baking sheets and bake for 10-12 mins. Remove from the oven and let them cool for at least 10 minutes.
7. Once cooled the cookie sandwiches by spreading at least two teaspoons of your favourite jam between the two cookies. Repeat and enjoy with a cup of tea.
title: Jam jam cookies

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350ºF (180ºC).
2. In a large bowl, mix together the peanut butter, sugar, and egg.
3. Scoop out a spoonful of dough and roll it into a ball. Place the cookie balls onto a nonstick baking sheet.
4. For extra decoration and to make them cook more evenly, flatten the cookie balls by pressing a fork down on top of them, then press it down again at a 90º angle to make a criss-cross pattern.
5. Bake for 8-10 minutes or until the bottom of the cookies are golden brown.
6. Remove from baking sheet and cool.
7. Enjoy!
title: Peanut Butter Cookies

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to fan 170C/ conventional 190C/gas 5. Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface so it’s slightly thinner than straight from the pack. Then cut out 18-20 rounds with a 7.5cm fluted cutter, re-rolling the trimmings. Use the rounds to line two deep 12-hole tart tins (not muffin tins). If you only have a regular-sized, 12-hole tart tin you will be able to make a few more slightly shallower tarts.

2. Beat the eggs in a large bowl and combine with the rest of the ingredients except the walnuts. Tip this mixture into a pan and stir continuously for 3-4 minutes until the butter melts, and the mixture bubbles and starts to thicken. It should be thick enough to coat the back of a wooden spoon. Don’t overcook, and be sure to stir all the time as the mixture can easily burn. Remove from the heat and stir in the nuts.

3. Spoon the filling into the unbaked tart shells so it’s level with the pastry. Bake for 15-18 minutes until set and pale golden. Leave in the tin to cool for a few minutes before lifting out on to a wire rack. Serve warm or cold.
title: Canadian Butter Tarts

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Stir together the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt.
3. Add the remaining ingredients and combine until well blended.
4. Pour batter into a well-greased 8 x 8-inch pan.
5. Bake for 25 to 35 minutes, until firm in the center and golden on the edges.
6. Makes 6 servings.

steps: 1. Combine sugar and water.

steps: 1. Melt butter.
2. Add onion and green pepper; cook slowly for 2 minutes.
3. Add remaining ingredients; simmer for 10 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

steps: 1. On hard surface, with meat mallet, flatten each chicken breast.
2. In large frypan, place butter over medium high temperature.
3. Add chicken and saute about 4 minutes on each side or until lightly browned and fork can easily be inserted.
4. Remove chicken and keep warm.
5. In same frypan, add mushrooms and saute about 2 minutes.
6. Add cognac and carefully ignite by touching edge of pan with match flame.
7. (Always use caution when flaming!) Allow flame to completely die out after several minutes.
8. Add cream and cook over high heat until mixture reduces and thickens, coating back of spoon.
9. Stir in cayenne, tarragon, dash of salt and lemon juice.
10. Arrange chicken on a platter and pour sauce over to serve.
11. Serves 4.

steps: 1. Mix batter well.

4. Serves 12.

steps: 1. Whip cream cheese until fluffy.

steps: 1. Rinse chicken pieces; pat dry.
2. Remove skin if you wish.
3. Melt butter in a shallow baking pan; stir in remaining ingredients. Roll chicken in butter mixture to coat both sides, then arrange, meat side up, in a single layer in same pan.
4. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, or until chicken is tender and richly glazed.
5. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Honey-Glazed Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 navel oranges, peel and pith removed, cut into chunks

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a blender, and blend until smooth.

3. Serves 2. Per serving: 132 calories; 0 g saturated fat; 0 g unsaturated fat; 0 mg cholesterol; 34 g carbs; 2 mg sodium; 2 g protein; 3 g fiber. Suitable for any week of the Whole Living Action Plan 28-Day Challenge.
title: Orange Berry Smoothie

steps: 1. Place chicken in a greased 2-inch baking dish.
2. Combine mustard, brown sugar and ginger; stir well.
3. Brush half of glaze mixture evenly over chicken.
4. Cover and bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes or until chicken is done.
5. Uncover and baste with remaining glaze mixture.
6. Broil chicken 4 inches from heat 1 to 2 minutes or until brown.
7. Transfer chicken to a serving platter and sprinkle with parsley.
8. Makes 4 servings.

steps: 1. Fill the filter-lined basket of a large automatic percolator with the brown sugar, cloves, allspice and cinnamon sticks. Prepare as you would coffee according to directions, but substitute cider for water.
2. Yields 16 to 20 servings.

steps: 1. Mix sugar, flour and cocoa in a saucepan.
2. Add butter, peanut butter and milk; heat to boiling.
3. Serve warm over cake in dish. Serves 8.
title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Sauce

steps: 1. Mix well the dry ingredients (sugar and cocoa).
2. Pour milk in skillet and melt butter with milk; add vanilla and sugar and cocoa mixture, stirring together with milk and butter mixture.
3. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly, over low heat to prevent scorching until desired thickness.
4. Yield:
5. about 12 servings.
title: My Chocolate Gravy(By The "Just However Much" Recipe Of Linda (Mrs.  Neal) Clark)

ingredients.text: 1 medium apple, peeled, cored and thinly sliced

steps: 1. Combine nuts, cinnamon and 1/2 cup sugar; set aside.
2. In a large mixing bowl, cream butter; gradually add remaining sugar, beating until light and fluffy.
3. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
4. Blend in vanilla.
5. Combine dry ingredients; add to cream mixture alternately with sour cream, beating well after each addition.
6. Spread half of batter in a well-greased 10-inch tube pan with a removable bottom.
7. Top with apple slices; sprinkle with half of the nut mixture.
8. Top with remaining batter, then remaining nut mixture.
9. Bake at 375° for 40 minutes, until cake tests done.
10. Remove from oven; let stand for 30 minutes.
11. Loosen sides of cake.
12. Lift cake with removable bottom from pan; cool.
13. Before serving, carefully lift cake from pan. Yields 12 to 16 servings.
title: Apple Cream Coffee Cake

steps: 1. Blend cheese and margarine until smooth.
2. Add flour, onion, salt and pepper; stir until smooth.
3. Shape dough into a roll, 1 1/4 inches in diameter.
4. Wrap in plastic wrap or aluminum foil. Chill.
5. Cut into 1/4-inch slices.
6. Bake at 400° for 8 minutes. Yields 24 servings.
title: Diabetic - Cheese Appetizers

steps: 1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Add buttermilk, margarine and eggs. Beat at low speed with electric mixer until moistened. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes. Spoon batter into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Combine remainder of brown sugar, pecans and cinnamon. Sprinkle over batter. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Uncover next morning and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Serve warm.
2. Serves 12.
title: Overnight Coffee Cake

ingredients.text: 4 teaspoons beef bouillon (could use chicken or vegetable, I prefer the Better than Boullion line)

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine flour, salt and nutmeg; set aside. In a heavy large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Gradually stir in flour mixture, milk, bullion, and water until smooth. Cook and stir until smooth and slightly thickened, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.

2. In a medium bowl, stir half-and-half into egg yolks. Blend in about half of the hot sauce. Stir egg mixture into remaining sauce. Cook and stir over medium heat about 2 minutes; do not boil. Remove from heat. Stir in cheese until melted. Cool to room temperature.

3. Refrigerate sauce until cooled. Pour serving sizes into freezer containers with tight fitting lids. Leave 1-inch space at top of each container. Attach lids. Label with date and contents. Store in freezer. Use within 6 months.
4. Serving size recommend was 1 1/3 cup (meaning recipe makes 6 servings) but we have a small family and I use 1/2 to 2/3 size servings.
title: Freezer Cheese Sauce

steps: 1. Thinly slice 2 lemons.
2. In 1 1/2-quart pitcher, combine lemon slices and 1/2 cup sugar.
3. Press the fruit with potato masher or wooden spoon to release juice.
4. Cut and squeeze remaining lemons to get 2/3 cup lemon juice.

6. Taste, add more sugar, if desired.

4. Reduce heat and simmer about 15 minutes.

steps: 1. Put all ingredients into a saucepan and cook until thick.
2. Mix with regular mayonnaise about 1/2 and 1/2.
3. Serves 5 or 6.

steps: 1. Combine sugar, water and spices in a 4-cup glass measuring cup.
2. Microwave at High 8 to 10 minutes.
3. Let stand at room temperature at least 1 hour.
4. When ready to serve, strain the sugar-spice mixture into a 3-quart casserole or large mixing bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients.
5. Microwave at High 6 to 8 minutes, or until hot.
6. Pour into cups or mugs and serve immediately. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Wassail

ingredients.text: 3 large chicken breasts, boned, split and skinned

steps: 1. Sprinkle chicken breasts with 1/4 teaspoon of the salt (if desired).
2. Melt margarine in a large skillet.
3. Add chicken; brown both sides.
4. Remove from skillet.
5. Add flour, sugar, mustard, cinnamon, ginger and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt to drippings in pan.
6. Stir to a smooth paste.
7. Gradually add orange juice mixed with chicken broth; cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and comes to a boil.
8. Add chicken breasts.
9. Cover; simmer over low heat until chicken is tender, about 25 to 30 minutes.
10. If you wish, 3 cups of hot, cooked rice may be served with the chicken.
11. May be done ahead.
12. Reheats well.
13. Serves 4 to 6.

steps: 1. Cream margarine and sugar in bowl until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs and vanilla.
2. Add enough flour gradually to make soft dough.

12. 144 servings.

steps: 1. Shape beef into 7 patties (1/2-inch thick).

steps: 1. In small heatproof bowl, combine peanut butter and chocolate; place bowl in medium heatproof bowl and fill the medium bowl with boiling water.
2. Let stand, stirring frequently, until mixture is melted and well combined.
3. Set 8 fluted paper candy liners on serving platter; using a teaspoon, spoon 1/8 of chocolate mixture into each liner.
4. Cover platter with plastic wrap and refrigerate until candies are firm.
5. Makes 4 servings each.
title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups

steps: 1. In the top of a double boiler, stir together cocoa, sugar and salt.

3. Place over direct heat and boil for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
