steps: 1. Dice tomato, jalapeno and red onion.
2. Mix together with lime juice and cilantro.
3. Let set at room temperature for 4 hours. Serve!
4. Serves 4.
title: Pico De Gallo

steps: 1. Combine cheese; sprinkle half of it in 8-inch square pan, forming a bottom layer.
2. Combine eggs and salsa.
3. Pour over cheese; top with remaining cheese.
4. Bake 25 minutes at 350°, until golden and bubbly.
5. Serve hot with tortilla chips, or allow to cool; cut into squares and store in refrigerator.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Mexican Fiesta Treat

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Set aside. In 12-inch skillet, cook ground beef and onion over medium heat until meat is brown, stirring occasionally. Discard drippings. Add next 6 ingredients. Simmer 20 minutes, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until most of liquid is evaporated. Pour 1/2 cup taco sauce into casserole. Arrange half tortillas (thawed) to cover, overlapping if necessary. Pour 1/2 cup taco sauce evenly over tortillas. Spoon in beef mixture. Top with sour cream and sprinkle on half of the cheese. Arrange remaining tortillas, overlapping slightly on cheese. Spread remaining taco sauce over tortillas and sprinkle on rest of cheese. Cover with foil and bake 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake 5 more minutes. Serves 8 (about 515 calories per serving).
title: Enchilada Casserole

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Combine chicken, 1/2 cup of salsa and lime juice.
3. To remaining salsa, add beef broth and tomato paste. Stir until blended.
4. Pour half of sauce in an 8-inch square pan. Spoon 1/4 of chicken mix into center of tortilla.
5. Sprinkle 1 1/2 tablespoons of cheese over it.
6. Loosely roll tortillas and arrange, seam side down, over sauce in pan.
7. Spoon other sauce over enchiladas.
8. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and red onion. Bake 25 minutes.
9. Makes 4 servings.
10. Contains 50 calories.
title: Chicken And Cheese Enchiladas

steps: 1. Heat oven to 375°.
2. Grease rectangular pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch. Mix Bisquick and water until soft dough forms; beat 20 strokes. Pat in pan with floured hands, pressing 1/2 inch up sides.
3. Cook and stir ground beef until brown; drain.
4. Layer beef, tomatoes and green pepper on dough.
5. Mix remaining ingredients.
6. Spoon over top.
7. Sprinkle with paprika if desired.
8. Bake until edges are light brown, 25 to 30 minutes.
9. Makes 10 servings.
title: Mexican Casserole

ingredients.text: 3 pounds of pork butt, with plenty of fat

steps: 1. 1. Cut pork into strips (three inches by one inch), add to a large pot with the liquids and salt. Bring to a boil and then simmer uncovered on low for 2 hours. Do not touch the meat.

2. 2. After two hours, turn heat up to medium high, and continue to cook until all the liquid has evaporated and the pork fat has rendered (about 45 minutes). Stir a few times, to keep pork from sticking to bottom of pan.

3. 3. When pork has browned on both sides, it's ready (there will be liquid fat in the pan). Serve either cubed or shredded (pork will be tender enough that just touching it will cause it to fall apart).
4. Goes very well with a green salsas such as Ninfa's green sauce or this tomatillo salsa or this salsa verde with avocados and tomatillos.
5. Serves 4-6

7. Notes: The key to this recipe is that the meat has fat, so don't trim it! If there's not enough fat on the meat the recipe will turn out too dry. Whether to shred the meat like pulled pork or leave it in cubes I think is determined by what you're used to eating. Texas isn't a pulled-pork state so the texture isn't as familiar as nicely done chunks. Likewise, I think the brilliance of this recipe lies in its simplicity. You can add as many different spices, herbs and aromatics as you like-but if you have good-tasting, happy pork why not let its flavor shine with just a bit of salt? Ultimately, however, making carnitas is a highly personal affair and so make them as they best suit you!
title: Carnitas (From Homesick Texan)

steps: 1. Brown meat. Drain. Stir in 2 3/4 cups water, salsa and chili powder. Bring to a boil; stir in macaroni. Cover. Simmer 10 minutes or until water is almost absorbed. Add Velveeta; stir until melted. Top with crushed tortilla chips, chopped green onions and tomatoes. Makes 6 servings.
title: Taco Mac And Cheese

steps: 1. Mix dressing, picante sauce, garlic and chili powder in large bowl.
2. Add remaining ingredients.
3. Mix lightly.
4. Serve warm with flour tortillas.
5. Great with Spanish Rice and kidney beans. Serves 4 to 6 people.
title: Mexican Chicken(Low-Fat)

steps: 1. Melt butter in a skillet. Add onion and saute over low heat until a delicate brown. Add cucumbers and water.
2. Cook until water is absorbed and cucumbers browned.
3. Mix sour cream, egg yolk, sugar, vinegar, salt, pepper and paprika.
4. Add to cucumbers and cook slowly until mixture begins to boil.
5. Serves 4.
title: Mexican Dish

steps: 1. Pound steak with a tenderizing mallet.
2. Marinate 1 hour in soy sauce and water.
3. Grill until done and slice across the grain in very thin strips.
4. In a large skillet, lay down one tortilla and spread with half of the cheese, tomatoes, jalapenos and chopped cilantro.
5. Top with half of the steak and the other tortillas. Cook on stove top until bottom tortilla is toasted.
6. Flip quesadilla over and cook until other side is toasted and cheese is melted.
7. Remove from pan; cut into sixths and serve with salsa and sour cream.
8. Repeat for other quesadillas.
9. Serves 1 to 2.
title: Steak Quesadillas

ingredients.text: 2 jalapenos, remove stems and seeds, chop fine

steps: 1. In small skillet over medium heat, melt butter. Saute the onion in the butter for 10 minutes, uncovered. Add the chili powder, tomatoes, jalapenos and simmer, stirring frequently, until slightly thickened. Add the cheese, stirring constantly. Cook, stirring constantly, until the cheese melts. Add the sour cream and cook for 1 minute more. Serve with soft or crispy tortillas.
2. Yield: 2 to 3 Servings.
title: Don Pablo'S Copycat Chili Con Queso

ingredients.text: 2 whole skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into strips
1 medium onion, cut into thin wedges
1/2 medium sweet red pepper, cut into strips
1/2 medium yellow pepper, cut into strips
1/2 medium green pepper, cut into strips

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine lime juice, garlic, chili powder and cumin.
2. Add chicken; stir.
3. Marinate for 15 minutes.
4. In a nonstick skillet, cook onion, chicken and marinate for 3 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.
5. Add peppers; saute for 3 to 5 minutes or until crisp.
6. Stir in salsa.
7. Divide mixture among tortillas and top with cheese.
8. Roll up and serve.
9. Serve with sour cream.
10. Yield:
11. 6 servings.
title: Chicken Fajitas

ingredients.text: 1 medium white onion, chopped medium fine
1 jalapeno pepper, seeded then chopped fine
1 bunch fresh cilantro, top 1/3 rd chopped coarsely

steps: 1. In a good sized bowl, place tomatoes, onion and peppers and stir well, then add cilantro.
2. (Secret technique that actually produces a better taste) Place kosher salt in a mound in center of tomato mix, and dissolve with juice squeezed directly from the limes.
3. Mix well and serve directly, or chill (the flavor improves if chilled overnight).
title: Homer'S Traditional Pico De Gallo

steps: 1. Make a cheese sauce by whisking together 1 cup Pet milk and 1 cup chicken broth and 2 tablespoons flour.
2. Cook over medium heat until thickened.
3. Add 3 slices fat-free cheese (stir in on direction when melting fat-free cheese).
4. In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, put small amount of sauce.
5. Layer 1/2 tortillas, 1/2 chicken, onion and chilies.
6. Top with 1/2 remaining sauce. Repeat.
7. Top with Velveeta cheese.
8. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
title: Low-Fat Chicken Enchiladas

steps: 1. Peel and slice eggplant. Brush both sides of each slice with oil. Place in a single layer on a greased baking sheet and bake at 450 degrees for 20 minutes.

2. Combine tomato sauce, chiles, green onion, cumin and garlic salt in a sauce pan. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. In a greased 9 x 13 casserole, layer eggplant, sauce and cheese. Top with sour cream and olives. Bake at 350 degrees for an additional 20 minutes.
title: Mexican Eggplant

ingredients.text: 1 medium eggplant, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch slices

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine the oil, garlic powder and oregano; brush over both sides of eggplant. Grill, uncovered, over medium heat for 4 minutes on each side or until tender. Spoon a small amount of salsa into the center of each; sprinkle with cheese.
title: Eggplant Mexicano

steps: 1. In small cups, place 1 teaspoon of chocolate syrup.
2. Whip cream, 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, nutmeg and sugar.
3. Stir remaining cinnamon into strongly brewed coffee.
4. Pour coffee into cups.
5. Top with flavored whipped cream.
6. Enjoy!
title: Cafe Mexicano(Demitasse Cups)

steps: 1. Combine all the ingredients in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and set it out at room temperature for 3 hours.
2. Transfer to a serving bowl if using right away, or transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate if storing.
title: Homemade Mexican Crema

ingredients.text: 1 cup unsalted butter, softened (plus extra for greasing pan)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Grease 2 cookie sheets. Place the butter and superfine sugar in a bowl and beat until light and fluffy. Sift the flour, cornstarch, and cinnamon into a separate bowl, then gradually work dry ingredients into creamed mixture with a wooden spoon. When well mixed, knead until smooth.
2. Take 1 teaspoons at a time of the mixture and roll into a ball. place the balls on the prepared cookie sheets. Bake in a preheated oven for 30-40 minutes, or until pale golden.
3. Place the confectioners' sugar in a shallow dish and toss the pastelitos in it while they are still warm. Let cool on cooling racks.
title: Mexican Pastelitos

ingredients.text: 2 pounds tomatillos, husked and cut in half
4 cloves garlic, or more to taste
1 teaspoon salt, or more to taste

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
2. Combine tomatillos, green onions, jalapeno peppers, and garlic together in a baking dish.
3. Roast vegetables in the preheated oven until softened and fragrant, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and increase oven temperature to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C)

4. Pour roasted vegetables, cilantro, chicken stock, lime juice, and salt into a blender no more than half full. Cover and hold lid down; pulse a few times before leaving on to blend. Puree in batches until a smooth salsa consistency is reached.

5. Place 6 tortillas, overlapping, in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Cover tortillas with 1/2 the chicken. Top chicken with 1/2 the mozzarella cheese and pour 1/2 the salsa over the cheese. Repeat layering process with remaining tortillas, chicken, mozzarella cheese, and salsa. Sprinkle crumbled queso fresco over the top.
6. Bake in the preheated oven until bubbling, about 25 minutes.
title: Chicken Enchiladas Verdes

steps: 1. Toss tomatoes, white onion, and cilantro together in a large bowl. Pour lime juice over tomato mixture; mix to coat. Season with salt. Chill completely before serving.
title: Scott'S Pico De Gallo

steps: 1. Place the sugar, cocoa, salt, flour, cinnamon, and water in a large saucepan. Place the saucepan over low heat and stir until the mixture dissolves into the water.
2. After the mixture is dissolved, turn up the temperature of the stove to medium-high. Stir the mixture until it boils. Boils for 3-5 minutes, stirring all the time.
3. Add the milk. Continue to stir until the milk is hot, but not boiling.
4. Just before the milk boils, remove the saucepan from the heat. Stir in the vanilla extract, and serve!
title: Chocolate Mexicano

steps: 1. To a stock pot add one liter whole milk, 1 cup buttermilk and 2 tbs lemon juice. Bring to a pre-boil simmer and stir until curds begin to form.
2. Turn off the heat and cover for 15 minutes.
3. Strain curds over a cheese cloth. Combine the cheese cloth and gently squeeze the remaining whey (keep for last step).
4. To store, fully cover with the drained whey and refrigerate.
title: Homemade Queso Fresco In One Hour

ingredients.text: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, pounded to 1/2- to 1/3-inch thickness

steps: 1. Pour buttermilk into shallow dish. Combine cornmeal, chili powder, and salt in separate shallow dish. Place chicken in buttermilk and turn to coat. Place chicken in cornmeal mixture and turn to coat.

2. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add 2 chicken breasts; saute until cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer chicken to plate; tent with foil. Repeat with remaining oil and chicken.
3. Serve with Salsa Verde (or your favorite salsa) spooned on top of the chicken.
title: Mexican Pan Fried Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 cups diced canned tomatoes, well drained

steps: 1. Heat oil in a 2 quart saucepan.
2. Saute garlic and onion until softened, about 3-5 minutes.
3. Add chili powder and ground cumin and cook briefly.
4. Stir in tomatoes, corn meal and salt.
5. Cook and stir occasionally until mixture is thick and bubbling, about 10 minutes.
6. When thick stir in beans, corn, and 1/2 cup cheese.
7. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
8. While cornmeal cooks, slice tops from peppers.
9. Remove seeds and inner ribs.
10. Blanch peppers in boiling water for about 4 minutes.
11. Drain well.
12. Spoon cornmeal mixture into peppers.
13. Place peppers upright into baking pan.
14. Top thickly with remaining cheese.
15. Pour hot water about 1/2 inch deep around peppers.
16. Bake for 40 minutes or until peppers are tender.
title: Tamale Bell Peppers

steps: 1. Flour, salt and pepper chicken and fry in butter.
2. Remove chicken and add other ingredients.	Add chicken, 1 bay leaf, 1 1/2 cups chicken broth or stock and 1 cup tomatoes (drained).
3. Cover and simmer 1 hour.	Cook rice to make 3 cups.
4. Alternate layers of chicken and rice in buttered casserole after bones have been removed from chicken.
5. Sprinkle top with soft cheese and bake until well browned.
title: Mexicana Chicken

steps: 1. Cook meat slowly while adding onions and peppers until meat is brown.
2. Add tomato sauce and spices; heat.
3. Place a layer of tortillas in bottom of a large casserole dish, then a layer of meat, one of cheese, tortillas until casserole is full.
4. Cover with soup.
5. Top with cheese.
6. Bake at 400° until bubbly.
title: Enchilada Casserole

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese, for topping

steps: 1. Mix together Bisquick and milk and spread into a lightly greased square baking dish.
2. Combine the rest of the ingredients except for topping in a bowl, then spread on top of Bisquick crust.
3. Top with more cheese if you like and chips.
4. Bake covered for about 30 minutes at 375°F.
5. Broil for a few minutes for if you want the top cheese layer to be crunchy.
title: Chicken Taco Bake

steps: 1. Peel and chop tomatoes and onions.
2. Simmer until onions are tender.
3. Add all other ingredients and simmer a few more minutes. Put in hot sterilized jars and seal.
title: Mexican Hot---Mexican Hot

steps: 1. Cook chicken breasts in water or chicken stock until done. Drain liquid, reserving 1/4 cup.
2. Shred chicken and mix with cream cheese, heavy cream and red onion.
title: El Chorro Chicken And Cheese Enchiladas(Chicken Enchiladas)

steps: 1. Cream butter and sugar.
2. Add eggs, salt
3. and cream well.
4. Add flour and nuts.
5. Shape into balls.	Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350 degrees for 12-15 minutes.
6. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.
title: Mexican Wedding Balls

ingredients.text: 1 cup yellow onion, diced (preferably a sweet Vidalia)

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in bowl and serve.

2. Hints: Tastes great on eggs or rice or a taco or my new favorite, "Healthy Baked Corn Tortilla Chips, recipe #263512." Also find the much less expensive fresh cilantro next to the bunched parsley vs. the prepackaged cilantro in the plastic boxes in the ready made salad mix section of the supermarket.
3. Variations: Spice it up with a diced chipotle pepper or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder or use 1/2 cup fresh diced celery in place of the celery seed for more of a crunch.
title: California Pico De Gallo

steps: 1. Melt both cheeses together on low heat or use low heat of an electric fondue pot. After cheeses melt, add evaporated milk, stirring constantly. Add remaining ingredients. Stir to blend flavors.
2. Add more evaporated milk if mixture becomes too thick. Serve warm in electric skillet, fondue pot or chafing dish with tortilla chips.
title: Chile Con Queso

steps: 1. In large skillet, heat olive oil on high, saute all vegetables at once for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
2. Add basil, picante, salt and pepper.
3. Stir well.
4. Cover and cook 3 to 5 minutes.
5. Add cheese and mix well.
title: Mexican Zucchini

steps: 1. Cook bacon and set aside.
2. Fry fish and flake.
3. Add bacon, tomatoes and onions and saute until vegetables are softened.
4. Roll in warm tortillas.
title: Fish Tacos

ingredients.text: 3 1/2 lb. pork roast (butt or shoulder cut)

steps: 1. Place lard in a heavy, deep pot over medium-low heat. Trim fat from the meat and cut the meat into 3-inch cubes and lightly salt. (Meat may be cut into 1-inch cubes for use as an appetizer.)
2. When the lard has melted, place the meat, orange slices and cilantro in the pot.
3. (Melted lard should completely cover the meat.)

4. Cook over medium-low heat 1 1/2 to 2 hours or 1-inch cubes, 2 to 2 1/2 hours or 3-inch cubes. The lard will begin to boil after 30 minutes. The orange slices supply the water which allows the lard to boil.
5. Boil gently through the cooking process.
6. As the water gradually cooks away, the temperature of the lard will rise, allowing the meat to brown.
7. If the meat has not browned at the end of the cooking time, remove the orange slices. Watch carefully and remove the meat as soon as it browns.
title: Carnitas(Little Meats)

steps: 1. Combine ham and onions; place about 1/3 cup down the center of each tortilla. Top with 2 tablespoons cheese. Roll up and place seam side down in a greased 13-in. x 9-in. baking dish.
2. In a large bowl, whisk the flour, milk and eggs until smooth. Pour over tortillas. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.

3. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. Cover and bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Uncover; bake 10 minutes longer. Sprinkle with remaining cheese; bake for 3 minutes or until the cheese is melted. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.
title: Ham Enchiladas For Brunch

steps: 1. Finely grate rind from limes to measure 1 tablespoon; juice limes to measure 1/4 cup. Place rind and juice in a large bowl. Add tomato and remaining ingredients except tortillas; toss well to combine. Cover and chill for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
2. Heat tortillas according to package directions. Spoon about 1/2 cup shrimp mixture down center of each tortilla; fold in half. Serve immediately.
title: Seviche-Style Shrimp And Avocado Tacos

steps: 1. Preheat your oven to 300°F Trim the pork roast to remove most of the fat (leave some on); cut into 2"x2" cubes. Place into an oven safe saucepan or Dutch oven along with the onion, orange, lime juice, bay leaves, salt, pepper, cumin, oregano, and water. Place on the stove over medium-high heat and bring up to a full simmer, stirring occasionally. Place a lid on the saucepan and move it to the middle lower rack of your oven. Bake at 300F for 2 hours, or until pork is fork tender (if you poke it with a fork, it easily slides off the fork). Remove the pan from the oven and turn the oven to broil. Using a slotted spoon, move the pork into a bowl and strain the liquid, placing it back into the pan for a glaze. Reduce the liquid over medium-high heat until the liquid reduces to about one cup.

2. Using two forks, pull each chunk of pork into two pieces, placing them back into the bowl. Toss with the reduced glaze to coat all pieces evenly; season with salt and pepper to taste. Place a baking rack onto a rimmed cookie sheet or a baking pan with raised sides (to contain any liquids). Place pork chunks onto the baking rack so that the juices will drip onto the baking sheet, about 1" apart. Put the baking sheet back into the oven on the lower-middle rack and allow to broil for 5-8 minutes, or until the meat starts to crisp on the top. Remove from the oven, flip all pork pieces, and place back in the oven to broil for an additional 5-8 minutes on the second side, or until edges are crisp but not burned.

3. Remove the meat from the oven. Squeeze some fresh lime juice over the top and give it a sprinkle of salt. Serve with warm flour tortillas, guacamole, minced red onion, cilantro, salsa and sour cream. The result: pulled pork so tender it melts in your mouth, with crispy broiled edges that will make your heart sing. The addition of fresh lime juice and salt at the end really perks it up. Leftover pork (if there is any) would be awesome as a filling for enchiladas, tamales, or burritos.
title: Mexican Pulled Pork-Carnitas(Atk)

steps: 1. Heat vegetable oil in skillet.
2. Add beef, onions and garlic; cook until no longer pink. Drain.
3. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to low, cover and cook for one hour (I've been content with 15 minutes).
4. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese, if desired, and serve.
title: Chili Con Carne

steps: 1. Cut shrimp into bite sized pieces.
2. In a bowl toss together shrimp, avocado, red onion, salsa and cilantro.
3. Drizzle the lime juice over the mixture and toss well.
4. For more kick add a dash of Tabasco.
5. Chill.
6. Place on warm tortillas.
7. Serve with lime wedges, additional salsa and cilantro.
title: Easy Shrimp Tacos

steps: 1. For crust, mix potatoes, sour cream and water and pat into bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan.
2. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until edges start browning.
title: Taco Casserole

steps: 1. Cook sausage, crumbled, thoroughly.
2. Drain.
3. Add salsa. Place 2 tortillas
4. on
5. the
6. bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
7. Spread 3/4 cup salsa
8. and	sausage
9. on
10. tortillas.
11. Top with 1/2 cup cheese.
12. Put 2 more tortillas and continue layering , finishing with cheese. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.
13. Let stand 15 minutes and cut into squares.
14. Can garnish with dollop of sour cream.
title: Mexican Sausage Casserole

ingredients.text: 2 chicken breasts, fried and diced into small pieces

steps: 1. 1) Dice chicken breasts into cubes. Fry in lightly oiled frying pan until cooked through. Cut into small chunks. (This recipe is also a great way to use up leftover rotisserie chicken from the night before - just strip the remaining chicken and dice into bits).
2. 2) Boil rice, set aside.

3. 3) Assemble burritos. I layer the ingredients in the following order - first refried beans, then salsa, then rice, chicken, then cheese. However, any order will do. Fold the burrito - see pictures for how.

4. 4) Heat 1 tbsp oil in a frying pan. I like olive oil, but vegetable oil will also work. Heat between med-low and med temperature. There should be just enough oil to grease the bottom of the frying pan without pooling.
5. 5) Fry each burrito lightly on each side until golden brown. Add additional oil as needed. I find that I usually add a drizzle of oil after frying two burritos. Serve hot!
title: Ultimate Burritos (Easy)

steps: 1. Whisk eggs together in a bowl; stir in bacon.
2. Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add egg mixture; cook and stir until eggs are completely set, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in American cheese, salt, and pepper.
3. Wrap tortillas in damp paper towels; microwave until warmed through, 30 seconds to 1 minute.
4. Spoon 1/4 cup egg mixture into the center of each tortilla; fold sides to cover. Serve with salsa.
title: Bacon And Egg Tacos

ingredients.text: 1-1/2 cups shredded pepper Jack cheese, divided

steps: 1. Cook macaroni according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, melt butter. Stir in flour until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Reduce heat; stir in lime juice. Stir in 1-1/2 cups cheddar cheese and 1 cup pepper Jack cheese until melted.
2. Remove from the heat. Stir in the jalapeno, chili powder and salt. Drain macaroni; add to cheese sauce and toss to coat.
3. Transfer to a greased 8-in. square baking dish. Top with remaining cheeses; sprinkle with paprika. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 15-20 minutes or until cheese is melted.
title: Mexican Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. Warm the cinnamon and the milk in a saucepan - be sure not to boil the milk.
2. Carefully stir in the chocolate until it is melted.
3. Remove from heat.
4. Beat the mixture until it is foamy.
5. Serve and enjoy!
title: Mexican Chocolate (Chocolate De Molinillo)

steps: 1. Place the frozen chicken, taco seasoning and salsa in the crock pot.
2. Cook on low 8-10 hours.
3. Shred and serve on soft or hard shells. Great as a burrito also. Serve with your favorite toppings.
title: Crock Pot Chicken Tacos

steps: 1. Mix and drop on hot griddle.
2. Spread thin and cook until dry on top.
title: Soft Shell Tacos

ingredients.text: 1 green bell pepper, seeded and sliced into strips
1 red bell pepper, seeded and sliced into strips
1 yellow squash, halved and sliced into strips

steps: 1. Wrap tortillas in aluminum foil, and place in oven. Turn heat to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Bake for 15 minutes, or until thoroughly heated.

2. In a 10 inch skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Add onions, red and green peppers, and garlic; stir to coat with oil. Cover, reduce heat to medium, and cook for 5 minutes. Stir squash into vegetables. Stir in salsa, cumin, and salt. Cover, and cook for 5 minutes.
3. Spoon vegetable mixture evenly down the centers of warm tortillas, and sprinkle with cheese and cilantro. Roll up tortillas, and serve.
title: Colorful Vegetable Fajitas

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into strips
1 medium green bell pepper, sliced into strips

steps: 1. Place chicken strips, onion strips, and pepper strips into resealable plastic bag.
2. Whisk together lemon juice, vegetable oil, and chili powder.
3. Pour mixture into the bag and toss to coat.
4. Marinate mixture in refrigerator for at least 1 hour, but better if marinate over night or while at work.
5. Spray grill pan with cooking spray.
6. Heat pan on medium-high heat.
7. Place chicken and vegetables on pan reserving marinade.
8. Grill 5 minutes on each side or until chicken is no longer pink.
9. While grilling, occasionally brush with marinade.
10. Place chicken and vegetables in center of each tortilla and wrap tortilla.
11. Serve with sour cream and salsa.
title: Grilled Chicken Fajitas

steps: 1. Place chocolate chips, coffee and water in a 4-cup measuring bowl.
2. Heat for 3 minutes in a microwave.
3. Remove from oven and stir in remaining ingredients.
4. Heat for 4 minutes.
5. Enjoy.
title: Mexican Chocolate

steps: 1. Blend until slushy and strain(you don't have to strain).
2. Serve in tall glass with ice.
3. Garnish with strawberries.
title: Mexican Sunrise

steps: 1. Whisk together the lime juice, olive oil, garlic, ground cumin, chili powder, salt, and red pepper flakes in a bowl; pour into a large resealable plastic bag.
2. Put the chicken breasts into the bag, coat with the marinade, squeeze out excess air, and seal the bag.
3. Marinate in the refrigerator for 8 hours to overnight.
4. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
5. Remove the chicken from the marinade and shake off excess. Discard remaining marinade. Arrange chicken breasts in a baking dish.

6. Bake chicken breasts in preheated oven until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 35 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
7. Shred chicken breasts with two forks to desired texture.
title: Marinated Fajita Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 slice bacon, crisply cooked, drained and crumbled

steps: 1. Preheat grill to medium heat.
2. Spread tortillas with dressing and sprinkle with chili powder.
3. Layer half each of the turkey and bacon and 1/2 slice of cheese for each tortilla.
4. Fold over tortillas to cover filling.
5. Grill 2-3 minutes on each side or until quesadillas are golden brown on both sides and cheese is melted.
title: Grilled Turkey Club Quesadillas

ingredients.text: 1 to 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and minced

steps: 1. Stir together all ingredients; serve with tortilla chips.
title: Pico De Gallo

steps: 1. Rub chicken in combined seasonings.
2. Brown in shortening in skillet.
3. When nicely browned pour in Zippy Vegetable Sauce. Cover.
4. Simmer 35 to 45 minutes.
title: Chicken A La Mexican

steps: 1. Brown onions in a small amount of oil; set aside.
2. Cook ground beef until in chunky, crumbled pieces; pour off fat!!
3. In a crock-pot, add all remaining ingredients.
4. Mix well; cook 2 hours. Add more "hot," if desired.
5. Serve over grilled hot dogs.
6. Great for a casual gathering, football tailgate or summer picnic.
title: Bert'S Tex Mex Hot Dog Topping

ingredients.text: 1 lb round steak (sliced into thin strips)

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine lime juice, olive oil, orange juice, cumin, chili powder,liquid smoke, salt and oregano.
2. Mix up well and set aside.
3. Slice meat into thin strips and put in a gallon ziplock bag or covered bowl and add marinade ingredients and mix well.
4. Marinate in Refrigerator overnight, mixing once or twice while in refrigerator.
5. Slice bell peppers and onion.
6. In a heavy skillet add a little oil and cook steak on high heat until done then add vegetables and cook until slightly tender.
7. Serve with flour tortillas and Guacomole.
title: Sheri'S Steak Fajitas

ingredients.text: 1 fat free tortilla (my favorite brand is LaFe)
1/2 cup refried beans (my favorite is Rosarita)

steps: 1. assemble refried beans, cheese and salsa on the tortilla.
2. wrap into a burrito and microwave it on high for 40 seconds or until it is fully heated.
3. Serve with a salad if you wish.
title: Fat Free Bean And Cheese Burrito

ingredients.text: 8 ounces sliced mushrooms, combination of shiitake and crimini and oyster

steps: 1. Saute the mushrooms, red bell pepper and green bell pepper in the olive oil in a skillet for 4 to 5 minutes.
2. Add the garlic and green onions. Saute for 2 minutes.
3. Remove from the heat. Stir in the goat cheese.
4. Spread 3 heaping tablespoons of the mushroom, bell pepper and goat cheese mixture over 4 tortillas. Top with the remaining tortillas.
5. Grill on a flat griddle or in a large skillet on both sides until golden brown.
6. Cut each quesadilla into 6 wedges.
title: Wild Mushroom And Goat Cheese Quesadillas

steps: 1. Place all in a shaker with ice and shake well.
2. Dip rim into cranberry juice then sugar.
3. Pour into the glass and garnish with an lime slice.
title: Mexican Cosmo

ingredients.text: 1 pound medium shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, toss shrimp with chili powder, cumin, and pepper. In a small bowl, stir together sour cream and 1 tablespoon lime juice. Heat olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat; saute shrimp 3 minutes, turning once, or until done. Remove from heat; toss with 1 tablespoon lime juice. Fill warmed corn tortillas with shredded lettuce, shrimp mixture and diced red onion; drizzle tacos with lime crema.
title: Shrimp Tacos With Lime Crema

steps: 1. Cook and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.
2. To burrito shell, fill meat, Monterey Jack cheese, beans, sour cream, black olives and salsa and roll.
title: Burritos

ingredients.text: 1 chicken, cooked and cut into serving size pieces

steps: 1. Cook sauce to a gravy consistency, stirring constantly.
2. Add chicken to sauce and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes.
3. Serve with beans or rice.
title: Mole

ingredients.text: 10 oz. can cream of chicken soup (light)

steps: 1. Combine ingredients and pour over tortillas.
2. Top with 1 to 2 tablespoons chopped jalapeno peppers, chopped tomatoes and 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar cheese.
3. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
title: Chicken Enchiladas

steps: 1. Cook meat in skillet with spices until brown (done); get tomato juice hot.
2. Dip tortillas in hot tomato juice.
3. Put hot tortilla in pan you are going to cook them in; place 1 tablespoon meat and 1/2 diced cheese on tortilla and roll up.
4. Continue until you have all 12 tortillas rolled up side by side.
5. Pour remaining tomato juice on top and bake until cheese is melted.
6. Cook in 9 x 13-inch pan. Serve with chopped onion.
title: Enchiladas(Low-Fat)

steps: 1. Brown the meat, garlic and onion in a 400° oven for 3/4 hour, or until well browned.
2. Stir frequently.
3. Add flour; blend well. Add remaining ingredients; stir well.
4. Cover; lower heat to 350° and cook for 1 1/2 hours.
title: Texas Chili Con Carne

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup grated cheese, such as monterey jack or cheddar

steps: 1. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Place the tortilla in the pan and cook for about 1 minute, until it begins to bubble.
2. Flip the tortilla over and sprinkle cheese all over the top.
3. Once the cheese begins to melt, top half of the tortilla with mushrooms, and fold in half.
4. Cook for 2 minutes on each side, until the cheese is melted and everything is hot.
5. Remove the quesadilla from the heat, open, and add your choice of stuffings.
title: Mushroom Quesadillas

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients.
2. Chill at least one hour.
3. Serve with grilled meats, tortillas, or chips.
title: Pico De Gallo

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a baking dish. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt; set aside.

2. Beat butter and sugar until creamy. Beat in eggs one at a time, then add mashed banana, canola oil, and vanilla. Fold in flour and 1 cup of chocolate chips. Place a dollop of batter into each tortilla, then roll up in a cylinder to form an "enchilada"; place into prepared baking dish.

3. Bake "enchiladas" in preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, 30 to 45 minutes. Melt the remaining 1/2 cup of chocolate chips in a small bowl using the microwave. Drizzle over the "enchiladas" as soon as they come out of the oven.
title: Chocolate-Banana Enchiladas

steps: 1. Brown chicken in 4 tablespoons margarine.
2. Take chicken out. Add pepper and onion to skillet.
3. Add rice, broth, salt and chili powder.
4. Bring to a boil and add 1 cup tomatoes.
5. Place chicken on top and simmer for 30 minutes.
title: Mexican Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb flank steak, cut in thin strips
1 cup thinly sliced red onion, divided
1 cup thinly sliced green bell pepper

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine steak, chili powder, coriander and oregano.
2. In another bowl, combine mango, tomato, 1/4 cup of the red onion, 1 tablespoon of the lime juice, cilantro and 1/4 teaspoon of the salt.
3. Set the salsa aside.
4. Heat oil in a large nonstick pan set over medium high heat.

5. Add steak, remaining onion, remaining salt, green pepper, cayenne and worcestershire sauce and cook, stirring frequently, for 6 to 7 minutes, or until vegetables are softened and meat is cooked to desired degree of doneness.
6. Remove from heat and stir in remaining lime juice.
7. Heat the tortillas according to package directions.
8. Working with one at a time, place a tortilla on the work surface and spoon 1/4 of the meat mixture in a strip down the center.
9. Spoon 1/4 of the salsa over the meat, then roll up the tortilla by folding the bottom flap up over the filling and then rolling the sides in to form a tube shape with an opening at one end.
title: Tropical Beef Fajitas

ingredients.text: 8 ounces shredded cheddar cheese (or Mexican blend)

steps: 1. Reserve half of the shredded cheese.
2. Mix all remaining ingredients together and pour into a 9 X 13-in. casserole dish.
3. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes.
4. Sprinkle reserved cheese over the top and bake for an additional 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted.
title: Low Carb Chicken Enchilada Casserole

ingredients.text: 4 (5 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
2 small plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
2. Bring a medium saucepan lightly salted water to a boil; add chicken breasts and reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and gently simmer until chicken is no longer pink in the center, 15 minutes. Drain.
3. Let chicken cool until it can be easily handled. Shred chicken with your hands; return to empty sauce pan. Stir barbeque sauce, parsley, and garlic into chicken.

4. Lay 4 tortillas on a baking sheet. Evening spread chicken mixture among the 4 tortillas, leaving a 1-inch border around the outer edge. Top each tortilla with 1/4 tomatoes and 1/4 Cheddar cheese. Place another tortilla atop each filled tortilla.
5. Bake quesadillas in the preheated oven until cheese is melted, 5 to 7 minutes. Cut into wedges to serve.
title: Barbecued Chicken Quesadillas

steps: 1. Put cheese, onion and olives in separate dishes.
2. Brown meat, drain and set aside.
title: Enchilada Supreme

steps: 1. Brown beef.
2. Combine nacho cheese soup and cream of chicken soup in a saucepan.
3. Heat.
4. Heat a small amount of oil in a fry pan.
5. Dip tortillas in oil to soften.
6. Drain on paper towel. Spoon beef on each tortilla; add a teaspoon of onion and sprinkle with sharp cheese.
7. Roll up and place in a casserole dish, seam side down.
8. Repeat for each tortilla.
9. Add green chilies to soups and pour over tortillas.
10. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
title: Mexican Enchiladas

ingredients.text: 2 to 2 1/4 lb. chicken, cut in 3/4-inch pieces

steps: 1. Heat skillet or wok for 3 to 4 minutes.
2. Add wine, boil for 1 to 2 minutes.
3. Reduce to medium heat.
4. Add butter and melt.
5. Stir in soy sauce, garlic powder and pepper.
6. Cook until combined, about 1 minute.
7. Remove from heat and pour into bowl for later use.
8. Dip chicken pieces into sauce.
9. Place chicken into pan or wok (with a little sauce to keep moist) and cook for 3 to 5 minutes.
10. Add onions at this time and cook to likeness.
11. Stuff tortillas and wrap.
12. Serve with sour cream, olives, salsa, lettuce, cheese and guacamole.
title: Chicken Fajitas

steps: 1. In a hot skillet scramble fry the onion, minced beef and garlic - breaking up all lumps.

2. Reduce the heat to 50% and add the vegetables, make sure they are chopped rather small (mexi-beans or kidney beans can be added if you so wish to this stage) and taco seasoning, fry for another 2-4 of minutes (until the taco seasoning become fragrant).
3. Pour meat mixture into a greased 20x20 inch ceramic/pyrex casserole dish with high sides.
4. In a large bowl, whisk the salsa, sour cream and creamed cheese (which has been well softened) and pour over the meat.
5. Place tater tots over creamy mixture in a single layer all over (my son loves this job). Top with cheese (he likes this job too).
6. Bake at 375oF (180oC) for 30 minutes.
7. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.
title: Oh So Creamy, Oh So Cheesy Taco Tot Casserole

ingredients.text: 1/2 fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, combine tomato, onion, jalapeno pepper (to taste,) cilantro and green onion. Season with garlic powder, salt and pepper. Stir until evenly distributed. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
title: Pico De Gallo

steps: 1. Put all ingredients into blender and puree.
2. May substitute mint chocolate chips for plain chocolate chips.
title: Mexican Chocolate

steps: 1. Brown hamburg and onion.
2. Drain.
3. Stir in kidney beans with liquid, tomato sauce, chili powder and garlic salt.
4. Heat to boiling.
5. Pour 1/2 of mixture in greased casserole, top with chips.
6. Put remaining mixture over layer, add cheese over top. Cover and cook at 350 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes.
title: Beef-Taco Casserole

steps: 1. Dice all of the ingredients and combine in a large bowl or container.
2. Chill.
3. Serve with tortilla chips.
title: Pico De Gallo

steps: 1. If the roast has skin or bone, leave them on. Rinse the roast and place in a large pot. Add enough water to barely cover.
2. Chop the onion into large pieces (about 8) and add to the pot. Add the salt.
3. Bring the water to a boil, then cover and simmer until the roast is tender, but not quite falling apart, about 2 hours.
4. Remove the roast and drain, discarding the onion. Remove any skin or bones. Cut or separate into large cubes of about 4 inches.
5. Put the lard in a heavy pot, melt and raise to a medium-high temperature. Test the temperature by dropping in a slice of bacon. It should boil immediately and take about 2 minutes to cook.
6. Cook all of the bacon in the lard, remove it and set it aside for another use. (This step is to flavor the lard).

7. Add the pork cubes a few at a time to the lard. Cook until they are starting to get crispy on the outside. I prefer to remove them when they are roughly halfway between totally crispy and not crispy at all, but that's a matter of personal preference.
8. Drain the pork, and salt if desired.
9. Use the carnitas for tacos, burritos or by itself with sides of rice and beans.
10. The lard can be cooled and reused. Store it in the refrigerator and smell before reusing. If stored too long, even in the refrigerator, it will go rancid.
title: Carnitas Michoacan

ingredients.text: 4 oz. (1 c.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
4 oz. can diced green chilies, drained
1/2 medium green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch strips

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Generously grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
3. Warm tortillas as directed on package.
4. Arrange in bottom of greased pan, overlapping edge of tortilla.
title: Mexican Egg Bake

ingredients.text: 1 lb. ground beef, cooked and drained

steps: 1. Mix baking mix, milk and eggs in greased baking dish (11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch) with fork until uniform color (batter will be lumpy).
title: One Pan Mexican Style Beef Bake

ingredients.text: 2 cups long grain brown rice, cooked

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Place chicen on foil-covered baking sheet. Top with salsa. Bake 20 min, topping with chips and cheese the last 5 min.
2. Meanwhile, cook bacon, drain on paper towels. Cook onion for 5 min. Stir in tomatoes, cook for 4 - 5 min, or until tomatoes begin to pop. Add rice. Cook until heated thru. Stir in bacon.
3. Top chicken with sour cream. Serve with rice mixture
title: Chicken Nacho Bake

steps: 1. Cook sausage and onion, bell pepper and tomatoes until done; drain.
2. Add salt and chili powder.
3. Cook spaghetti until tender; drain.
4. Add to sausage mixture; then add milk and sour cream. Pour all into baking dish.
5. Spread grated cheese on top.
6. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.
title: Mexican Casserole

steps: 1. Heat Velveeta cheese, milk and picante sauce over low heat; stir until sauce is smooth.
2. Serve with tortilla chips, corn chips or fresh vegetables.
title: Picante Con Queso

steps: 1. Beat together.
2. Pour onto a hot griddle, and spread out with a fork, making each the size of a pancake.
3. Fry until golden brown.
4. Fill with your taco meat, etc.
title: Taco Batter

ingredients.text: 1 sweet red pepper, cored, seeded and thinly sliced
1 large leek, rinsed well and thinly sliced
1 fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped

steps: 1. Combine sweet pepper, leek, jalapeno, garlic, oil, chili powder, cumin and salt in microwave-safe 1-quart dish or 9-inch pie plate.
2. Cover with waxed paper.
3. Microwave on High for 6 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
title: Vegetable Quesadillas

steps: 1. Blend sugar and milk.
2. Let come to boil.
3. Add butter.
4. Cook 5 minutes.
5. Do not stir.
6. Remove from fire.
7. Beat thoroughly.
8. Add nuts, vanilla and drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper.
9. If mixture hardens, set pan in hot water.
title: Mexican Kisses

steps: 1. Add onion, garlic and rice to hot oil in heavy saucepan.
2. Fry about 3 minutes or until golden brown, stirring occasionally. Stir in a mixture of chili powder and salt.
3. Add water; stir. Cover tightly.
4. Bring to boiling and simmer until rice is tender, about 25 minutes.
5. Makes about 8 servings.
title: Mexican Rice

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp.
2. Remove from drippings, drain, crumble and set aside.
3. Add vegetables and chili powder to drippings. Stir, cover and cook over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes or until corn is tender.
4. (Stir occasionally to keep from sticking.)
5. Add salt and pepper; mix well.
6. Pour into serving dish; sprinkle with crumbled bacon.
7. Serve hot.
8. Yield:
9. 6 servings.
title: Mexican Skillet Corn

steps: 1. Steam green beans until tender-crisp, about 15 minutes. Drain.
2. Whisk together other ingredients and pour over warm green beans.
3. Allow to marinate at least 1/2 hour.
4. Serve at room temperature or chilled.
5. Yield: 4 servings.
6. Carbohydrate 12 g, protein 3 g, fat 28 g, calories 292.
title: Mexican Salad

steps: 1. Cook cauliflower florets; drain and set aside.
2. Combine sauce ingredients in large saucepan and cook over medium heat until bubbly, stirring constantly.
3. Add cooked cauliflower and corn. Toss well and serve.
4. Serves 6.
title: Zesty Mexican Cauliflower

steps: 1. Peel and slice cucumbers very thinly. Oscar Wilde-style thin, people.
2. Add taco mix and lemon juice.
3. Mix. Chill. Enjoy.
title: Taco-Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. In a saucepan over medium heat, bring water, salsa and bouillon to a boil. Stir in rice; remove from the heat. Cover and salt stand 6-8 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Fluff with a fork.
title: Mexican Rice

steps: 1. Rinse the chickens and pat dry with paper towels.

2. Place the chickens, carrots, onion, and salt in a 12-quart pot. Add enough cold water (about 16 cups) to cover. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer gently, uncovered, for 1 hour. Skim off any foam that appears. Transfer the chickens to plates; let cool. Remove and discard the carrots and onion. Add the rice to the broth and simmer for 20 minutes.

3. Meanwhile, shred the chicken meat, discarding the skin and bones. Add the meat and pepper to the broth and heat for 3 minutes. Scoop the avocados into individual bowls and ladle the soup over the top. Sprinkle with the cilantro and squeeze on the limes.
4. 12-quart pot
5. Omit the avocados, cilantro, and limes. Let the soup cool, then ladle into large resealable bags, filling each one halfway. Store for up to 3 months.

6. Thaw overnight in the refrigerator or thaw partially in the microwave. Warm in a covered saucepan over medium-low heat for 20 minutes. Scoop the avocado into bowls, ladle in the soup, and garnish with the cilantro. Serve with the lime wedges on the side.
title: Mexican Chicken Soup

steps: 1. Brown stew meat in oil in a large pot. Cover meat with water and boil until tender. Add potatoes, onions, cumin, garlic salt, pepper and enough water to cover potatoes and onions. Cook until potatoes are done. Add stewed tomatoes. Let cook until thick like a stew.
title: Mexican Meat And Potatoes

steps: 1. Soak beans overnight. Mix water, beans and onion in a 4-quart Dutch oven. Cover and heat to boiling; boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand 1 hour. Add just enough water to cover beans. Stir in remaining ingredients.
2. Heat to boiling.
3. Reduce heat, cover and boil gently, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender, about 2 hours. Add water during cooking if necessary. Drain.
4. Reserve broth for recipes calling for bean broth. Cover and refrigerate beans and broth separately.
5. Use within 10 days. Yields 6 cups, 12 (1/2 cup) servings; 2 cups broth.
title: Mexican Low-Fat Pinto Beans

steps: 1. Sort the beans to make sure there are no small rocks, screws, etc. in them. And yes, I have personally found these things in dried beans before. Sort or hope you have good dental coverage.
2. Put the beans, all the spices, and the olive oil in a large pot. Mix well.
3. Add the chicken broth and water, and stir to mix well.

4. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat to a simmer. Cook beans, uncovered, for 3 to 4 hours until done to your liking (It usually only takes me 3 hours, and sometimes less than 3 if I have it at a fast simmer. After 2 hours, take out a bean every 30 minutes or so and eat it to check if it is done enough for you).
title: Pinto Beans For Burritos

steps: 1. Melt margarine in large skillet.
2. Add rice and onion and brown lightly.
3. Add remaining ingredients.
4. Mix and bring to boil.
5. Cover and put on low heat, stirring occasionally until liquid is absorbed.
title: Mexican Rice

ingredients.text: 1/2 medium green pepper, cut in thin slices

steps: 1. Season beef strips with salt.
2. Add cherry tomatoes, avocado, green pepper and onion.
3. Mix
4. chili sauce, oil, chili powder, hot pepper sauce and garlic.
5. Add meat and vegetables and toss.
6. Serve individual portions on bed of lettuce.
7. Serve corn chips and grated cheese to sprinkle on top.
8. Makes four to five servings.
title: Taco Beef Salad

ingredients.text: 1 yellow onion, cut into 1 inch chunks
1 bell pepper, any color cut into 1 inch pieces
3 garlic cloves, minced or 3 teaspoons garlic powder

steps: 1. Add the oil to the pan and put heat on to medium high. Add the rice and saute until golden brown approximately 10 - 15 minutes.
2. Add the onion and bell pepper and saute another 5 - 10 minutes.
3. The important thing is to make sure the rice is toasted to a nice golden brown.
4. Using a garlic press, add the minced fresh garlic by squeezing the press and cutting off
5. the garlic as it comes out, with a knife.
6. Continue to saute for an additional 3 minutes. You will notice a wonderful garlic aroma.
7. Add the tomato puree, chicken broth and salt. Stir and turn heat up to high. Bring to a full boil while stirring. Continue to boil for 2 minutes.
8. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
9. When it's done, turn off the heat, remove the lid and stir in the peas.
10. wait 5 minutes before serving.
title: Mexican Rice

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Spray a 9x13" pan with nonstick cooking spray, set aside.
3. In a large nonstick pan, heat the oil, add the beef, bell peppers and scallions. Cook, stirring as needed, until the beef is browned and the vegetables are softened, 6-8 minutes.
4. Add tomatoes, spices and salt, cook, stirring as needed until the flavors are blended, about five minutes.

5. Arrange alternate layers of the potatoes and beef mixture in the baking dish. Cover with foil and bake 40 minutes, uncover and sprinkle evenly with the cheese. Bake until the potatoes are cooked through and the cheese is melted, about 10 minutes longer.
title: Mexican Potato Casserole (Weight Watchers)

ingredients.text: 2 medium acorn squash, halved and seeded
1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed
1/2 cup shredded monterey jack cheese (may sub Vegan cheese for a great Vegan meal)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Coat a rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray.
2. Brush cut sides and cavity of squash with oil. Sprinkle with 1/4 tsp of the pepper. Place cut side down on prepared baking sheet.
3. Bake 30-40 minutes until tender (don't pierce it with a fork though). Turn cut side up.
4. Mix beans, nuts, tomatoes, scallions, cumin and remaining 1/4 tsp pepper in a medum bowl.
5. Spoon a heaping 1/2 cup of bean mixture into each squash half, pressing down gently to get all the filling inches Sprinkle with cheese.
6. Bake 10-15 minutes, until cheese is melted and golden.
title: Tex-Mex Stuffed Acorn Squash

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut into small cubes

steps: 1. In a large (2 gallon) stockpot over medium heat, combine oil, chicken base, diced onion, cumin, chili powder, garlic and cayenne pepper. Saute, stirring occasionally, until onions are tender. Place masa harina in a large saucepan over low-medium heat. Gradually add 1 quart of water, stirring constantly, to blend and remove lumps. Add masa harina mixture to onions and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer mixture 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly to eliminate the raw taste of the masa. Add remaining water to stockpot. Add tomatoes and allow mixture to return to a boil. Reduce heat to low and add cheese. Continue to simmer, stirring occasionally, until cheese melts. Remove from heat and add chicken. Ladle into serving bowls.
title: Chicken Enchilada Soup

steps: 1. In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil and saute onions and garlic.
2. Add the chicken bouillon to the pan and crush the cubes.
3. Add 1 tablespoon oil and the rice and fry the rice until the rice turns slightly brown.
4. Add the salt, water and tomato paste and mix well.
5. Cover the pan and simmer 25 minutes.
6. Mix rice thoroughly and serve.
7. ENJOY!
title: Super Easy Mexican Rice

steps: 1. Heat shortening in heavy skillet over medium heat.
2. Add onion and rice and cook until onion is tender.
3. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until done.
title: Mexican Rice

ingredients.text: 2 whole Roma Tomatoes, Diced And Drained On Paper Towels
2 cups Chicken Stock, Preferably Home Made

steps: 1. In a skillet, add oil and put pan on medium heat. Add onion and saute for 3 minutes. Add garlic and saute for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add rice and stir and saute for 1 minute. Add carrots, tomatoes and chicken stock and bring to a boil. Cover with lid tightly. Turn stove down to low. Cook on very low heat for 20 minutes. Next, add peas, corn and cilantro. Salt and pepper to taste. Fluff with fork and let sit off heat for 5 minutes. Fluff with fork again. Let sit up to 10-15 minutes and serve.
2. This is a delicious and easy dish.
3. When I chop the tomatoes in the winter months, I add a sprinkle of salt while they are draining.
title: Mexican Rice

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
2. Place potatoes in a bowl; drizzle 1 tablespoon oil on top, add garlic powder, and mix to coat. Lay out potatoes on a baking sheet.
3. Bake in the preheated oven until tender, about 30 minutes.
4. Heat the remaining oil in a skillet over medium-low heat. Add red bell pepper, onion, corn, jalapeno, salt, and black pepper; cook and stir until vegetables are slightly soft, about 10 minutes.

5. Heat a griddle over medium heat. Cook tortillas, flipping halfway, until evenly warmed, 2 to 3 minutes. Divide tortillas among serving plates; fill with the baked potatoes and sauteed corn mixture. Top tacos with green onions and cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.
title: Vegan Potato Tacos

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Cut top off tomatoes; scoop out pulp. Drain tomatoes upside-down on paper towels 10 minutes.
3. Heat oil and saute onion, garlic and peppers for 5 to 10 minutes.
4. Add corn, chicken, seasonings and sour cream.
5. Heat through.
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
7. Spoon filling into tomatoes and sprinkle the tops with cheese.
8. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.
9. Serve at once.
title: Mexican Corn And Chicken Tomatoes

steps: 1. Shuck the corn and preheat your grill on high.
2. Combine all ingredients (everything except the corn and Parmesan) in a bowl.

3. Grill the corn over high heat until cooked through and slightly charred on all sides, about 10 minutes total. When corn is finished, remove it from the grill and baste with the creamy mixture. Sprinkle Parmesan over corn. For extra kick, lightly sprinkle with even more chili powder! Serve!
title: Grilled Mexican Street Corn

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb green chili, roasted, peeled, seeded and diced medium

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. In large saute pan place butter and heat to medium high until melted and hot. Add zucchini, squash, and corn and saute for two minutes until just warmed.
3. Add green chiles and stir well. Cook for five minutes.
4. Place mixture in baking dish. Sprinkle with jack cheese and cheddar.
5. Bake for 10-15 minutes until cheese is melted.
title: Calabacitas Con Queso And Chile Verde (Squash With Cheese And Gr

ingredients.text: 1 cup brown rice, long grain, organic
1 1/2 cups vegetable stock (ideally your own, commerical ok but often very salty)

steps: 1. Saute onion, carrot, zucchini in olive oil, medium hot, til just soft. Add garlic.
2. Add rice and dry seasonings. Brown lightly, approx 5 minutes. After the browning, add cilantro.
3. Add enough boiling stock to come 1 inch above rice.
4. Cover with tight lid and bake in 350 F oven about 50 minutes, until liquid completely absorbed.
5. Serve.
title: Baked Mexican Brown Rice

ingredients.text: 1 avocado medium, halved, pitted, thinly sliced

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Season to taste and serve.
title: Tex-Mex Bean Salad

steps: 1. Begin by mincing the garlic and shallots and cubing the tomatoes, carrots and green peppers. Set these aside.
2. Heat two teaspoons of olive oil and one tablespoon of butter in a pan and lightly saute the garlic and onions on medium-low heat until the onions begin to turn translucent, not letting them brown.

3. Next, add the carrots and green peppers, stir well to coat the vegetables in the oil, raise the heat to medium and cook for 3-4 minutes until the carrots begin to soften. Add the corn and tomatoes and continue stirring.

4. After the tomatoes have begun to cook down, approximately 4 minutes, add two tablespoons of your favorite taco seasoning and stir well. Cook an additional 5 minutes on medium to medium-low heat. Taste the vegetables and add a dash of cayenne pepper if you want more spice.
5. This can be served as a side dish or as a meal over brown rice.
title: Tex-Mex Vegetables

ingredients.text: 12 to 16 large eggs, preferably fresh from a farmers' market
1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped red onion (about 1 large/225-gram onion)
1 1/2 pounds spinach, fresh or frozen (thawed and drained if frozen)

steps: 1. Put the eggs in a cooking pot and add water to cover by about 2 inches. Then add the olive oil, onions, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Cool and remove the eggs with a slotted spoon. Tap the eggs gently against the counter and peel under cold running water, keeping them as whole as possible.

2. Return the peeled eggs to the pot with the seasoned water and simmer very slowly uncovered for at least 2 hours, or until the water is almost evaporated and the onions almost dissolved. The eggs will become dark and creamy as the cooking water evaporates and they absorb all the flavoring.

3. Remove the eggs carefully to a bowl, rubbing into the cooking liquid any of the cream that forms on the outside. Heat the remaining cooking liquid over medium heat, bring to a simmer, and add the spinach. Cook the spinach until most of the liquid is reduced, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon, about 30 minutes, or until the spinach is creamy and well cooked. Serve a dollop of spinach with a hard-boiled egg on top as the first part of the Seder meal or as a first course of any meal
title: Huevos Haminados Con Spinaci (Long-Cooked Hard-Boiled Eggs With Spinach)

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb extra lean ground beef (at least 90%)
3/4 cup reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese (3 oz)

steps: 1. In 10-inch nonstick skillet, cook beef over medium-high heat 5 to 7 minutes, stirring frequently, until thoroughly cooked; drain. Stir in water, chili powder, cumin and ground red pepper; reduce heat to medium-low. Cook about 5 minutes or until most of liquid has evaporated.
2. 2. Divide lettuce among 6 salad plates; top each with meat mixture and remaining ingredients except chips. Arrange chips around salad. Serve immediately.
3. 3. If you are in a hurry you can just combine all but the chips in a large bowl and serve with chips on the side.
title: Healthified Taco Salad

ingredients.text: 21 1/2 ounces cream of chicken soup (2 cans, condensed, sodium reduced)

steps: 1. In a 3 quart saucepan, mix all ingredients except tortilla chips.
2. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until thoroughly heated and cheese is melted. Top individual serving with tortilla chips. T.
3. This make 6 1-cup servings.
title: Cheesy Chicken Enchilada Soup

ingredients.text: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast halves

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Brown chicken breasts for 4 to 5 minutes on each side. Shred and set aside.
2. To the pot add onions and garlic; saute for 2 minutes, or until onions are translucent. Pour in chicken broth.
3. In a medium bowl combine masa harina with 2 cups of water and whisk until well blended.

4. To the onions and garlic add the masa harina mixture, remaining water, enchilada sauce, cheese, salt, chili powder and cumin. Bring to a boil; add shredded chicken. Reduce heat to low and simmer 30 to 40 minutes, or until thickened.
title: Chicken Enchilada Soup Ii

ingredients.text: 1/2 small (2-pound) green cabbage, cored and very thinly sliced (about 4 cups)
1/2 medium white onion, peeled and very thinly sliced (about 1/2 cup)
1 small jalapeno, ribs and seeds removed, minced (optional)

steps: 1. In a large bowl, toss together cabbage, onion, carrot, and jalapeno, if using. In a small saucepan, combine vinegar, salt, and sugar a cook over medium heat, stirring, until salt and sugar are just dissolved. Pour brine over vegetables and toss to combine. Cover and refrigerate for one hour before serving.
title: Quick Curtido (Mexican Cabbage Slaw) Recipe

ingredients.text: 2 medium ripe tomatoes, cored and quartered (about 12 ounces)
1 medium onion, preferably white, peeled, trimmed of root end, and quartered
3 medium jalapeno chiles, removing the ribs and seeds from 2
4 garlic cloves (med. minced or pressed through a garlic press about 4 teaspoons)
1 lime, cut into wedges for serving

steps: 1. Adjust an oven rack to the middle position and heat the oven to 350 degrees. Process the tomatoes and onion in a food processor until smooth and thoroughly pureed, about 15 seconds, scraping down the bowl if necessary. Transfer the mixture to a liquid measuring cup; you should have 2 cups (if necessary, spoon off excess so that the volume equals 2 cups). Remove the ribs and seeds from 2 jalapenos and discard; mince the flesh and set aside. Mince the remaining jalapeno, including the ribs and seeds; set aside.

2. Place the rice in a large fine-mesh strainer and rinse rice under cold running water until the water runs clear, about l 1/2 minutes. Shake the rice vigorously in the strainer to remove all excess water.

3. Heat the oil in a heavy-bottomed straight-sided 12-inch ovenproof saute pan or Dutch oven with a tight-fitting lid over medium-high heat for 1 to 2 minutes. Drop 3 or 4 grains of rice into the oil; if the grains sizzle, the oil is ready. Add the rice and fry, stirring frequently, until the rice is light golden and translucent, 6 to 8 minutes. Reduce the heat to medium, add the garlic and seeded minced jalapenos, and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in the pureed tomato mixture, chicken broth, tomato paste, and salt. Increase the heat to medium-high and bring to a boil. Cover the pan and transfer to the oven. Bake until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender, 30 to 35 minutes, stirring well after 15 minutes.
4. Stir in the cilantro and reserved minced jalapeiio with seeds to taste. Serve immediately, passing the lime wedges separately.
title: Mexican Rice(Atk)

ingredients.text: 1 cup black beans (freshly cooked or rinsed and well drained canned)

steps: 1. Place 4 of the tortillas on a work surface. Sprinkle one-quarter of the corn, beans, onion, cheese and chili powder evenly on each tortilla, leaving a 1/2-inch border. Top with the remaining tortillas and press down to help them stick together.

2. To cook them on the stovetop: Heat a large, lightly greased with cooking spray a skillet or grill pan over medium heat. Add 1 quesadilla and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, then flip over and cook another 4 to 5 minutes. It's done when it begins to get brown flecks and the cheese is melted.

3. To bake: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Place the quesadillas on a large, ungreased, rimmed baking sheet (use nonstick spray oil if the tortillas are on the dry side) and bake for 5 minutes per side.
4. Transfer the quesadillas to a cutting board and cut each into 4 wedges. Let them rest for 1 to 2 minutes before serving.

5. Reheating: Quesadillas are best eaten fresh. If they need to be reheated, avoid the microwave, which makes them soggy, and the oven, which dries them out. Instead, warm the quesadilla in a nonstick skillet over medium or medium-high heat, turning it once, until the cheese softens and the tortilla crisps slightly, 3 to 4 minutes total. (Those with thick fillings will remain somewhat soft.).
title: Corn, Black Bean And Red Onion Quesadillas

steps: 1. preheat the oven to 190°C (170°C for fan assisted ovens), gas mark 5. Cut each potato into thick wedges. Chuck in a large bowl with the oil and turn to coat.
2. Throw them onto a large tray and sprinkle over the Old El Paso Seasoning Mix for Mexican Wedges. Cook for 20-25 minutes turning occasionally until tender.
title: Mexican Spicy Potato Wedges

steps: 1. Boil tomatoes in water until skin bursts.
2. In blender, puree tomatoes, and half of the garlic and onion.
3. Brown rice in oil.
4. Add the rest of the garlic and onion to rice.
5. Pour tomato sauce over rice.
6. Do not stir mixture.
7. Simmer for 5 minute.
8. Add broth and cilantro.
9. Let simmer for 30 minutes (until rice is soft) without stirring.
title: Authentic Mexican Rice

ingredients.text: 1 medium white onion, peeled and halved
3 medium jalapeno chiles, 2 halved with ribs and seeds removed, 1 minced with ribs and seeds
1 lime, cut into wedges for serving

steps: 1. Heat a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat for about 2 minutes.

2. Add tomatoes, onion, garlic, and halved chiles and toast the vegetables, using tongs to turn them frequently, until softened and almost completely blackened, about 10 minutes for the tomatoes and 15 to 20 minutes for the other vegetables.
3. When cool enough to handle, trim the root ends from the onion and halve each piece.
4. Remove the skins from the garlic and mince.
5. Mice the jalapenos.
6. Adjust an oven rack to the middle position and heat oven to 350°F.
7. Process the toasted tomato and onion in a food processor until smooth and thoroughly pureed, about 15 seconds, scraping down bowl if necessary.
8. Transfer mixture to a liquid measuring cup; you should have 2 cups. If necessary, spoon off any excess so that the volume equals 2 cups.
9. Follow the recipe for Mexican Rice from heating the oil in the pan or Dutch oven, adding the toasted minced jalapenos and garlic along with the pureed tomato mixture.
title: Mexican Rice With Charred Tomatoes, Chiles, And Onion

ingredients.text: 12 ounces tomatoes, very ripe and diced or 8 ounces tomato sauce
1 cup long grain white rice, rinsed

steps: 1. Process tomato with water until pureed and smooth.
2. Rinse rice in a strainer under cold water until it runs clear- about 1 1/2 minutes. Shake to remove excess water.
3. Heat oil over medium-high heat in heavy skillet about 2 minutes. Cook onion and garlic until golden.
4. Add rice and fry, stirring until light golden, about 4 minutes.
5. Stir in tomato water mixture. Crumble bouillon and sprinkle over rice and water in pan.
6. Increase heat to medium high, and bring to a boil.
7. Cover pan and cook until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender, 10-15 minutes, stirring and checking rice often. Add more water if necessary, but rice is usually done before it sticks to the pan.
8. Stir in cilantro, mix in lime juice and adjust salt to taste.
title: Guadalajaran Jalisco Mexican Rice

steps: 1. *If you prefer brown rice, increase liquids by 1/2 cup each.
title: Easy Mexican Rice

steps: 1. In large fry pan heat oil.
2. Add corn and cook until it browns a little. The carmelizing of the corn makes a difference in the taste.
3. Quarter zucchini lengthwise and chop into small pieces.
4. Chop tomato in small pieces.
5. Once corn is nicely browned, add zucchini, tomato and spices.
6. Cover with lid, reduce heat, and cook just until zucchini begins to become tender.
title: Weight Watchers Calavacitas (Mexican Succotash) 1 Point Per Cup

steps: 1. Mix all of the ingredients well and refrigerate.
2. Serve on lettuce leaf or as a dip with corn chips.
title: Guacamole Salad

steps: 1. Shred finely the first four ingredients.
2. Mix the mayonnaise, coriander, chili powder and liquid smoke with salt and pepper to taste and pour over vegetables at last minute before serving.
title: Mexican Cole Slaw

steps: 1. Saute rice, onion, green pepper and garlic until tender and rice is brown.
2. Stir in water, bouillon and salsa.
3. Cover and simmer 20 minutes until rice is tender.
4. Stir in olives, green onion and cilantro.
title: Mexican Rice

ingredients.text: 1 c. fat-free shredded mild cheddar cheese

steps: 1. Mix mayonnaise, picante sauce, garlic, chili powder in a bowl.
2. Mix chicken, tomatoes, cheese, onion and bell pepper in a large bowl,
3. Pour sauce over other ingredients and serve with chips.
title: Mexican Chicken Salad

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. chopped, well drained green chilies

steps: 1. Wash potatoes well.
2. Bake potatoes at 400° for 1 hour or until soft.
3. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise, carefully scoop out potato pulp into bowl (leave 1/2-inch pulp to keep potato skin intact). Set skins aside.
4. Add yogurt and pepper to pulp; mash until fluffy. Stir in 1/2 cup cheese, chilies, pimento and cilantro into mixture. Stuff skins with mixture.
5. Place stuffed potatoes on ungreased baking sheet, sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup cheese.
6. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
7. Peel avocado and remove pit.
8. Mash with lime juice until smooth.
9. Spoon on hot potatoes.
title: Taco Baked Potatoes

steps: 1. Blend in food processor or blender tomatoes,garlic & onion.
2. Saute rice with a little oil in frying pan. When toasted add tom mixture, turn down to simmer for 2 min or so.
title: Mexican Rice

steps: 1. Bring about 6 cups water to a boil and pour over rice in a bowl. Soak rice until it has turned a more opaque white, 2 to 3 minutes. (Rice can be soaked up to 4 hrs.) Drain well and spread out on a kitchen towel to dry, at least one hour.
2. Cook onion and garlic in oil in a wide 4-5 quart heavy pot or deep skillet over med. heat, stirring, until softened, about 3 minutes.
3. Add rice and cook over med-high heat, stirring, until pale golden, about 5 minute Add broth, water, and 2 teaspoons salt and bring to a boil.
4. Cover tightly and cook over low heat until rice is tender, 18-20 minutes. Let stand covered 5 min., then fluff with fork and serve.
title: Mexican White Rice (Arroz Blanco)

steps: 1. Place a large pot over medium heat, add EVOO. Add the onions, garlic and season with coriander, cumin, salt and freshly ground black pepper. Cook until softened, about 8-10 minutes.
2. Add the Rotel, chicken stock corn and black beans (you can substitute chili beans if you do not like black beans) to the pot and bring to a bubble.

3. While the mixture is coming to a bubble, place the tortilla chips (reserving a handful for garnish) in a food processor and pulse to grind, or in a resealable plastic bag and crush with a rolling pin or empty wine bottle. You should have about 1 cups of ground chips. Add the ground chips to the mixture and cook for 10 minutes.
4. When ready to serve, add the chopped, cooked chicken to the pot along with 1/2 to 3/4 cup of cilantro and the lime juice, and cook 2-3 more minutes, until the chicken is heated through.
5. To serve, ladle the tortilla chicken stew into a bowl and garnish with some of the reserved tortilla chips and some cheddar cheese.
title: Mexican Black Bean Chicken Soup

ingredients.text: 3/4 c. (3 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese

steps: 1. Combine first 4 ingredients; whisk mixture just until blended. Heat a heavy 8-inch skillet over medium heat until hot enough to sizzle a drop of water.
2. Add butter and rotate skillet to coat bottom.
3. Pour egg mixture into skillet; sprinkle with cheese and jalapeno peppers.

6. Top with salsa.
7. Yields 1 or 2 servings.
title: Easy Mexican Omelet

ingredients.text: 1/3 c. shredded reduced fat Cheddar cheese

steps: 1. Combine tomato and basil; set aside. In large nonstick skillet over medium heat, saute potato and onion in margarine until tender. Pour Egg Beaters into skillet; sprinkle with pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until set. Divide egg mixture evenly between tortillas. Top with cheese. Fold tortillas over egg mixture. Top with tomato mixture. Makes 4 servings.
title: Breakfast Burrito(Diabetic)

steps: 1. Warm tortillas in frypan.
2. Place equal amounts of scrambled eggs on each tortilla.
3. Spoon on salsa (to taste).
4. Sprinkle on grated cheese.
5. Enjoy!!!
title: Breakfast Burritos

title: Torpedo Breakfast Burrito

steps: 1. 1.Top tortillas with salsa and cheese. Heat in the microwave until the cheese is melted, about 30 seconds.

2. 2.Meanwhile coat a small nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Heat over medium heat, add egg substitute and cook, stirring, until the eggs are cooked through, about 90 seconds. Divide the scrambled egg between the tacos.
title: Quick Breakfast Taco

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. shredded reduced fat Monterey Jack cheese

steps: 1. Cook bacon in nonstick pan until browned.
2. Pour off fat. Drain on paper towel.
3. Crumble and reserve.
4. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in pan.
5. Add tortillas, one at a time, cooking for about 30 seconds or until softened, turning halfway through cooking.

title: Breakfast Burritos

steps: 1. Whisk together flours, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Combine egg, milk, canola oil and vanilla; stir into dry ingredients just until moistened.

2. Preheat a griddle over medium heat. Lightly grease griddle. Pour batter by 1/2 cupfuls onto griddle; cook until bubbles on top begin to pop and bottoms are golden brown. Turn; cook until second side is golden brown.
3. Meanwhile, beat together cream cheese and yogurt. Spread over pancakes; top with banana and raspberries. Fold up.
title: Raspberry-Banana Breakfast Tacos

ingredients.text: 20 ounces butternut squash, seeded and cut into 1-inch cubes
1/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper, to taste

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Spray a large nonstick baking sheet with oil.

2. In a medium bowl, combine squash, olive oil, garlic powder, cumin, smoked paprika, 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper. Toss well to coat. Spread squash evenly onto a sheet pan and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until browned and tender, tossing once halfway through.
3. Heat a small skillet over medium heat, lightly spray with olive oil spray, add eggs, season with salt, cover and cook to your desired doneness.
4. To assemble bowls: Layer 2/3 cup squash, 1/2 cup pico, 1 oz avocado, 1 egg and 1 tablespoon cheese. Repeat for remaining bowls.
title: Breakfast Burrito Bowl

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 200 degrees F (95 degrees C). Wrap tortillas in aluminum foil; place in the preheated oven.

2. Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove bacon from skillet. Cook and stir refried beans in bacon grease until heated through, about 1 minute. Cover beans and remove from heat.

3. Whisk together eggs and egg whites in a bowl until uniform, about 1 minute. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat, add egg mixture. Cook and stir until almost solid, about 2 minutes; stir in Cheddar cheese and remove from heat.
4. Top each warm tortilla with 2 tablespoons of refried beans, 2 bacon strips, half of the eggs, 1 tablespoon of salsa, and 1 tablespoon of sour cream. Roll tortillas into burritos.
title: Breakfast Burritos For Two

ingredients.text: shredded cheddar cheese (as much as you want)

steps: 1. First, put your tortilla on a plate.
2. Next, scramble the two eggs.
3. Then, put the eggs in the tortilla, and spread the bacon bits around evenly.
4. Now, put as much shredded cheddar cheese as you want on the egg.
5. Microwave for 15-25 seconds (just enough to warm the egg, bacon, and tortilla, and to melt the cheese.) Take it out and fold the tortilla like a burrito!
6. Lastly, EAT!
7. Hope you enjoy!
title: Breakfast Burrito (Like Mc Donald'S!)

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 pounds potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes
1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut into 1-inch pieces
1 jalapeno, seeded and cut into 1-inch rings
1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps: 1. Soak potatoes in cool water for 20 minutes.

2. Preheat the air fryer to 320 degrees F (160 degrees C). Drain the potatoes, dry them with a clean towel, and transfer to a large bowl. Drizzle 1 tablespoon olive oil over the potatoes and toss to coat. Add them to the preheated air fryer basket. Set the timer for 18 minutes.
3. Put bell pepper, onion, and jalapeno in the bowl previously used for the potatoes. Sprinkle in 1/2 teaspoon olive oil, taco seasoning, ground cumin, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
4. Transfer potatoes from the air fryer to the bowl with the vegetable mixture. Return the empty basket to the air fryer and raise the temperature to 356 degrees F (180 degrees C).

5. Quickly toss the contents of the bowl to mix the potatoes evenly with the vegetables and seasoning. Transfer mixture into the basket. Cook for 6 minutes, shake the basket, and continue cooking until potatoes are browned and crispy, about 5 minutes more. Serve immediately.
title: Tex-Mex Air Fryer Hash Browns

ingredients.text: 5 dashes salt and pepper (or to taste)

steps: 1. Pour and heat the oil in a frying pan. Add and saute the onion, pepper, and the garlic and heat. When these are just about to soften, add the cilantro, the tomato and finally, the beaten eggs.

2. These are stirred so as to mix with all the rest of the ingredientes until they are done to your taste (soft or stiff). You will observe that they remain a bit loose and with some liquid---this is normal, and is due to the liquid retained in the tomato.

4. NOTE: The tomato may be squeezed before cutting in order to seed it and to remove excess liquid.
title: Johnd'S Savory Scrambled Eggs (Huevos Pericos)

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp.

8. Roll 2 tablespoons egg mixture in each tortilla.
